The plains surrounding the trail look very quiet and safe. Small bushes are scattered all over the fields. Further to the east you see a high hill rising over the tree-tops of the dense forest between the fields and the hill. The trail continues in a north-south direction.
7169: A hungry warg (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

The path continues over the plains, but further north the plains switch to small hills with dense vegetation. To the west you see a field with small scattered bushes, and it strikes your mind what a perfect place this would have been to play hide and seek as a child. To the east the plains continue but not very far, dense forests take their place as the ground climbs up a high hill in the east.
7170: A hungry warg (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

The trail continues its way to its final goal. The trail looks like it is not used as much now as it once was, most of the tracks left in the ground are from the local wildlife. To the south the woods get lighter while to the north the terrain only gets harsher.
7171: A hungry warg (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

You are standing on the trail leading to the mountains in the east. The trail bends continuously to avoid some of the minor hills in the area, making the journey easier. The wildlife in the surroundings is probably rich, ranging from different herbivores to wolves roaming the woods in the search for prey.
7172: A hungry warg (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

Standing on the trail leading towards the mountains in the northeast you suddenly notice a swamp just north of here. On the other side of the swamp you see water, probably a river. The trail continues through its many twists and turns towards its final goal, wherever that might be.
7173: A hungry warg (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

The trail continues through many bends and turns in its general direction to the northeast and southwest. The trail is very old, and clearly is not used very much today. The woods surrounding the trail are quite dense right here, making travel outside of the trail very much of an effort.
7174: The trail continues through the woods. To the north the ground slopes down to a river, and further up that river you see what seems to be a bridge. The forest gets lighter the closer to the river you get, and further west of here it ends completely to leave place for a small swamp.
7175: To the north the trail aproaches a bridge, inviting you to cross the river with ease. The trail also continues to the southwest, away from the mountains in the east. The river runs very gently under the bridge, and west of the bridge there is another river coming down from the north.
7176: The river gently flows under the bridge from the mountains in the east and just to the west of here you see another branch of the river coming from from the north. The bridge itself is not very large, and seems to be very old. From the woods surrounding the path an occasional howl can be heard.
7177: This seems to be a seldom trodden trail leading north and south. To the south there is a bridge. Southwest two branches of the river Bruinen meets and continues westward toward Rivendell.
7178: The trail is slightly sloping upwards in the eastern direction. You can follow the trail south and cross a river, or you can follow it east towards the Misty Mountains, but there is shallow water north of you.

A squirrel scampers around here, looking for nuts from the trees.

You find yourself on an old trail, between the Misty Mountains and Rivendell. There are several paths into the Misty Mountains, but most have bad ends or will take you to nowhere. This trail might lead into the mountains to the High Pass.
7180:
A grey wolf is here, snarling aggressively.
A squirrel scampers around here, looking for nuts from the trees.

The trail leads eastward towards the Misty Mountains and hopefully to the High Pass. The High Pass has long been an important trade route across the mountains. It has been believed safe from orcs. Now, however, rumours say that orcs are in the area. Still, many cross the mountains yet. It is said that Beornings from the Vale of Anduin are keeping the pass open.
7181: The South Fork of the Bruinen

The river runs in a more or less straight line from east to west. The northern bank looks like a nice place to spend the night around a campfire. In the clear water you notice a large school of some strange fish. Now, where did you put that fishing rod?
7182: The Bruinen is winding its way toward some distant mouth. To the north-west lies an inviting river bank. As you look south, you see high cliffs towering above you. There seems to be a bridge over the river somewhere up there, a bit further downstream.
7183: Here, the mighty Bruinen continues its journey to the great ocean far west. It flows south, but the stream is slow here, so you can also make your way upstream, to the east.
7184: The South Fork of the Bruinen

The water is full of nasty, sharp rocks. As you navigate past them you notice a swollen, armour clad corpse on the bottom of the river. Pour soul, he must have fallen down from that steep cliff south of the river.
7185: The South Fork of the Bruinen
This part of the river is rather narrow, and your vessel speeds up, as you pass the ominous looking cliff to the south. The current is too strong for you to be able to travel further upstream.
7186: The South Fork of the Bruinen

The blue water of the Bruinen floats west here with clucking and splashing sounds. Looking south, you see a slope leading up on a plateau to the west. You feel like getting ashore at once, and climb up there to admire the view that ought to be really astonishing from up there. To the west, the river seems to pick up speed on it's way west.
7187: The South Fork of the Bruinen

It is very silent here, even the birds are quiet. The southern bank looks suitable for disembarking your craft. The northern bank, wait... Wasn't that an elf vanishing behind a large tree? Hmm, why are the birds still so quiet, you wonder as you drift down the river.
7188: The South Fork of the Bruinen
The river is making a smooth bend here, to the west. The south bank is covered with reed, and from somewhere the croaking of a frog can softly be heard.
7189: The South Fork of the Bruinen

You are floating in the middle of a calm river. It is very peaceful here. Near the bank is a flock of resting wild ducks, gently bobbing up and down, as the water-ripples from your vessel passes them.
7190: You are in the middle of the southern fork of the River Bruinen. The river runs very calm and gentle here, and along the slightly muddy banks there are some light woods.

You are in the middle of the southern fork of the River Bruinen. The river is very wide here, and the southern bank is more of a swamp than solid ground. To the north you see a dark pine-forest. To the east the river makes some gentle bends and turns, but continues upstream in an eastern direction.
7192: You are in the southern fork of the River Bruinen, which slowly makes it way westwards. East of here you see another branch of the river coming down from the north. Further east there is a bridge over the eastern branch. The southern bank looks to be very wet and swamp-like ground.
7193: You are in the southern fork of the River Bruinen. From the north another branch comes down, and joins together with the branch coming from the east. Across the eastern branch there is a small stone-bridge, and a path to the north and south of the bridge. Further west on the southern bank the ground seem to be very wet, almost like a swamp.
7194: You are in the middle of the river. Just to the west of here you see a path going across the river on a stone-bridge. Further to the east the river has its source somewhere in the Mountains. On the northern side of river the bank is much more gentle than the somewhat rockier southern bank.
7195: A brook trout is here, swimming in the current.

You are in the middle of the southern fork of the River Bruinen. Far to the west you see a bridge going across the river. Further to the east the river seem to be much wilder as it exits out of a ravine. The southern bank is very rocky, and further east it becomes even impossible to climb up the southern bank.

You are in a branch of the river. To the east the river bends to the south as it exits out of a steep ravine. To the south you have huge cliffs, preventing you from exit the river that way. To the north the bank is much nicer, but even that bank becomes more rocky to the east. Far to the east you see a bridge across the river.
7197: You are in the river just at the place where it bends to the west, out of the ravine to the south. The water is very fast here, and you have to work hard to stay put and not be pulled away by the strong current. North of here the bank is very rocky, but still climbable.
7198: You are in a fast flowing part of the river as it passes through a steep ravine. The cliffs on both sides are very high and rough, making it impossible to exit the river here. The current is very strong here, so it would be impossible to go upstream, the only way to go is following the current downstream, out of the ravine to the north.
7199: The current in the river becomes stronger and stronger the closer you get to the ravine to the west. The ravine is very steep, and once you enter it will probably be impossible to go against the current upstream again. To the south there is a light forest that continues almost all the way down to the river.

This forest is very light, and follows the southern bank of the river just north of here. Looking westwards along the river you see the river entering a ravine. A steep slope goes up to the top of the ravine, and to the south the forest continues and gets darker and darker the further in you go.

Far away in a northern direction you hear water splashing agains rocks with full force, it might be the sound of a waterfall.

So far it is a quite open forest, but to the south of here a thick wall of bushes seems to hinder your way. To the north you see a slope going up to a high plateau. Far away you can hear the sound of rushing water.

To the south the plateau continues and to the west the cliffs along the river gradually become lower and lower.

This plateau is on the top of some huge cliffs overlooking a narrow ravine below. Through the ravine you see a rapid stream making its way down to the exit of the ravine further to the north. 7206: The banks become more and more rocky the further east you go. Just to the east of here they grow into huge and steep cliffs, making it impossible to reach down to the river below. To the east you hear a loud noise, as if there was a waterfall or some rapids.
7207: A tall stag is here, grazing peacefully.

This bank of the river is a little more rocky than the smoother northern bank. Further to the east the rocks become larger and the bank slowly develops into high cliffs far to the east. North of here the river flows quite gently and passes under a bridge that leads a trail across the water just to the west.
7208: A large thorny branched shrub is growing here.

You are in the middle of a forest with high trees. On the ground there grow some bushes with some black berries on them. To the south you see what seem to be some hills. To the north huge, sharp rocks and steep cliffs make it nearly impossible to walk.

To the south these woods with high trees change into a very hilly landscape, and further to the south you see the hills grow even higher. A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.

The forest seems to somewhat open up to the west as the ground starts to slope down a little. To the east, however, the forest seems to grow even thicker and the undervegetation becomes more sparse. Far to the northeast you see some high hills; the view from up there would probably be magnificent.
7227: The dense woods around you are making the travel hard and boring. Sometimes the quiet and silent surrounding is disturbed by a howl from a wolf or some bird landing in a tree-top above you.
7228:
A white wolf is here.
A white wolf is here.
A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily.
A black wolf pads restlessly, looking for its next prey.

This hut has probably not been used in a long time. The roof has partially fallen in and one of the stone walls has started to crumble. The door and all of the windows are broken. The floor is covered with all kinds of junk but in one corner you see a small trapdoor in the floor.
7229:
A brown fox is here, looking for some rabbits to chew up.
A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.

The light forest changes into grassy plains further to the south. North of here however you see a deserted hut that seem to have been empty for a long time. The roof has fallen in at one place and all windows on this side are broken and so is the door. Perhaps it was once the home of a local farmer.
7230:
A small cluster of clover grows here.
A placid pond is here, inviting you to take a refreshing drink.
A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.
A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.

The plains here at the border of the light forest to the north are covered with thick grass. The plain descends down to a small hole at one place, with a small pond with some light trees at the edge of the water. This would be an important place for the animals in the area as the water seem to be very fresh.
7231:
A restless rabbit bounces around.
A restless rabbit bounces around.

The plains at the border of the thin forest to the north are covered with thick grass that reaches far beyond your ankles. The plains continue to the east and west; west of here you also see the ground descend down in a hollow, where some trees also grow.
7232: The grassy plains continue to the east and west of here. To the north the plains slowly turn into a thin forest. The grass growing on the plain is not as thick here as it is further west, but much taller. The tall grass is a perfect hideout for larger animals such as deers.
7233: A small plant grows here, with long, pointed leaves and flowers at its top.

The thin forest is very sparse and slowly fades away into the grassy plains to the south. North of here the ground slopes down into a ravine which looks like a dead end. East the thin forest continues and far to the east you see what seems to be a thick forest.
7234: The ravine comes to a stop as a huge cliff prevents you from exiting anywhere but back south. To the south the ground slopes up some and some trees start to cover the ground. Down here in the ravine the main vegetation is bushes, quite thick bushes actually, some of them might even have food on them.
7235: The woods seem to go on forever with the small exception of some high hills starting just northeast of here. The trees in the surrounding area are tall and have many thick branches, making the sunlight very dim. On the ground there are some fallen trees that are very murky and rotten.
7236: A low, many-branched shrub covers the ground here.

The ground start to rise here, starting off with very small hills but rapidly growing into higher ones. The forest growing on the slopes is quite dense and there is a clear lack of sun to the ground. Westwards the forest seems to thin out, but not very much.
7237: The forest opens up somewhat as the hill ascends over the treetops of the forest below. Further east the hills get even higher, and the forest on their top is very scarce. West of the forest you see fields that never seem to end, and a track running in a north-south direction.
7238: The woods on the northern side of the hills are not as thick as the ones further to the west. To the south the hills grow higher, and in their middle you see a high hill rise above the others. The forest continues to the north and west. The ground-vegetation here is quite sparse, and here and there you see some rabbit-holes indicating that there might be rabbits around.
7239: You are now standing on the highest hill in the area; it rises high above the others and the view from here is magnificent. To the east you see the Misty Mountains tower up like a giant wall. Westwards the forest opens up in wide plains, and to the north you see parts of the River Bruinen making its way to the southwest.
7240: The landscape around you has changed very dramatically compared to the wide forests around the hills. The hills are covered with a sparse forest, some plains with high bushes and high grass. To the north the hills grow even higher, culminating in a high hill that can be seen from very far away. To the east the hills slope down in a very thick and dark forest.
7241: The forest surrounding you is quite dense and it seems to continue to the east and west. North of here the ground rises up in some hills where the vegetation clears up a little. To the south the forest also clears up a little, and you see a small pond in the forest.
7242: A placid pond is here, inviting you to take a refreshing drink.

The forest here is notably lighter than the ones north and east of here. The vegetation on the ground here is also much richer than that of the surrounding woods. A small spring comes out from a rock at a small cliff, probably an underground spring from the hills you see in the north. The spring ends in a hole in the ground, forming a small pond of fresh water.
7243: This thin forest slowly fades away into grassy plains to the south. East of here the thin forest becomes a little thicker and further to the east you see a thick forest that becomes even thicker to the northeast. On the ground the grass grows thick and that makes the ground very soft and nice to walk on.
7244: A small cluster of clover grows here.

The grassy plains that surround the area are covered with tall grass that would reach a grown up deer to its belly. To the north the plains transform into a light forest, and further to the north the forest becomes much darker.
7245: You are in a place in the forest where it shifts hastily from a thin forest to the west into a dark black forest a little to the northeast. Right here the forest is still quite light, and the ground is covered with thick grass, but not far east and north the forest is much thicker.
7246: The woods become thicker and north and east of here they become even thicker. West and south of here the forest opens up into light forest and grassy plains. To the northwest you see some hills rise above the forest, the view from up there would probably be quite good.
7247: The forest slowly changes and becomes thicker and thicker the further east you go. East of here the forest has so thick undergrowth that it is not even worth considering going there. To the north the dark forest continues, but to the south and west it seems to clear up a little, making it possible for the sunlight to reach the ground.
7248: West of here the hills seem to go on forever, to the east however they fade and leave place to a dark and cold forest. The slopes of the last hills are covered with light bushes, providing some shelter for all the animals living in the area.
7249: A black wolf pads restlessly, looking for its next prey.

The vegetation on these hills changes dramatically with respect to that of the other hills in the area. Gone are the scattered bushes and the sparse forest. Instead here grow thick, thorny bushes that would probably tear you apart if you tried to force your way through them. To the west the hills grow higher, and you see a hill that rises above the others like the crown of the hills.
7250: The dense forest here makes a border to the dark forests to the north. To the east the dense forest continues, but west it opens up into a much lighter one. The ground is covered with small rocks, making travel a little difficult.
7251: The dense forest surrounds you and makes you feel very small. To the north the forest grows even thicker. Further to the east you see the Misty Mountains tower up like a wall, but that is still beyond your reach as the dense forests prevent further travel to the east.
7252: A man walks stealthily here, enshrouded in a grey woollen cloak.

The dense forest from the south gets even thicker the further north you go. To the north the forest is so dense it is not even possible to go there, and you have to turn back or find some other entrance to the forest.
7253: The forest here is very dark and it is very hard to travel anywhere, in fact it is impossible to travel anywhere but west from here as the thick bushes and trees effectively block your way. The ground has no vegetation whatsoever, just plain soil surrounding the thick roots of the trees and bushes.
7254: As the forest continues it gets darker and darker all the time, thick bushes with lots of sharp thorns get more and more frequent, making travel here very tiresome. To the west the bushes seem to clear up some though, and the forest seems to get a little lighter, even though that does not say much.
7255:
A brown snake watches you.
A mole is looking out of a mole-hill here.
A mole is looking out of a mole-hill here.
A brown snake watches you.
A small vicious black rat squeaks at you for disturbing it.

You are amid some very thick bushes, just at the face of a cliff to the east. The sunlight probably never comes all the way down under this bush. North of the bushes there is a light forest, but to the south the forest is much thicker and darker.
7256: The dark forest seems to go on forever but to the north you see something out of the ordinary, a huge cliff rising quite high up. At the bottom of the cliff there are some huge bushes, it seems to be impossible to force your way through.
7257:
A bright red mushroom is growing here.
A small mushroom grows nearby.
A bright red mushroom is growing here.

Thick bushes and trees make up the main vegetation here. The bushes are indeed powerful and their roots are big and bulky. To the east the forest grows even thicker and it is probably not possible to travel far in that direction. South of here the forest cleans up somewhat, making that the only way out of this gloomy place.
7258: The forest becomes darker and north of here it becomes really dark. To the south and west however it clears up a little. The ground is quite rocky here, making it difficult to walk. As you look up in the sky you see high trees with lots of branches, preventing the sunlight from hitting the ground with full energy.
7259: This cellar under the deserted hut is in far better shape than the main building itself. Along one wall stands what is left of some old shelves that seem to have been a storage place for food and groceries. The shelf covers almost all of the wall and only leaves a dark corner at the far end. The floor is not of soil but of stone, making you think that it was not a regular farmer that once lived here; however, that is only a wild guess.
7260:
A dark intangible shadow turns to face you.
A dark intangible shadow turns to face you.
A dark intangible shadow turns to face you.

This hidden room was probably the study of some important man. At the wall you see an old desk and a chair, the desk has a few closed drawers. Fixed to the wall you see a shield and a longsword. This place has something strange with it, something evil. You just cannot figure out what, though.
7261:
A huge stone troll looms overhead, ready to crush your body.
A powerful young troll stares at you.
A powerful young troll stares at you.
A grey-skinned mountain troll stands here.

Breaking down the earthwall you enter a hidden chamber behind the wall. The chamber is big and has lots of dark corners. As you explore the chamber you sense a strong presence of evil. Maybe you should get out of here while you can. On the floor you see marks of something having been dragged across the floor.
7262:
A large cave troll is here, staying close to his mother.
A large cave troll is here, staying close to his mother.
The ugly troll mother is roaming the cave, taking care of her loved ones.

The tunnel is quite large and you have no problem walking in it, it is dug out of the earth and has a rounded roof. You suddenly realise what kind of creatures live in these tunnels as you see huge piles of bones at the end of the tunnel, and the huge footprints in the ground. Those are troll-tracks, trolls!
7263:
The corpse of a huge, poisonous spider is lying here.
The corpse of a huge, poisonous spider is lying here.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.

The tunnel comes to a bend and continues to the west and south of here. The tunnel is large and you have no problem standing or walking in it. You wonder who made theese tunnels, but can not come to a conclusion on that. On the walls you see a lot of spider-web; some spiders quickly run across the ground as you enter.
7264:
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.

Entering the hole under the roots you see an earth tunnel continue to the north. The tunnel is quite large and would not give you any problem exploring it. The roof is rounded and the whole tunnel seem to have been dug out by someone - or something.
7265: Walking in the light vegetation close to the road makes you forget about all the dangers in the forests around you. You hear birds singing from the bushes in the area. North of here the bushy landscape continues, but to the east and on the other side of the path the forest has completely taken over.
7266: A brown bear is sleeping here.

You have obviously stumbled into the lair of a bear. You see skeletons of small animals lying around, and you can almost feel the large inhabitant breathing you in the neck. Perhaps it would be best to get out of here really soon... The only way out is west, back through the cave opening.
7267: To the west, there is a hill, that might give you a nice glance around the surrounding land. Rocks and thick foliage prevents you from going further east. To the south, there is a small grove, from which you hear the beautiful song of some birds.
7268: A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.

Some small trees have gathered here, in the middle of nowhere. Small birds are singing, and you hear the twigs moving as the small animals rush around on the ground. This small grove is in the middle of the vast plains continuing to the west. To the east you can see light vegetation. To the north, you see a small field, just next to a hill.
7269:
Traces of fierce white tones form the aura of this place.
A mug with a frothy brew is here. (blue aura).
A sturdy leather backpack has been left here.
A sturdy leather backpack has been left here.
The scalped corpse of *a Troll* is lying here.
The scalped corpse of *a Troll* is lying here.
The corpse of a cavebear is lying here.
The corpse of a cavebear is lying here.

You have entered a small cave hidden behind a large boulder. The cave is not very big, and on the ground you see remains of what once was some animal. The conclusion is that this cave is inhabited by some flesh-eater. To the south the cave-entrance leads back out into the open vegetation.
7270: You are in a quite flat area with an occasional small hill here and there. Scattered bushes grow all over the place, but not very dense. To the north, behind one of the bushes, you see a boulder that looks like it has a cavity behind it. East of here a path runs in a north-south direction.
7271: Hill at the Bank of the River

You have reached the top of a small hill overlooking the river as it bends around the hill from the east to the south. The river runs very quietly down there and you see birds floating around there, and an occasional fish splash in the water. To the east the hill descends into a minor swamp.
7272: You are on the southern bank of the river. The area is more of a swamp than solid ground. To the west the swamp ends as the ground rises into a small hill overlooking the river. South of here the swamp slowly changes into a light forest.
7273:
A slender plant grows here, with clusters of tiny pink flowers atop its stem.
There are two swamp irises here.

To the north-east two forks of the river join together, pushing the water towards the southern bank. This is probably the main reason why you are having problems finding solid ground to stand on. Further up the banks the tree-line marks the beginning of solid ground, and from within the forest you heard birds singing which, combined with the gentle flow of the river, gives you a true nature-experience.
7274: A tall stag is here, grazing peacefully.

This is a small clearing in the forest. In every direction except north you see thick, thorny bushes which make it impossible to walk that way without an enormous amount of trouble. To the north there is some light forest separating the clearing from the southern bank of the river.
7275: You are standing in short grass, barely reaching above your boots. If you have a vessel, you can go into the river Bruinen just north of here. To the west, you see a peaceful spot, very suitable for taking a break. You see a small hill in the south-west.
7276: This calm spot next to the steady river to the north seems to be an excellent place to rest, and recover from the hazardous travels through this unfriendly land. To the east you see a grassy field, and to the south, you can climb a small hill.
7278: You are high up on the eastmost parts of a high cliff, overlooking the river Bruinen to the north. To the east, a rather steep slope can take you down to the riverside. Looking west, you see a high plateau, from where you can get a good look on the surrounding lands.
7279: Looking around you, you see that you have the river Bruinen about forty feet below, swiftly running west, past the house of Elrond. To the south, the highest point of this plateau is, from where you could get a really nice view. Looking east, you see that the cliff ends in a slope down, towards the water in the river.
7280:
A large, loyal falcon is circling above.
A fat rabbit is here, chewing on some grass.

Ahhh.... Finally having climbed this high plateau, you can now enjoy one of the most astonishing views you have ever seen. Turning around, you see Eriador spreading out beneath you. To the north and the east, the Ettendales, to the south, the rocky plains of what used to be Eregion and to the west, Rhudaur.
7281: Standing high up on this cliff, you have a magnificent view over the river Bruinen, floating west towards unknown adventures. Looking north, you see that the river-bank is much more in level with the river itself, allowing you to board a vessel. To the west, you see a small path leading to a stone bridge further downstream. East of here is the highest point of the plateau, offering a tremendous view over the land.
7282: A fat rabbit is here, chewing on some grass.

The slope you are standing on can take you up on a plateau to the west, or down to the flat land surrounding it. You hear the sound of running water to the east, and as you look to see from where it comes, you make out a small cabin next to a spring.
7284:
A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.
A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.

From this small hill, you get an overview of the nearest surroundings. To the north, you see the river Bruinen. It is yet not the wide, mighty river it will become as it reaches its mouth at the Mighty Ocean in the far west, but it still gives a mighty impression as it floats by. To the west, you see a small spring with a lodge south of it.
7285: Aha... Finally, a trace of human(oid?) life out here. To the north, you see the back of a small lodge. Vast plains are to the south and the west. East, passage is blocked by thick bushes. Listening carefully, you hear the sound of running water from the north.
7287: Well, well... Still on these old plains. Looking south, you see a small change in the land though - the plains seem to become more and more rocky there. In all other directions you see nothing but plains. Far in the east, the Hithaeglir, as the elves call the Misty Mountains tower above the land... In their shadow is a small but dense grove of trees.
7289: You seem to have reached the southern end of the vast plains. Dense bushes and some trees make progress impossible to the south. Vast plains stretch east, north, and west. To the east, the ground appears to be covered with rocks, making passage harder. Looking across the plains, you see some form of motion, not sure whether it is man or beast... or something else.
7290: Looking around, you see a small trail to the south. It leads east towards the grey mountains, and west, back to Imladris. There are vast plains in all other directions. Looking north, you make out a plateau far away from here. Perhaps you can get a good view over the countryside from there.
7291: A wolf cub happily plays here.

You are in the middle of a grassy sea. Vast plains stretch in all directions, and you see nothing exciting anywhere. Only to the east, something disturbs the flat view - the Misty Mountains towering over the world, hiding its secrets. Gazing south, you notice a tiny trail leading east and west.
7292:
A small cluster of clover grows here.
A small cluster of clover grows here.

You are standing in the northern end of a grassy sea. Vast plains stretch to the east, south and west. Only to the east is there something to break the flat terrain - the Misty Mountains towering over the world, hiding its secrets.
7293: You are in the middle of a grassy sea. Vast plains stretch in all directions, and you see nothing exciting anywhere. Only to the east, something disturbs the flat view - the Misty Mountains towering over the world, hiding its secrets.
7294: This is the beginning of a seemingly endless plain, stretching east and south of here. Looking west, you see a small path leading north, up a hill and south, towards an intersection.
7295: A small ledge cut in the cliff-side allows you to climb up or down. Looking down, to the south, you see vast plains, and wasteland reaching the horizon. The ledge is obviously not made by nature, and you feel safe climbing it.
7296: You are standing in the middle of a grassy sea. Vast plains stretch in all directions, and you see nothing exciting anywhere. Only to the east something disturbs the flat view - the Misty Mountains towering over the world, hiding its secrets.
7297: This is the north-west end of the vast plains. High cliffs are both to the north and the west, making any progress in those directions completely impossible. Looking south, you see the plains stretching far away...
7298:
A sturdy peg for hanging armour is on the wall.
A large stone fireplace with a roaring fire warms the room.
An elven hunter, fair and mighty, roams here warding against evil.
An elven hunter, fair and mighty, roams here warding against evil.

This small house consist of only one room, and it is obviously the home of a hunter of some kind, with heads from all kinds of different beasts set on the walls. A bed stands in one corner, with an old, and probably useless composite bow above it. The only exit is through the wooden door to the north.
7299: The deserted wasteland spreads around you. The only change in the local scenery is a small ruin on a hill to the west. No birds live here, and the only sound you hear, is the rattling of a snake disappearing into the brownish grass.
7300: Nothing, and again nothing exciting can be found in the discouraging view that meets you as you turn around to have a look at the surrounding land. Wasteland lies to the north and the south. Moving east and west is prevented by thorny bushes and thick undergrowth.
7301: This portion of the wasteland must have been forested at one point, as there are many broken and rotting stumps still clinging to the rocky soil. There are no trees left intact, however, and the only vegetation to be found are small, stunted bushes and a few patches of hardy grass and weeds, almost brown from lack of moisture.
7302:
A brown snake watches you.
A brown snake watches you.

The land here is the same wasteland you have been walking through for far too long. You notice that there are more bushes here, than there was further back. A sudden rattle in the bushes makes you spin around, but you see nothing special... You have a VERY bad feeling about this place.
7303: You seem to have reached the end of the wasteland. Huge blocks prevent any further travel to the east and the south. However, wasteland lies both north and west of here.
7304:
A strip of leather with a buckle is lying here.
There is a water skin lying on the ground.
There is a water skin lying on the ground.
A strip of leather with a buckle is lying here.
A statue of a troll is posed in a moment of flight yet forever frozen in stone.

There is not much left of this old house. The walls are still intact, but that is about it. The old floor seems to be ready to break any second, and you feel that you'd better leave this place really soon... You can get back to the trail to the north, or enter the vast wasteland to the east or the west.
7305: This part of the land has been devastated by some since long forgotten war. Nothing grows here, and you can hear no animals, nor any sound from human beings. But, on a small hill to the east, you see the remnants of an old building.
7306: This is the beginning of the wasteland, stretching south from the trail to the Misty Mountains, that is north of here. To the west, you see a small, sparse forest. As you turn yourself east, you see something that seems to be an old house or ruin.
7307: You are at the border of a sparse forest to the south-west. East, you see wastelands, through which you see a small trail leading east to the mountains far away. But... what is that ? You barely make out a small ruin a bit east of here!
7308:
A dove rests near one of the flowers.
A dove rests near one of the flowers.

You are standing among some birches - you could even call it a small and very sparse forest. It continues to the south and to the east. Looking east, you see the end of the forest not very far away from here. Beyond the forest edge, wasteland stretches in all directions.
7309: This is the southern end of the sparse forest. Huge blocks, apparently thrown here by something BIG prevents you from moving any further south of here. To the west, you see some plains, while the forest continues to the east and the north.
7310:
A grey wolf is here, snarling aggressively.
A grey wolf is here, snarling aggressively.
A black wolf pads restlessly, looking for its next prey.

You are surrounded by grass and nothing but grass. To the east, you see some trees, and beyond those, the mountains that Morgoth built a long time ago to prevent the elves from reaching the shores of the Belegaer, and Aman, the Land of the Valar further to the west.
7311: A black snake hurries towards you with sly intentions.

The small forest seems to end here, but you can still go back into it to the west of the north. You hear some birds singing, but, what was that? A sudden howl from somewhere inside the forest makes you shiver. You'd better take care if you decide to go further in among the trees. This part of Arda has never been the same since the foul orcs of Sauron were here during the siege of Rivendell in the second age of the sun.
7312: Brown grass and small, almost dead bushes cover the devastated land around you. There is not a single bird singing, and you hear nothing but the wind. In many places the ground is pierced by large rocks thrusting up through the shallow soil. The wasteland appears to continue on to both the north and east.
7313:
A shining silver coin has been dropped here.
A shining silver coin has been dropped here.
A shining silver coin has been dropped here.
A spirit floats towards you and howls with an evil laughter.

You have found the old cellar of the ruin above you. The damp air is heavy to breathe, and the dark earth walls are dripping with water... A chill runs down your spine, and you have a very un- pleasant feeling of not being alone down here. Something certainly is waiting for you somewhere here in the darkness.
7314:
A brown fox is here, looking for some rabbits to chew up.
A brown fox is here, looking for some rabbits to chew up.
A brown fox is here, looking for some rabbits to chew up.
This small, dirty hole is obviously home to some foxes. You wonder how anyone can freely settle in a simple hole in the ground...
7315: This passage is low, its earthy walls are filled with rocks jutting out and tearing your clothes and skin. Roots intertwine themselves on the ceiling and floor, holding up tons of dirt and stone in their unity. Water drops steadily from all around, and this passage seems to go on forever...
7316:
A grey snake slides along the water.
A grey snake slides along the water.
You are in black, oily water at the bottom of a well, the rope above being too high above ones head.
7317: This used to be the small field of the farm east of here. There is no seed left here, only the coal black ground with charred bits of straw lying on it is left to testify that this field was all burnt down not very long ago...
7318: You are standing at the old stone-well of the farm. It doesn't seem to have been used for many decades, the brick is withered, the rope hanging down seems to be rotten and the bucket is missing. As you look down the well, you see nothing but a pitch black hole extending deep into the ground.
7319: This elevated place is naturally protected by a sheer fall to the north, which allowed the fortifications to be much lower than west of here. Nothing more than a few overgrown rocks has survived the many years since it was abandoned. To the south the ground falls away to sheer cliff also: the hill was cut into long ago, to extract boulders for buildings and walls.
7320: A ridge of hills comes to a sudden stop just south of here, at the foot of an high and impassable wall of rock. Its grey stone is marked with inclined brown stripes - the softer brown rock has eroded to form a series of hollows on the wall, as if someone had passed a rake over it.
7321: At the Foot of the Hills

The grass grows long and unhindered here, completely covering the slightly undulating terrain. A few half-ruined walls can be seen on the top of the hills which slope up steeply south of here, and westwards a deep dike lies before a wall. Probably in this place battles were fought at some point in time, but nothing has survived the hundreds of years since to tell the tale.
7322: A few scattered rocks are all that remains here of an old fortification. The line of boulders marking where the ancient wall once stood follows the ridge to the west, while eastward it fades into obscurity amongst the hills. A wide fissure opens in the sloping ground to the south, and the trickling of water can be heard from within.
7323: This section of the fortifications was built to bar the gap between two hills, and is still quite tall and well conserved. It stretches east and west from here, climbing up the slopes. Ivy completely covers the wall, yet it is impossible to climb down it, and you will have to make a long detour to get to the other side.
7325: Deep Dike in Front of the Wall
A diamondback rattlesnake is coiled here, ready to strike.

Standing on the bottom of the trench the wall appears tall and strong, especially since on this section the years have not taken such a heavy toll as elsewhere. The ruins are completely covered by ivy to the point that is difficult to see the stone behind the foliage. However the ivy cannot offer a good enough hold for it to be possible to climb the wall. Brushwood fills the bottom of the dike.
7326: A hungry warg (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

A small trail comes out of a wide cleft to the west, and travels between the ridge of hills that rise to the north and a small copse to the south. Grass and undergrowth cover the landscape and have partly invaded the track, but even though some fallen boulders hinder your path the trail is quite easy to follow.
7327: A small group of pines grows here beside a small creek coming from the hills, the ceaseless noise of the water filling the copse. All around grass and small bushes cover the landscape, making travel between the pines slightly difficult. The pale line of a path encircling this place can be seen from here, travelling along at the feet of the hills.
7328: A small creek flows out of a wide cleft among the hills to the north, and proceeds southward by the edge of a small copse of pines. On the other side many mounds of splintered rock stick out of the earth, and although they must have stood here a great long time no plant yet grows on them.
7329: A large rabbit looks peacefully at you, ready to dart away.

Some low and broken ivy-clad walls stick out of the weeds and high grass, and large slabs lie scattered everywhere, half buried and eroded. To the north a stone quarry was dug, like a deep wound, into the flank of an otherwise green hill. Here the stone was cut and squared, and westwards beside a small brook mounds of waste still rise. There must once have been forts and barracks here, but now nothing remains.
7330: A large pile of boulders is sitting here, probably debris from a rockslide.

The rocky shoulder of the hill was dug away long ago, and boulders hewn out of it to build the fortifications that run over the hills not far to the north. Numerous rocks litter the ground, most of them having fallen from the sheer hillside, but some do not appear quite so natural - they have flat sides and blunted edges.
7331: A rock lizard is here, motionless as it observes you.

Gushing out from the base of a high hill on the north, the water has worn away the calcareous rock and a wide fissure has formed. Scattered on the ground here are several large stones, half buried and broken. Still, looking closer one can see flat sides and right angles on them - a sign of the hand of man. A rivulet follows the cleft southward and soon disappears amongst the rocks.
7332: You are standing within four walls - the only remnants of the small farm. The only ways out seem to be through the two holes remaining from doors to the north and the west. Looking around, you see nothing of value among the rubble and charred bits of wood that lie in the used-to-be farm.
7333: This used to be the small yard in front of the little farm south of here. Turning west, you see a small, but crumbled well, that surely hasn't been used for very long. The main building's roof is gone, and wind and rain hasn't exactly been nice to it. The small barn, east of here, seems to be a bit more intact though. North of here, a path can take you east into the mountains or west, back to the civilised elves in Rivendell.
7335: You are standing in some small plains, squeezed in between rocky grounds in the north and a path leading east and west to the south. Beyond the path, you see the remaining parts of an old farm, abandoned a long time ago.
7336: You are in some grassy plains just west of a path leading up a slope to the high plateau in the north-west. The plains continue to the north, on the west side of the slope below the plateau. As you gaze east, you see the mighty Misty Mountains far in the distance.
7337: These plains lie just west of a steep cliff. The plains continue to the south, while they turn very rocky to the west. Looking south, you see a small path in the distance.
7338: You are in the middle of a very rocky area. North of here, a slope leads up onto the plateau you can see in the north-east. Looking east, you see that the rocks get fewer and fewer, turning the rocky grounds into green plains, stretching far east towards the mighty mountain range called Hithaeglir, the Misty Mountains.
7339: This slope leads you up to a path on a plateau to the east. Looking downhill, to the west and the south, rocky grounds extend south from the riverside. The river itself is north of here, slowly running west to the Belegaer, the large ocean in the west.
7340: This is just south of the river Bruinen. The ground is all covered by large and small rocks, making it very hard to pass. As you look across the river further down-stream, you see it pass under the shadow of the forest on its banks, and disappear from view.
7341: A gentle slope climbs away from the river, covered by tall green and brown clumps of grass swaying in the breeze. At the shoreline a thick stand of weeds grow in the mud, making passage onto the river somewhat trying. To the south the ground is rougher; still, even there grass prevails over the brush and brambles.
7342: A green meadow lies between the Bruinen and the outskirts of a forest to the south. Grass and weeds grow on the soft mud at the riverbank, and many animals have left their tracks as they come to drink. On the other side of the river a gloomy pine forest extend for miles.
7343: Imposing trunks of ancient firs rise all around, dominating the landscape in all directions. The undergrowth is thick and matted: brambles, thorn bushes and creepers make it difficult to travel through the forest. Westward, where the ground slopes steeply downwards, the vegetation has grown so thickly tangled it is now impassable.
7344: By a Jagged Finger of Rock

A massive, jagged finger of rock sticks out of the ground here, dotted around at its base by a few boulders. All around sparse islands of grass and brush are the only counterparts to the uneven, rocky ground. Far to the north the line of the Bruinen can be seen glittering at the feet of a huge dark forest.
7345:
A wolf cub happily plays here.
A wolf cub happily plays here.
The mother wolf stands here, protecting her young cubs.

You feel as if you are in the middle of a pile of rocks. Moving around is very hard, but you barely notice some plains surrounding a small path leading east-west a bit further south of here. Perhaps going south would make travel a lot easier. But, will you be the only one using that path out here in the wilderness ? To the east, a high plateau rises above the lowland that surround the river Bruinen.
7346: A hungry warg (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

This trail was made to serve the fortifications along the walls. It passes through the level ground south of the hills and makes a sharp turn from west to south, following the line of ancient fortifications. An overgrown track leaves the main path to the north and climbs the hills, disappearing behind a steep bank. It probably leads to the ruins that can be spotted at the top of the western hill.
7347: This small path travels a few yards from the overgrown ruins of an old wall which stretches northward over a series of small humps in the moors. It seems to be used now only by animals, and bushes and tufts of high grass invade the trail. The ground slopes gently to the east where a copse of pine trees can be seen.
7348: The South Fork of the Bruinen
It is slightly darker here, since you are passing under a bridge that stretches across the south fork of the Bruinen. You notice the nice echo as a large swan reminds you of it's existence.
7349: You are under the stone-bridge across the fork of the river. The path above you runs in a north-south direction. At the southern base of the bridge you see a small hole in the stonewall. To the west you see a smaller river coming down from the north, merging with this branch.
7350: You are standing next to the river, that flows both east and south of here. The water looks clear and refreshing to drink. To the west a steep cliff-side raises into the air, carrying a bridge over the river. When you look south, across the river, you see more high cliffs overlooking the Bruinen. To the east, the river continues further upstream.
7351: This is the outskirts of the wild forest extending to the north. You can enter the forest by going west. South of here you see the riverbank and beyond it, the calm river Bruinen flows steadily past Rivendell, Tharbad and eventually into the Belegaer. East of here you see a small hill, overlooking the surroundings.
7352:
A robin is sleeping here.
A woodpecker is here, tapping on a tree.
A robin is sleeping here.

Around you is a lush forest at the foot of the Misty Mountains. Dew glistens off the leaves above as well as ferns growing close to the ground. Birds chirp happily and small animals are often seen scampering around. There are some odd tracks here and there, and you can detect some feel of evil hanging somewhere in the air. To the north is a sinister forest, so dark than no sun can reach the ground. To the south is a broad river leading to a higher hill. From there, you ought to be able to get a good view of the surrounding land.
7353: A small hill is here, just at the bank of the Bruinen. However, thick bushes prevent you from reaching the river from here. North of you, a large, hostile forest spreads out. The forest looks more hospitable to the west, where the trees thin out.
7354: A path in the forest starts to become more well defined. To the east you can see quite a ways, considering the growth of trees you have encountered so far. To the north you can barely make out some break in the trees. The forest thins out to the south.
7355: As the path in the forest continues, the sounds of chirping birds begins to cease. The path has become well defined, and it continues to the east.
7356:
A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

The peaceful mood of the forest has left and it is replaced with a quiet thoughtfulness. To the north are a large number of trees, growing close together, with their branches entertwining. The path continues to the east and west, while a small hill looms to the south.
7357: A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.
As you move farther along into the forest, the feeling of peacefulness is replaces by a certain uneasiness. The trees on the sides of the trail are impenetrable, so you can only go west or east.
7358: A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

You are now so far within the forest that your sense of direction is fading. There is absolutely no light from the sun this deep within the forest, but you can still follow the path. There are a few paw-prints in the dried dirt, about the size of a large dog's foot.
7359: A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

The tracks in the dirt become more well defined, as you follow the trail into the deepest parts of the forest. Any resemblance of a peaceful forest are lost now, and a definite sense of evil has overcome the area. In the distance you can hear wolves howling. The trail takes a turn here, going from the west to the north.
7360:
A large mean-looking troll is here (red aura).
A large mean-looking troll is here (red aura).

As you enter this small house, you notice how dirty it is. There are rags thrown about everywhere, a layer of dust on all the furniture, and a big pile of dirty dishes near the fire. A few cots line the far wall, and they aren't even made. You get the feeling that whatever lives here doesn't even have a mother to watch out for them.
7361: An ancient name for this dark pine forest, which stretches itself northward, is Taur-en-Morthonion. During day light can be seen to the south, and the sound of running water comes from that direction.
7362: You have reached the southeastern corner of the forest. The river runs east and south of you. You also notice that the river branches here. There is a bridge across one of the branches, but you will have to cross the other branch to get there.
7364: A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

This is deep inside a pine forest. It is as dark as the darkest night. The branches of huge trees around you let almost no light through. The ancient name of this forest is Taur-en-Morthonion, the Forest of Dark Pines.
7365: A hungry warg (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

In this part of the forest is dominated by younger trees. They are tall and with thick trunks, but the lowest branches are in reach of your hands. You find a climbable tall tree. If you climb up, you may get an overlook of the forest.
7366:
A rabbit is here eyeing your presence warily.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

The braying of wolves is louder now, and it seems that you have invaded the territory of something dangerous. The wolf tracks lead to the north, but there are more tracks that lead to the south, and end abruptly.
7367: Now within the very bowels of the forest, a slow terror begins to creep into your bones. You begin to lose all track of time, as the evil feeling within grows and grows. The path is littered with tracks and takes another turn to the east.
7368: The trees here block your direction to the west and south, but you can still go both north and east. There are a few scored trees in this area, made very sloppily and uncaring to the trees. It is obvious that elves did not do this.
7369: A grey wolf is here, snarling aggressively.
The forest takes another twist here, giving you the choice of turning back or heading to the north. The scores on some of the trees are old, but they can still be seen in the trees.
7370: A grey wolf is here, salivating profusely.

As you make your way through the forest, your eyes try and adjust to the dark shade which enshrouds you. Progress from this point seems possible in only two directions, north and south. The trees grow too thick to the east and west.
7371:
A grey wolf is here, salivating profusely.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.
As you follow the path, you see a break in the forest to the west. There you can see a large hill, and the sky above it. The path ends here, but you can continue a bit more to the north.
7372: A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

You must be pretty far into the forest. There seems to be no end of it in any direction. It is dark as the darkest night. Above you, there is a thick layer of branches that let almost no light through. The heart of the forest might be to the west.
7373: A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.
There are dark pine trees in all directions and no path can be found. Many travellers has been lost in this hostile enviroment. Maybe the forest's inhabitants have something to do with it to.
7374: A river flows silently just east of you, forming the eastern border of this dark forest. On the other side of the river there is a trail going east into the mountains.
7375: The thick layer of leaves over your head prevents any light from getting into the forest. The trees here are as wild as any others in the forest, and there is nothing taming them in this part of the forest.
7376: The trees on both sides of you are thick, growing together very close. Coupled with the undergrowth that is growing everywhere in this forest, it makes movement hard on you and your clothes.
7377: A small, beautiful clearing in the forest lies here, covered in a rich, green grass. For some reason, no trees grow in this clearing, which makes you wonder if parts of even this forest have been tamed. To the north the forest continues, and to the southwest, you can see a small camp.
7378: Over in this section of the clearing there are a few lines tied up between the trees. Strung over them are the furs of animals, big and small. Over towards the trees there is a long wooden table, with benches on both sides. To the east the clearing continues, and to the south you spot a small camp.
7379: A tall and strong hunter is standing here.

As you enter the camp, the forms moving about within it become clearer. They are distinctly elven, and appear to have been here for a while. They welcome you to their camp, and offer you a spot beside their fire to share tales and meals. The hunters are dressed in the skins of animals native to forests, and you notice that their weapons are not far away.
7380: The small clearing ends here as the forest cuts it off to the east and west. Here the grass continues to grow, but a few feet away is a small, clear pond, with water that looks suitable for drinking. Off to the west you can see a small camp with a few forms moving around it.
7381: As you move into the forest, the trees grow closer together and the light begins to fade. A path that looks manageable runs from the north to the south, with trees lining it on both sides. To the north you can see the entrance to the forest.
7382: The part of the forest tamed by the elven rangers is far gone now, and the trees and undergrowth block travel in all directions except to the east and south. The forest has a nice, peaceful feeling here.
7383: A small grasshopper clings to a blade of grass, ready to spring.

The feeling of nature is very heavy in this part of the forest. These parts seem untravelled by anything other than the lower animals. You can go either to the north or to the west, all other ways are blocked by the foliage.
7384:
A huge, black wolf is here, ready to devour.
A huge, black wolf is here, ready to devour.
The roots here seem to reach up and trip you as they weave a web across the floor of the forest. There are so many roots that you can almost walk on them instead of the ground.
7385: A small grasshopper clings to a blade of grass, ready to spring.

The sounds of nature surround you as you walk through the forest. As you get used to walking through the forest, it becomes easier to avoid the roots and vines. Movement is possible to the north and east.
7386: The undergrowth here is a bit sparser than in other places in the forest. There are a few large tracks visible in the dirt underneath. The trees allow movement to east and the south.
7387: As you make your way through the forest, the undergrowth tugs on your pants and scratches up your boots. You can see that some of the undergrowth has recently been moved and shoved up against the trees.
7388:
A rabid raccoon stands here, frothing at the mouth.
A rabid raccoon stands here, frothing at the mouth.

A small animal, or family of animals has burrowed into the undergrowth here. This small place smells of wet fur and dirty animals. The ground is made up of packed dirt and the roof and sides are dirt and some of the undergrowth that surrounds everything in the forest. The burrow is a tight fit for you, and it continues on to the east, getting even tighter.
7389: You start climbing up the hills here, which is not too hard, as the slope is rather gentle and free of rocks. The hill climbs up to a peak to the west where the view is somewhat better. To the south lies a large, sprawling forest, filled with trees that grow close together.
7391: A rabbit is here eyeing your presence warily.

As you climb up the gentle hill, you find yourself feeling better for yourself. You think that if you can conquer this hill, then the great Misty Mountains that can be seen off in the distance will be as foothills to one of your abilities. The hills lead off to the west, and the plains to the north.
7394: Here the trees of the forest, which lies south and west, grow sparse. Out of the forest, a monotonous flatland lies. Thick trees block large-scale movement southwards into the forest. There are a number of pawprints in the ground leading from the west and ending here.
7396: The trees here are too thick for you to go anywhere but back to the south. The ground is covered with the undergrowth, and walking here is harder than anywhere else in the forest. Sticks and twigs catch at your pants scratching them up a bit.
7397: You walk among thick trunks of old pines. The ground is made of packed earth, and nothing but the pines grow here. The lowest branches of the trees are well above your head, and you can move quite freely around. The light is dim. Not even on a bright day, will you be able to see much. From the depths of the forest you hear strange sounds. Foul beasts might lurk in the shadows.
7398: Huge pines stand close to each other. Most of the light never reach the ground. Some strange sounds comes from the depths of the forest. To the west is a small mountain.
7399: Hills to north, northeast and east makes a frame to this dark forest which stretches itself south and west. Southwest is a small mountain. Large and very steep mountains gives the horizon to the north a cruel look.
7401: Dark trees covers the flat hill. The vegetation is dense and the air is damp. A high mountain raises to the north. Not even a very skilled climber could defeat such hostile rocks. The mountain opens up to the east. There an overhang shades the ground from all sunlight.
7403:
The corpse of a ferocious warg is lying here.
The corpse of a ferocious warg is lying here.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

You are in the outskirts of a very large and dark forest. Rumours say that very large creatures inhabit this area. North and east there are smaller trees and a less dense vegetation. The soil is better here. Southeast runs a river slowly along the border of the forest.
7404: This is the northeast part of a very big dark forest. North of you is a steep slope covered with a thick layer of snow during the winter. Then a cold wind from Misty Mountains brings tons of snow. During the summer it never completely melts, as it lies in the shadow of the sun most of the day.
7405: The dense vegetation on the hill makes it hard to pass. No sunlight can be seen during the day. The undergrowth is sparse and you hear no birds singing. The air is damp.
7406: A lot of tall trees grow very dense on this flattened hill. Thick roots penetrates the rich soil. Far north a mountain raises and shelters an east west passage by an overhang. It is not possible to go east. The dark hills continues south and west.
7407: The hostile mountain to the north becomes somewhat friendly when it shelters you from hard winds and rain at this place. To the west is a flat hill covered with dark trees. The overhang continues eastwards.
7408: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily.

The sun never reaches this place. There are several rocks and the only vegetation are grey lichens. The air is very damp. It is like a breath from the mountain which, like a mouth, opens up to the north.
7409:
A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.
A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.

The rocky flats are shelterd from rain by an overhang. It also makes this place permanently dark. During day some light can be seen from south and east. Some nights sounds and fragile light comes from east.
7410: This is the entrance to a large cave. This far you can ride into it but if you want to go any further with a mount you have to dismount. A dark tunnel leads down into the mountain.
7411: The tunnel is wide and extremely steep. Carvings of men with long spears on the walls reveal that this tunnel once was made by Hillmen. Perhaps it was once used as a burial chamber. The tunnel continues further down.
7412: The tunnel takes you no further down into the mountain. No matter how silent you might try to move your steps make faint sounds. By the sound of the echo you can assume that west of here is a large chamber.
7413: You are in a very large chamber almost thirty feet below the surface of the ground above. There are sound of breathing. It may have been your own.
7414:
A huge stone troll looms overhead, ready to crush your body.
A large mean-looking troll is here.
A large mean-looking troll is here.

This corner of the chamber seems to be pretty intact. Everywhere else in the chamber, the things that were put here originally had been destroyed and old meals and excrements of trolls cover the floor. This part, however, seems tidy. A very interesting painting is on the western wall.
7415: This chamber is really big, about nineteen feet across. The chamber was once used as a burial chamber, but there are no bodies or treasures to find in this very room.
7416: *Volta the Black Numenorean*, wielding a dark broadsword, is standing here.

This is a burial chamber. You found some tombs, but they are destroyed, and the bodies that once were laid there are scattered around on the floor. Dry grass has been lain on the floor around the tombs and appears to serve as beds for someone who is very tall.
7417: A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.

A small overhang shelters this place from harsh weather. A big, burned out, camp fire indicates some visitors. Some rudiments from a corpse can be a sign of a meal. It looks like some kind of metal is stuck into the ground or just left there but not totally covred with rocks and soil.
7418: The ground is covered by gravel and small rocks. Scattered birches are fighting for their existence. Long ago, an avalanche caused huge amounts of snow to slide down and destroy all in its path.
7419: You are near the top of a hill. Another, but lower, hill is to the east. If if go there you might not be able to come back from that direction. The sides of this hill are rather steep.
7420: You are close to the top of this very large hill which stretches itself south- wards. When the sky is clear you have a nice overlook of the lands. North and far southwest are large and dark forests. There are some flat areas and other places are covered by hills. To the east the Misty Mountains dominate the view.
7421: No trees grows here. The ground is swampy but easy to cross. A crevice to the north prevents you to go to the low hill there. Eastwards a flat area opens up. South and west are large hills.
7422: You are in a flat area south of some high hills. There are not many trees. Only small birchwoods survive the harsh climate of this area. Towards the Misty Mountains the hills get larger and stepper.
7424: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily.
You are on the top of a cliff. Cliffs rise sheer from the water around all the lake. The lake is one of the sources of Bruinen.
7425: You are in the middle of a deep lake. The water is cold and dark. There are no fish or other living creatures in the water. An extremely skilled climber can manage to climb up on the cliffs north of here.
7426: This branch of the river Bruinen joins another branch south of here. To the west is the corner of a very large and dark forest. To the east is an old trail and to the southeast an old bridge.
7427: You are on a branch of the river Bruinen, between a dark forest of pines at the western side, and an old trail on the opposite side. The river runs silently to the south, where it joins a larger branch of Bruinen.
7428: You are on a small branch of the river Bruinen. It flows to the south and its origin is in a rocky area to the northeast. There is an old and seldom trodden trail along the side of the river.
7429: You are not very far from the source of this branch of Bruinen. Water flows from some hills to the northeast. The river is calm as it runs through a flat area. There is an old trail south of here.
7430: You are on a branch of river Bruinen close to its source. The mountains east and south are to steep to climb. During very dry seasons there is not much water flowing in the river which might make this part to a shallow section. On the sharp rocks are several bones from unfortunate climbers.
7431: This is the source to one of the contributing rivers of Bruinen running from from a lake of fair size. The lake, east of here, can't be reached from this place. The sound of a waterfall to the south is getting noisy. North and west steep hillsides makes it impossible for mounts to go that way. During very dry seasons there is not much water here and this part is then a shallow section of the river.
7432: The water comes from a lake in the north and flows rapidly westwards and you can hear some noise from a waterfall. A steep mountain side blocks your view to the east. This part of the river is a shallow section during very dry seasons.
7433: This is a lake of fair size. It is the source of the river which runs out of its southwestern corner. There are no streams flowing from the mountain sides into the lake. Cliffs rise sheer up from the cold and deep water.
7434:
There are two water lilies here.
There are two tall, grey-green plants here.

The river of Bruinen has many sources. This is one of them. Far west, near the Ford of Bruinen, it will grow larger. Much later it will join the River of Mitheithel and form Gwathlo, the Greyflood. At Tharbad, Glanduin joins the river. At Lond Daer in Eriador the river finally joins the Great Sea.
7435: This is the end of a dark and cold lake which supplies a branch of the river Bruinen with fresh and clear water. To the north is a very steep mountain side. The cliff east of here looks much easier to reach than the cliffs up from here.
7436: You are on a top of a cliff. The cliff rises sheer from a lake. The lake is one of the sources of Bruinen. One of Bruinen's contributing rivers runs from this lake to the lands below.
7437:
A giant slug is here, oozing around.
A giant slug is here, oozing around.
You manage to pull yourself through the wet tunnel. Suddenly it becomes much wider. On a big rock are some bones. You hear a sound and there is a movement in the shallow water.
7438: All around you are scattered birches twisted into miserable forms by the wind and winter snow. This is really an unpleasant area. The inland climate gives cold winters and warm summers. During the summer mosquitos are a horrible plague.
7439: You are east of a large hill. The hill side is too steep to climb. To get to the top of it, you will have to walk around it searching for a better route to the top. The area elsewhere is mostly flat, covered with scattered small birches and a few small pines.
7440: The wind is really strong here. It howls through the sparse trees and your clothes make a flapping sound. The scattered birches are waving in the wind.
7441: You are in a light birchwood. The trees stand scattered and offer you little shelter from the chilly wind. They are small and twisted by snow and wind. Some of them are brown and they look like a good material for a weaponsmith.
7442: This cliff rises steep from the flat surroundings. To the south is a dark lake. The lake is the source of one of the contributors to the Bruinen river.
7443: A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.
There are no trees on this flat area. Strange rocks with sharp points looks like partly fallen pillars. The wind whistles and howls as it passes between them.
7444: There are no trees here, not even a single birch. Almost no soil have found a shelter among all rocks. Only thin grass waves in the harsh wind. There are a lot of stones in the ground.
7445: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily.

The landscape is hilly and rocky. Far north and far east there are several mountains. A large and dark forest grows southwest beyond the flat area covered with birches. Just north of here there are rocky flats. The hills to the east and south can easily be reached from here. The strange hill west faces this hill with steep sides. You must first go south if you want to climb it and investigate the formations on the top.
7447: A ferocious warg is here, snarling angrily.

It is very dark and only some lichens can survive in this spartan enviroment. The mountain to the north is high and very steep. Long time ago an avalanche caused tons of snow to slide down the mountainside. It passed the overhang and deposited rocks and trees south of here. The overhang continues east and west.
7448: An overhang stretches out from the mountain in the north and almost touches a smaller mountain in the south. It is very dark. From a big crack in the southern mountain some sounds can be heard.
7450: There are some mysterious stones on the top. They once formed a thick wall. Who would build anything in the wild land, so far away from all towns and villages? This land was once a part of the kingdom of Rhudaur. It was habited by Hill-men. Then the area was deserted after the defeat of the Witch-king of Angmar more than thousand years ago. The ruins might be remnants from that distant time.
7451: You finally reached the top of the hill and start examining the ruins. There is not much left of what once stood here, and you ponder a while trying to understand its purpose. When you search the ground you find broken parts of bones. You start digging and reveal more. You find larger bones, and skulls. Human skulls! You realise that this once has been a kind of shrine, a place of sacrificing. The sacrifices have been men mostly, but you even find some bones of small children.
7452: You are in a flat area covered with a light birchwood. The flats expand far to the east, to the foot of the Misty Mountains. You see the mighty peaks of the Mountains rise sheer up into sky. Long tails of clouds are hanging from the peaks as the wind is forced up the steep sides of the mountains, bringing much snow as well, also forming glaciers in areas sheltered from the sun.
7453: Just a few birches and some scattered grass found its home on this rocky hill. This is not a nice place to stay at when the wind blows.
7454: A hungry warg stands here, sniffing around for flesh.
The area is covered by a light birch forest. The trees are smaller than those which can be found in southern areas where the climate isn't so harsh. Long winters and strong winds rule here.
7455: This flat area is covered with a light birchwood. The trees do not look like the brethil found in southern areas. These are much smaller, nine feet at most. Strong wind and snow during the winter have given them twisted forms. Some lie almost horizontally. They continue to the north and to the east. From the south the sound of running water can be heard.
7456: The birches in the light birchwood are smaller than the ordinary ones that are found in southern areas. Tall mountain peaks above the eastern horizon remind you that you are close to the Misty Mountains. Most paths into those mountains have bad ends. If your destination is those mountains, choose your path carefully.
7457: There are rocks on the ground. The humid air makes it impossible to see anything else. The water is loud and nothing else can be heard. Beware, from time to time, when there is a lot of water, no magic can be used here. This part of the river is only shallow when there is not much water during very dry seasons.
7458: You are on a small mountain along a river. Huge boulders and rocks have to be traversed. The nearby waterfall make the air thick and humid. A rumbling sound can be heard.
7460: There are five doors in this corridor, just like the painting on the wall in the chamber above. Maybe Hill-men built the chamber during the time they were loyal to the Witch-king of Angmar. There is an inscription above the entrance to this corridor. Probably because of the domination of the Witch-king, the author had tried to write it in the Black Speech. One does not need to be an expert in languages to see that the grammar is really bad. Probably it is supposed to say that five chieftains of Hill-men are buried here. They were all buried in 1974, slain in great battles the year before the defeat of the Witch-king and the fall of Rhudaur.
7461: You stand in the middle of a corridor. There are five doors, three doors to the north of the corridor, and two to the south. Each door opens into a small chamber, each with a tomb of a chieftain of Hill-men.
7462: You are in the end of the corridor. Five doors, three north, two south are set into the walls of the corridor. Each door is a door into a small chamber, each containing the tomb of a chieftain of Hill-men.
