7721: Shaping the course of the river, the Grey Mountains rise up to the west. The river bends and winds around them. Steep rock rises up on both sides of the river. The looming Grey Mountains make your whole body feel icy.
7722: The water here rushes west at a furious pace, as if trying to escape something horrible in the east. Its clarity gives no hint of the terrors it must have seen as it washed down out of the Misty Mountains. The banks of the river are steep and slick, giving no hope of climbing them. The river flows westward to the Grey Mountains.
7723: The water here rushes west at a furious pace, as if trying to escape something horrible in the east. Its clarity gives no hint of the terrors it must have seen as it washed down out of the Misty Mountains. The banks of the river are steep and slick, giving no hope of climbing them. Although this is a peaceful place, you feel a sense of dread and despair begin to shadow your soul.
7725: An old and content hermit sits by the fire, lost in daydreams.

A wave of warm air plays over your skin, feeling almost scalding compared to the numbing cold outside. The red-stone walls of this cave seem to act as a natural reflector of the heat, not only produced by any bodies that may reside here, but also, most importantly, of the fire in the centre. It burns solemnly on pine boughs and limbs that were collected from the floor of some woods. This would be an ideal place to rest for a while, surely safe from any predators that may be about. A small, sputtering fire burns here, providing a little warmth and light.
7726: The mountains rule unchallenged here. In fact, as you peer south and east and north, you can see nothing but these grey mountains. Only from a peak could you possibly see the land bowing below. The wind is as strong as ever here, whipping your hair about and stinging every exposed piece of skin. You find it leaves a bitter taste in your mouth.
7727: Your eyes, longing for the majestic beauty of the cliffs you gazed on before, find no solace in this horrid grey landscape. And the ground before the cliffs, which seemed like torture to your legs, was unspeakably kinder than what you tread upon now.
7728:
A green key lies here, barely visible on the ground.
A half broken rusted key has been left here.
A sturdy pack horse is standing here.

Sheer, impassable walls of grey stone rise up to the east, preventing any travel beyond them. Impassively they look down upon you and judge whether your existence is worthy...and deign not to inform you of the decision. An icy blast of wind is the only answer you hear to your pleas for mercy from this dangerous clime.

You find yourself in a large cavern sunk deep into the face of the mountains. The air is cool and clammy and there is a stench that you can't quite identify. There are signs that someone or something has been here recently. Maybe you should leave before it comes back.

An old and rickety wooden chest stands in a forgotten corner.
A dark intangible shadow turns to face you.
A dark intangible shadow turns to face you.

This hut, poorly constructed at the base of a cliffside, gives little protection from the outside cold. A small stove is placed in one corner, and some charred remnants of wood suggest it was used not too long ago for heat. To the south the rough land before the cliffs can be traversed, but you think you spy a possible, and rather dangerous, route to climb up the cliff here.

On top of the world, it seems, this plateau atop the cliffs stretches many leagues in some directions, particularly east and north. The landscape is full of large stones and boulders, some making what were perhaps cairns. And some pile upon each other until they form small hills. A peculiar musky scent assails your nostrils here. Above a small, dangerous route down, there lies a rock overhang, sheltering some ground with shade.
7732: A woody evergreen plant grows here, with many stems reaching upward.

Here, on the sandy bank, enough fertile soil has been carried from the north to allow this sturdy patch of pines to survive. The air is as cold as anywhere else in the realms, and you wonder if the evil in the northern soil gives these trees some unnatural ability to withstand the cold. The cliffside that borders these woods curves from west, forming a small pocket to catch more erosion from the river.

A waist-high evergreen shrub grows here, with thick, reaching branches.
On the shrub, there are two piles of grey-green leaves.

On the bank of the river, many trees find abundant water and soil to grow and prosper in. The woods is predominately pine trees and the like, evergreens long accustomed to the cold clime and resistant to frost. To the east a sheer face of a cliff rises, impossible to scale or surmount.

You pause a second, looking around you, and see little signs of life, except the faint claw-marks that tear up the forest floor.

The few shafts of sunlight that reach the forest floor from the canopy above seem to spin about you, and only confusion registers in your mind...

The forest you stand in is thick, the trees clump together for protection against the cold. Occasionally a fierce wind reminds you that you, too, need shelter from this clime. The ground is littered with dead and dying pine needles, crunching softly as you walk. Sunlight is blocked from the canopy of trees overhead, and you must strain your eyes to see more than several meters ahead, all the forms and trees and plants and animals meld into one confusing scene in the dark. The quick panting of breath can be heard.
7740: A frigid wind bites into your face as it howls through the cluttered, cold branches. Old pine trees rise like black slender manilantles all around, gathered for some clandestine, and horrible purpose. The ground is cold and hard, and sharpened rocks and hardened roots protrude from the shadows. The wind rises again, and this time seems to be mingled with a wolf's lonely call.
7741: The climbing gets slightly harder here, and the rough slope continues to ascend to the east. The chill wind blows against your skin and hair, making you feel much colder than you should.
7742: This hill rises up above its surroundings, cresting the mounds about it like some ancient tower of old. In all directions the view is breathtaking, and the only sound that can be heard is the whistle of the cold wind that bites through even the thickest clothing. And disturbing this are the howl of what you hope are only wolves.

To the north you can barely make out the beginnings of a rocky trail somewhere into the mountains. The black forest continues on in all directions, and you wonder how far it can actually go, and whether you could find your way if you ventured inside.
7751: The huge, old trees gather around as if inspecting a tiny, insignificant creature. Next to their enormity you feel small and hopeless. The dark magnifies your trepidity, and the haunts of your subconscious seem to stalk the shadows. And all the time the cold, alien mist writhes slowly through the tangle of undergrowth and bushes.
7752: You follow a well-used animal trail and then lose it, stumbling back into the undergrowth, and scratching your face and skin. Wolves howl balefully into the dark, first from in front, and then another some distance behind. The immense old pines block sight in a haphazard fashion, and you seem to catch sight of danger several times, but are never sure of it.
7753: The trees grow particularly close together here, in a thick clump that takes some doing to get around. To the south, you can barely see some hills through the wall of pines. And all around lies the forest, waiting, it seems, for something.

Here is the edge of a large pine forest. The fringe is not so dark or cold as the interior, but still the dank and frigid mist wafts dormantly around. The sounds of a living, breathing forest quietly unnerve and disturb you.
7755: Darkness descends upon you, but no stars speckle the black mantle overhead. It is a kind of thick, oppressive blackness, more like the midnight of a cavern than that of the surface lands. A dank mist circulates through the chilly air, infecting you, no doubt, with all sorts of unhealthy vapours. The sounds of something pacing through the undergrowth echo preternaturally from deeper within the woods.
