You are standing at the bottom of the mountainpeak. You will have to climb to reach the top. There is a lot of snow covering the trail further up, so you will have to force your way through if you really want to reach the upper point of this area. You can go north on the trail, or you can leave up.
8478: A mountain goat is here, jumping from cliff to cliff.

You have now reached the top of this mountain, although you see that this is not the highest peak around here. In the distant north you can see higher mountains, each seeming taller than the previous one and many with very pointed peaks. This tip, like most tips around, is covered with snow.
8479: You are now on the ridge of this mountain and there is snow everywhere. To the north, you can see a large range of mountains rising up. On your west you see far down into the lowlands. To your south, you see a steep slope that meanders up to the highest peak of this mountain. You can climb down to the lowlands here.
8480: This path is extremely steep. In fact, you spend more time climbing than actually walking. This area is mostly covered with snow which makes every step dangerous. To the west you can see a trail leading further down to the lowlands.
8481: This trail takes a torturous path through the mountains. There are some low trees and bushes around here, but the trail climbs tall mountains to the east and the west of you, and you can spot snow on their higher slopes. Another branch of the trail leads down into a valley to your north.
8482: You find yourself among the high mountains in the Misty Mountains. There are a few trees around you, crooked, with a miserable look. The ground is covered with a thin layer of soil, but beneath it you can feel the hard stone. East of you a huge range of mountains are reaching towards the sky, with snowy peaks. The wind here is chilly and it might be hard to find shelter if a storm would hit you.
8483:
A very strong orkish leader is here on patrol.
An experienced orkish scout is looking for tracks on the ground.
An orc soldier is standing here.
An orc soldier is standing here.
An orc soldier is standing here.

The mountain is sloping downwards to the west here, leading towards some boulders that seems to hinder you from going that way. Somehow, nature seems to force you to go south into a narrow pass, or walk up to the trail. Loose stones and rocks are getting more and more frequent and it is getting hard to travel fast. From time to time you can hear a bird squeeking loudly from above, but it is hard to see the source of the noise.
8484:
A lone hawk soars high above you.
A hungry warg is standing here, ridden by you.

This is an extremely narrow trail, which twists through the mountains. On all sides there are huge mountains that reach as high up as the eye can see. Stones can be heard falling down the sides, crushing other stones as they reach the bottom. The passage is limited to travel either south or north, and hoping no stones will fall during the journey. Every sound is amplified as it echoes between the mountains.
8485:
A small and tough weed grows here.
A small and tough weed grows here.
A lone hawk soars high above you.

As you walk around a corner of this twisted, narrow mountaintrail, you find yourself at a dead end. A huge sheer cliff stops you from walking any further. As you stand still for a while, a deadly silence lingers in the air. At the base of the cliffs around you, a few plants and flowers has found a refuge.
8486: At the Base of a Cliff
*an Orc*, wielding a black runed dagger, is standing here.

Here, at the base of some huge cliffs reaching towards the sky, you find a small stony shore at the edge of a mountain lake. There are lots of stones here, making it hard for you to walk here. Some of them are pointed, but there are also some round ones to be seen. The water south of you is dark and ominous, however, the sharp cliffs on the other side which are mirrored in the surface, gives you an extremely steady impression.
8487: This small dark lake lies between the high peaks of the Misty Mountains. Sharp cliffs leads down into the dark, hostile water. North of you a stony shore is hidden between the mountains. The air here is chilly and sometimes you hear something reach the surface, to vanish as fast as the mirrorlike image of the mountains in the water has been grumbled.
8488: A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.

Deep within the Misty Mountains, this oval mountain lake lies beneath rocky cliffs. Its water is dark and ominous, making it impossible to see further than a few yards in it. North of you, a stony shore is split into two by a sharp cliff. Its sheer rockface makes a hard and undestroyable impression between the two shores.
8489: This dark lake, hidden between the mountains, is surrounded by the sharp cliffs of the mountains. A sharp pointed cliff is splitting the stony shore north of you into two. The water is dark and ominous; it is impossible to see further than a few feet in it.
8490: Here, beneath some thorny bushes, you find a stony shore. Pointed stones and rocks makes it hard to walk here. Pieces of dead animals can be seen among the stones. The shore is leading down to the dark waters south of you. It seems to be a small lake lying here, deep within the Misty Mountains. The water looks ominous, sometimes you can hear something reach the surface just to disappear as fast as the image of the mountains on the other side has been grumbled. A small dark entrance to a cave is lying north of you.
8491: A huge stone giant is here, glaring at you.

Here, far below the trail you left, you find a small cave. You can see light from outside south of you, and far away the black water of a lake. The cave floor is cold and moistured, water is dripping from the sharp stones in the wall. Shadows are flickering in the light, and sometimes the echoing sound of a stone falling can be heard.
8492: The small trail seems to end here, mountains stop you from continuing in any direction. The bushes are really dense, making it hard for you to walk fast here. South of you a small lake is lying far below you, the mountains on the other side mirrored in the dark surface of the water.
8493: A mountain goat is here, jumping from cliff to cliff.

This small trail is leading slightly downwards. As you get further east, more bushes seem to be able to survive. All around you high mountains with white pointed tops are reaching high into the sky. Sometimes a bird can be seen high in the sky. Corpses of dead mountain goats and wargs can be seen scattered along the trail.
8494: Here, south of the trail, few living things can be seen. The trees and plants that has survived are crooked and miserable. All around you, mountains are reaching for the sky and a cold wind blows through the valleys and over the peaks. Some tracks of something or someone can be seen, and some remains of animals are scattered across the landscape. A descending trail leads to the east, while north of you, the trail is leading upwards.
8495:
A huge warg is here, moving in for the kill.
A huge warg is here, moving in for the kill.
A huge warg is here, moving in for the kill.

You are walking carefully on a stony path. Here you can see stones, boulders and pebbles of every conceivable size and shape. The path is difficult to walk upon. To the west you see a large rising mountain, and you notice the snowy peaks through the haze. You can continue on the path and move further south, or you can return north.
8496: You are walking on a stony path. Here you can see stones, boulder and pebbles of every conceivable size and shape. The path is difficult to walk upon. Here, the path splits east-west.
8497: You are walking carefully on a stony path. Here you can see stones, boulders and pebbles of every conceivable size and shape. The path is difficult to walk upon. The path continues to the north, or you can go back west.
8498: You are walking on a stony path. Here you can see stones, boulders and pebbles of every conceivable size and shape. The path is difficult to walk upon. You see a cliff to the north of you.
8499: You find yourself standing on the edge of a mountain plateau. This must be the end of the plateau, as you can see a path leading eastwards among all the numerous mountains around here. To the south is a steep downward slope, all sheer rock interlaced with ice-filled crevices.
8500: You are walking among mountains on both sides of you. The path seems to be well-trodden though, and you can move pretty fast here. You hear no birds here, or anything else. A cold wind makes you feel cold all over. The path leads north and west.
8501: You are walking among mountains, with peaks on both sides of you. On your left side you see a big mountain, which you can try to climb up the side of. This path seems to be well-trodden though, and you can move pretty fast here. You hear no birds singing, only the echo of your footsteps. You can either stay on the path going south, or you can try to climb up on the top of the mountain.
8502: At this crossing, several paths meet. One trail seems to lead west, another one leads south, and one can go down here. This place seems like a meeting ground of some sort. A ring of large stones in the middle is likely acting as a waymark.
8503: You make your way on a small rugged track in the mountains. The trail is slow to walk upon, because there are many stones and pebbles to move around all the time. You face a big mountaintop to the south of you, and the trail turns east here.
8504: You make your way on a small rugged track in the mountains. Stones and pebbles are scattered all over the path, making it hard to walk upon. The vegetation is scarse, with only a few trees and bushes growing beside the road. You are surrounded by mountaintops, and the air is chilly.
8505: This is the end of the misty path. It is still hard to see anything here, due to all the mist that covers this place. You can either go north, or try to climb upwards, though something seems to be in your way if you want to go up.
8506: You are walking on a very misty path. It is hard to see anything here, due to the mist that covers this place. The mist seems to naturally be hanging over this place all the time. It is hard to see anything clearly here, but you notice that this path seems to be the correct way up to the mountains.
8507: A sharp-eyed hawk is here stalking some prey.

You make your way on a small rugged track in the mountains. Lots of stones and pebbles seems to be in your way all the time, making the path slow to walk upon. You see some mountain tops to the south, and a huge stone in the middle of the road catches your eye.
8508: A small flower grows here, with a purple bloom and wide leaves.

You are walking in the mountains, without following any special path. It is easy to walk here. You can barely spot the top of the mountain, partly hidden in clouds. Maybe it is possible to make your way all the way up to the top. There seems to be a trail to the south of you.
8509: You have come to a very sharp turn in the path. You notice that this path must lead up to the mountains, as you can see more mountains around you. It's difficult to walk here, due to all the small pebbles and rocks everywhere. You can leave south and head for the mountains, or you can go east into a narrow pass.
8510: This pass is very narrow, but not impossible to walk through. To the north you can spot a small crack in the massive wall of stone. This place is shaded by all the mountains around you. East of you some hills are rising and a small path is leading west.
8511: In this dark and brooding valley, a deathly silence lingers. The smell in the air is most foul, and leaves a dreadfully unpleasant taste in traveller's mouth.
8512: A huge olog-hai troll is here staring blankly at you.

The trees here are blocking out the sun completely, making it hard for you to see anything clearly here. At the western part of the valley, a huge boulder seem to be covering some kind of an entrance. No birdsong can be heard here, and the stems of the trees seem to be waiting for something or someone.
8513:
An infant troll, baring its teeth, snarls here.
An infant troll, baring its teeth, snarls here.
The ugly troll mother is roaming the cave, taking care of her loved ones.
An experienced orkish scout is looking for tracks on the ground.

It is hard to see anything in here, but you notice very fast that this is a troll lair, where the trolls multiply to roam across the Misty Mountains. You can spot a huge table in the middle of the room, and you also see heaps of broken bones lying all over the earthfloor.
8514:
A grey-skinned mountain troll stands here.
An experienced orkish scout is looking for tracks on the ground.

You are at the end of this dirty cave. There is a big shelf on the wall, which probably serves as food storage. You can see some corpses of unknown races lying there, skulls cracked and bones broken. No weak creature could have done that.
8515: You are walking on some rolling hills. You can see many more hills to the south of you. The landscape around you consists of hilltops, some of which are grassy, others rocky. A strong wind is blowing from the mountaintops to the west of you. You can spot snowclad peaks far away.
8516: You are walking on some rolling hills. You can see many more hills to the south of you. The landscape around you consists of hilltops, some which are grassy, others rocky. You can spot snowclad peaks far away, and some birds flying high in the sky.
8517: You are walking on some rolling hills. You can see many more hills to the south of you. The landscape around you consists of hilltops, some which are grassy, others rocky. You can spot snowclad peaks far away, and some birds flying high in the sky.
8518: You are walking through some rolling hills. The landscape around you consists of hilltops with some being grassy and some being rocky. West of you, huge mountains rise and give the impression of a wall. A trail leads south, while to the north you can see the appearance of more hills.
8519: The hills here are rough and rocky. The path you followed is impossible to follow due to all the rocks and boulders of different sizes constantly obstructing your way. You notice a tiny path seeming to go south. A gorge is opening up to the north, making it impossible to go in that direction. There are some less rocky hills to the west of you, while east of you the rocky hills seem to continue.
8520: The hills here have become much more rough and rocky. You have to take it real slow up here, twisting your way between large boulders and stones. The surrounding area looks pretty waste and dead, but to the east of you, you can see more hills and some of them are also covered with green grass.
8521: You are standing in the middle of hills stretching both to the north and to the south. The hills climb and fall endlessly, but you notice that you slightly move upwards. There is no bird singing here, and it seems like the hills are watching you in a strange way, like they seem to be disturbed by your presence. the surrounding area looks rather waste, cold and dead.
8522: All the small hills here surround you totally, making you a bit worried. The air here seems to carry a strange feeling to you. Or maybe it is only the fresh wind blowing steadily in your face all the time that annoys you. To the east you can enter a steep slope, and in all other directions you can only see hills.
8523: You are walking up and down on several small hilltops. The landscape around you is changing. There are some spots of snow around here, and you also see a lot of bushes and low trees around. To the west you can see a narrow pass, and to the north you can see more hilltops.
8524: You are walking up and down on several small hilltops. The landscape around you is changing. There are some spots of snow around here, and you also see a lot of bushes and low trees around. There are a lots of birds high up in the sky. To the far east you can see more lowlands. To the west you can see a big range of mountains rising up.
8525: You are walking up and down on several small hilltops. The landscape around you is changing. There is more vegetation here, and most rocks and pebbles here are covered with moss. Southwards, you can see some big rocks, and to the west you can spot more hilltops.
8526: In Front of a Mountain Cabin

You are in front of a mountain cabin. The cabin is nested among high rocks, making it well-hidden in this mountain country. This cabin must have been used by the mountaineers, maybe to give them shelter from the weather and a safe place to sleep for the night. However it seems to have been a long time since anyone visited this place.
8527:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.

The cabin seems to be abandoned a long time ago. The floor is rotten, and a foul stench is here as well. There are no windows here, except a small one on the northern side, making this place very dark. The room has no furniture and looks very naked. In the far left corner you can see a hatch, probably leading down to the cellar.
8528: You are standing on a steep slope, leading down to some small hills. The ground here is covered with grass, and you can even see a few bushes and low trees around. To the west you can see more hills open up, and further west you can see a huge range of mountains rising up. East of here you can see some occasional mountains, but it seems like this must be the easternmost part of Misty Mountains. North of you, you can see some rocks.
8529: You are walking among some grassy hilltops. There are no special path to walk upon here, but you travel fast and easy here anyway. To the far west and south you can see the dreadful and famous Misty Mountains rising up in the horizon. The air seems to carry a strange feeling to you. You can enter a steep slope up here, or you can enter more hills to the south.
8530:
A small evergreen plant grows here, its woody stems reaching two feet.
A small evergreen plant grows here, its woody stems reaching two feet.
A small evergreen plant grows here, its woody stems reaching two feet.

You are standing between small hills covered with green grass. The hills climb and fall endlessly, but you notice that you are moving slightly upwards when you travel northwards. To the west and south of you, the hills look more rocky, while northwards you can see more hills in front of you. There is a big gorge to the south, making it impossible to travel that way.
8531: The path here is extremely difficult to walk upon because of all the rocks and boulders obstructing your way. This, however, seems to be a dead end. On the north side, a large gorge is blocking your way. The eastern and southern areas look too steep to travel down. The only exit is back west.
8532:
An old, strong cave troll is standing here.
A large earth troll is digging here, looking for some tasty morsels.

This looks like the end of this tunnel. You can spot some different digging equipment scattered on the ground. Some ragged clothes are lying in a heap in the northwest corner. The smell of rotten flesh is very strong here. The only exit is to the east.
8533: A small, mean earth troll is standing here, thinking of something hideous.

You are standing in a large tunnel going east-west. It must be some kind of escape route or hideout for the trolls during daylight. It is very dark here, and the air is damp and chilly. A dribbling sound can be heard from the moist walls of earth.
8534: This seems to be an underground tunnel system probably made by trolls, for use by trolls. The presence of trolls is very strong and an odour of rotten flesh pervades the air. A dribbling sound can be heard from the moistured earthwalls. The tunnel continues to the west.
8535: This place must have been used by the mountaineers as a storage place. It is quite dark, and a foul stench pervades the air. But more than that, an evil presence seems to lurk here. The southern wall of the cellar seems to be more decayed than the rest, quite rotten, with planks only loosely held in most places.
8536: You are walking on a stony path. Here you see stones, boulders and pebbles of every conceivable size and shape which makes walking difficult on the path. You can hear the sound of babbling water to the north. A steep slope leads to the west, or you can continue north towards the sound of water.
8537: A raft has been left here.

At last, you are standing on this old bridge. It looks like it was built long ago, but still spans the swift river to help travellers get across. You can actually enter the river itself down here, but you need a boat or some kind of floating device. To the north, there is a tall mountain rising up before you, and to the south you can see a pebbled path.
8538: You are standing at the foot of a large mountain. It didn't look as large from a distance. The sound of babbling water can be heard from the south. A stony trail edged with brown grass leads up the mountain. You can either climb up, or go south toward the sound of water.
8539: You are walking in the mountains. It is very easy to walk here. One problem with staying here is that you can be easily seen. You also take the risk of falling down into a gorge or being trapped by foul creatures that may still roam the land. This seems to be a dead end. You can not go any further south by walking. Your only exit is to the north.
8540: Finally you made your way up here. It wasn't an easy climb at all, and you notice how cold and chilling the wind is here. There is a great view westwards, you can see mountain peaks and other heights far away, with snow gleaming on the tops.
8541: You are walking in the mountain, without following any special path. It is easy to walk here. You have arrived at the end of this mountain. To the north, you face many more mountains. They look sharp and dreadful.
8542: A huge solid rock protrudes out of the mountain, sheltering this place from cold stinging winds and the blistering sun. It extends precariously out over this sheltered platform, seemingly ready to crash down on it at moments notice, at a whisper of eastern wind. The only way from here is the climb up the mountain in that same direction.
8543: You make your way to the top of the hill. From here, you can see the water pouring down the side of the mountain. The air here is fresh, and you can hear the sound of rushing water. To the north, you can walk upon a ridge, or you can go back down to your east.
8544: You find yourself at the bottom of a big cliff. At first, this appears to be a dead end. There are many big rocks here and it seems possible to climb up the side of the cliff. You may, however, leave this place and go back to the path to the south.
8545: You are standing at the end of the ridge. Below, you can see an old bridge which looks rather primitive. Water from a gap in the mountain flows to make a waterfall. The melted snow from the mountain peaks flows toward the river bed adding strength to the rushing water. The only exit is to the south.
8546: You struggle to climb your way up the side of the cliff. You can see far in all directions. To the east, you see big mountains, and southward you see rocky plains and even some small trees. There is a ridge to the north of you. However, you notice more cliffs to the west if you decide to go that way, or you can go down again.
8547: Ooooooooooops! Oh Dear! You did a big mistake here. You slip and fall and your body is smashed to pieces at the bottom of the valley. You wonder if anyone will ever find your corpse here as your life fades away... .
8548: This is the end of the ridge. From here, you have a great view in all four directions, but you see mostly mountains everywhere. Below you, a swift mountain stream is pouring out of a gap in the mountain. An extremely steep path is sloping down to the shore. It looks very dangerous!
8549: A sharp-eyed hawk is here stalking some prey.

This is a narrow ridge. You see the ground far below you on both sides, and you have a great view over the surrounding area. A couple of birds can be seen in the sky and a few small trees exist here. The edge of this ridge is to the north.
8550: You walk upon the edge of the cliff, which seems to end here. The only way to continue is to climb down to the bottom of the cliff. It looks like a small dark valley down there, and seems like an ideal place for creatures that don't like light. You can go back east, or climb down.
8551: You find yourself north of a cliff. There seems to be a small path leading up towards it. Pebbles and rocks are scattered in the brown grass beside the path. A few living plants can also be seen. The wind coming from the north is chilly and freezing and there is no shelter in sight. A couple of birds can be seen high in the sky.
8552: You are floating in the middle of a mountain stream. The water flows rapidly and you can clearly see the water pouring out of the big gap on the side of the mountain east of you. It seems impossible to move in that direction. You can leave up back to the bridge, or you can stay in the water of the stream which is moving west.
8553: You are floating in the middle of a mountain stream. The water seems to be more calm here than to the east. On both sides of you, you can see rocky walls, making it impossible to climb up on any side. The river goes east-west.
8554: You are floating in the middle of a mountain stream. The water is dark and ominous, but calm. The rocky walls seem to bend over trying to reach you. The river makes a sharp bend to the south here.
8555:
A trout swims here.
A trout swims here.

You are floating in the middle of the mountain stream. On both sides of you, there are big rocky walls which make it impossible for you to enter on any shore. The river flows west, but it is possible to go back north.
8556: Here the river goes underground. The swiftly running water makes it difficult for you to control your craft. You notice a landing to the north. You can go north or back east.
8557: This landing is surrounded by rocky walls and cliffs. On all sides of you, there are rocks and stones of all shapes and sizes. A dangerous looking hut lies to the east, its walls rotten and murky. A very small path leads to it. To the south, you can see the mountain river you came from.
8558:
There is a water skin lying on the ground.
A grey-skinned mountain troll stands here.

You enter an old hut. It has been a very long time since it was last used by the local mountaineers. The hut has no windows or other exits except from the broken door that you entered. It is a very primitive hut, but still servicable for use as shelter for the night from the cold winds.
8559: You wonder if it was a good idea to do this climbing after all. When you look upwards you only see more heights to be conquered by you, and you can also spot the top far away. It seems like the snow is lying heavy on its shoulders. You are getting cold here, as you are wading in the snow.
8560: At last you are standing on the highest peak in this area. The view here is really incredible. To your north several peaks, almost as high as this one, form a wall. It will not be easy to climb back down. All the snow here makes it dangerous to move around and it probably doesn't take much to cause an avalanche. The only exit is down.
8561: You made your way to the top, and do not regret the climbing at all. You can see far away in all directions here. Unfortunately, the very cold wind and thin air up here, make you easy exhausted, and you should better get down before you catch a cold. You better take it easy when you move down again.
8562: It is hard to observe many details here, because it is very dark. The trees act as roof preventing sunlight from entering. You hear the sound of water nearby, and you see the water pouring out from a small crack in the side of the cliff. A path leads to the south, but you can also go west to an even darker part of this valley.
8563:
A stone troll is standing here, scowling about.
A powerful young troll stares at you.
A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.
A powerful young troll stares at you.

It is really hard to see anything here. However, this place looks evil and the air here is thick and heavy. The trees close out any light from above and no birds are singing here. You seem to be at the end of this dark valley. The only exit is to the east.
8564:
A half-rotten corpse is hanging here.
A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.
A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.
A huge stone troll looms overhead, ready to crush your body.
A huge stone troll looms overhead, ready to crush your body.
A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.

This small cave enclosed in darkness doesn't give away many secrets. There are piles of bones spread all over, and a couple of corpses give the cave a dank, foetid smell. This is the home of some trolls. The only exit from here is to the north.
8565: This appears to be just another dead end. On all sides of you there are big stone walls which prevent you from travelling in any direction except back the way you came. The trail leads to the southern wall where it abruptly ends at some loose boulders.
8566:
There are two half-rotten corpses here.
A huge stone troll looms overhead, ready to crush your body (red aura).
A huge stone giant is here, glaring at you (red aura).

The foetid smell of rotten corpses hits your senses as you enter this room. You see broken bones lying in the corners. There is a northern wall where some large rocks have been placed on each other to serve as a chair. This has to be the home of a large creature. The only exit is to the south.
8567: You have finally reached the bottom of the slope. There, are many stones here and there appears to have been some kind of water recently. Somehow the water has drained away to other places or has simply evaporated. The stones are smooth and dark green. You notice big footsteps in the soft soil. Something huge has walked these desolate parts of Arda. To the north you see a rocky wall.
8568: As you move on, you notice that the trees grow larger here. You can see that this path has not been used for a long time. It is overgrown with dry moss, and rotten leaves spot the ground. The path descends gently to the west.
8569: Everywhere around you, the Misty Mountains cover your view. There seems to be no end to these huge mountains with their white peaks. A small tree can be seen in the middle of all those boulders and rocks, its small branches reaching no further than a few feet out from the tiny, brown stem.
8570: A lone hawk soars high above you.

Everywhere around you, the Misty Mountains cover your view. Boulders and rocks make it hard for you to walk here and the vegetation is sparse. The wind is howling and freezing to your bones. Once in a while, a bird can be seen in the sky.
8571: The Misty Mountains seem invulnerable to the icy wind that blows here. It is very hard to get used to it, whipping at you all the time. Rocks and pebbles are lying all around, making travelling here tiresome. The mountains seem to never end. Once you have climbed one, there is another one waiting for you on the other side. South of you a huge rock can be seen.
8572: Towering over other big boulders and rocks, you see this one huge rock, which is the size of over ten metres across. Atop of it some bones can be seen, as if a bird had been sitting there, chewing on some dead animal and then simply dropped the remains. When you move closer to the huge rock, you see some small boulders lying in a heap beside it, they seem to cover a hole in the ground beneath this huge rock.
8573: Between rocks and boulders there seems to be a small path, though it his hard to find anything living around here who could possibly have made it. It is mostly a tiny little path, where pebbles seem to have been kicked aside. Scattered beside it, there are a few living plants and some grass, which seem more dead than alive. To the west, you see a huge mountain rising towards the sky.
8574: You find yourself north of a huge mountain, its snowy peak sparkling white. The wind from the north is freezing your bones, making them ache. But north of you there is a valley, it might suffice as shelter from the wind. Though it might be hard to get back up here again, once you have climbed or fallen down. The mountain prevents you from going south here, but there seems to be a way to circle it, if you travel southwestish. Rocks and boulders are in your way wherever you look, and it seems hard to find anything alive here.
8575: South of you the snowy peak of a huge mountain rises towards the sky, where some birds can be seen. It seems impossible to get to the top, but there is a way to circle it and get to the southern side of the mountain. North of you, the slope gets steeper and ends up in a dark valley. It seems like it would be hard to get back up here, once you have climbed or fallen down. This is a very exposed place, making the wind chilly and hard to find shelter from. Somehow, a few plants have managed to survive, hiding between the boulders.
8576: You are slowly climbing the mountain. You see no path anywhere, just a lot of stones and rocks. It is hard to walk quickly here. The mountain side you are climbing is pretty steep, sometimes when a rock comes loose, it does not stop rolling down the side until it is out of view. Further up the mountain side, the top can be seen, but there is no way to reach it. You can either travel down the mountainside again, or try to circle around the top to the northern side.
8577: North of you, a huge mountain rises towards the sky, its snow clad peak gleaming bright white. A small trail is lingering its way up the mountain, between rocks and boulders. Maybe it is possible to reach the top. South of you, the trail leading west-east is twisting through the Misty Mountains. This area seems very grey and it is hard to find anything alive here except grass and tiny plants.
8578: You find youself at the side of a mountain. North of you, a snow clad peak rises towards the sky. It blocks all your view north, but there seems to be a way to get further up the mountain if you walk east. The ground is rocky, but between the rocks, grass and other small plants have managed to survive. South of you, the trail leading west-east is lingering its way through the Misty Mountains.
8579: Boulders and rocks make it hard for you to travel here. A few plants live here but those are not what first catches your eye. A huge mountain rises northwest of you, its white peak gleaming bright. There seems to be a way towards the top somewhere west of you. South of you, the trail leading west-east lingers its way through the mountains, there seems to be a cliff hanging over it southeast of you, though it might be hard to get there. It would probably give you a good view of whoever might be travelling the trail.
8580: You find yourself on a rock above a small path. The path is twisting through the mountains and beneath you it goes through a small cleft. You have a good view of the path in both directions, west and east, and you can see if anyone travels on it. The rock you are standing on is not very stable and you had better watch your step or you might fall down.
8581:
A burly giant is here, covered with thick fur and snow.
Zagrz, wielding a steel claymore, is standing here.

Beneath this huge rock, you find a deep rocky hole, which seems to be the home of something or someone. Torn pieces of clothes, bones and other bodyparts are scattered all across this hole. The temperature is higher than above, but the air is very damp.
8582: This area of dark pine forest lies at the eastern end of a long valley. In every direction save west, high cliffs of granite loom overhead - their stark rock surface adding a forbidding aspect to this lovely vale.
8583: This narrow valley is hidden deep in the towering peaks of the Misty Mountains, kept isolated by the high cliffs that form its walls. The valley floor is home to a dense forest of pine and cedar - so dense that only on the brightest of days does an occasional beam of sunlight penetrate to the ground.
8584: You hesitate but do jump into the darkness, and you expect to die. In a few seconds you will know...
8585: The ground here is not entirely stabile, constantly giving off creaking and cracking noises as the snow shifts. Travelling in any direction but back west would be too perilous to consider.
8586: This forested valley provides a welcome respite from harsh mountains that completely encircle it. The valley is deep enough that it is sheltered from the frequent blizzards that sweep across the surrounding peaks in winter. To the northwest there is a lake fed by several waterfalls that bounce down the mountain's face.
8587: A stone troll is standing here, scowling about.

A long lake lies between the mountain peaks extending to the west. The calm surface of the water reflects the towering mountains and the sky behind them. Lumps of snow and ice float in the dark water like small islands. A majestic mountain face rises from the water on the far northern shore of the lake, and to the west this forest of pines and cedars continues. A tall spur of grey rock blocks travel eastward.
8588: Tall pines and cedars tower overhead, completely blotting out all view of the sky. To the north, a lake can be spied among the trees, probably fed by snowmelt from the surrounding peaks. The valley continues both east and west, like a verdant gash among the whites and greys of the Misty Mountains.
8589: This is the western end of an extremely deep valley. The slope to the west is extremely steep, but it is possible to scramble up to the top of a ridge. The northern portion of the valley holds a lake fed by many delicate water- falls that dance down the cliff walls. To the east, the pines and cedars form a canopy that keeps the forest floor shrouded in eternal twilight.
8590: There is some snow on the ground.

The narrow trail continues - despite the damage caused by frequent rockfalls, it is still fairly easy to follow. Down and to the east, there is a rather large valley - probably formed by some ancient glacier in a long ago time.
8591: A long lake lies between the mountain peaks extending to the west. The calm surface of the water reflects the towering mountains and the sky behind them. Lumps of snow and ice float in the dark water like small islands. A majestic mountain face rises from the water in the north, but to the south a narrow strip of rocky ground extends between the lake and the mountain.
8592: This lake is nestled in the bottom of a long valley that is completely surrounded by tall peaks. Several ribbon-like waterfalls cascade down the cliffs along the northern shore of the lake, while deep and gloomy forests fill the remainder of the valley.
8593: A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.

You walk on the surface of the glacier, and you have skilfully avoided falling down into any cracks. You are pretty close to the top of the glacier, but a huge crack prevents you from going further to the south. In a smaller crack you see something strange. It is possible to walk down into it without risking your neck.
8594: You are standing on an edge. In the shadow to the north lies a glacier. You can enter a tunnel inside it through a small hole. Down to the south you see a long steep slope filled with rocks and boulders. If you climb down, you won't be able to climb back; it's too steep for that.
8595: You find yourself at the bottom of a crack in the glacier. A pile of fallen blocks of ice makes it possible to climb up on the surface of the glacier. Apart from some blocks of ice, the ground is rocky here. A tunnel goes south and north.
8596: The tunnel goes west and south. There is a tunnel sloping upwards to the south. You know that you will soon reach an exit if you continue in that direction.
8597: You are standing on the glacier and you look around you trying to spot any safe routes that will take you across it or to the top. If you decide to move on further across this glacier, you should watch your steps carefully! If you have no experience in walking on surfaces like this, you better get off this glacier right away.
8598: The trail stops here. The glacier blocks the way. You see the top of the glacier to the south and you wonder if you can climb up there to get an overlook. To the north you see the bottom part of the glacier, lying several hundreds of metres below you. You look at the surface of the glacier and see that it is full of big cracks and rocks.
8599: You have entered a tunnel inside the glacier. The tunnel must have been made of water flowing through here. The ground is rocky and a bit wet, and the walls and the roof have a deep blue colour. The temperature is higher in here than outside and the wind isn't beating at you anymore. However, you can still see your own breath.
8600: A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.

It is really gloomy here. Tall mountains block the sun throughout the whole year. Nothing seems to live here, except some sparse bushes which are twisted into miserable forms by the wind and the snow. As the trail bend southwards, you see that it will take you to a glacier.
8601: You follow a tunnel going slightly down. You think this tunnel will lead you down to the bottom of the glacier. The world outside among the mountains of Hitheaglir is horrifying, but inside this glacier you see great beauty. The icy walls form various shades of a soft deep blue colour. The sound from the small stream echoes all over through the tunnels.
8602: The tunnel bends west here, and you have to go on your knees to get further. The floor of the tunnel is no longer rocky. The tunnel is almost cylindrical. You better be careful! Ice is slippery stuff.
8603: A huge stone giant is here, glaring at you.
Well, the tunnel didn't lead you down to the bottom of the glacier. Instead, the tunnel continues down into a hole in the mountain.
8604: There is some snow on the ground.

This ledge has a commanding view of the trails below. The cliff face to the east has a large door sealing off what appears to be a cave. To the west, a steep trail leads down to the other, larger, trails. A cave opens up to the east.

A Zaugurz orc soldier is standing here.
A Zaugurz orc soldier is standing here.

This cavern is wide at the centre but narrows to the east and north making it an ideal place for defence. A large gate has been set into the western rockwall, improving the chances to hold this cavern against intruders. Fresh markings in the eastern stonewall surround a doorway.
8606: This is a square artificial cavern with fresh marks on the stone. It is very tidy and quite warm. A bed, two chairs and some shelves make up the furniture. The only exit is back through the door.
8607: The rocky tunnel bends to and fro, stretching both to the north and to the south. The southmost end narrows and turns steeply downwards in the same place, making further travel in that direction impossible for any beast larger than a rat. Near this dip in the tunnel a metal ladder has been set into the grey rock wall, leading upwards into a cave.
8608: This is a rather small cave, circular in shape and with a diameter slightly less than thirty feet. The black rock walls are almost completely clad in blueish ice while numerous icicles and stalactites hang down from the cavern ceiling. Two metal ladders disturb the natural air of this cave, one leading down into a narrow hole and the other leading up to another cavern.
8609: The floor of this rocky tunnel is lined with numerous long and irregular rifts. Several massive stalactites hang from the ceiling high above. In a few spots, the otherwise grey rock is graced with the sparkle of some other, more metal-rich, mineral. The tunnel extends to the north and to the south.

A half-decayed corpse of a goblin lies rotting on the ground.
A small black vicious rat squeaks at you for disturbing it.
An Uruk-tarkhnarb slave is standing here.
An Uruk-tarkhnarb slave is standing here.

Large metal hooks have been set into the wall at various heights from the ground. The rock walls around some of these hooks are stained with dried blood. Some weird machines are standing in the middle of the room, probably constructed with one thing in mind - to make people talk. Fresh blood has been splattered on most of the southern wall.
8611: The air in here is very moist, and small puddles of water cover the stony floor. A large hole has been barred off with steel bars in the eastern wall. Tiny piles of small stones cover the floor in the vicinity of the bars. A large hole in the southern wall seems to lead to another cavern, and a hole in the floor is the beginning of a tunnel.

This tunnel has a very irregular floor, as if some unnatural beast had clawed rifts into it. The rock is almost black, and stalactites hang from the ceiling. Small steps have been carved into the western solid rock wall, allowing an easy climb into the extending tunnel. A massive gate is set into the southern wall. The eastern wall is covered with cracks and crevices, scars from an ancient rockslide.
8613: Narag the Zaugurz master scout is standing here.

This is a small chamber created by a rockslide not to long ago. The air is moist and the faint dripping of water can be heard. A bed has been placed in one corner of the cave, it looks like its been used recently. Small mushrooms cover most of the floor, many of them crushed.
8614:
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack is a dagger.
Gorkolung the Zaugurz master warrior is standing here.

Wooden targets resembling elves and orcs have been lined up on the far southern side of this square cavern. Cuts and markings have been slashed into the rock walls, most likely by weapons missing their targets or glancing off shields. A few fresh red stains on the stone floor indicate that combat with a bloody outcome occurred here recently.
8615:
A wooden cupboard stands here.
A small oaken table has been set here.

Four crude wooden tables have been situated in the middle of this cave, benches placed around them to allow for a brief rest during meals. Glowing coals placed in a concavity in the ground warms a thin stone slab making it possible to cook food on it. Large cupboards cover the eastern wall completely, most likely used to store huge amount of rations.
8616: This tunnel is very narrow. Sharp rocks are protruding from the walls, threatening to pierce everything they come in contact with. A light draught can be felt from the northern tunnel in this t-shaped junction.
8617:
A large bulletin board, entitled "The Zaugurz Outpost", is mounted here.
A Zaugurz orc soldier is standing here.
A Zaugurz orc soldier is standing here.
A powerful uruk of the Zaugurz tribe is standing here.
Bulgotha, the Captain of the Zaugurz outpost, is standing here.
An orkish officer of the Zaugurz tribe is standing here.

This large cave seems to have been crafted by the powers of nature, ages ago. Close to the eastern wall, a wooden platform has been constructed. Exits lead deeper into the mountain to both the north and the south. The air seems somewhat warmer to the north.
8618:
A mailbox stands here stuffed full of messages.
A filthy straw pallet is lying here.
A noticeable crack runs down one of the walls.

The warm floor of this ledge slopes slightly inwards to the middle. Black trails of smoke slowly rise towards the ceiling high above, adding to the darkness of this cave. To the south a tunnel slopes sharply downward into the depths of the mountain. Looking down, one can see a large forge cave below.
8619: A circular stone well has been built here.

A well has been built upon a stone dais in the middle of this small cavern, allowing access to water in case of a siege. The western wall of this cavern has been slightly blackened around a jagged opening leading deeper into the mountain. A constant jet of hot air flows into this chamber from this opening, warming the surroundings. The cave grows larger to the south.
8620: Ammunk, wielding a hammer, is standing here by his forge.

A crude stone forge sits in a depression of the uneven floor of this cavern, simple tools and firewood piled by its side. The fire in the forge blazes, its occasional flares turning the walls blood-red before letting them fade to black again. The broken ceiling of the cavern is supported by a few blackened rafters which can barely be seen through the smoke.
8621: An old, sturdy mine cart stands here on the end of a pair of iron rails.

The tunnel is very finely crafted, with smooth walls and floor. It ends rather abruptly to the north, where a large cave-in has left only a small hole in the wall. A pair of solid iron rails lead into the low tunnel. To the south, the tunnel opens up to a large cave. Next to the tunnel entrance a huge wheel has been mounted into the wall, connecting to an extremely thick metal wire.
8622: Mushrooms cover the floor and most of the walls of this narrow, steep tunnel. The tunnel rises to the north into what looks like a crossing. The air in here is very moist and seems to attach itself to everything it comes in contact with.
8623: Here the tunnel branches into every compass direction except west. This tunnel is very narrow, but clearly not crafted by nature. It was probably dug to connect two places with each other.
8624: The tunnel slopes from the west into the mountain to the south, where it seems to become wider. Faint metallic sounds can ocasionally be heard from that direction.
8625:
An orkish officer of the Zaugurz tribe is standing here.

A faint draft can be felt from the western exit in this tunnel going east-west. The tunnel is exceptionally straight and does not look like it was created by the forces of nature.
8626: The corpse of a large bat is lying here.

The tunnel narrows and starts sloping upwards towards the surface of the mountain. The walls here have a dark red hue originating from some kind of mineral packed into them. Small piles of bat-droppings make progress upwards somewhat harder.
8627: A bloodthirsty bat is sleeping here, hanging from the ceiling.
New markings on the rock forming this tunnel indicate that it was carved out of this massive mountain recently. A trapdoor has been set into the roof at the higher end of this steeply sloping tunnel.
8638: There is some snow on the ground.

You walk through a narrow pass. Actually, it seems to be a large crack, possibly made by a great earthquake ages ago. This pass is a shortcut to the other side of the mountain, but what awaits you there?
8639: There is some snow on the ground.

You walk through a narrow pass. Actually, it seems to be a large crack, possibly made by a great earthquake ages ago. This pass is a shortcut to the other side of the mountain, but what awaits you there? There's a trail south of you.
8640: You choose to leave the trail. It's probably a bad idea; it's easy to get lost if wandering around well off any road in these mountains. You better return to the road while it's still within range of vision. A lot of snow covers the mountains ahead.
8641: Where will this path take you? The path is very narrow here, and you have to walk very carefully to avoid falling down into certain death! You doubt it was very wise to follow this path.
8642: The icy wind chills you. You feel it blow through your clothes. You are still walking on a trail bending its way through the Mountains. You look up the mountain-sides, and realise that you would probably not escape an avalanche right here. You better move on!
8643: The path goes higher up into the mountains to the west, and to the east you see it going pretty straight forward, with a lot of small bends, though. You are surrounded by tall mountains. You see long tails of clouds hanging from the peaks as the wind is forced up the steep sides of the mountains, bringing much snow as well.
8644: The trail head east-west here. Even though the trail is rocky and windy, there has been enough traffic on it that there is a path worn down in it. When you look to the north, you can see the mountains in the distance, and when the light hits the top just right, you can see a bit of movement around the peak.
8645: The trail heads to the east and west here. There is a rocky valley to the north which you might be able to reach safely. There is a large plateau to your west, and off in the north you can see the higher peaks of the Misty Mountains. When you look close, you can clearly see that there is some sort of bird flying about the peaks.
8646: The trail bends to the east and south here. There is a dark valley to the north, and far below you, which you might be able to reach safely. There is a large plateau to your west, and off in the north you can see the higher peaks of the Misty Mountains. When you look close, you can clearly see that there is some sort of bird flying about the peaks.
8647: You are in an extremely rocky valley, and the sides of the mountains are far to steep to climb up. You can't see very far, because no matter which direction you turn, there is a boulder in your way. You should be careful, because anything could be hiding behind the rocks.
8648: You are in an extremely rocky valley, and the sides of the mountains are far to steep to climb up. You can't see very far, because no matter which direction you turn, there is a boulder in your way. You should be careful, because anything could be hiding behind the rocks.
8649: This valley has mountain walls so steep that climbing them would be inconceivable. The boulders block the view in every direction. Cavernous openings glare darkly from under the larger rocks, and one cannot be sure what manner of a creature is hiding in them.
8650: There is some snow on the ground.
You are pretty sure that you are on the right track. Few seem to travel here now, but this trail is far better than any other you have walked the last hours.
8651: There is some snow on the ground.

The air is warmer down here, but the tall mountains make the place gloomy; the sun never rises high enough to see it. The vegetation here is odd and quite different from anything you have seen before. You wish to move on and get away from these mountains. You can follow the path southwards through a narrow cleft, or follow the path up the valley-side.
8652: There is some snow on the ground.

You are in the lower part of this path going far up the mountain-side. In the valley below you, there are trees and green low vegetation, unlike the flora up in the mountains. It seems like a peaceful place, well hidden among the tall peaks of the Mountains.
8653: There is some snow on the ground.
A small path starts here. You can't get further up. You can follow the path down to the bottom of the valley. The way down is very steep with many bends.
8654: Far below, at the foot of the ridge, a small trail snakes along the side of the mountain. High up and to the west is a major peak crowned with snow. Although the landscape is too severe to reach the trail directly, perhaps it might be possible to descend at the gentler slopes to the south.
8655: This steep slope is dotted with tough evergreens that have managed to get a foothold among the rocks. At the foot of the incline there is some sort of trail - whether it was made by animals or intelligent life is impossible to tell.
8656: This path seems to lead nowhere. From this point you have a good view of some valleys leading in different directions south of you. You look for possible ways further into the mountains, but you can't find any obvious ways. You are afraid you will be lost in these unfriendly mountains if you continue further into them, but it may also be that it's a short distance to the other side. You don't know. Maybe you should try to find the path to Elrond's elven home, even though it must be pretty far away.
8657:
There is some snow on the ground.
A very strong orkish leader is here on patrol.
An orc soldier is standing here.
An orc soldier is standing here.
An orc soldier is standing here.

The trail is in a horrible state. There have been many avalanches here since last time anybody did work on this trail. You doubt you can follow this trail for long; it's hard to distinguish the trail from the rocky terrain around you.
8658: There is some snow on the ground.

You walk on this path leading downwards. All the bends makes the way down to the bottom quite long. There is a short and fast way down to the east of you, it is very steep and looks dangerous. The path turns to the west and it is hard to see where it is leading, since it is turning and twisting a lot. Stones, boulders and mountains is all you see around you. Sometimes you can hear the sound of someone running through the mountains... or maybe it is just a stone rolling down a mountainside.

A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.
A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.

This steep mountainside is hard to climb. Loose rocks and boulders makes it hard to get a good grip anywhere. Low bushes are sometimes the only thing that keeps you from falling down. Far above you a trail can be distinguished and below you the mountain is flatter and safer. This is not a very good place to stay at.
8660: You check the ground before you every step now, but you find that it is quite safe to walk here. The trail is twisting down, but will it take you anywhere? You are far away from the High Pass now. You have to find a way back, or else you will be lost in these horrible mountains forever.
8661:
There is some snow on the ground.
A mountain goat is here, jumping from cliff to cliff.

You are halfway down to the bottom of the valley. Walking on this path is exhausting, no matter whether you climb down or up. You stop a short while to let the wind dry off your sweat and then continue.
8662: This ridge runs from north to south, climbing steeply as it does. To the southwest a high peak looms - this ridge leads to the mountain's shoulder. East and west the steep slopes are too dangerous to attempt a descent - those wishing to reach lower altitudes will have to follow the ridge north.
8663: Snow and ice makes it difficult to go further. You don't see much up here because of mist. You see, however, that the mist is even thicker higher up.

The path is blocked by a heap of stones, however. You can't get any further.

This rock shelf overlooks a dizzying panorama - a fall of several hundred feet awaits to the south and east. Northward, it is possible to ascend the mountain, for though the terrain is harsh, the slope is not as great as in other places.

The summit of the mountain lies above, and it looks to be accessible by a difficult climb. Several hundred feet below lies a somewhat flat area where it might be safe to rest.
8670: Here at the peak of the mountain the world is a silent landscape of snow and ice. In every direction other mountains rear - some higher than this one - hiding the horizon from view. The slope to the south is climbable, although far from gentle, so that looks to be the only way to proceed.
8671: You are in the beginning of a large cave that extends far to the south. It is quite cold in here, and the water dripping from the ceiling quickly turns to ice as it is exposed to the frigid air. You can't see very far to the south...the cloud of steam and vapors from your breath obscures your vision.
8672: You are in a crack in the mountains that leads back to the west, or if you are daring, down further into the mountain. It is quite cold here, and you can see ice forming on the walls and ceiling, the beginnings of a complex structure of ice stalagmites and stalagtites.
8673: The walls in this place seem to be made from glass, but one painful touch lets you know that it is in fact ice. As you look around, you see bones that appear to be from a game animal, and you wonder what kind of beast could live in this desolate place.

The ice-demon is here, fighting Starbuck (SS).
Starbuck (SS), wielding a great warsword, is here, fighting the ice-demon.

As you step into this large cave, your breath comes out in steamy clouds, fogging your view of what lies ahead. However, when you hear a loud growling from behind a ice stalagmite, you fear that you have made a mistake coming to this frozen lair.
8675: Thanks to your keen intelligence and eyesight, you managed to find the crack in the mountain face. It is a very tight squeeze, but you can turn sideways and continue on to the east. As you look to continue, a strong blast of frigid air hits you from the east, and you wonder why you suddenly got very cold.
8676: A A A A A A A A A A A A A A A A A A A A A A H H H H *splat* You have just come to an abrupt ending.

The ground is extremely rough here, branch and stone. One wrong step could send an unwary traveller tumbling down the hill, for the mountains are unkind and fraught with danger.
8678: You are on a very steep slope leading up to the mountains. You can see the beginnings of a forest to your south, and think you can walk down the slope to reach it. You can also head north, heading further up the mountain and into the unknown.

8680: A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.

You have reached the eastern edge of the valley, and looking through the mist, you can see that the ground slopes up to the east, leading right into the mountains. As you look into the valley you can see yellow eyes peering at you from the mist, and wonder which direction is the lesser of all evils.
8681: You are right in the middle of the valley, and it is especially dark and damp here. The grass is knee high, and you think you feel things crawling along your leg. When you look up, instead of seeing sky you can only see the branches of large trees looming overhead.
8682:
A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.
A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.

This valley is extremely dark for the thick mist blocks out most of the sky. This valley is quite green though - perhaps a result of all the moisture accumulated here. One cannot be certain, but it almost sounds like growling off in the distance.

The mist in this valley makes everything very dark, and your light reflects off the fog, making small rainbows wherever you look. Despite this fascinating effect, everything about this valley makes you nervous, especially when you hear a loud growling in the distance.
8684: You are at the edge of the forest. The trees are just beginning to thicken now, and the ground is getting softer as you continue into the forest. As you look into the heart of the woods, it appears that the trees are moving around, as if they are trying to corral some new prey.
8685: You are in the middle of a forest, and can't see a damn thing! The mist is so thick here that you can almost see your reflection in it. When you look at the trees, they seem to be shifting about, and you can't tell which direction you are going, or even came from.
8686: You are in the middle of a forest, and can't see a damn thing! The mist is so thick here that you can almost see your reflection in it. When you look at the trees, they seem to be shifting about, and you can't tell which direction you are going, or even came from.
8687: After such a long climb, you are almost at the top of the mountains. However, judging from the size of the birds that you see there, it might be good idea just to turn around and head back to the safety of the plateau.

You can head up to the top of the mountain, but after noticing the large birds up there, it might be a better idea to just head back down into the valley.
8689: The corpse of a huge warg is lying here.

This valley is directly in the shadow of the mountains, and between that and the trees, it is nearly impossible to see beyond your light. There is very little vegetation here because of the lack of light, so the only animals around must be carnivorous....
8690: You are in a very dark valley, but not sure exactly where, because it is so dark that it is easy to get turned around. The trees here loom overhead, blocking out all shreds of light. There are many track marks on the ground, many which you recognise as canine, yet larger than any dog you have seen before.

This valley is directly in the shadow of the mountains, and between that and the trees, it is nearly impossible to see beyond your light. There is hardly any vegetation here, so the noises you hear behind you must be coming from carnivores.
8692: The ground gets very steep here, and you have to be careful to not slip and slide down the slope. There is a dark valley to your south, which is shadowed by the mountains and some very large trees.
8693: You are on a somewhat steep slope that leads directly up to the mountains. Looking up, you can see some large birds flying around the peaks. You should probably be careful of where you walk, because the ground is very rough here, and one wrong step could send you sliding down the hill.

8695: You are on a flat plateau that overlooks the trail to the east, and a dark valley to the north. The mountains loom to your west and north, making you want to stick to the safety of the plateau. There aren't very many animals around here, even though there is an abundance of plant life.
8696: You are in the middle of a flat plateau. You can see the mountains far to the north, and the Angmarian Trail further to your east. Even though there is abundant vegetation here, there aren't very many animals. It seems strange to you....
8697: You are still on this flat plateau. The walking here is very easy, even though you do have to step over many fallen trees and other bushes. You notice that the trees did not fall down naturally, but judging from all the claw marks, some very large creature was the cause.
8698:

You are still on this flat plateau, yet now there is a lone tree emerging from the ground. The tree is leaveless, and the branches barely seem to be able to hold their own weight. However, now you finally know the cause of the lack of animals, and you should leave soon if you don't want to be just another carcass on the ground.
8699: *WHEW* You have finally made it to the top. It was definitely worth the climb, because the view from here is amazing. You can see a great deal of Arda from your position here. You really would like to stay up here much longer, but the thin air and high winds make it difficult to stay here and be safe.
8700: You are on a flat, dry, and rocky plateau that heads further west. If you choose, you can go following the sloping ground east, which leads straight into the mountains.
8701: You are in a broad plateau, which is quite flat in comparison to the mountains to the east. The terrain is very rocky here, and it is quite possible that anything might come out from behind the next boulder.

8703: A slobbering giant greedily lumbers towards you.
The plateau simply ends here. If you want to continue west here, you might be in for a long fall, because the drop is extremely steep and rocky. There is nowhere to go except back the way you came.
8704: You are on a path which heads further north, or east into a fog covered forest. You are not sure what is in the forest, but every time you look at it the trees seem to move a little, as if they were closing in on some new prey.
8705: The ground here flattens out quite a bit, and the walk isn't that bad. There isn't very much vegetation here, and what little you see reminds you of the carnivorous plants. The plateau continues all directions, but you only see more of the same, flat, dusty ground.
8706: You have finally reached the end of the path. The only thing left until you reach the top is the long, difficult climb. The air is very thin here, and the stench permeating from above is very strong now. You still doubt whether or not to continue, but the urge to explore is too strong to stop now.
8707: You are in what appears to be the former den of a very large bird. The birds seem to be gone though, and their only remains are a large pile of old feathers and bones on the ground. The view from this perch is outstanding...you can see for many miles in every direction.
8708: You are on a path that is slowly winding its way up the mountain. It is starting to get hard to breathe now, because of the lack of oxygen, and the horrible odour which is coming from just a little further down the path. Looking closely, you notice some scratches on one of the larger rocks.
8709: *Nolozighar the Man*, wielding an ornamented sabre, is here searching for something, riding a pack horse.

You are on a path which leads you west up to the mountain, or east into a fog-shrouded valley. You can't see into the valley, because a thick layer of mist covers everything except the tips of the trees, which peer at you like large, green eyes.
8710: You are on a path which continues to wind up the mountain. Each step is painful as you step on rocks, stones, and what appears to be the bones of humans and various other animals. You wonder whether or not you really want to find out what is at the top of the mountain.
8711: You are on a path which continues to wind its way up the mountain. The path heads south here, and you are provided with an excellent view of what is below you, including a very strange looking circle of trees, which is surrounded by an eerie fog.
8713: You are at the edge of the broad plateau. You can see many hills to the west, but would need to grow wings to go that way, because there is no way to walk down without being seriously injured.
8716: You have reached the edge of the plateau. You can't go any further west, but there seems to be some tracks heading to the east...the only thing is, they don't look humanoid.
8718: The ground is quite rocky here, which is a good change from the rest of the plateau. You can climb up to a ridge to the east, or continue on into the plateau. As you look to the east, you can see the mountains, and catch a glimpse of something flying around the higher spires.
8719: Finally, you are seeing something other than dust and decay. The ground here is beginning to get quite rocky, and there are many rocks and boulders scattered about. As you look around one boulder, you realise what a good hiding place they make, and wonder what is hiding behind the next boulder.
8720: The ground here starts to slope up to the east, in anticipation of the mountains. Everything around is very dusty, and you are wondering what happened to all the vegetation around here.
8721: The land is very flat and dry here. As you look at the mountains and see all of the water on the mountains, you wonder how there could not be more vegetation here. It looks like there used to be a small pond here, but it has long since dried up.
8722: You are on the edge of a broad plateau. There is no way to continue further west because the land drops off suddenly. However, the drop does give you a good view of the lands to the west, and you can make out several campfires in the distance, and wonder what type of creature is camping in this desolate area.
8723: You are on a narrow ridge that overlooks a wide plateau to the west. On your east, you can see the mountains looming overhead. You wonder to yourself whether or not you really want to explore them any further.
8724: You can explore the ridge further to the east or south, or walk down to the plateau below. The plateau looks extremely dry, and you can't see a hint of green anywhere.
8725: You are on a narrow ridge that overlooks a wide plateau to the west. On your east, you can see the mountains looming overhead. You wonder to yourself whether or not you really want to explore them any further.
8726: You stand on a narrow ridge overlooking a wide plateau to the west. The eastern horizon is dominated by the tall spires of the neighbouring mountains. Their daunting heights makes you rethink whether you should continue and brave the treacherous terrain.
8727: You are on a small, extremely hazardous path in the Misty Mountains. The mountains rise up on all sides of you, and no matter which way you travel you are in for a treacherous climb, because it seems that the rocks could slip at any moment, plunging you down the mountain buried under tons of rock.
8728: You are on a small, extremely hazardous path in the Misty Mountains. The mountains rise up on all sides of you, and no matter which way you travel you are in for a treacherous climb, because it seems that the rocks could slip at any moment, plunging you down the mountain buried under tons of rock.

8733: You are on an outcropping of rock which overlooks the river valley far below. There is absolutely no way that you are going to be able to get down from here. You are just going to have to turn back the way you came.
8734: This ledge overlooks the valley and the ridge below you. The ground here is very cracked and broken, almost as if an earthquake had hit here. However, the ground is very stable, even if it is painful to walk on.
8735: You are at the end of the ridge here. You think you can climb up to a ledge here, because the cliff face is very broken and full of all kinds of handholds. You can see down into the valley from here too, and seeing the green grass reminds you of much better days.
8736: The valley ends here, and there is a large overhang to your east. The ledge is much to high to reach from here though. If you want to get up there, you will have to find a different way to go about it.
8737: The valley starts to slope up here, and the grass isn't quite as green as it is in other areas. You look at the mountains, and get a strong feeling that the reason for the change is the evil presence emanating from the north.....
8738: You are on a broad ridge which overlooks the river valley. To the north, you can see a large circle of trees. You can't tell what is in the middle though...some sort of mist is blocking your view.
8739: You are on a broad, flat ridge overlooking the river valley. The ground here is very easy to walk on, which surprises you since you are so close to the mountains. As you look down and see the river, it reminds you of how long its been since you have taken a nice refreshing dip in the water.
8740: A placid pond is here, inviting you to take a refreshing drink.

This would be the most beautiful place you have ever been, if it weren't for the ominous mountains to your north. The grass here is soft and green, and would be a perfect place for a nap. There is a small pool of water here, probably excess runoff from the mountains.
8741: You are in a lush river valley. For the first time in many miles, you feel at peace. However, one look north at the mountains reminds you of the dangers which surround you.
8742: Plain and simple, this place stinks! The walls are covered with furs of various animals, including some wargs. There are bits and pieces of bone and flesh scattered all over the floor, making footing slippery and treacherous.
8743: You are right underneath the large ridge you were just walking on. You can climb back up if you want, but not sure if it would be a great idea. As the wind howls above, it draws with it a stench from the west, which reminds you of rotting meat.
8744: You are amidst a circle of trees, all which tower above you like hideous giants. You attempt to see into the centre of the circle, but a strange mist blocks your view, and the only thing you can make out is a slight hint of movement.
8745: Reaching the centre of the massive circle of trees, you enter an area of thick and cloying fog. The fog seems almost alive, its sinuous tendrils reaching around to caress your clammy skin. An illogical fear builds in your soul, and you wonder how long you can stay here before sheer terror forces you to leave.
8746: You are amidst a circle of trees, all which tower above you like hideous giants. You attempt to see into the centre of the circle, but a strange mist blocks your view, and the only thing you can make out is a slight hint of movement.
8747: You are amidst a circle of trees, all which tower above you like hideous giants. You attempt to see into the centre of the circle, but a strange mist blocks your view, and the only thing you can make out is a slight hint of movement.
8748: The trail leads north-south here. There is a broad plateau to the west, and in the north you can make out the spires of the Misty Mountains. Looking at the mountains gives you a great feeling of awe at their majesty, and a feeling of dread of what lies within them.

8750: The trail turns to the west and south here, providing you with an excellent view of the mountains. The hills surrounding you are relatively flat, but there are so many rocks and boulders in the way, that you are afraid you would get lost in there.

8754: The hills here are not steep, but there are boulders everywhere, making you watch your every step. You thought that you were just next to the trail, but as you look around, you are not sure where you are anymore.
8755: You risk your life climbing in these mountains. The mountain sides that are not covered with snow, are very rocky. You must walk very carefully, or soon you will be sliding down the mountainside among tons of loose rocks. South of you, you see a trail going east-west.
8756: You have reached the top of one of the climbable mountains. It is not one of the tallest, but you have a fair view. You spot two possible trails through the Mountains; one on the southern side of this mountain, and one down on the northern side of this mountain.

Strange claw marks on the walls and scattered bones on the floor may give you some idea that whatever lives here is not friendly. But looking at the seemingly random scratches, you notice that they may actually be a crude form of writing.

Rocks and debris lie strewn about the floor of this gully. The sides have been worn smooth with the passing of water from many winter storms, but no water is in evidence at the moment. The gully leads south, where it makes a bend to the east, or you can climb back up a narrow channel in the mountainside.
8765: A hungry warg stands here, sniffing around for flesh.

Here the gully bends to the east and north. You can spot no way to climb up the mountainside from here, and so you must follow the crude path along the bottom of this depression to wherever it may take you.
8766: The ditch bends to the west and south here, and to the south you spot a large pile of rocks seeming to block off any further progress. To the west you can see that the gully makes another bend to the north again. You can see no way of climbing the mountain from here, so for better or worse you must follow the path you are on.

A huge olog-hai troll is here staring blankly at you.
A huge olog-hai troll is here staring blankly at you.

The floor is littered with refuse giving off a vile smell, and you would prefer not to know what you were standing in. Strange snuffling noises come from the north, behind the sturdy door, making you wonder what sort of animal is kept in here.

Rotten straw is all the evidence of bedding in this cell, and a small channel running down the side of the room is obviously the sanitation. The smell in here is even worse than the smell outside, making you want to throw up.

This cave looks like it was a full scale exercise in depravity. Filth has been smeared over the walls, human remains lie in grotesque positions strewn all about the floor. A strange scratching noise can be heard coming from the east.
