21531: This part of the forest is dominated by a veritable storm of little seedlings that have been stirred up by the gentle warm breeze that blows through this comfortable forest. They catch the light of sun, moon or stars and play with it, dazzling the onlooker with a sea of glinting, floating shapes.
21532: The trees and undergrowth get thinner to the east where a stream passes through the forest. Running from the north to the south, it grows steadily ever wider, as it makes its way towards the Celebrant. The rushing water has cut deeply into the streambed, making it impossible to get down to the stream from the tree-covered bank.
21533:
A man's-waist high evergreen shrub grows here, with bright green branches.
On the shrub, there are two piles of splayed leaves.
An elven lady is walking around here.

Thick, lush grass grows to two feet and higher on this small plot of land that is wedged between a small pool to the north and a running stream to the east. This seems like the perfect place for a tired traveller to lie down and gaze up at the graceful interwoven boughs of mellyrn adorned with flowers and leaves of gold or pale green.
21534:
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
An elven lady is walking around here.

The mallorn-trees here are neither very young, nor too tall; most likely, the soft soil near the stream does not allow for deep roots, limiting their growth. The shorter trees allow more light through to the ground and more flowers to grow among the tree-trunks. The golden and white elanor and niphredil here are joined by various flowers of pink and soft blues.
21535: The mallorn-trees stand in a circle here. Their limbs stretch towards the centre of the circle in a manner that makes this clearing look like a temple or a gathering place. One could imagine a festival or wedding being held here, among the silvery-grey mallorn trunks standing tall like the pillars of a grand building.
21536:
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A squirrel scampers around here, looking for nuts from the trees.

The forest of Lorien spreads out all around. Crowning each silvery bole, the green or golden foliage seems to shine and radiate warmth inside your very being. A large cluster of elanor flowers grows here at the base of one of the mellyrn, their faint aroma wafting through the air.
21537:
A patch of star-shaped moss covers the ground.
A small harmless centipede is here.
A woodpecker is here, tapping on a tree.
A finch flies low above the ground.

The forest completely encloses the small glen, giving it the look of a sheltered dwelling. Light barely penetrates the layer of boughs, and all sounds appear to be muffled. Upon the base of one of the thicker mallorn-trees some marks have been etched.
21538: The golden boughs of the mellyrn intertwine together to create a golden arbour. The mellyrn are joined by the golden blooms of elanor and pale flowers of niphredil that sprout along the base of the trees. Many other forest flowers in pastel shades dot the grassy turf. Many small bushes and shrubs grow between the trees, making passage through the forest difficult.
21539: A dense carpet of blue flowers dip their heads in the breeze.

The trees part in a small sliver high above that lets in enough sunlight during the day for the grass to grow thick and lush. This part of the forest seems to be the beginning of a thick section that extends to the north and west. The trees and shrubs that grow here impede passage to anyone not as light of foot as the elves that dwell in the Golden Wood. To the south, the sounds of a running river can be faintly heard.
21540:
A woodpecker is here, tapping on a tree.
A squirrel scampers around here, looking for nuts from the trees.

In this part of the forest the golden mellyrn dominate, but smaller clumps of birches and elms can be seen here and there. The forest floor is carpeted with lush grass and the blooms of previous years. The forest thickens to the north and west, but diminishes to the south and east.
21541:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A colourful butterfly is fluttering around here.

The trail of well-trodden grass leads up to a stream to the west. One can hear the soft gurgling of water as it makes its way over the rocks in the stream. A light, airy scent of flowers and fresh water is in the air. The mellyrn stand tall, soaring seemingly straight to the heavens. Their silvery trunks block the way to the north and south, making it impossible to enter the Golden Wood proper. The path leads away from the stream eastwards.
21542:
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A partridge attempts to hide in the undergrowth.

Many flowers speckle the sides of this forest trail as it makes its way along a stream. Tiny yellow flowers, named elanor by the elves, along with the pale blooms of the niphredil, poke out from the lush green grass. Their faint aroma barely reaches your nose.
21543: This shaded part of the forest offers some comfort for those weary from life on the road. The silvery-trunked trees have a light mossy coating that is soft and cool to the touch. The plush green grass is dotted with the fragile pale yellow mallorn blooms that have dropped from above. A little hole in the ground at the base of a nearby mallorn shows evidence that a family of chipmunks or other small forest creatures lives here.
21544:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A roe deer is standing here, watching the terrain while chewing the vegetation.

The trail begins to wind its way through the forest, a small stream ambling along in parallel with it, at some distance to the west. The sound of running water gurgling down the streambed as it makes its course towards the main river can clearly be heard from this spot.
21545: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The trail bends here to avoid the stream which is beginning to pick up its pace as it heads from the north to join to the main arm of the mighty Celebrant to the south. The trail continues on to the north and to the east, its turf soft and springy - not the hard matted dirt of most forest trails.
21546: The majesty of the Golden Wood continues to radiate, as the heart of this seemingly undying land is revealed for all to see. When light of the skies falls from above, the pale yellow and gold hues of the mallorn crowns cast a warm glow on the surroundings. A couple of mallorn nuts have fallen at the base of one of the trees.
21547: A squirrel scampers around here, looking for nuts from the trees.

The golden-laden mellyrn boughs open up a little bit here. The fresh scents of grasses and flowers fill the air. To the east the trees fall away completely, revealing a clearing in the woods, in the heart of the Naith. The lack of trees ahead allows the sunlight to cascade on this area during the day, and at night the moonlight adds a silvery tint.
21548: This part of the Golden Wood continues to display the treasures of Lothlorien. The forest floor is covered in the remnants of golden blooms which have fallen from the canopy above during previous years. Were these blooms gathered into a bed, they might make the most comfortable resting place ever.
21549: Sharp Turn in the Winding Trail
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The trail makes a sharp turn here and heads both south and west. Sounds of the forest glide to your ear. You can hear the creaking of the trees, the rustle of the leaves, lilting animal cries in the distance and countless other sounds that, added together, seem a symphony.
21550: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The trail here is a straight passage from north to south. The grass is very wet, especially on the west side of trail, kept moist by the forest stream. The flowers near the stream grow tall and their scent seems almost to be overpowering. Strange mosses also grow near the stream; their golden-greenish hue matches the mallorn foliage nearly identically.
21551: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The forest trail continues on its path from north to south here. It never leaves the side of the stream, as both travel from the northern edges of the Naith to the southern edge of Lorien marked by the mighty Celebrant River which flows down from the mountains under which the dread Moria lies.
21552:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A squirrel scampers around here, looking for nuts from the trees.

A path comes from the north and seems to lose shape as it continues eastward. To the east, the lush green grass of the forest trail gives way to a myriad of grasses, leaves and twigs intermingled with some trees. There is a river to the west, flowing gently to the south.
21555: A colourful butterfly is fluttering around here.

The Celebrant flows by just south of here. The banks of the river are steep and firm. From the sides of the banks, the roots of the mellyrn protrude and dip into the sweet waters of the Celebrant river that has dug a deep channel through this forest. A barely visible trail runs from east to west among the trees. The forest spreads out in all directions bar south, as far as the eye can see.
21556: At the Border of the Naith

A faint trail meanders through the thick undergrowth here, getting more distinct to the east and almost disappearing among the trees to the west. To the south, the Silverlode cuts a deep channel through the forest. It is possible to scramble down the riverbank to the water. Beyond the river the unprotected forest lies, different in look and feel. The short distance between the northern and southern bank feels like a great gap, as by crossing it one would leave the Naith of Lorien, the protected elven land.
21557: A pleasant trail winds its way right along the edge of the river. It swerves up and down, left and right, as it follows the carefree dance of Celebrant on its way south. On its other side, the trail is bordered by an imposing forest of mellyrn, same as can be seen on the other bank of the river. Small pebbles are scattered along the path. Judging from the intermittent patches of grass on the south bank, the river used to be farther from the path once before claiming its current bed.
21558: Along the Borders of the Naith
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.

A narrow clearing, a soft carpet of green grass and golden elanor, is squeezed in between the golden forest and the silver stream. A tiny trail runs southeast here, away from the horrors of Moria and toward the wonders of the Heart of Lorien. The clearing slopes gently toward the river, whose waters whoosh as an occasional wave washes a golden flower away in its embrace.
21559: A clear and pleasant trail winds its way along Celebrant. It bends from west to south here following the course of the river along its northern bank. The trail seems barely trodden for it was made by the light elven feet of Galadhrim rangers who go across the river to gather news and to defend the borders of Lothlorien from the evil that walks Dimrill Dale and the Mountains beyond.
21560: Under the Eaves of the Golden Wood

A golden spider rests on a tree-branch.
A sturdy pack horse is standing here.
A blue dragonfly is circling around.

A smooth narrow trail runs under a great archway of mallorn trees here. Their golden boughs interweave forming an intricate pattern of shimmering yellow on blue above the head of a rare traveller. Celebrant glitters through the trees to the southwest. Its melodious soft voice can be heard for many miles around. The trail bends from north to east here as it follows the river on its way to the sea, as the spirit of Nimrodel rushes to be reunited with that of Amroth, her lover.
21561:
A restless rabbit bounces around.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

Smooth and straight runs the trail here. The smell of trodden grass and that of the river to the south combine to become, by a peculiar stroke of fate, that of seawater. The voice of Celebrant magnifies this illusion, for here it sounds like a thousand waves beating tirelessly at the forgotten shore of a land that is no more.
21562: Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.

A large grove of golden mellyrn presides over the forest here. Their great grey trunks are of mighty girth and gigantic height. A bright vertical streak fades in and out of existence upon the bark of one of the trees as a light wind disturbs the forest. Patches of tiny golden flowers grow beneath the closely growing trees and scintillate merrily when they catch light. The river whispers gently and peacefully to the southwest.
21563:
A patch of star-shaped moss covers the ground.
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
A bee flies around here, collecting nectar from the flowers.
An elven boy is running about here.

Eternal twilight reigns here, for the crowns of mellyrn are too thick and well spread to let sun in during the day or starlight during the night. Yet the air shimmers with an eerie afterglow that plays upon the silver bark of the trees and makes dust particles in the air shine. Pale niphredil grows amid the short grass and the snowflakes of silvery moss.
21564: A blue dragonfly is circling around.

The long, delicate but insistent fingers of ivy-like underbrush caress the flawless silvery bark of the mallorn trees. It grows to the height of human waist here, impeding passage of anything live. Celebrant's calming song comes from the southwest, but it is barely loud enough to be heard here. Its timbre varies with the wind as if the forest and the river were singing a duet.
21565: The golden forest thickens to the south and thins out to the east of here. The solid grey boles of the older mallorn trees stand firm and tall, witnesses to centuries of peace that came before. The slender stems of younger mellyrn quiver with the wind while maintaining the air of antiquity, which weighs on the forest like the drops of water weigh on the leaves after a summer rain.
21566: A golden spider rests on a tree-branch.

The Golden Wood surrounds you in all its majesty and magnificence. The silvery branches of mellyrn and their golden crowns are similar to a stained window with pieces of sky strewn in among silver and gold. The picture keeps changing with every wisp of the wind. Celebrant's subdued voice comes from the south interwoven with the rustling of trees and the singing of birds.
21567: A small grasshopper clings to a blade of grass, ready to spring.

The mallorn trees wind in a circle around a small glade. When light of the skies falls onto the glade, it catches in the golden tree-crowns and makes the majestic silvery trunks gleam with silvery radiance. The lush green grass is steeped with moisture, being so close to the river. All in all, this place is a scene of the delicate beauty that can be found only in the Golden Wood.
21568:
A tall stag is here, grazing peacefully.
A partridge attempts to hide in the undergrowth.

The forest floor is uneven here, with great roots sticking out of it here and there, impeding passage. Between the roots on the ground are what appear to be many small stones lying among the graceful stems of the thick green grass. Upon closer inspection it becomes apparent that these perfect ovals are the silver-shaled nuts that have fallen in abundance from the mellyrn all around. In all directions, the wide expanse of the Golden Wood extends.
21569:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A colourful butterfly is fluttering around here.

The Golden Wood spreads out all around. Huge silvery trunks of the mellyrn dominate the forest, their golden crowns reflecting and radiating all the light around you to create a dazzling effect. It appears as if there is a path here, leading west and south, but it is very faint and might be no more than an animal trail.
21570: A great mallorn tree dominates this part of the forest, its branches overhanging a hundred yards of the forest turf. The aromatic scent of its blooms is truly pungent here, with blossoms from seasons past still littering the forest floor. Upon closer inspection, a thin rope ladder can be seen, its colours merging with the grey bark of the tree.
21571:
A small animal, all covered in spines, snuffles amongst the undergrowth.
A small grasshopper clings to a blade of grass, ready to spring.

An elven trail through the Golden Wood passes directly to the west of here, its well-trodden turf easily noticeable against the longer grass. The grass grows especially thick and deep in this part of the forest that is nearly surrounded by the waters of the Celebrant and its tributaries. All around the mellyrn rise, intermingled with birch and elm trees.
21572: The sounds of the forest echo in your ears. The rushing water of the stream can be heard to the west, but it is by far not as noisy as it would be were one to stand right at the stream bank. The noise from a distance somehow makes this part of the forest seem all the more peaceful by the contrast it affords.
21573: The silvery bark on the trees glitters faintly, making images of an ancient past dance in front of your eyes. The glory of Lothlorien is but a mere hint at the ancient kingdom of old. Someday, even this realm will be gone, as the prophecy foretells.
21574:
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.

This little clearing in the Golden Wood opens up to a small mound covered by the lush, green grass and the forest flowers. Tall, golden stalks of some flowering plant surround the mound. The aroma of many blossoms pervades this area, but does not overpower.
21575:
A small cluster of clover grows here.
A large elk is standing here, chewing grass and leaves.

A tall cliffside rises to the west, the firm ground holding up well against the wear of ages. A few mallorn trees grow here, hardly tall enough to reach halfway to the cliff top, though still spectacularly well-grown compared to any normal tree. Luxurious grass tickles the side of the cliff and the heels of the mellyrn, its green prominence invading all space among them.
21576: This clearing in the forest of Lothlorien gives way to a cliff that overlooks a good part of the Naith below. Far away to the east, the fair city of Caras Galadhon may be descried by none but the keenest eye. The ground falls away sharply to the east. To the west, the clearing continues.
21577: A small cluster of clover grows here.

Beautiful mellyrn are all the trees that grow here, their kingly golden crowns, each one of a kind, glittering with every gust of the wind. Their grey trunks are elven spears like none others, pointing into the sky defensively as if to protect this enchanted land from whatever may attack it from above. A tall hill rises to the southeast of here. From this side it looks unclimbable.
21578:
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
A patch of star-shaped moss covers the ground.

Polished grey boles of the many mallorn trees that grow here dazzle the eye, while their golden branches enchant with their beauty. The arms of the mallorn trees rise high into the sky, bow-shaped, as if to cradle it in their caring hands. A few snowflakes of forest moss sprinkle the ground along with an occasional golden or silver star-shaped flower.
21579:
A waist-high evergreen shrub grows here, with thick, reaching branches.
On the shrub, there are two piles of grey-green leaves.
A pretty elven girl is strolling around here.

The land drops sharply here, plummeting a hundred feet down an overgrown forested incline before coming to rest in some thick sage bushes at the foot of the hill. A few undersized mellyrn struggle to stand straight, their roots plunging deep into the hillside. Fanuidhol stands out in the distance, the tall white spur jutting into the clouds surrounding it like a wizard's hat.
21581:
A patch of star-shaped moss covers the ground.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

The mallorn trees, each holding a piece of the soul of Lothlorien, are prominently exhibited here in all their glory and splendour. Light is playing on their silver trunks creating an illusion of water running down them. Like first winter frost, the ground is touched by a silver web of snowflake-shaped moss spread out close to the trees themselves. A half-domed hill rises to the north of here.
21582: Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.

The forest here is a tonal pandemonium in shades of pearl, silver, and grey, with hints of mauve and blue peeking out of the shadows. Vermillion of the mallorn crowns accentuates the vertiginous nature of the colour scheme native to this land. For indeed, the dazzling visual display, that is this forest, is like no other spot upon the mortal lands.
21583: A woodpecker is here, tapping on a tree.

The stylish caprice, that is the green strands of ivy laying its way through the gossamer-soft silvery moss, is glimmering within the ever-moving gold-tinted patches of light. It filters through the gilded branches of mellyrn growing here. A quiet forceful purpose is present in the flamboyant tangle that produces this effervescence, though there is no self-evident recurrent motif.
21584:
A patch of star-shaped moss covers the ground.
A tall stag is here, grazing peacefully.

Droplets of light shimmer into existence and vanish just as quickly as the wind touches the golden crowns of the mellyrn, casting shadows on their stiffly upright naked grey boles. No underbrush grows here but the silvery moss that requires little light to spread. A peaceful atmosphere stretches for miles around, for few things are capable of disturbing the magics of this ancient wood.
21585: A patch of orange mushrooms springs from the ground here.

Silver trunks and golden leaves or flowers - it is a simple yet utterly breathtaking combination. Such is the forest in this part of Lorien where only mallorn trees grow. The underbrush is thick here, but soft and supple to the touch, like birch sprouts in spring. Celebrant sings its lullaby to the south, but whether it is for the gentle creatures of the Naith or for the few travellers and elven rangers away from home, one cannot tell.
21586: This is a snug little corner of this sprawling forest. The light does not penetrate too deep in here, allowing thick mosses and little ferns to flourish in this part of the wood. Tall, thick-trunked mellyrn block the way to the west, north and east, but to the south the forest opens before you.
21587: Great, silvery mallorn trunks plunged into the deep, lush, green grasses of the forest dominate the landscape here. The grass is so tall that it makes a loud rustling sound whenever any creature moves through it.
21588: For some reason, a circle of white stones gathered from the river has been constructed here. Whether it was designed as a spot for meditation among the beautiful mellyrn of this forest, or was simply the product of a child's afternoon activity, it is hard to determine.
21589: The forest floor takes an abrupt turn downward to the east, making travel in that direction unwise. The valley below stretches out before you, but there are better vantage points of the valley to the north of here, where the incline turns into a cliff.
21590: The land slopes down eastwards from here at a gentle angle, not impeding the growth of the mallorn trees, but making their roots grow in a more spread out fashion. The cosy places among the roots and just under the grey trunks make for excellent hiding places for small forest animals. The golden forest stretches out in all directions. To the north a small clearing is visible.
21591: A long-bodied animal with thick brown fur bounds through the trees.

Upwards and onwards, the mallorn trees strive to reach the sky and to embrace their brethren at the same time, their thin elegant arms holding their many hands in a mock parody of a universal handshake. Star-shaped silver moss conceals the soft brown ground here. The golden forest parts to the north.
21592: A sturdy swing is hanging here from a lonely mallorn.

Trampled grass, so unusual for this land, strewn with flowers and thick dishevelled sage bushes grows under a lone sprawling mallorn tree. Weighed down by a flet, the ancient tree seems to have grown wide out and around as if to cradle it within its mighty paws. An elven ladder is hanging along the trunk of the tree. A sturdy swing made of the same kind of rope as the ladder is attached to one of the stronger branches.
21593: In the Shadow of a Hill

A small grasshopper clings to a blade of grass, ready to spring.
A nightingale is here, chirping a sweet melody.

A steep incline levels out here. This part of the forest is destined to spend most of its days in shadow, as the hill to the east obscures it from the sunrise and Misty Mountains conceal it from the sunset. The golden forest is relatively sparse here with little underbrush to hamper the passage and plenty of animal tracks criss-crossing the ground each and every way.
21594: A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

This forest refuge is the abode of many forest animals. The soft ground is dug up in many places between the roots of the famed mallorn trees. Their burnished crowns dazzle with their exuberance. Mounds of yellow leaves are piled up against the glossy silvery trunks. A fairly tall hill is silhouetted against the sky eastwards.
21595:
There are two mushrooms here.
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
A patch of orange mushrooms springs from the ground here.

A collapsed tree in the middle of the clearing houses several mushroom patches. Red, brown, purple and yellow, the mushroom caps come in all shapes and sizes - a merry variety to go with the golden petals of elanor and gossamer stars of niphredil that grow nearby. All around, the golden forest rises, as if protecting the peace of this small pastoral corner of the world.
21596: The forest rolls downhill to the east here, continuing on an incline that began somewhere to the west. Leaves and blooms from previous springs litter the forest floor. An uncautious traveller could slip and find himself sliding down this forested slope.
21597: A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.

This part of the forest presents a picture that is quite unusual for the Golden Wood: one of the mellyrn here seems to be dying. The rocky soil by the cliff does not seem to be providing enough sustenance for the graceful tree, and its once golden boughs and silvery trunk have turned a sickly yellow and dirty brown.
21598: The mallorn trees begin to give way to sunlight to the east as the ground nears the edge of a small cleft. From here it is impossible to see how far the drop off is. With the increased sunlight in this area, various types of scrub brush and other low-lying plants have been able to flourish. The colours of their flowers engage the eye. Pastel blues, reds, and oranges mix with the abundant gold and silver of the mallorn trees, making the sight a feast for the eyes.
21599:
A colourful butterfly is fluttering around here.
A partridge attempts to hide in the undergrowth.

The forest continues down a slight grade towards the east. One can see the mellyrn of various heights that stand to the east. The reddish-orange sunrise over the golden tree-tops must make a magnificent sight. All over the forest floor divots can be seen, indicating that some forest creatures have been foraging for food here.
21600:
A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.
A pretty elven girl is strolling around here.

The trail snakes in and out of the golden forest running all the while along the north bank of the river. The south bank of the Silverlode is shrouded in grey mist which makes it seem far more remote than it actually is. Tall mellyrn are stretching their golden boughs over the trail as if trying to shelter it from unfriendly eyes lurking in the haze to the south, but on the land of Lorien no shadows lie.
21601: The trail dives into a grassy hollow, which is concealed by the overhanging branches of mellyrn from all sides except south, where Celebrant flows unhindered. Two short square pillars of smooth white stone guard the clearing close to the water. The top of the eastern column is cut off diagonally so that when looking from the river, the guiding star carved into its top can be seen. The western pillar has a metal ring attached to it, and the floor of the hollow close to it is lined with traces of boats dragged ashore. The noses of a few boats are peeking from the grass.
21602: The Elven trail runs through the golden forest, unnoticeable but for the lighter bough dance and the lack of underbrush activity. The magnificent mallorn-trees, the only trees in this forest, are crowned with gold and garbed in grey with a silvery sheen on the southern parts of their boles, the latter being just a reflection of the swift waters of Celebrant.
21603:
A small grasshopper clings to a blade of grass, ready to spring.
A restless rabbit bounces around.

A trodden path goes up and down a green hillock here. Just to the south, Celebrant glistens silver-grey behind a row of mallorn trees. The hillock rises as an island amidst the sea of gold, its mellyrn threatening to hide the sun with their sprawling silvery branches.
21604: A Stone upon the Forest Path

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A restless rabbit bounces around.

The elven path widens here to form a small circular clearing, encased, like a precious jewel in a necklace, within a ring of stunningly beautiful leafless mellyrn. A round flat stone, that travellers can rest their weary feet on, is set in the middle of the clearing. The trail runs around the stone eastward toward the heart of the wood and the final elven abode.
21605:
A restless rabbit bounces around.
A restless rabbit bounces around.

Eastward bound, the path goes downhill here, briefly disappearing into the thick underbrush at the bottom of the hill. It runs under the eaves of the mellyrn of the legendary Golden Wood, the subject of many a tale in the world outside, both good and evil. Their grey stalks enclose the path, and their wide spread branches with golden leaves or flowers upon them shelter it from the unfriendly eyes.
21606:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.

A lightly trodden path winds its way through the Golden Wood. The forest is thick here. Its low hanging branches are obscuring the view and impeding the way. Silver-wrapped Celebrant glistens through the golden filigree of mallorn crowns to the south. The trail, adorned with ghostly niphredil, runs west to east here toward the heart of Lorien.
21607: Running east and west, the small forest trail follows the Celebrant, balancing precariously on its steep bank. Standing tall and proud, though not so numerous, the golden trees of Lothlorien, the mellyrn, are lined up like an army column along the trail. Soft whispers can be heard from within the ranks of the trees as the wind gently brushes past the great boughs.
21608:
A large thorny branched shrub is growing here.
On the shrub, there are four piles of blackberries.

Running atop the sheer cliff, this small trail follows the curve of the fair Celebrant like a faithful lover, never straying from its side. The drop to the river is a fair distance and the raging waters speak of a lost love too sad to endure. Just north of the trail, the sparse forest stands serene and contemplating, whispering softly the concealed words of passion and comfort.
21609:
A nest is here.
A cute, fluffy owlet is waiting here for its mother to return with food.
A cute, fluffy owlet is waiting here for its mother to return with food.
A great horned owl looks cautiously around it.

Rising high above the Celebrant, the rocky outcrop lies bare as all the soil has been swept away by gentle winds. Far below, the white rapids rage unhindered, casting white foam-spray high into the air and creating a deafening sound. Not far off, to your northwest, grow the thick mallorn woods, striving towards the distant sky, ever reaching higher and higher.
21610: High above the Celebrant, close to the edge of the cliff runs this small trail. Bordered by the dense mallorn forest and the deep ravine in which the river flows, it offers a splendid view. The soothing sound of the flowing water from below blends with the whispering of the forest as the wind gently blows through the tree-tops.
21611: The forest here is sparse, allowing the tall grey mellyrn to stretch their boughs towards the skies above. The spacing of the trees allows the light of sun and stars to reach the ground, dispelling the grey shadows that rest between the great silvery boles of the noble trees.
21612: Just north of the small forest trail, the woods become less dense, allowing the light of sun, moon or stars to filter down and illuminate the trunks, creating marvellous displays of shadow and light. As the wind blows, the patterns twist and change, giving the impression of movement among the trees.
21613: A sprawling green bush of stinging nettle grows here.

Specks of gold fly across one's field of vision, as the mallorn leaves succumb to the light wind that seemingly chases the pale ghosts of antiquity down the untrodden pathways of time. The age-old growth impedes passage although light is ample here and the mallorn trees are sparse.
21614: Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.

A complicated sheer arrangement of fine white branches, silhouetteted against the sky, completes this forest sanctuary. The effervescent golden crowns of the mellyrn project a gossamer web of ghostly light on the ground, highlighting the patches of grass dotted with diaphanous white flowers of niphredil. The branches grow lower and thicker in the southern part of the forest, impeding the passage, but offering even more compelling views into the nature's stained glass windows to the world.
21615: The mallorn trees of this grove are quite typical of their kind, but for the naked limbs raised to the sky. The forest here has the untanned look of late winter for the trees have neither the golden flowers of early spring, nor the gilded leaves of late autumn that bestow upon the mallorn crowns their customary burnished royal look. The loss lends the forest an eerily pale outline and a subtle air of vulnerability. Unyielding but lush, some evergreen bushes linger further along south, toward the warmer parts of the land.
21616: Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.

The tiny sparks of gold and silver reverberate along the shimmering expanse of the boundless grass blanket that conceals the ground. This arresting effect comes from the fragile stalks and delicate flowers of the ghostlike niphredil and the thin semi-transparent mallorn leaves, somewhat disturbed by a faint wind. The mallorn trees reign the elven forest as far as the eye can see, though they seem to be particularly vigilant and implacable further south.
21617:
A bright red mushroom is growing here.
A patch of orange mushrooms springs from the ground here.

The mallorn trees stretch languidly toward the sky, dazzling in their display of the luscious golden crowns and the glorious pallor of the boles. The young offshoots, shorter and scantier clad, are languishing in the shade of their mighty parents, content to wait in twilight for the dawning of a new age. Abundant green underbrush camouflages the ground and partly the view to the south.
21618: A small grasshopper clings to a blade of grass, ready to spring.

Grand, tall, and erect, the mallorn trees of Lorien are a marvel to behold. They are a solid presence, a promise of permanence and peace in the world where barriers crumble and races dwindle and disappear. At the same time, they seem eerily distant, for such wholesomeness and purity of shape and colour does not exist within the Middle-earth anymore, but for a few patches of elven land that have mysterious powers of their own. To the south, the trees huddle protectively, spaced much closer than in other places. But while one's passage might be inconvenienced by this, the view remains just as commanding.
21619: An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

This part of the wood seems younger than the rest, if one can compare eternity with eternity that is a few ages less. The golden mallorn trees are slender and tall here, their bodies shooting into the sky like arrows, but their crowns not far spread enough yet to hide the sky. Gold, silver and green dominate the wood - the colours that are pure and timeless as the land of Lorien itself. These colours are significantly deeper to the south where the forest thickens like a protective barrier.
21620: A finch flies low above the ground.

The ancient forest soars silently about you as if transplanted here from some long-forgotten lay. Its silvery trees, tall and mighty, are crowned with a roof of golden fire. Light fresh wind plays joyfully among their silvery trunks. At a distance, a river murmur can be heard from what seems like every direction - a trick of sound for the forest of gold and green stretches for miles blocking every view.
21621:
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A dove is standing here.

The silver mellyrn part here, the thinning wood giving way to a grassy clearing, its floor studded with tiny star-shaped golden flowers. The ground rises to the east where the clearing turns into a hill upon which a large grey monolith can be seen. The golden forest stretches for miles and miles around you. The raised clearing gives you a good view of its golden roof which staunchly hides everything that goes on underneath it.
21622:
A round tangle with waxy leaves and white berries grows on a branch nearby.
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.

North and downhill, the ground plunges from a high clearing and into an ever- thickening golden canopy that is Lorien's indigenous flora. The mallorn trees that constitute it stand out of it, drawn in precise and sure strokes, but with a mysterious suggestion echoing in the aristocratic curves of their branches.
21623: Quest: elven ropemaker (bring him a hithlain plant)

An elven ropemaker is fiddling with some thread here.
A golden spider rests on a tree-branch.

The magnificent mallorn trees rise high here, as if pasted into this landscape from some ancient elven tale of fame and glory. Destined to guard this land until the last of elven race has passed away beyond the confines of this world, they cow lesser trees with their graceful outline and noble stature. A hill rises to the north of here. In all other directions the forest grows even deeper.
21624: At the Bottom of the Hill

A nearly vertical hillside rises to the north right in front of a small open space closely surrounded by an ancient forest of tall gold-crowned trees. Two strands of the same ivy bush, its leaves a deep luscious green, run up the hillside parting slightly and then meeting up again where they end, forming a circle. The top of the hill is barely visible, but some switchbacks run up the side of it from some spot to the east.
21626:
A waist-high evergreen shrub grows here, with thick, reaching branches.
On the shrub, there are two piles of grey-green leaves.
A low shrub with bright green, oblong leaves is growing here.
Scattered in and on the shrub, there are three piles of blueberries.

Sporadic, cheerily green vegetation dominates the landscape here. Sage and berry bushes, and the flowers are enjoying unrestricted access to the sun as very few trees grow here. The few that do are young mellyrn, their silvery trunks and golden crowns benefiting greatly from the contrast with the green background of the forested hillside to the south.
21627: A blue dragonfly is circling around.

The ground slopes downwards to the north at a rather uncomfortable angle, but that does not seem to hinder the trees of the golden forest. Mighty mellyrn, all of them, the trees seem to penetrate the skies with their tops and illuminate it with the fine web of their golden branches glinting merrily at any time of the day, whether in the light of Sun, or Moon, or stars. A hill rises to the south of here, though it looks too steep to climb from this side.
21628:
A placid pond is here, inviting you to take a refreshing drink.
There is a huge, pyramidal beehive here.
A bee flies around here, collecting nectar from the flowers.
A bee flies around here, collecting nectar from the flowers.
A bee flies around here, collecting nectar from the flowers.
An elven beekeeper is standing here, peacefully watching his bees.

The glade of tall springy grass is surrounded by the golden forest. The ground is even here, and but for the surrounding trees this opening would look perfectly ordinary. The vegetation looks forever undisturbed, though whether this effect is due to little traffic through this area or to some special magic worked by the Lady of the Land, one cannot say. A tall stone block with flat weathered surface is standing upright here.
21629: A large yellow apple lies here.

The dense mallorn forest borders the apple orchard of Lady Galadriel from the north. The tall noble trees garbed in silver and gold provide a marked contrast to the greenery of the garden. Basil grows in abundance here, clutching at the ivy-strung fence. A few young apple offshoots reach out and up, having escaped the confines of the planted garden.
21630: The breathtaking beauty of the mallorn forest does not yield to passing of age or Men. This corner of the land seems frozen in time, ages ago, when no word was yet laid on stream or stone. Lack of young trees or grass on the firm golden-brown ground complements this ageless effect.
21631: Ivy Meadow within the Golden Wood
A cluster of white star-shaped forget-me-nots flourish here in reminiscence.

Silvery trees surround a small glade strung with ivy bushes. Their long threads, thickly dotted with dark green leaves, cover the ground in several layers as they do not have anything to hang on to, and it seems as if some power is preventing them from venturing into the golden forest around. A small stone plaque is barely concealed under the live tangle of ivy and fallen golden leaves.
21632:
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
A nightingale is here, chirping a sweet melody.

A forest of mighty mellyrn, wide of girth and tall of height, of indeterminate age grows here. The whispering of their golden-tipped branches in the wind mingles with the singing of birds. The grass is short though luxurious here, and among its healthy greenery, a few flowers sparkle, indigenous to Lorien. An intangible air of mystery fills the forest, as if it is always on the verge of some great happenstance.
21633: Moving swiftly among the proud mellyrn, this small but well-trodden path runs winding and twisting beneath the great waving branches, darting in and out between the silvery grey trunks. Soft rustling can be heard as well as the peaceful chirping of birds from within the forest.
21634: This small stream courses southwards amongst the great trees that surround it, babbling happily and sending joyful echoes into the dense wood beyond. Just alongside the stream lies a small forest path, opening up the forest floor to the skies above and allowing some light to fall upon the otherwise shadowy ground.
21635: Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.

The surrounding forest has drawn back respectfully here, making room for this single, great mallorn tree. The girth of this grey-clad giant strikes you with awe, and its heavily laden boughs stretch both far and wide to catch the light of sun or moon upon its countless clusters of saffron-shaded blossoms in summer and gilted leaves in winter. From within the grey maze of its branches the cheerful warbling of songbirds can be heard, and the wind whispers softly as it gently caresses the ancient tree.
21636: Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.

The path makes a wide turn across a grassy boulder-strewn clearing in which a few mallorn trees grow. It is high up the southern slope of the hill. The wind gently ruffles the leaves and branches of the few mellyrn that grow here. Golden patches of elanor are clustered around the rocks trying to escape the occasional strong gusts of the winds that threaten to send them floating down into the Golden Wood proper. The path disappears into the forest south of here, while its western end launches into the final ascent.
21637: A narrow, barely trodden path runs up the southern slope of a tall hill. The mallorn trees that grow here seem to be executing an eternal southward-bound bow. The silvery trees up the slope shelter the path from the sun with their golden crowns even as it goes into several sharp switchbacks as it ascends. The switchbacks lengthen the climb but make it less strenuous, and small rocks guide the traveller's way.
21638: Fork at the Foot of the Hill

The main pathway makes a wide turn here coming in from the south and turning east. The exquisite silver-green canvas of the sage brush skirts wide of the turn, giving way to a half-moon of granite rocks set in the ground to the south of the path. To the north, a hill rises swiftly, its steepness hidden by the young mallorn forest and more sage underbrush. A tiny path disappears up the hill and turns west as its goes into its first switchback.
21639:
A waist-high evergreen shrub grows here, with thick, reaching branches.
On the shrub, there are some grey-green leaves.

The path weaves south to north here, making its way through sage bushes. The bushes are as high as human waist, though it is nearly impossible to tell one bush from the next, for their small but splayed green leaves, whose backs are tinted silver, make the surroundings look like one grey chaotic spider web laid over a field of green. Sweet herbal smell rises above the path from the sage leaves crushed under the feet of careless travellers.
21640: The Hill of a Thousand Stars
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The golden trees are edging their way up the hill. A tall grey monolith tapering toward the top but with a square base dominates the hilltop. A single rune, an elegant and elaborate "G", is carved into its sunset side. Its maker used no ordinary chisel and hammer, for the rune glimmers faintly like a rising star as if containing some fiery power. Its energy is seemingly similar to that of the land around it, yet subtly different, the way two stars in the evening sky are different and yet the same. Twelve round marked stones lie in a straight line to the east of the monolith, and their twelve siblings line up to the west, the shadow of the runed stone in the middle indicating time of the day.
21641: Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.

The forest of tall grey trees with golden crowns as is typical of this land grows here. Their silver-skinned boles lift their gold studded arms to the sky. At the feet of the trees, upon the grass of cheerful green, elanor grows. Its golden stars shimmer upon the glossy green carpet as their real counterparts do in the sky on a clear moonless night. The ground rises to the north as the trees gradually give way to a small clearing.
21642: A colony of red ants is here. The ants seem to ignore you.

Past, future, and present manifest themselves in the unearthly silver and gold of the mallorn trees, which in their royal bearing and majesty give no indication that there ever was or will be time when they were or will be anything other than what they are now: the living guardians of the last truly elven land with proud grey trunks and fiery crowns that put all the dwarven treasures to shame.
21643:
A large beautiful rose bush is blooming here.
Deep inside the bush, there is a white rose with leaves and thorny stem.

The bare mallorn trunks, their soft bark gleaming damp silver in the dimness of the ancient wood, stretch their arms leisurely toward each other. The great boughs form a delicately wrought mosaic - golden against the blue, grey or black of the sky. A pale square of a flet hangs high up among the branches, though there seems to be no obvious foot or hand support that would allow to reach it.
21644:
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A long-tailed bird watches you from the vegetation.

The sparsely growing mallorn trees give way to a cacophony of colours: the green grass here is studded with flowers in an unimaginable number of different shades of gold, yellow, and orange. The colour of elanor changes subtly as it moves from the cover of the great silver trees toward the unshaded spots among them. The unseen birds sing merrily from the branches of the mallorn trees adding a welcome touch to the festive mood of the forest.
21645:
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A sturdy pack horse is standing here.

The floor of the wood is golden here, whether from fallen leaves or the flowers of elanor, and golden is the roof, and its pillars are of silver, for the bark of the trees is smooth and grey. Shadows fall and waver in the breeze that whispers of times long gone and secrets lost, but the land of Lorien stays peaceful and unscathed against the tide of time.
21646: There are two clusters of flowers of niphredil here.

The dim shadows thrown by the mighty mallorn trees play in the grass forming the ever-shifting patterns of light and dark at their feet. Now and again, a silver star-shaped flower catches light, and then fades again into a short blink of obscurity. The silver-grey forest stretches out in all directions as far as the eye can see.
21647: As the tall mellyrn stretch their boughs towards the open sky, the grounds below are cast into shadow. The wind plays amongst the branches, shifting the shadows into forms that dance amongst the great silvery trunks to the soft whispering of the proud trees.
21648: A fallow deer is grazing peacefully here.

The great trees of the Golden Wood stand tall here, rising high into the sky. Yet even so, they grow sparse enough to allow some light to fall upon the landscape below, creating a fierce contrast of gold and shadow. The forest grows more dense and solemn to the north, whereas to the south it opens up, becoming lush and bright. You can barely make out a small forest path running at the edge of the forest to the east of you. From beyond it you can hear the Celebrant rushing forth eagerly along its stone bed. Here within the woods the faint whispers of the trees and the song of several hidden birds fall lightly upon your ears.
21649: Running high above the Celebrant, this small trail curves gently to follow the edge of the cliff. Bordering the trail are the grey boles of the Golden Wood, the ageless mellyrn standing high and proud as a reminder of the magic that is the soul of the forest. Softly the trees whisper, while drifting up from below comes the chittering of the water over the stones.
21650:
A large shrub grows here, filling the air with a heavy scent.
On the shrub, there are two handfuls of fragile flowers.

The spacious forest is light and open, allowing the light to illuminate the ground freely, dispelling most shadows. Although the trees rise high, they stand far apart, with enough space between their lofty crowns to allow watching the open skies. The wind blows freely here, the soft gusts of cool air gently rocking the tall trees and creating faint whispers throughout the woods.
21651: The trees grow more dense here, barring all passage save to those on foot, and allowing almost no light to penetrate the thick canopy above. Completely blocking out the sky, the great grey mellyrn form a green vault in which shadows veil the details of the terrain. To your south, the forest appears to open up, while to the east and north you can barely make out a faint path tracing its way through the heart of the golden woods.
21652: The trail runs from the east to the west here, passing just south of a small waterfall that sends the light reflected from its cascading surface to shimmer and sparkle among the towering mellyrn. Surrounded by the softly whispering forest, you hear also the joyous babbling of the small brook as it runs swiftly alongside the forest path.
21653: Babbling happily, the small stream runs among the roots of the solemn trees towering above. As it courses down a small hill, the water is sent cascading over the mossy stones, creating a small and beautiful waterfall which sparkles in the soft light. A little pool has gathered below the falls, offering the thirsty wanderer a cool and refreshing drink.
21654:
A long-necked bird, with a fairly short spear-like bill stands here.
A brook trout is here, swimming in the current.

Flowing gently southward, the stream winds and twists as it darts in and out between the towering grey mellyrn. The clear and cold water sparkles as the light cast by the skies above penetrates the foliage, creating dancing patterns of green and gold. The golden woods whisper softly as a small breeze passes by. From a distance, the song of the nightingales can be heard.
21655: A brook trout is here, swimming in the current.

Twisting and turning gently, the stream winds its way between the solemn grey trees, reflecting what little light filters down through the golden canopy above. The soft babbling of the water pouring over the mossy stones mingles with the whispers of the wind in the branches and the soft singing of distant nightingales.
21656: The forest opens up and the tall mellyrn graciously allow the light of the sky to fall upon the well-travelled path. Running almost in a straight line, the narrow trail runs parallel to a small forest stream. Accompanied by the babbling of the brook and the song of the hidden birds, the trail continues north and south.
21657: A Path in the Golden Wood

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

A light clear path emerges from the mallorn forest to the south. It widens considerably as it turns west and dives under the shadow of the aspen gate that leads to the apple orchard beyond. The ground is grassless here but firm, and the grey mellyrn provide all the shelter one might need from rain, fog, and unfriendly eyes that always watch the land of Lorien from afar. Glimpses of another trail can be seen to the east.
21658: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The green branches of four slender aspen trees, standing in a square, entwine forming a thick canopy that shelters the entrance to the apple orchard. A fence of ivy coming up to it from north and south weaves itself around the aspens, so that the only way in is to walk between them. These trees, though dwarfed by the mellyrn of the Golden Wood, are still by far some of the tallest trees to inhabit Middle-earth.
21659:
There is a red, delicious-looking apple here.
There is a red, delicious-looking apple here.
Kementir, the Keeper of the Orchards, is stooping over some flowers here.

The apple orchard of Lady Galadriel would be an object of envy for any Shire farmer. Apple trees of all shapes and sizes, most of them in bloom, have the run of the place. Ripe apples hang like oversized decorations in this carnival of green and pink, green and gold, green and the most magnificent royal red. The orchard is surrounded by a fence of ivy, separating it from the mallorn forest outside. The apple trees hang low and heavy under the weight of their fruits. The power of this land is evident even here, for the apple trees of Lorien are the size of grown oaks, if not quite making it close to that of the mellyrn.
21660:
A sprawling green bush of stinging nettle grows here.
An erect shrub with green pinnate leaves is growing here.

A faint forest footpath, outlined with tiny red and golden flowers and white polished pebbles, widens slightly and then comes to a dead stop here, as it comes against a fence of ivy, strung among some bushes and aspen trees. An apple orchard lies beyond the fence to the east. Slightly darkened silvery trunks of the mallorn trees and their outstretched golden crowns conceal this place from the rest of the world.
21661: Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.

The pebbled elven footpath enters from the south here, tracing the foot of a tall hill outlined against the western sky, and then diving into the lustrous golden forest in the east. The passage is level, strewn with pebbles and larger polished stones along the sides, and no tracks can be distinguished upon them. Exuberant, elanor glitters in the grass, as if a hundred golden eyes are winking at you mischievously.
21662: Faint Footpath along the Foot of the Hill

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.

A minor footpath hugs the foothills here. Ascending steeply, the hill rises to the west, shielding travellers from the gloomy view of Misty Mountains. Barely visible, the switchbacks zigzag from somewhere to the east up the hill and out of the view. Golden flowers glint in the grass just below the silvery trunks of the mallorn forest stretching for miles and miles to the east.
21663:
An erect shrub with green pinnate leaves is growing here.
A sprawling green bush of stinging nettle grows here.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

A lethargic path runs around the foot of the hill here. The golden forest rises to the east of it. Some lively raspberry bushes intermixed with nettles line the slope to the west, looking very out of place in their down-to-earth simplicity. An occasional pebble tumbles downhill and lands on the byway.
21664: White light shimmers though the taut elegant forms of the mallorn trees like through a thin veil, accentuated by the golden raiment of their branches. The clear voices of birds in the sky and the rustle of the wind in the trees enliven the scene that stretches unchanging as far as the eye can see.
21665: A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

Shadowy spires rise from the ground and disappear into the sky. They are mellyrn - the ancient watchers of Lorien, and the most obvious testament to the power that holds this elven land intact despite the ravages and wars around it. The ground rises some to the south and the forest recedes in that direction.
21666: Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.

The sheer moonlight-filled flowers of niphredil carpet the ground among the trunks of the great mallorn trees. They peek from every nook and corner among the trees' mighty roots. The dark green sinewy vines of ivy wind around the lower parts of the mellyrn all the way to the golden wreaths of their lower branches that creak in unison with the softly sighing wind.
21667: In the Shadow of the Twin Mellyrn

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
A furry, striped raccoon is here, nosing around for some berries or roots.
The garden snake slithers harmlessly here.

The middle of the round green glade is raised, forming a pedestal for the two formidable mallorn trees. So much alike they are and so close do they grow, as if they may well be twins - the two ancient stewards of the never changing wood, bowing slightly in the opposite directions, watching east and west intently for the signs that only they will know.
21668: Quaint and lordly, the ancient mallorn trees detach themselves from the dreamy curtain of the darkened enchanted forest. They rise high, their sheer grey branches silhouetted ghostlike against the sky. The golden forest is thick here, so that hardly any ground can be seen among the sturdy mallorn roots that dig their fingers deep into the ground to support the giant grey trunks.
21669: A great horned owl looks cautiously around it.

Deep shadows line the naked ground sprinkled with dead golden leaves. But they are not the scary shadows of morbid children's tales, but the warm shadows of late summer evenings. By some fluke of heavenly design, mellyrn have grown especially close to each other in this part of the forest. The branches of their crowns are interwoven with each other as to make each particular one indistinguishable, creating a near perfect illusion of isolation from the rest of the world.
21670: A hollow tree is growing upright here.

Deep shadows line the ground here. Among the ethereal splendour of the mallorn wood, all other things seem diminished. The light hardly touches their silver trunks, yet their shadows are many and their outlines are clearly visible. The interplay of light reveals that the bark pattern on the trees is not always natural. Thick though unthreatening, the golden forest stretches out for miles in all directions.
21671: A finch flies low above the ground.

The smooth forest ground rises eastward here. The grey mallorn trees of great height and mighty girth populate the slope. Their gold-covered branches are concentrated on the top parts of the upward narrowing trunks, but they are too thin and delicate to conceal the sky, the magnificent westward view of the gaunt grey peaks of the Misty Mountains, and the fact that the golden forest stretches far in all directions.
21672:
A patch of star-shaped moss covers the ground.
A long-bodied animal with thick brown fur bounds through the trees.

The golden forest is sparse here, for the ground is mostly stone with patches of typical Lorien light coloured soil appearing here and there. The stone forming the ground is white and smooth, covered with silvery star-shaped moss in places. The moss cannot conceal the half-faded inscriptions that cover the stone in Elven runes. The forest becomes thinner to the south as it follows a downward slope.
21673: An opossum stands here, sniffing around the ground.

The golden forest parts here, baring the rocky ground that drops straight down to the east. A clear spring bubbles out evenly from among the white boulders. The water runs among the rocks and pours over the cliffside down into the pool below. A rare mallorn tree grapples the rocks with its roots in search of the ground to feed from. The view from the cliff east encompasses the eastern Lorien with fiery mellyrn crowns spanning the leagues till the wispy snake of Anduin. The river cuts off the forest abruptly and the land beyond becomes grey, barren, and seemingly uninhabited.
21674:
A large elk is standing here, chewing grass and leaves.
A woodchuck is watching for enemies here.

A wall of white stone several spans high blocks passage west. Water pours over the side of the cliff and plunges down the wall in a single sheet of shimmering white, collecting in a semicircular pool at its foot. The cliff face descends rapidly on either side of the wall, forming a wider semicircle from which a path departs east. The cliffside behind the humming waterfall looks silky smooth, but for the odd artefact in the middle which glows iridescently.
21675: The mallorn forest surrounds this wide rectangular platform of white stone from all sides except to the south. There, it turns out to be the top face of a tall rock forming the northern side of a semicircular stone well that houses a shimmering waterfall and a pool of clear water at its foot. A narrow stone staircase, incised in the wall, descends from this small plateau into the well, snaking eastwards along the wall as it goes down where the rock surface slopes more gently.
21676: Sparsely growing mallorn trees dot the landscape. Eastwards a faint path can be seen through their silver filigree. The tall proud trees have especially sprawling golden crowns, but the shadows they cast are still not as deep as the ones in the deeper parts of the elven forest. The ground turns into white rock and drops off sharply to the south, where a view opens onto the southern parts of this enchanted place.
21677:
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.
A tall stag is here, grazing peacefully.

Ghostly light illuminates the grey-green grass, the sage bushes, and the lower parts of the mallorn trees. Silver diaphanous stars of niphredil sparkle around in abundance. The magical forest feels alive with power. Some more green is visible through the trees to the north, and a path can be seen, running to the east of here.
21678: A Faint Path through the Golden Wood

The mellyrn, their branches elegant and sprawling, are watching the forest on either side of the path, of which the only indicator is this curious disregard. This widening in the woods is due not so much to the trees growing sparsely, as it is due to the branches of the mallorn trees diverting most of their attention away from the path. A subtle sense of consciousness emanates from the trees as if all the ghosts of all the elven legends of the Golden Wood became whispering shadows living hidden within those majestic grey trees.
21679: A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

Bordered by tall and proud mellyrn, the trail is partly shadowed here as it curves gently southward, following the forest stream. All around you are the soft sounds of the living forest of Lothlorien.
21680: An elven lady is walking around here.

Running alongside the small babbling stream, this well-trodden path is shadowed by the tall trees standing densely all around. The trail curves slightly here from west to south, keeping up with the flowing water. The soft trickling of the stream becomes intertwined with the rustling of the trees and the song of concealed birds.
21681: Turning slowly, the forest path follows the small stream carefully on its course towards the Celebrant, forming a border between the silver sheen of the water and the golden woods. From within the trees, a soft whispering can be heard as well as the warbling of unseen songbirds.
21682: The trees slowly open up, making room for a small trail just north and east of here. As the woods grow less dense, the shadows are dispelled by the light from the sky falling almost unhindered towards the ground. Within the few remaining shadows, faint moving shapes can be seen and soft singing can be heard.
21683: A Faint Path through the Golden Wood
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

A faint snake of pebbles slithers southward among the silvery trunks of mallorn trees and down a mild incline. The only indication that this is indeed a path and not a fluke of forest magic is that the pebble trace widens to the south and is not longer concealed by the golden boughs of nearby mellyrn. The path is just as faint to the north as it disappears among the mallorn trees and into the forest beyond.
21684: A Path in the Golden Wood
A large elk is standing here, chewing grass and leaves.

The silvery mellyrn part here for a forest path studded on either side with small grey stones. Unseen, the wind sneaks among the mallorn crowns of royal gold, disturbing them ever so slightly, though not enough to conceal the sky above the path. The trees are firm and slender - they do not look old, yet they have a timeless quality about them as if there has never been any change in this small corner of Middle-earth.
21685: Here amidst the dense grey mellyrn, the great age and wisdom contained within the Golden Wood seem much more vivid and present, almost tangible. The deep shadows that lie beneath the boughs seem alive, yet not hostile as small birds dart in and out among the branches, singing happily.
21686: The proud forest stands towering here, reaching high towards the open skies that you can discern through the tree-tops. Lush grey and golden mellyrn strive in friendly competition, growing taller than in most other parts of the Golden Wood. The open and spacious forest is light and joyous, allowing the sun to dispel most of the shadows in daytime.
21687: A dense canopy of green and gold prevents any light from reaching the forest floor here, forever shrouding the tall silvery tree-boles in shadow. Although dense and shadowy, the forest is filled with movement and the songs of birds echoing throughout the vast Golden Wood.
21688: Standing tall and dense, the mellyrn here bar all light from reaching the ground and create deep shadows that play amongst the foliage and smooth, grey trunks. Shapes of varying sizes can be seen moving in the distance, ranging from smaller birds to an occasional stag. As the wind blows through the boughs above, the Golden Wood whispers softly to you.
21689: A Bend in the Forest Path
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The forest path coming from the north banks sharply down and right around a green tree-covered hillock. It disappears briefly under the shadow of a large mallorn tree, located just inside the bend at the foot of the knoll, only to reappear shortly to the west. The sound of water, the music of wind and droplets, is lulling travellers in that direction.
21690:
A partridge attempts to hide in the undergrowth.
A partridge attempts to hide in the undergrowth.
A blue dragonfly is circling around.

Stopping by a flowering shrub here, turning at a cluster of bright flowers there, this small trail runs through the forest like a wanderer following somebody's light footsteps or a voice calling at the edge of hearing. Here and there it approaches tall mallorn trees whose branches hold flets and birds' nests, yet nowhere does it stop to rest at the trunk of a tree or wait for a ladder to be thrown from the canopy. The chirping of birds can be heard from the shrubs and trees around the trail, from whence they observe the woodland path unseen.
21691: A Stream in the Golden Wood

Flowing out of a small depression to the north, the stream picks up speed as it hurries down the sloping ground south on its way to meet Celebrant. The streambed is sandy, but the water is clear and sparkling, as if it had never touched sand nor forest soil. Mellyrn bend to the stream from the soft grassy banks, their reflection a blur of silver and gold in the fast flowing water.
21692: You see two large yellow apples on the ground.

Two layers of stones have been laid on the ground here, forming a simple hearth, on which a small fire is burning. The stones have obviously been arranged very carefully, to prevent the fire from breaking out of its assigned borders and singeing the live soil and grass of the forest. Since here, in the very heart of Lorien, Elves have little need of light in the dark or heat in the Winter, they probably use this fire to bake apples and toast bread, and in the night tell stories and sing songs around it, watching the sparks fly into the dark sky.
21693:
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

The forest opens up here into a large clearing, almost two hundred feet across. It is circular in shape and one can only guess at the reason why. Perhaps as night falls and the stars shine brightly above, the elves light fires, dance and sing, celebrating and enjoying themselves. There are remnants of a fire in the centre, and you can see that the grass is lying flat in a small circle around the hearth. From the surrounding forest you can hear song and laughter as well as the soft whispering of the enchanted forest.
21694: Standing tall and solemn, this proud forest strives towards the sky, forever trying to reach the twinkling stars that bathe Lothlorien in their silver light during nighttime. Standing rather far apart, the green and golden crowns do not prevent the light from the sky from reaching the ground and dispelling the grey and green shadows that rest from time to time among the grey trunks. The woods sway softly to the occasional passing gust of wind, which creates a faint song among the branches and leaves, mingling with the distant song of birds.
21695: A brook trout is here, swimming in the current.

As the small stream gathers momentum, it can be heard clearly from the thick surrounding forest. Clear and cold, the water strives eastward towards its long sought for companion. Running side by side, the stream seems to be in friendly competition with the forest path.
21696:
A shrub with maple-like leaves is growing here.
On the shrub, there are two handfuls of blackcurrant berries.
A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

Running alongside the swift forest stream, this small path lies below the open sky. The great trees of the Golden Wood stand sparse here, allowing the light of the sky to fall unhindered upon the well-trodden soil. The soft splashing from the stream blends with the song of hidden nightingales and the whisper of the mellyrn as the wind gently rocks the forest.
21697: The path deliberately winds its way among the mellyrn, slowly travelling beside the small forest stream barely visible within the woodland just north and east of you. From within the deep reaches of the enchanted wood you can just make out the soft song of hidden birds and the gentle whisper of the great grey trees as the wind gently rocks the ancient boughs, creating faint ripples of sound that blend with the babbling of the glittering forest stream.
21698: Wedged in between the two trails, this small appendix of the forest stands dense and proud, towering high into the sky. The great mellyrn sway softly to a gentle breeze and whisper quietly as the wind sifts through the boughs. Soft singing from the birds can be heard from within the canopy.
21699: Running east and west, this small trail forms the border between the Golden Wood and the Celebrant. High above the rushing water, you can still feel the moisture and hear the joyful song of the flowing river. Blending with the babbling of the deep Celebrant are the soft whispers of the tall mellyrn standing densely to the north of the trail.
21702: Running along the edge of the slope, this small forest trail is the border between the river and the forest. West, the mellyrn stand tall and dense, shadowing the ground, while to the east the silver band of the Celebrant runs sparkling and dazzling below you. The soft whisper of the forest blends with the roaring of the fast-flowing water as it hastens towards its companion in the east.
21703: A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

Stretching out towards the great river, the golden forest stand dense in the wedge between trails. Faintly the song of the Celebrant can be heard from the east, carrying through the woods. Blending with the music of water, warbling of birds can be heard accompanying the soft rustling of the waving branches.
21725:
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.

A combination of the rivers to the east, south, and west and the high, green wall to the north gives this long, shining lawn a sheltered and secretive feel. The grasses are tall, soft, and pale golden in hue; flowers of sun-golden and star-silver shade are supported above this living carpet on slender, green stems. Across the Anduin in the east, mighty currents pound relentlessly against a sheer stone cliff topped with tall hardwood trees. In the west, a white structure of stone and wood has been built at the calmer Celebrant's edge.
21726:
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.

The sound of swiftly flowing water dominates your senses. To the east, a high wall of soft green turf gives way to the mighty Anduin, which presses powerfully against the steeply sloped banks as it races southward. Any attempt to ford the river in that direction would surely result in death. From the north and southwest come the playful, airy sounds of smaller waterways. Golden-topped mellyrn rise from the forest floor in all directions but east, like ancient sentries guarding a sacred clearing. Above, the sky rises high. At your feet, myriad delicate flowers spring from a lush organic carpet.
21727:
An elf, clad in the garments of a woodsman, moves stealthily among the trees.
A long-tailed bird watches you from the vegetation.
A long-tailed bird watches you from the vegetation.
A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

The stream here is shallow and noisy as it falls down through rocky crevices and silty pools. Not far to the east the small waterway merges with the wide, powerful waters of the river Anduin, which flows steadily southward between forested banks. Tall mallorn-trees rise above the high northern bank. Westward, a small trail runs parallel to the stream.
21728: Grasses and flowers lap at the powerful trunks of the mellyrn that dominate the landscape. The smooth, golden curves of ancient boughs intermingle above you, so that not a single inch of sky can be seen above the living ceiling. To the south, a small stream tumbles swiftly over smooth rocks, its foamy fingers tickling fertile brown banks. In the west a simple arc of grey stone traverses the woodland brook. The steep grade of the riverbank, combined with the swift current would make ascending from the stream to the forest impossible.
21729: In all directions, your view is dominated by the tall, straight trunks of golden-boughed mellyrn. Every inch of these lush woodlands seem to be filled with a healthy, thriving species of wildlife. Despite this abundance of organisms, the forest does not feel constricted or over-populated. Rather, every living thing, from tiny blade of grass to impossibly ancient tree, exists in harmony.
21730: A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.

This forest is a model of dichotomy. Tall, thick mallorn-trees, rooted in this earth for thousands of years, live side by side with the tiniest flower whose bloom lasts for no more than a season. The downward slope of the land becomes more pronounced to the east and south, where the sound of running water is the loudest.
21731: An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.

The wide trunks of golden-crested mellyrn rise above you in all directions. Flourishing under watchful shadows of these ancient trees are countless tiny plants and flowers. Every colour of the rainbow seems to be represented in a dozen shades, although the dominant hues are of green, grey, and gold. Looking up, the trunks disappear into a sky of intertwining limbs and broad leaves. A mighty river can barely be seen through the undergrowth to the east, sliding powerfully between the sloping banks.
21732: Massive mallorn-trees loom proudly in all directions, like thick-walled towers topped with gold-encrusted battlements. This forest doesn't just look ancient, but rather seems to radiate oldness. The strong and graceful trees thrive upon a power that quite obviously encompasses this entire land. Slender shoots and delicate flowers provide poignant contrast to these silent giants. Every now and then the faint sound of music reaches your ears, but you can not tell if it is voice or instrument that yields these ageless melodies.
