White, yellow and blue flowers cover the ground here so thickly, that there seems to be no spot where you could set your foot without stepping on a flower. Garden flowers, forest flowers and field flowers all grow together, forgetting their preferences and prejudices about surroundings, landscape, soil and lighting. To the west the clearing continues, and flowers in shades of red seem to replace flowers in shades of blue.
21908:
A bee flies around here, collecting nectar from the flowers.
A bee flies around here, collecting nectar from the flowers.
A bee flies around here, collecting nectar from the flowers.

Large, brightly coloured flowers cover the soft ground under the great mallorn. A low hedge with an ivy-covered gate in it encloses the flower patch and the tree. Here and there beehives and honeycombs can be seen among the branches. Countless bees fly all around the golden tree, as if it was one giant beehive. The low buzzing of the bees mingles with a clear sound of flowing water. The air is scented with flowers and honey.
21909: Bright white light streams down from the crown of a mallorn tree, casting wavering shadows on the grass. A thick cloud of mist shrouds the tree branches, completely concealing the source of the glow. The gold and the green of the mellyrn are pale from the mist and strangely bright light. The grass beneath the golden trees is in places quite short, as if it has grown just recently; although the flowers have fully opened blooms, they are also of a short stature, as if something had stopped or slowed their growth.
21910: A sturdy pack horse is standing here.

The golden trees stand slightly apart here, and the forest soil beneath them is covered not with grass, but with a carpet of thick green moss. To the north of you the ground slopes down into a deep glen. A barely visible mist or a haze hangs over the glen, a barely discernible haze that does not obscure the view, yet gives the picture a slight semblance of unreality as if the whole place could be gone if you only blinked your eyes.
21911:
A hollow tree is growing upright here.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

Many flowers and tiny shrubs cluster around the hollow tree that grows from the ground here, leafless but seemingly quite alive. Whatever accident or whimsy of nature had created it, it apparently failed to destroy the tree's living energy and spirit. Thin vines with tiny white flowers climb its sides, forming a wreath on its top. Assembled around this strange, flower-crowned apparition, the plants look like a crowd of woodland creatures performing some rite of Spring.
21912: To the east, behind a line of mellyrn, a road passes through the wood, its surface smooth and glittering from a distance like a river of green. In all the other directions the forest of Lorien spreads in a dream-like golden haze where all shapes and lines seem to blend together, yet grow distinct and sharp when you let your gaze rest upon them.
21913: Among the golden trees on this hill the West Wind itself seems to have taken its abode, singing with the nightingales, tugging at the branches, flapping the leaves, and playing with light and shadows. Here the wind brings scents of strange flowers, grasses and trees from distant lands, and weaves them into the gentle breezes of the Golden Wood. Here it sometimes brings also strains of sweet music, fairer than any flower scent yet shorter than the fall of a drop of rain.
21914: Lying in the midst of the golden forest, this courtyard passes between two lines of slender trees of white bark that stand on its sides like colonnades. It runs from the east to the west to what appears to be a clearing in a circle of mellyrn. The tessellated floor is half white marble, half the living forest floor covered with thick green grass, in places decorated with tiny bluebells or tiny flowers of elanor. This mosaic of marble and grass runs to the very entrance of the mallorn circle where it stops at a grassy threshold.
21915:
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A dark-haired, grey-eyed elven lady is standing here, clad all in white.

Mallorn trees surround this woodland temple on all sides, interspersed with slender columns that branch into airy arches at about three yards above the ground. Between the arches and the branches, many panes of matte and transparent glass are suspended. Bright images are painted or stained upon some panes, while others are blank as though left as a background for one perfect mallorn branch silhouetted against them. The ground is paved with white marble except in the very centre of the circle, where a large altar-like stone sits in the soft earth. Cool water emerges from an opening on its top and trickles down the side, and the ground around it is covered with pale flowers of niphredil. A low railing surrounds the circle, the only opening in it allowing entrance from the east. But to the west, the mallorn trees themselves seem to have stepped aside where an arch opens above the railing like a window, letting the westering sun enter here as it dips below the tops of the golden trees on its way across the Sea, to Elvenhome and to the Blessed Lands beyond.
21916: A Glade in the Golden Wood

The small oval glade is covered by a carpet of ankle-deep green grass, out of which a few long-stemmed flowers lift their heads. Dug into the ground in the very centre of the glade is a basin of white stone sprinkled with silvery specks. The basin is about six feet wide, and its rim is carved in the shape of a wreath of mallorn leaves. Clear water fills the basin, and its surface reflects the golden trees around the glade, their crowns climbing tier upon tier like clusters of sunset clouds, or like golden towers of a city built upon a mountain.
21917: Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.

Two barely visible trails, marked only by a few bent plant stems, meet beneath an oval opening in the canopy formed by the mallorn branches. A hint of music hangs in the air here, a tune on the very edge of hearing that seems to fade whenever you strain your ears trying to make it out.
21918: A cluster of white star-shaped forget-me-nots flourish here in reminiscence.

In a secluded clearing surrounded closely by the golden trees, a small, grass-covered mound rises from the ground. It is likely of elven construction, as its shape appears too regular and its sides too smooth to be natural. White flowers crowning its top suggest that this is a burial mound, although there is nothing else about it or its surroundings that is mournful or reminiscent of death and the passage of time. Bright flowers grow all around it and climb halfway up its sides, and birds sing cheerfully in the treetops around the clearing.
21919: A patch of star-shaped moss covers the ground.

As if fingers of transparent mist were floating in the air, or a hidden fire was burning somewhere, making warm draughts rise from the ground, the images of the trees around you sometimes waver and become blurred before coming into focus again. Even those mellyrn that appear unobscured by any haze or illusion seem bleaker and paler than the golden trees just to the south. Below the trees, the grass is silvery as if covered with dew or raindrops and sprinkled with many tiny white flowers that give off a soft fragrance.
21920: In the everchanging pattern of light and shadow that lies on the forest floor here there is one square-shaped shadow that does not change as the branches of the trees move. Barely visible in the foliage of the mallorn tree above the shadowy square is a grey platform, to which a silvery ladder leads along the bole of the tree.
21921:
A circlet of golden flowers has been left here.
A small oaken table has been set here.
A sturdy, sure-footed elf is standing here.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.

Nestled within a patch of tall grass and reeds, this structure is designed to house a variety of slender boats and barges. The floor is constructed of long wooden planks, laid side by side and painted white, extending about a yard out over the surface of the water. Several niches of open water protrude into the boathouse, alongside of which sturdy metal rings have been bolted into the floor beams for the purpose of securing the boats. On each corner of the hythe jutting into the river a stone pylon anchored beneath the clear waters supports the floor. Walls of meticulously interlocked stones rise from the planks on the north and eastern sides of the structure; like the planks below, these smooth stones have been painted a clean shade of white. A simple white door made from three planks fitted together lies in the eastern wall. Hooks secured into the walls support oars, rope, and other nautical tools. Above, a vaulted wooden ceiling protects inhabitants from the elements.
21922:
A small oaken table has been set here.
An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.

Within the branches of this great tree, the elves have built a small wooden platform. Here live those of the Galadhrim who are in charge of the stables and the rope bridges across the Celebrant. The flet is spartanly furnished and contains only a small table and a few sleeping mats. A small wooden ladder is placed near the bole of the tree, to allow easy passage up and down the tree.
21923:
A white-painted bench is here.
A large encrusted cedar chest is standing here.

This light platform was built on a junction of two sturdy mallorn branches and has no walls or railing. A grey rope ladder leads down through a round opening in the middle of the platform. Built with care and without excessive decoration, the flet seems to be as much a part of the tree as the leaves and the branches. With the exception of an old chest and a low bench there is no furniture, but it seems to be just enough, as if anything else would have broken the harmony of the picture.
21924: Two grey ropes form this slender bridge that leads through the tree branches, from one flet to another. The ropes pass side by side, sometimes resting on mallorn branches or by the side of a tree trunk, sometimes bound together by bands of grey cloth or a stem of a climbing plant. Although the bridge might seem flimsy, it is apparently quite stable - the ropes don't bend under your weight and don't slide when you move, as if some invisible force was keeping them in place.
21925:
A large bulletin board, entitled "Clerics' Guild", is mounted here.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Suspended on silvery ropes descending from the crowns of the tall mellyrn, this flet seems to have no support from below or on either side. Every breath of wind through the grey boughs sends minute tremors through the floor, yet the flet does not shift even slightly, as if held in place by an unseen power. A low round table in the middle of the flet holds a crystal bowl with water collected in it. A grey silken hammock in the branches above appears to serve as the sleeping place for the owner of this dwelling; blue fringes of the covers hang over its side.
21927:
A small termite is running around making strange sounds.
A small termite is running around making strange sounds.
A small termite is running around making strange sounds.

A faint, greenish light filters through the roof of grass, turf and branches into this dark, warm grotto. Piles of leaves and twigs, both fresh and dry, cover the ground, rustling and crackling with every movement in the cavern. In the faint greenish radiance coming from above even the dry leaves on the floor seem green, and the greyish moss on the walls seems more alive than it would otherwise look. Thin vines with tiny pale flowers on them entwine with the branches on the ground and climb up the mossy walls to the roof.
21928:
Some pine nuts lie scattered upon the ground.
A tawny-coated bear is sleeping here.
A tawny-coated bear is sleeping here.

The walls, floor and ceiling of this hollow are carpeted completely by soft, green moss. Here and there, water-drops and spider webs glisten faintly on the green cover. Across the cavern floor, tracks of some large animal lead to the northern wall, where a few pinecones and branches lie half-submerged in the moss. The air is almost still, but fresh, being scented by pine-needles and wet earth, perhaps washed by an underground spring.
21929: In the Branches of the Great Mallorn

A sticky honeycomb lies on the ground.
A sticky honeycomb lies on the ground.
A drone bee flies around here, angrily buzzing.
An angry bee is here, collecting nectar from all the flowers of the garden.
An angry bee is here, collecting nectar from all the flowers of the garden.
A huge, bulky queen bee is here.
A drone bee flies around here, angrily buzzing.

Beehives of all sizes and honeycombs of all shapes cover the spreading branches of the golden tree. A low buzzing, louder humming and an angry drone fill the air, drowning out all the other sounds of the forest. The strong, sweet scent of honey is overpowering; a deep breath could be enough to make one dizzy from the sweetness.
21930:
A large encrusted cedar chest is standing here.
A neat straw pallet is lying here.
An elven lady is walking around here.
A colourful butterfly is fluttering around here.

Cradled in the branches of a great mallorn tree, this wooden platform is so light that it seems the tree is holding it on the tips of its branches. A low railing runs along its edges and a woven screen stands to one side. Light of sun and stars, warm winds, scents of earth, grass and flowers, and singing of birds are all free to enter this airy dwelling with no roof but for the forest canopy. Here, one could live for ages, forgetting about the ground, using the surrounding branches for support and breathing the sweet forest air.
21931: High above the shimmering golden forest, a lofty flet lies nestled in the branches of a tall mallorn. A light seems to lie on the land around you, shining through every leaf and flower; a power seems to be in every tree, spring or stone, and a memory of ages long gone and forgotten seems to flow through the air.
21932: Curundil the master fletcher is standing here.

Bundles of ash and other wood are stacked high against one wall whereas the rest of the structure boasts the tools of a skilled craftsman. Large windows and an arched doorway offer a glimpse into the golden forest outside. Sounds of a bubbling brook enter through the western window and the gentle fragrance of flowers permeates the air. A small forge sits in one corner, whereas the meagre living quarters are barely concealed by a curtain just opposite.
21934:
The small fierce-looking bat is hanging from the ceiling, obviously sleeping.
The small fierce-looking bat is hanging from the ceiling, obviously sleeping.

As the cavern extends from the south to the north and east, widening slightly, the soft forest soil of the floor and the ceiling is replaced by limestone. Over time, tree roots crumbled the formerly solid rock, first causing fissures to appear on it, then causing first smaller crumbs and then larger chunks to detach and fall off. As the soil mixed with limestone crumbs, moss overtook the cavern floor allowing vines to clamber up the walls, taking hold in every crack. The sound of water can be heard from the east, mixing with its own echoes to create an almost uniform din.
21935: A small wood sprite is sneaking around here.

Damp darkness reigns in this underground hollow. In the gloom, many whispers travel from one unseen wall to another, tangling among the overhanging roots. No words or pattern can be distinguished in these whispers, and it seems as if the trees were talking to each other and to the earth itself. Far away, faint yet distinct, a different sound can be heard - the sound of running water.
21936:
A patch of moss grows here on a wet, flat stone.
An albino salamander is here, perched on some rocks.
An albino salamander is here, perched on some rocks.

Year after year, water dripping from the ceiling of the cavern dissolved the limestone, allowing it to form icicle-like stalactites on the ceiling and stalagmites below them on the floor. Some of these have grown towards each other until they joined, forming uneven pillars. The northern wall of the cavern appears to be solid, but the southern wall has an oval opening in it with a steady cascade of water dropping behind it, filling the air with fine spray and a fresh scent. Echoing among the stalactites and stalagmites in the cavern, the sound of flowing water is multiplied until it turns into a roaring din as if the Sea itself was beating at the shore just outside the walls of this cavern.
21938:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
A patch of moss grows here on a wet, flat stone.
A subterranean lizard is here trying to blend with the surroundings.
A subterranean lizard is here trying to blend with the surroundings.

This passageway is narrow but tall, assembled from grey stone blocks which at one time were fit together masterfully, yet which have now crumbled within the unyielding hands of time. The tunnel bends away to the east, but in the west it has completely caved in. Many splintered bones lie scattered across the black, damp dirt floor, and it appears that a large animal has excavated a sleeping burrow into the western wall.
21939: As it bends from south to west, this narrow passageway is roughly rectangular in its cross-section, although the north-eastern wall leans ominously inward at several points. Many of the grey stones are crumbling into a thin, soft dust that coats the uneven floor. Fresh sets of animal tracks, characterised by a broad, scaly foot, are easily recognisable in this dust.
21940: Judging from the claw marks on the ground, some large animal have dug this muddy burrow through the dirt-filled remains of a caved-in stone tunnel. The walls and floor are made up of damp, black earth interwoven with the occasional roughly-cut stone block and tree-roots of varying diameter. To the north the ancient architecture seems to have better withstood the effects of time, as the muddiness of this pit gives way to an intact stone passageway.
21941: The corpse of a forest giant is lying here.

A massive, weathered boulder sits atop this forested ridge, almost entirely covering a shallow crevice which dips into the rocky ground. Several wide-trunked hardwoods provide cover from the elements on either side of the boulder, so that this natural shelter is well-hidden from the outside. The floor is damp and soft, covered with a thick layer of decaying foliage.
21942:
A tawny-coated bear is sleeping here.
A tawny-coated bear is sleeping here.

This natural cave is airy and spacious. Walls of light stone rise toward a cupola-shaped ceiling that recedes into darkness. Patches of grass billow from a few cracks in the walls and the ground, vigorous despite the everlasting twilight. The floor of the cavern is equally split between soil and stone. The soil patches carry distinct marks of large paws.
21943: A large encrusted cedar chest is standing here.

The floor of this cramped chamber is lined with wooden beams, their surface dusty and spotted. Dead golden leaves glimmer along their edges. The walls narrow quickly toward a square spot at the very centre of the domed ceiling. A rough but recognisable white outline of a hand, its finger pointed upwards, palm forward, marks the north wall.
21944:
An arrow rack stands upright in the corner.
Standing in the rack are eight arrows.

A wooden flet is secured among the lower branches of a tall mallorn tree. Dry branches that form its floor are drawn together with pieces of silvery bark. The whole of it is secured to the wider branches of the supporting tree using four lengths of luminous elven rope. The ends of the ladder are made of the same rope and tied around the main trunk. A few smaller flets are visible in the branches of adjacent trees. They look as if they might be accessible from here.
21945:
A cluster of white star-shaped forget-me-nots flourish here in reminiscence.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.

A foot-high square grey monolith, four hand-spans wide, crowns the hill. The summit of the hill bears a scattering of young hesitant mellyrn and this stone, enigmatically placed in the middle. A majestic view opens from here on the forest, the mountains, and the rivers surrounding and passing through the land. The hill descends sharply in all directions, but some stairs lead from the summit to a level clearing below the top. The southern side of the hill is nearly vertical and bare, while the others have some vegetation and undersized mellyrn struggling to hang on to them.
21946: Vaulting high up the eastern slope of the heavily forested hill, this staircase makes its way up the final stretch of the path toward the summit, seemingly struggling to hold on to the sharp grade, much like the proud mallorn trees around it. Stone slabs, slightly caved-in from wear, comprise most of it, except for a few steps at the bottom where the ground is held together with dead birch branches. A fantastic view of the forest predominantly of pale green and gold opens from here, though a traveller would do well to be cautious should he choose to enjoy it - the staircase is steep and there is no handhold.
21947:
The corpse of a drone bee is lying here.
A drone bee flies around here, angrily buzzing.
A drone bee flies around here, angrily buzzing.
A drone bee flies around here, angrily buzzing.

This enormous beehive with a narrow opening to the north is a tempest of sound and fury. Bees, bees, and more bees dart back and forth in some order that only they can perceive. A modicum of fresh air makes it in through the tiny hexagonal ventilated openings along the top. Such openings are spread all down the sides of the beehive, their purpose there no longer to pass air but to hold that which is the most precious product of honeybees' daily labour.
21948:
There is a huge, pyramidal beehive here.
There is a huge, pyramidal beehive here.
There is a huge, pyramidal beehive here.
A huge, bulky queen bee is here.
An angry bee is working on a honeycomb here.
An angry bee is working on a honeycomb here.

A multitude of glorious golden beehives stand in rows here, constructed and maintained with care and affection by the elves of the Golden Wood, for they are the source of their favourite drink. The pyramidal shapes glitter in the shade of this small forest nook, concealed from outside by trees, moss and old leaves. Merry buzzing permeates the air, getting louder to the south.
21949:
An elven lady is walking around here.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

Amid the thick foliage and branches of the mallorn resides an elven home. The flet is constructed of sturdy, smooth, polished wood. It has no railings; years of living high above the forest floor have enabled the elven residents to move through their vast network of flets without fear of falling down to the ground below.
21950:
A sturdy leather backpack has been left here.
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there is a hunting knife.
A finch flies low above the ground.

Hidden in the branches of a great mallorn tree, this flet seems to be the home of a single elf. The surroundings are simple and even austere. A single table with a chair, a chest and a small pallet are all neatly arranged on the wooden platform. The pallet doesn't appear to be much slept upon, and the rest of the furniture shows traces of only occasional use, suggesting that this elf might be a hunter or a ranger.
21951:
A simple wooden chest is here.
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there are two large yellow apples.
A pretty elven girl is strolling around here.
An elven boy is running about here.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

This is the home of an elven family. The talan, polished smooth, is of medium size, enough to house a few elves and their possessions. The furniture is simple and unmistakably of elven make. The only entrance into this home is the rope ladder leading up the trunk of the great tree.
21952:
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there are a large yellow apple, a loaf of white bread, and a flagon.
An elven lady is walking around here.

After ascending the fine threaded rope ladder to this talan, a wondrous room is revealed. So neatly tucked away in the higher parts of the mallorn tree is this place, surrounded by a thin screen coloured in pale greens and yellows, that one could very easily miss it. The talan itself is quite large and is populated with well-polished wooden furniture, tapestries displayed over the railings and fine embroidered rugs on the smooth wooden floor.
21953: An elven lady is walking around here.

This talan rests high in the branches of a mallorn. It seems that this part of the tree serves as the comfortable bedroom for the elves who live here. On the floor are several wooden pallets with soft down mattresses on them. This talan is not as large as the lower one, but is still a good size, with room enough for a family of elves.
21954: A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.

This beautifully crafted bridge stretches across the deep, shadowed fosse in a graceful arch. Although it is broad enough to carry several elves, there are no pillars supporting its weight, which gives to it a sense of frailty. The low railings are meticulously carved, inlaid with silver and gold. Several arcane symbols can be seen on the railings, as well as rare gems forming mysterious patterns.
21955: A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.

In the deep lane formed between the green walls, the Great Gates of Caras Galadhon are set. The path is laid with stones, placed in such a way as to create vivid patterns on the ground. The sides of the walls are supported by carved and treated wood, with the symbols of Celeborn and Galadriel inlaid in silver.
21956:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
An elven lady is walking around here.

You find yourself on a small path that climbs the gently sloping hill. Laid with white stones in wonderful patterns, the trail carefully avoids the golden trees standing on the hill. Just south of you are the great gates of Caras Galadhon, and to your west the green towering wall rises sharply.
21957:
A brass lantern has been set on the ground.
A large bulletin board, entitled "Warriors' Guild", is mounted here.
An arrow rack stands upright in the corner.
Standing in the rack are two ash arrows.
A sturdy peg for hanging armour from is on the wall.
On the peg, there are a large wooden shield, a pair of hard leather trousers and a small wooden target shield.
A sturdy peg for hanging armour from is on the wall.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack are a longsword, a shortbow and a shortsword.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
Haldir the Elf is here (glowing).
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
A grey-clad elf is here.

A small semicircle of marble benches stands at the foot of a large mallorn. In the centre of the circle there is a table, a chair and a couple of weapon racks. Lying on the table are lists of guards and schedules. The racks are full of weapons for use by the elves on guard and by other residents of Caras Galadhon should the city be under siege. A ladder stands against the wall that towers south of here, providing easy access to the top.
21958:
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Small paths form large intricate patterns amidst the lush bright flowers that grow here. The few mellyrn standing around almost seem to have deliberately left this space open to let the sun and stars shine unhindered upon the dazzling display of elanor and niphredil.
21959: A sturdy trained horse is standing here.

The small glittering stream gains speed here, running swiftly southward in eager anticipation towards its union with the greater waters of the world. Towering above is the great wall surrounding the city, and all around you is the garden of Galadriel - enchanted, beautiful and immortal.
21960: The river runs down into the ground below the wall, babbling and sparkling as the last rays of light gradually filter away. Turning slightly, the stream hurries onward, never hesitating, into the deeper shadows.
21961: Completely submerged in water, you barely manage to see that the dark is being replaced by grey shadows as the water pushes on. The walls have been polished smooth by the flowing water. There is nowhere you can get a firm grip or foothold as the stream drags you along farther southward.
21962: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Skirting the great wall, the trail darts in and out of the woods, twisting and turning. Both to the north and to the east the path vanishes quickly among the mighty golden trees that stand towering above you. From within the reaches of the enchanted forest you can hear the faint whispers of the trees and the soft singing of the ever-present nightingales.
21963: The small path runs up the hill, winding and twisting to avoid the trees that surround it. A few steps of marble here and there ease the ascent where the slope of the hill is more steep. From the south voices can be heard, carried on a light breeze from the great gates of the city that can just barely be discerned among the golden trees that stand high and proud all around you. The path beneath your feet runs both west and south from here.
21964: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

You find yourself on the southern slope of the hill among the large mellyrn that are the heart of the golden forest. The forest opens up slightly to your north higher on the slope where the elves have planted a beautiful vineyard. Just east of here you can spot a thick hedge, preventing passage both east and south, although there seems to be a small passage in it that could lead you onward.
21965:
Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.
Delicate golden blooms adorn the ground like a cascade of stars.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A nightingale is here, chirping a sweet melody.

The forest opens up, allowing the light of heavens to fall down onto Galadriel's enchanted garden. Solemn and lonely, a few mellyrn stand towering in the midst of a mosaic of colours. Narrow, well-trodden paths form strange patterns amongst the flowers, separating them into fields of dazzling and sparkling beauty. The chirping of nightingales can be heard from all around against the quiet babbling of the fountain stream.
21966: A narrow, gracefully arched bridge leads across the sparkling fountain stream connecting the garden of Galadriel with the valley that is home to the Mirror. The bridge is cut out of white stone, polished and inlaid with silver strands, making it shine and sparkle in the lights of the city. During cloudless dark nights the light of the stars is reflected by the surface of the bridge, throwing cascades of light onto the flowing water below it.
21967: A wide and shallow basin of silver rests here on a pedestal.

A small valley lies hidden here within dense hedges, yet open to the skies above. Not much disturbs the peace and silence, almost as if the living forest around was showing respect towards this obscured place. In the centre of the low green hollow stands a single white basin, sparkling as light reflects from its surface.
21968:
A sturdy target for arrows, made out of thatch, stands here.
An elf, clad in the garments of a woodsman, moves stealthily among the trees.

Quiet and solemn, the tall trees stand here reaching upward, as if straining to reach the sky in competition with the green wall encircling the city. A rope is tied to several trees and poles forming an enclosure. The enclosed area contains an archery range with distinct shooting stations. The slope is rather level here but rises quite sharply to the northeast, climbing towards the crown of the green hill.
21969: Among the towering mellyrn of the golden forest the wind whispers softly, carrying words of power and wisdom. Throughout the woods soft voices can be heard. A small stair of white polished marble ascends the hillside, beckoning travellers to climb and get a better view, but the trees stand too thickly to allow much to be seen. The path quickly hides behind the trees both to the north and to the south, as the golden forest stretches out to cover and shelter its inhabitants.
21970: Just off the path into the magnificent forest, a few bells hang from a branch. As the wind blows gently, the bells create quiet and beautiful sounds and harmonies at the very edge of your hearing. Close to your east you can spot a small vineyard that lies in a clearing. North, up the slope of the hill, the trees stand denser but still the light of skies manages to filter down through the canopy, dancing across the leaves and undergrowth.
21971:
There are three piles of juicy grapes here.
A grey-clad elf is here.

This vineyard grows on the bank of the fountain stream. Here the elves grow the large grapes from which they make the delicious wines which are served with their meals. The golden forest itself has graciously stepped aside, allowing the vines ample space to grow strong and healthy.
21972:
A swan swims gracefully on the surface of the water.
A brook trout is here, swimming in the current.

As the stream leaves the crown of the hill, it starts its long journey towards the great rivers. Hurrying down the slope, the water almost seems alive, jumping, laughing and teasing as it travels through the softly whispering woods.
21973: Twisting and turning between the trees, the stream is making its way down the slope slowly and gently. Always sparkling and babbling, the water fills the surrounding woods with a soft soothing veil of sound. Flowing south, the small fountain stream rushes below a bridge of white stone before continuing its long journey towards its distant goal.
21974: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

A large mallorn stands here, its branches reaching high up into the sky. Soft voices can be heard from a large flet that rests among the branches of the tree. A ladder stands against the bole of the mallorn, leading up towards the flet. As the trail continues east, the dense trees open up into a small clearing from which you can hear soft music being played.
21975:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A young bard is standing here, singing softly.
Rumil the Master Bard of Lothlorien is here smiling gently (glowing).

Here the bards of Caras Galadhon hold their assembly and this is where they sing and play, performing and telling tales. Anyone who wants to is welcome to listen and share their tales. Even when the clearing is empty, the surrounding trees seem to sing in soft whispers the tales of the bards. In the centre of this small clearing stands a polished marble statue in the shape of a harp. As the soft winds rustle through the clearing, the strings of the harp are set in motion, creating quiet, gentle music.
21978:
An apple tree with bright green leaves grows here.
On the tree's branches are six large yellow apples.
An apple tree with bright green leaves grows here.

On the western slope of the hill close to the wall stand a few trees that are not of mallorn kind. Large and fair, these apple trees strive to match the splendour of the golden forest, but struggle in vain. Even bearing some of the finest apples known on Arda, the poor trees shrink in comparison to the surrounding woods, but even so they are loved and cared for by the elves of Caras Galadhon, who gratefully accept the fruit of the competition.
21979: Close to the high wall surrounding the city, the ground levels out until the slope is almost insignificant. The dense forest approvingly gives room to the wall that rises sharply in the east. Just to the north, the forest opens up around a large, ancient mallorn standing in solemn and quiet contemplation. To the west you can barely discern a path running through the woods.
21980:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.

One of the tallest trees in Caras Galadhon towers towards the sky here. Not only does it dwarf the surrounding mellyrn, but it rises high above the wall as well. All around the tree the forest is dense, but closer to the wall the woods are more sparse, almost as if the trees were keeping the distance out of respect.
21981: You find yourself on the eastern slope of Caras Galadhon close to the great defensive wall of the city. The trees do not grow too close to the wall, so the forest is rather open and light. The winds play freely among the branches, and the leaves rustle softly above you.
21982: Just next to the trail rises the high green wall that forms the defence line of the elven city. The golden trees grow high here, almost touching the sky as they stretch their branches towards the heavens in friendly competition with the neighbouring wall.
21983:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A grey-clad elf is here.

This white platform rests comfortably among the branches high in a tree. Several shelves stand along the edges, laden with exquisite armour and weapons - the smith's personal favourites which are not for sale. The railing that encircles the flet is made of a fine silver chain resting on smooth black iron posts from which the light of the silver lamps is reflected in all directions.
21984:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
A large encrusted cedar chest is standing here.
A small oaken table has been set here.
A noble Elf stands here, proudly displaying his valuable assets.

This small flet glitters and sparkles in the light. On display in cabinets are luxurious items, crafted by the last of the great artisans from the old Noldorin city of Ost-in-Edhil. Wooden shelves and work benches are placed in a semi-circle around a small stone hearth that stands off towards a corner. Tiny flames dance in the fireplace, allowing the smiths to heat and work their material to perfection. A couple of wooden chests and a table are placed along the edge of the flet. In a corner are a few sleeping mats.
21985:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
Ecthelion the Elven-smith is here.
A grey-clad elf is here.

Close to the wall the forest gives way and opens up into a small clearing. At its centre stands a small forge with a roof supported by wooden pillars. Here the smiths of the city craft their beautiful artefacts, as well as repair and create the tools and weaponry that are used daily by the elves. The capacity of the forge is not too large, but the workers are masters of their art and love their craft.
21986:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
A young smith is standing here, working the forge.
A grey-clad elf is here.
A grey-clad elf is here.

A large mallorn rises to the sky here. It stands in solitude, quiet and solemn, as if left alone by the rest of the forest out of respect. Under its sprawling branches the smiths and armourers of the Galadhrim meet to exchange knowledge and teach their apprentices. Tools of all kinds lie neatly arranged on a small wooden table standing at the foot of the tree. Placed in a semicircle around the table are several benches of white marble. A small fire burns on a forge just next to the table.
21987: Beneath the Flets of the Galadhrim

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

On the northern slope of the high hill, close to the wall you hear the sounds of a forge mixing with elvish songs, laughter and shouts reverberating through the woods. The high trees standing here are crowded with flets, the wooden platforms where the Galadhrim dwell. Ladders run up almost every tree. Several rope bridges connect the tree-crowns.
21988: Beneath the Flets of the Galadhrim
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

You find yourself by the wall on the northern slope of the hill, surrounded by the tall mellyrn that are homes for the Galadhrim. Almost every tree rises proudly towards the sky and carries several flets among its branches. From within the greenery you can hear laughter and song, the soft language of the elves whispering soothing words.
21991: Beneath the Flets of the Galadhrim

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

Here, among the flets in the heart of the Galadhrim habitat, you are surrounded by the sounds of everyday life. A child laughing, soft voices and soft singing envelop you among the well-trodden paths. High up in almost every tree lie several flets, making the treetops burst with life. Rope and wooden ladders climb up the boles of several trees. High in the tree-crowns, rope bridges can be seen running between the flets.
21992: Beneath the Flets of the Galadhrim

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
Celebrindal, Lady of the Galadhrim, is before you.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

You find yourself on the outskirts of Caras Galadhon, close to the towering wall that surrounds the large hill. High up among the trees you can see some wooden flets among the branches. On these platforms elves move about, singing softly or laughing and shouting to each other. The trees open up into a large clearing just to the west, but to the south the forest grows dense.
21993: A wooden chest stands in the corner.

High up in the air this large wooden platform rests securely in the branches of a huge mallorn. The flet is furnished rather sparsely although still quite functionally. Several sleeping mats lie rolled up in a corner and a table and some benches stand in the centre. As a soft breeze gently blows through the leaves, the outside light is dispersed and gives life to fantastic displays of greenish light and shadows.
21994: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Bending slowly, the twisting trail runs up the slope, climbing higher and higher towards the crown of the hill. Passing between the tall mellyrn, the trail evades them carefully, as if it does not want to disturb the ancient trees. Just west off the path one can spot some trees bearing large yellow fruits, but the path turns away from them, continuing south and east.
21995:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A pack horse (Rood) is standing here, ridden by you.

Stretching along the slope of the hill, the path can follow a nearly straight course here, diverting only infrequently to pass by the trees that grow less densely in this part of the forest. Just east of here it forks, travelling both east and south. To the west the path also curves softly southwards. Although rooted in ground lower down the slope to the north, a tall mallorn towers high above you, dwarfing the surrounding trees.
21996:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A grey-clad elf is here.

As the path reaches the crown of the hill, the golden forest opens up graciously, letting the trail split into a fork. Reaching into the heart of Caras Galadhon, the path travels towards the shimmering white fountain lying just south of here. Northward it travels down the slopes into the surrounding forest, passing among the trees crowded with the flets of the Galadhrim.
21997: Beneath the Flets of the Galadhrim

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
Celebrindal, Lady of the Galadhrim, is before you (hidden).
A grey-clad elf is here.

You find yourself on the northern slope of the large hill between a winding trail and the heart of the Galadhrim habitat. The large mellyrn rising high on the slope below you are crowded with families living on the wooden platforms - flets, that are so common among the forest-dwelling elves.
21998: Beneath the Flets of the Galadhrim
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Here, some way up the northern slope, you are in the middle of the everyday life of the Galadhrim elves. Voices ring out from within the tall trees, calling out from the lofty flets resting on the branches of the proud mellyrn. To the east the forest opens up into a large clearing bustling with activity. A winding trail passes through the forest just to the south.
21999:
A large bonfire is burning here.
A brass lantern has been set on the ground.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A grey-clad elf is here.
An elven boy is running about here.

Although large, this clearing never feels empty. The trees around it fill the air with soft singing of the birds, and the voices of the Galadhrim can be heard faintly through the woods. Being in the centre of the Galadhrim habitat, the clearing is a central gathering spot for the festivities in the city. In the centre of the clearing stones are laid out, covering the ground so as not to damage it when the great bonfires are lit during the feasts.
22000: A Path through the Golden Forest

A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A grey-clad elf is here.

Running along the slope of the hill, the small trail leads through the golden forest, twisting and turning to avoid the large trees. Tall and mighty, the surrounding mellyrn rise above the path, hiding it from the sky and shrouding it in soft shadows. The soft whispers of the trees mingle with the singing of birds to create a feeling of tranquility as well as serenity.
22001: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Bending sharply, the path continues through the forest, running along the gentle slope. The trees are not very dense here, letting the light of the skies fall directly on the ground, creating pictures of gold, green and black in the undergrowth. Just east of the trail is a dense stand of young trees striving for space in youthful competition, and north of here the woods open up into a large clearing. Continuing south and west, the trail vanishes among the trees as it curves around the hill.
22002: What must have been a clearing just a few years ago is now full of young trees, striving towards the sky. Reaching only a few yards up in the air, the young mellyrn are unhindered in their growth as they are widely spaced and cared for by the elves.
22003: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Following the slope, the trail curves gently as it runs west and south. As the tall trees stand rather far apart here, light of the skies plays freely among their branches and on the ground beneath them. Just north of here grows a small stand of low young mellyrn, while farther down the slope towering trees loom high above you.
22004: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The small trail runs through the forest, carefully avoiding the trees, almost as if it had asked the forest's permission before starting on its ardous journey. High trees arch above the trail, creating a ceiling that filters the light, letting only a few rays pass through. As the light reaches the ground, it illuminates the forest, making it spring into colour and life. Among the splendid scenery you hear soft singing and voices coming from the south.
22005: You find yourself on the eastern slope of the hill of Caras Galadhon. Through the surrounding trees you hear song and laughter and the occasional warbling of a bird. Where the forest opens up towards the north and east, a small curving path makes its way through the trees. From the south you can hear the quiet burbling of a small stream.
22006: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

The path makes a turn here, bending towards the east and north. As the forest is rather spacious, it can run in an almost straight line along the slope of the hill, only avoiding an occasional golden tree. Very soft splashing noises can be heard in the distant south, mingling with soft singing coming from the east. As the forest is not so dense here, the light cast by the skies creates a vivid display of many colours.
22008: A Small Stream through the Lawn

A swan swims gracefully on the surface of the water.
Galadriel the Lady of Lorien is standing here (glowing).

Flowing gently down the slope, heading southeast, the small stream seems almost to be alive. The soft whispers of the trees are answered by the soft splashing noises of the sparkling water. Very faintly, almost too low to hear, the stream seems to sing and laugh, teasing you as it travels from the great fountain to the northwest on its long journey to meet the oceans.
22009: At the Home of Celeborn and Galadriel

A large bulletin board, entitled "Board of the Free Peoples", is mounted here.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.

The large hill that is Caras Galadhon is crowned by a lush green lawn with a great mallorn reaching high into the sky. The trunk is so thick that it would take a small army to encircle it. A small stair runs up the trunk to the lower levels of the flet that can barely be discerned through the colourful branches. Looking around, the view is splendid, although the surrounding forest blocks most of it. Still you can gaze over the golden forest and see Galadriel's Garden as well as the sparkling waters flowing down the hill. Just north of the mallorn lies a white fountain that sparkles and splashes. Beside it lies a small pavillion, its glass windows flashing a myriad of colours towards you.
22010:
A well-crafted white fountain is here, water pouring forth from it.
Randir the elven guide is standing here.
A beautiful and docile horse is standing here.
A grey-clad elf is here.

Surrounded by grass, the white marble fountain is standing in front of the great mallorn that is the home of Celeborn and Galadriel. Shimmering and sparkling as the flowing water catches the light, the fountain creates a veil of soft, soothing splendour. The faint noise of water splashing down in the small marble pool surrounding the fountain is relaxing. The combined effect of the sounds of the pool and the fountain creates a sense of tranquility, as well as deep joy. A small stream leaves the pool, slowly making its way southeast down the slope, beginning the long arduous journey towards the mighty river Anduin.
22011: A large and finely decorated harp of white marble has been built here.

You find yourself high on the western slope just below the crest of the hill, where anyone would feel small in comparison to the towering mallorn rising to the east. It is by far the largest tree within the city walls. The surrounding trees seem to shrink, unable to match the uncrowned king of the mellyrn.
22012: Here, on the western slope just below the crest of the hill, tall trees rise high towards the skies. Just off the path the undergrowth is still not very dense, and the ceiling of leaves allows the light of heavens to filter down to set off dancing shadows within the woods.
22013: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Working its way up the slope, the winding path climbs slowly towards the top of the hill. Bordered on all sides by the towering trees, the path passes beneath arches of green, softly whispering branches that filter the faint light of sun, moon, or stars reaching through them to the ground.
22014: Having climbed almost halfway up the western slope of the large hill, the twisting path carefully skirts the large trees as it darts in and out between the massive trunks. As the trail curves along the slope, it makes a rather sharp turn and vanishes behind the hill just to the north.
22015: A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.

Just north of the great trunk of the mallorn, this large wooden platform rests among the lower branches of the tree. Encircled by a low railing, with many wooden chairs surrounding round wooden tables, this flet is where most of the elves eat their meals. Alongside the western edge of the platform hang a few silvery wind chimes that create soft, soothing music as the wind gently sways the branches of the tall tree.
22016:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A grey-clad elf is here.

Circling the massive trunk of the great mallorn, the wooden stairs lead high up in the tree. Several exits on the different levels lead to flets that have been built among the great grey branches. From within the greenery, laughter and singing can be heard as well as soft speech and the faint noises of kitchen staff preparing a meal.
22017:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
An elven caretaker is standing here, offering his guests a rest.
A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

Being close to the ground, this white platform is not encircled by any rail. Instead, beautiful draperies and tapestries hang from the many branches that surround the flet. Swaying gently in the breeze, images on the colourful cloth create a place where one can stand and let the mind wander into the stories told by the everchanging patterns.
22018:
A large cabinet capable of storing goods is here.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
An elven cook is standing here, singing softly as she prepares a meal.
An elven scout stands here, blending in with the background.
An elven scout stands here, blending in with the background.

This small talan is sturdy, constructed to withstand almost anything. In the centre of the flet is a large oven, surrounded by a few smaller hearths that are the source of all greater meals served in the home of Celeborn. Here also are made meals for the guards and visiting woodsmen who are only in the city for a short while. A small parchment note is secured to the trunk.
22019:
A large bulletin board, entitled "News of Arda", is mounted here.
A huge clock is standing here.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
A wary elf, all clad in grey, moves silently here.

Small but still of great importance, this white flet rests high up in the tree, gently embraced by the strong branches. This is where the council meets to run the normal affairs of the city. This is also where scouts and rangers report as they arrive in the city with messages or dispatches from the borders. A great round table stands in the centre, surrounded by large wooden chairs. In a corner stands a large bookshelf, filled with maps and books.
22020:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
A small oaken table has been set here.
A large bookshelf sits against the wall.
On the bookshelf, there is a Grey Havens map, a map of Rivendell and a silvery-green leaf.
An elf sits here delving into some old tomes of elven lore.
An elven librarian is here taking care of all the books.
A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.

The sounds of the city recede slightly when one enters the great library of Caras Galadhon. Much of the great tree is used to create the walls and the ceiling of this house of knowledge. Great boughs arch high above, forming a vast dome of whispering green or golden leaves. The grey bole of the mallorn, together with screens and curtains hanging from the lower branches, helps shield the large chamber from the activities on the talan outside. Bookshelves and tables stand in ranks, filled with knowledge, both ancient and newly gained.
22021:
A large bulletin board, entitled "Tales", is mounted here.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
Celeborn the Lord of Lorien is standing here (glowing).
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
Eregalen the Elf, wielding a nasty orkish fang, is resting here.
A sturdy trained horse is standing here.
An elven lady is walking around here.

This great hall is a chamber of oval shape, in the middle of which is one of the trunks of the great mallorn, tapering towards its crown and yet still making a pillar of wide girth. The chamber is filled with a soft light; its walls are of green and silver and its roof of gold. Chairs enough for many elves to be seated stand on the wooden floor. Beside the bole of the tree and canopied by a living bough stand two thrones, gleaming and glittering in the sparkling light of silver lamps.
22022:
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.
A tall and proud elf is standing here.

High up in the tree this large platform the size of an ocean-faring ship rests secure in the embrace of the great mallorn. On the northern part of the flet lies a small palace built of the finest wood, while the southern part is wide open and free. A low railing encircles the flet. A polished wooden stair runs along the bole of the tree to ease the travel between its different levels.
22023:
A large bulletin board, entitled "Free Peoples' Chronicles", is mounted here.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is hanging from a tree branch.
A young bard is standing here, singing softly.
A beautiful and docile horse is standing here.
An elven lady is walking around here.

The great platform lies firm against the thick branches of the mallorn, not moving even as gusts of winds sway the smaller branches. A narrow wooden railing runs all around the platform. The most prominent feature in sight is the great hall that lies on the northern part of the flet, although several other features attract attention. The polished floor is covered with beautiful carvings inlaid with silver strands that glitter in vivid patterns, reflecting light from a myriad of silver lamps and sending it to dance among the branches. The railing is meticulously crafted out of the finest wood by the finest artisans. It seems delicate yet is strong and supportive, just like the elves themselves.
22024: An excellent view opens from the top of the great green wall that encircles the fair city of Caras Galadhon. A well-trodden path atop the bulwarks, shielded by protective crenellations, allows the elven archers to patrol the city and keep a vigilant watch on the surrounding woods. Below, the golden forest stretches out far in all directions, the only break in the green and gold being that of the white stone road far below, running just outside the wall.
22025:
An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.
A grey-clad elf is here.

Protecting Caras Galadhon, the broad city walls rise high, allowing a splendid view and a perfect defensive position. Letting the eyes wander, one cannot help feeling awed by the beauty of the land. The forest lying below, the white stone road, the deep fosse encircling the city appear to be works of perfection, art and harmony. A feeling of peace seems to fill the air as one gazes north into the depths of the golden forest.
22026: Facing mainly north, the wall rises high above the ground. Below the wall lies the great golden forest, spreading towards the horizon in all directions before vanishing in a haze far far away. Closer by one can see the white stone road that encircles the city and the deep fosse which forms the first line of defence of Caras Galadhon.
22027:
An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.
A grey-clad elf is here.

Broad and high, the impressive wall surrounding the city allows a few elves to walk abreast easily. Curving softly, it faces northeast, giving a beautiful view of the golden forest. The most prominent landmark lies at your feet - the deep shadowed fosse, lying just outside the wall.
22028:
A large encrusted cedar chest is standing here.
A lovely elven maid is working as a seamstress here.

This is where the tailors and seamstresses of Caras Galadhon sew, embroider and mend the delicate clothes for the elves of the city, from the smallest child to Lady Galadriel herself. Strips of silk and cotton and rolls of threads lie scattered all around the platform. Scissors and needles are stuck into rolls of threads or hung in pouches from the branches. In the back of the flet are many buckets of dyes of all colours. The elves seem to favour most green, blue, yellow, white and grey, similar to the colours of the golden forest, but other dyes are available as well, for those that might have a fancy to use them.
22029: A wooden chest stands in the corner.

Cradled in the midst of the strong branches close to the great grey trunk of the tall mallorn is a small platform that is sparsely furnished. A low railing encircles the flet and a few sleeping mats lie on the floor. A small chest for personal belongings stands in a corner. A small table is in the centre of the talan, surrounded by wooden chairs.
22030:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
A large bookshelf sits against the wall.
On the bookshelf, there are a quill pen and a piece of paper.

High above the ground this platform lies cradled among the branches of the large tree. The dense foliage forms a canopy that encloses the flet keeping the inhabitants dry. A few sleeping mats lie neatly on the floor, and a large round table with a few benches around it stands by the trunk of the tree. Two large wooden chests and a fine bookshelf stand near the edge of the flet side by side.
22031:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.
An elven lady is walking around here.

This large flet high up in the tree is scantily furnished with a few sleeping mats, a small table and two benches. Besides this furniture, one can see a small wooden chest standing near the edge of the platform and a bookshelf that stands close to the trunk of the tree. The branches surrounding the flet offer some shelter but still let the light filter in, brightly coloured by the leaves that act as a roof. Rope bridges lead from the flet in all directions but north, and a white ladder leads down to the ground.
22032:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there are a quill pen and a piece of paper.

This large wooden platform high among the branches of a tall mallorn tree is obviously the home of a few families. The flet is divided into a few smaller parts, all of which are furnished in rather similar ways: a few sleeping mats, a table or two, a few chairs or benches and a couple of wooden chests. A ladder leads up to another flet along the bole of the tree.
22033:
A large encrusted cedar chest is standing here.
A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.

High above the sloping ground, where the elves of Caras Galadhon reside, wooden platforms, known to the elves as flets, rest amid the thick branches of the tall trees. This platform is neatly furnished. A few sturdy wooden beds and several sleeping mats indicate that this is a large household. A finely carved wooden chest standing off to the side gives an air of importance to the room, as does a large table surrounded by carefully crafted chairs.
22034:
A large bookshelf sits against the wall.
On the bookshelf, there are a piece of paper, a quill pen and a silvery-green leaf.

This white talan is rather small and contains only a a wooden desk, a chair and a couple of bookshelves. Several rolled-up parchments lie on the desk. A quill pen and a small flask of ink complete the image of a home of an elderly scholar.
22035:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
A sturdy peg for hanging armour from is on the wall.
On the peg, there are a forest green cloak and a plain hood.

This large platform rests securely in the firm grip of the great tree. The flet is big enough to house two families that have put up small screens to divide the platform into smaller parts. Sleeping mats lie all over the floor and several small chests stand along the low wooden railing.
22036: An elven boy is running about here.

From atop the great green wall encircling the fair city of Caras Galadhon you have an excellent view of the golden forest of Lothlorien lying at your feet. Its vast expanse of trees reaches for the horizon, undisturbed in its might and beauty.
22037: An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.

High upon the slightly curving wall that rises above the golden forest, you get a view that is best described as magnificent and breathtaking. The forest stretches out below you towards the horizon, only disturbed close to the wall by a small silvery band trailing southward and by the deep fosse surrounding the wall.
22038: Almost right above the assembly of the bards, the air is filled with sweet music that makes the post on the eastern wall more a reward than a duty. The high wall faces due east here, falling off sharply towards the deep fosse before the green and golden forest reaching out towards the horizon.
22039: An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.

Facing due east, you are perched on top of the great defensive walls of Caras Galadhon. Just below the wall, the trees thin out as the ground sinks into the broad and deep fosse that lies in shadows just beneath the wall. Lifting the gaze, one can watch the forest stretch endlessly towards the eastern horizon.
22040: Finding yourself on top of the green wall you have an excellent view. Behind you, the large hill that is Caras Galadhon rises, and below you, the shadowed fosse lies in grey shadow, spanned by a shining white bridge. You can see the great gates of the proud elven city by your feet. A ladder leads down to the ground, and one could take a stroll along the wall as it is broad enough to let several elves walk abreast.
22041: An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

High up on the broad southern wall, your position allows you to see far away. Curving slightly, the top of the bulwarks is a path, worn by many feet of the elven guards walking the rounds. The golden forest stretches out for miles and miles in front of you, interrupted only by the broad shining silver band of the Celebrant in the distance. Behind you lies the city of Caras Galadhon in splendour and radiant beauty.
22042: An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.

Curving ever so slightly, the wall still faces mostly southward, giving you a splendid view above the surrounding forest and the deep shadowed fosse. To the north rises the green tree-covered hill that is the heart of Lorien, and just by the foot of the hill lies the enchanted garden of Galadriel.
22043:
A brass lantern has been set on the ground.
An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.

This small platform has been built close to the gate to allow archers a better firing position. On the outside it is walled to shield the elves, and there are small apertures to allow free line of sight. Just west of the platform the wall runs above the great gates and to the east it slopes downward. A small circular tower stands on the wall just above the gates, its smooth surface reflecting light in all directions.
22044: Above the wall, a large platform lies nested in the greenery, carefully crafted to blend into the surroundings. The hidden position allows any defender to send a storm of lethal arrows raining down onto anyone trying to breach the great gates of the city. At this elevated position, a small tower was built, reaching skywards to allow an unsurpassed view of the approaches to the city. Looking almost due southwest, you can see far past the gate in the green wall surrounding the large hill of Caras Galadhon. Directly below you, spanning the shadowed fosse, lies a sparkling stone bridge, leading towards the great gates of the city. Beyond the bridge stretches the great body of the mallorn forest, the enchanted Golden Wood of Lothlorien.
22045:
A brass lantern has been set on the ground.
An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.

High above the ground, this elevated platform has been built to allow the defenders of Caras Galadhon to wreak havoc on any advancing invaders. Crafted to blend in with the hill and the wall, the platform is surrounded by finely made ornamented walls built to shield the archers, both from view and from any incoming fire. Looking away from the high platform, slightly to the southwest you can make out several details in the surrounding woods: a towering mallorn, the deep shadowed fosse and the shining white bridge spanning it, the graceful white stone road running in a circle around the wall and the broad silver band of the Celebrant in the distance.
22046:
An arrow rack stands upright in the corner.
Standing in the rack are five ash arrows.
A finely crafted crystal lamp is here.
An elven archer dressed in green is here, watching the forest.
An elf of the Galadhrim is walking around here.

This small tower stands directly above the gate of Caras Galadhon. A few narrow open windows are placed waist-high in the circular wall at even distances to allow archers to watch and fire upon an approaching foe. Even though it is built for the purpose of defence, it is richly decorated with carvings in the wood and silver lamps to light the dark.
22047: From this high ledge on the green wall you can see the great gates of the city of the Galadhrim just below. The large forested hill of Caras Galadhon is due north of you, and to the south a deep fosse lies below your feet, only spanned by a sparkling white bridge. You can make out the forest road leading due south as well as the white stone road that runs around the city.
22084:
There are two large stone jars here.
A clear pool of water has formed amongst some nearby tree roots.

In an age not remembered by many, an array of silver-barked beech trees were planted to form this protective circle. Though these noble trees look decrepit and nigh on ruined, the elaborately arranged branches and thick solid trunks are evidence that they were once lovingly tended. The ground is level but strewn with rocks and scattered with dry leaves that crunch underfoot. A pile of decaying ferns lay on the western side of the enclosure. Along the southern side a spring noiselessly bubbles water from beneath the ground.
22085: This shallow hole has barely enough room for a child to stand in. Dug out of the rich composted soil long ago, the sides of this hollow have become crumbly and can easily be scraped away. The earth along the southern edge is more compact and long marks have been scratched out its surface. It looks like huge fingers worked tirelessly to gouge out the soil. On the bottom of the hole, the crumbled earth has formed a thick powdery layer.
22087:
Bunnud is standing here.
Elemmire the Elf, wielding a double edged eket, is standing here.
A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.
Thram, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.

A long and narrow, earth-filled tunnel stretches into the milky darkness. Diseased roots are visible throughout the walls, victims of an unknown source that is poisoning the flora of the area. Decaying pieces of vegetation are littered on the ground in this tunnel.
22088:
Bunnud is standing here.
Elemmire the Elf, wielding a double edged eket, is standing here.
A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.
Thram, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.

As the tunnel twists and bends, steady feet are required to negotiate the serpentine curves and the muddy floor. The air is still and damp. An odour of death and decay lingers in the dark. The tunnel coils south and east.
22089:
Bunnud is standing here.
Elemmire the Elf, wielding a double edged eket, is standing here.
A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.
Thram, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.

At a turn in this dark, dank tunnel, death is palpable. Dead, rotting roots protrude from every surface. Spider webs are widely strung from one jagged surface to the next. Small skeletal corpses, picked clean of every bit of flesh, litter the ground.
22090:
A tiny spider is here, fighting Bunnud.
A worm is here slithering around.
A monstrous black spider prepares to trap her next meal.
Bunnud is here, fighting a tiny spider.
Elemmire the Elf, wielding a double edged eket, is standing here.
A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.
Thram, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.

The tunnel narrows drastically, hampering your very movements. The smell of death, once subtle, has grown noticeably stronger. An assortment of bones and rotted flesh become more conspicuous with each step taken. The tunnel twists north and west.
22105:
An old, sturdy mine cart stands here on the end of a pair of iron rails.
A soot-covered Urughash is here, mining away at the rock.
A soot-covered Urughash is here, mining away at the rock.
A short Urughash is here, watching the area.
A malicious Urughash is here, keeping the miners in line.

A pair of flickering torches mark the path where the mines take a bend to the east and south. A hard concoction of rocks and mud covers the ground among an old set of rusted iron rails that lead southwards. It seems the orcs were trying to mine to the east, but dark cracks in the ceiling tell a more horrendous tale. The ceiling consists of dark roughened rock, its sides grated with pick axe marks, causing large crevices to appear within the rock.
22306: The current is strong and turbulent here as the water flows against a solid cliff face to the west and the river is forced southwards around it. However, despite the strong eddies, the water is clear so the rocky cliff and the riverbed can be easily seen.
22317: The strong branches of the great trees end in front of the wall of a steep cliff rising above the tree tops. An arrowtip-shaped piece of the cliff has collapsed down in the forest, and the resulting breach is now at the height of the tree forks. A large branch is only two feet away from the cliff and could be used to jump into the breach. The way down is more hazardous, as no lower branches can be spotted from this location.
22325: A rich growth of algae, moss, and liverwort covers the rocks in the roaring, mist-shrouded falls. As the river flows from the deep pool at the base of the cascade it quickly picks up speed, funnelled between steep rocky riverbanks. The river froths and churns as it moves rapidly through the densely wooded landscape.
22339: The water here is a maelstrom of sound and crushing power as masses of water flow down from the river far above. The river runs wildly here, swirling and pulling at you, sucking you below the surface and pulling you towards the fast flowing rapids to the east.
22340: A sturdy pack horse is standing here.

An ancient decaying oak looms overhead, laid to rest across the fast flowing river. The fallen tree forms a natural bridge across the river, although judging by the large chunks of decaying wood that occasionally fall from its bulk, It may prove to be unfriendly to those who attempt its passage.
22360: The river here narrows to less than forty feet at the top of the falls before cascading eastwards over the edge of a steep incline down into a mist shrouded emptiness far below. Only a madman would fling himself out into such emptiness, as the concealing spray of the crashing waters might hide all manner of interesting, but painful ways, to die.
22361: Fierce currents from the pressure of the pounding water crashing down the waterfall from the river above, suck at the arms and legs, pulling you from side to side and pushing you down into the plunge pools depths. The powerful down force of the crashing churning water tires the body and saps the will to fight for the faint light so near yet so far above.
22412: Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.

The forest is not too thick here but gets much thicker to the southeast. A small mallorn grows here, dwarfed by its larger ancestors. Although the young tree has a long way to grow in order to reach the heights of the tallest mellyrn of this wood, the canopy of branches is not so dense here and it will receive the sunlight it needs. Myriads of small bushes and plants flourish on the forest floor. The niphredil flower has done exceptionally well here. It grows in clusters, its white contrasting sharply with the deep green of the lush grass.
22413: A dense carpet of blue flowers dip their heads in the breeze.

The forest ground slopes down to the west. Layers of mallorn blooms and leaves from the previous years make the trek in that direction a slippery one. A row of mellyrn to the east and another to the west form a corridor from the south to the north. Scents of many flowers fill the air.
22414: The foliage of the trees here is of medium thickness, just enough to give this part of the forest just a little shade from the light of day. The silver-barked mellyrn are joined by some slender and bright white birches. Together, the white and silver boles stand like so many frosty pillars beneath the green and golden foliage that comprises the leafy canopy above.
22415: The sounds of the forest are readily apparent here. The rushing of water can be heard not too far away. The chirping of birds and the occasional animal noises can be heard from every direction. Many insects are swarming around.
22416: In the Midst of the Trees

The mellyrn that dominate this Elven wood are joined here by graceful elms and tall, thin birches whose white papery bark peels at the touch. The forest is quite dense, but many paths through the undergrowth make it easy to find the way among the trees without getting lost.
22417: The forest is dominated by the sounds of the Celebrant that rushes past seemingly not far from here. To the north, the wide graceful boughs of Elven mallorn trees beckon, as if promising a quieter solitude than this noisy forest near the river.
22418: Several blooms of snow-white and palest green cover the ground.

The forest around you is filled with fresh air as a soft warble from the flow of water carries on the wind. To the southeast the river Celebrant flows lazily eastward, searching for a path that will allow it to join with the river Anduin. The slender mellyrn, that densely pack this region, stand tall, with their long branches concealing the sky.
22419: From this opening in the forest to the south one can see the swift Celebrant unobstructed by the trees. It flows east, makes a turn to the north in the distance and disappears to the northeast. Of all the mellyrn, a single tree stands out. Its silvery grey trunk divides near the top into a crown, much like others' of its kind. But the branches seem to have grown to the soft murmuring of the waters below - they quite clearly depict the twists and turns of the Celebrant!
22420: A small grasshopper clings to a blade of grass, ready to spring.

The forest floor drops into a narrow, but deep gully here. The east side of the gully is too steep to ascend. Here the age-old mallorn blooms and other remnants of past foliage have gathered, creating a soft pillow-like mat. The gully levels out to the south, but it is possible to get onto higher ground to the north and west.
22421: At the Banks of the Celebrant

The tall mellyrn line the banks of the mighty elven river Celebrant. The cool, clear waters of the river flow past just to the south and east of here.
