From the east a chilly air current, carrying the smell of decay and of burnt wood, flows west, towards one of the gaping holes in the chamber's west wall. North of here, enormous in size, a black statue holds up the ceiling of the hall.
42138:
A stone-grey troll advances toward you, with fury in its eyes.
An uruk-hai is here, growling to himself.
A stone-grey troll advances toward you, with fury in its eyes.
An uruk-hai is here, growling to himself.

A huge statue, made of black stone, dominates the centre of the hall. Standing firmly on its feet, the statue supports with its strong arms the weight of the ceiling, which might otherwise have collapsed as many of the nearby tunnels. Judging from the build, the statue might have represented a giant-sized Dwarf; however, its face was utterly destroyed by some patient Orc or Troll, by hammering on it and smashing it with a pick. The crumbled remains, mixed with rotten food, lies at the statue's feet. Gloom enfolds the surrounding chamber in all directions.
42139: This is the southeastern corner of an old, gloomy chamber with soot-encrusted walls. A few half-burned logs lie scattered on the ground, as if some sort of fire was lit and then hastily put off here. Chill air flows into the room from a small crack in the floor; the gentle whistling of the wind, however, is totally covered by the echos of heavy steps and, occasionally, by some harsh shouted words, too garbled to be understandable.
42140: Here, in the middle of the chamber's eastern wall, in the old days of Durin the Sixth a corridor used to leave the hall and venture into long forgotten places. Perhaps it was the wrath of the Balrog, perhaps lack of maintenance, perhaps the orkish rampage; whatever the reason, now the wooden supports have crumbled to useless shards, and the passage caves in a few paces outside the hall. The room extends itself to the west; a large, dark statue connects floor and ceiling in the middle of the chamber.
42141: The large, dark, echoing hall meets here its northeastern corner. The smooth eastern wall curves sharply, and gradually becomes more and more cracked as it runs northeast towards the beginning of a tunnel. The floor is littered with some remains of many gruesome meals; the leftover seems to become less sparse as one walks towards the enormous frozen shape to the southwest.
42142: An old corridor, badly damaged by the passage of time, by lack of manutention and - probably - by some ancient conflagration, continues to the north. Its cracked walls seem to have withstood a terrific blow: had it been made by anyone else but Dwarves, the tunnel would have certainly collapsed by now. A foul stench pervades the air, coming from both directions.
42143: Each time one walks through this section of the tunnel, dust and a few small rocks fall down from the ruined ceiling, adding to the layer of gravel on the floor. The supports which once made this a safe passage lie now, shattered and half-burnt, among the gravel. In its current situation, the tunnel is very frail: the ceiling might collapse any time, crushing everything below.
42144: This is the western end of an ancient passage, carved through a layer of grey rock with dull green stripes. The walls and ceiling are full of cracks; as one looks northeast, towards a bend in the tunnel, the conditions of the passage seem to worsen. Yet, the dangers of a cave-in might be less than those of meeting the hordes of orcs that, judging on the noise and the smell, live in the cavern to the west.
42145:
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.

This is the eastern part of a medium-sized, filthy chamber. Though it was originally a natural cavern, either the Dwarves or, more probably, the current inhabitants partially reshaped it to suit their needs, smoothing the walls and digging a narrow tunnel leading south. A pile of heavy stones, perhaps the remains of the tunnel's construction, lies in a corner.
42146:
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.

The narrow, crude tunnel soon reaches a dead end in another chamber, smaller than the main Uruk cavern but still filled with signs of the Uruks' continuous presence. In the middle of the room, a large, rough column carved from the same stone of the walls supports the ceiling. A half dozen sets of chains and manacles hang from the southern wall; one of those sets holds an old skeleton.
42147: A very long time ago, perhaps with the awakening of Durin's Bane, this section of Khazad-dum was severely damaged. Some of the corridors, as the ones to the south and southwest, suffered major damage but were not utterly destroyed. This was not the fate of this chamber: only a narrow passage along its southern wall survives. The rest of the room is now completely filled with the crumbled remains of the ceiling. A stone stair used to lead up, but the steps now end against a wall of fallen rocks.
42148: Black runes have been inscribed with a piece of coal on the grey-green, cracked walls of this old passage. The floor slopes down gently as the tunnel approaches the source of the foul smell to the southwest.
42149:
The corpse of a grey troll is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.

You have reached the western end of a natural chamber, smaller than many other rooms that can be found in Moria. The main body of the cavern lies east of here; a smaller alcove to the south is cloaked in darkness. The entire floor is littered with remains of orkish meals and with the trophies - mostly small, worthless items - the Uruks have taken from their victims. The smell of orcs is the strongest you have ever felt: either there is a very large number of the foul servants of darkness living here, or they are particularly smelly - even for an orc.
42150:
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.
The corpse of an uruk-hai is lying here.

The southern end of the cavern looks like a meeting place for the Uruks of the Black Chasm. Small niches in the walls hold the skulls of vanquished foes and, sometimes, other remains. The ever-present smell of orc fills and contaminates the air all around.
42151: An old passage in the depths of the Misty Mountains leads west, where it vanishes in the gloom, and ends in a natural cavern to the east. The utter silence and darkness of the western tunnel contrast sharply with the guttural voices and the glinting of metal inside the chamber. A foul, sickening smell permeates the air, getting even worse to the east.
42152: Here the tunnel bends slightly, from the east to the southwest. Judging on what one can perceive from this place, both directions look dangerous. From the east comes the stomping noise of metal boots, added to the stench one has learned, by now, to associate with the Uruks of Moria. In the other direction the air is becoming hotter, and an almost palpable aura of corruption and evil - even worse than that of the Orcs - can be felt.
42153: This is the southwestern end of a narrow corridor, with smooth granite walls and a slightly slippery floor. The air is uncomfortably hot, but it becomes cooler as one follows the tunnel northeast. A faint, dull red trail, perhaps dried blood, can be barely seen on the ground.
42154:
Tordol the Dwarf (t) is standing here.
Crone the Elf is standing here.
Kalisto the Woman, wielding a blackened spear, is standing here.
Oguga the Dwarf, wielding a bejewelled oak staff, is standing here trying to concentrate.

Here a narrow, winding tunnel departs in a northeasterly direction from a much wider grey-walled road running north and south. The air is difficult to breathe, due to the fierce heat and the strong smell of brimstone getting stronger with each pace to the north. From time to time, a muffled explosion, similar to a distant thunder, can be heard northwards, followed by a cloud of dusty hot air.
42155: The wide, grey-walled corridor stretches on to the north, and abruptly ceases against a wall of blackness to the south. As one walks northward, one can feel the noteworthy gradient of temperature: from the extreme, deadly chill to the south, the road leads to a region of fierce heat filled with the smell of brimstone. Both directions seem equally fearsome, which is a good reason to call this place the Road of Terror.
42156:
A large arrow lies on the ground.
A large arrow lies on the ground.
The corpse of a dragon column is lying here.
The corpse of a dragon column is lying here.

The wide corridor to the south ends here, in front of a majestic, awe- inspiring portal. Nearly unbearable waves of heat sweep the room from the north to the south, as if the orange-red glow coming from behind the gaping portal were the fiery breath of one of the ancient Dragons of Morgoth. Two carved columns flank the opening to the north, one on each side; ominous symbols, foreboding a dreadful doom, are inscribed above the portal.
42184:
A great wolf with a sable coat glares around with red eyes.
A great wolf with a sable coat glares around with red eyes.
Shaghosh, chieftain of the Durghash tribe, is here.
A bulky cave troll is here, looking like a massive pile of stone.
A bulky cave troll is here, looking like a massive pile of stone.

This is a suite of three oblong rooms which are interconnected through wide stone archways. The large entry chamber contains stone tables which are overladen with food and drink, along with a good supply of rotting bones. The eastern chamber is crammed full with battle trophies and displays of gargantuan teeth and broken skulls. There are many shattered weapons and shredded banners, a large tentacle, and also a white cave-bear fur hanging upon the walls over there. The western chamber holds a large stone table covered with maps, battleplans and old parchments. There are several small orc statues which are arranged on a large table map, apparently with some significance for a coming battle or campaign. A faint breeze ripples through a black curtain emblazoned with the Red Eye that drapes from the chamber roof to cover most of the south wall here.
42185:
A sparkling golden necklace has been left here.
A perfectly formed emerald is here, sparkling.
A pair of shining chain mail leggings lie here.
A fire opal catches the light.
A large warhammer is on the ground.
A fortune in gold lies in a heap.
A lovely silver ring has been left here.

The lead-lined walls here provide security and isolation from any prying eyes or hands. The Durghash have taken pains to make this place impervious to all unauthorised entry, especially from thieves among their own race.
42186:
A black warg fur is here lying on the ground.
A small barrel made of aged oak and strong iron hoops stands here.
A scuffed and worn leather satchel has been left here.

Shaghosh has established a refuge from common orcs here in a deep pit which has been cleverly concealed beneath his public reception chambers. Every surface here is covered by sewn carpets of black warg fur, excepting a bare stone staircase which climbs up the eastern wall. A large bed consisting of many kinds of animal pelts stacked inside a heavy wooden frame in the centre of the room appears to have been the eye of a recent storm of debauchery. A few casks of potent wine, several jars of strong perfumes and small bowls of mind-addling drugs lie scattered about the room for the enjoyment of Shaghosh's guests. A set of iron cuffs is fastened to the south wall next to a large metal cage used to hold unwilling participants in the fun.
60177: The corpse of a hungry warg is lying here.

This is an entrance to a narrow crooked path that provides passage between the steep inclines of the Misty Mountains. Scars can be seen along the walls of the passage, where the rock was painfully chiselled away. The pass appears to be ageless, cut from solid granite and shielded from environmental weathering by the towering mountains. However, crusty remains of tools and shifts in the mountain itself indicate the passage is hundreds if not thousands of years old.
60178: Embedded deep into the granite mountain, the pass continues both west and south. A sheer cliff lies to the east while to the north the mountain wall blocks the scenery and access to the valley floor. While much effort and care went into construction of the passage, how it came to be is indeterminable.
60179: This pass, on the fringes of the Misty Mountains, is narrow and crooked. To the east, both north and south, the mountains continue, blocking much of your vision, while to the southwest the region where the mountains turn to plains is visible. The pass itself is embedded deep into the rock for each step was painfully chiselled into the rough terrain. While the exact age of the pass is unknown, it appears to predate the flight of people, now known as Dunlendings, who chose to settle the area now known as Bree.
60180: Cut deep into the granite rock, the narrow passage winds its way through the Misty Mountains. All around the mountains loom above blocking much of your vision of the surrounding terrain. To the east the pass approaches a large crater while to the west the pass continues as it winds through the mountains and later to the base of an ancient forest.
60181:
A brown donkey watches the surroundings, perhaps looking for a chance to graze.
A brown donkey watches the surroundings, perhaps looking for a chance to graze.
A beautiful and docile horse is standing here.

Some thirty feet deep, the crater is largely formed of granite sprinkled with a few glistening pieces of silicate. While the exact origin of the crater can not be determined, it was clearly created by an internal force pushing out towards the surface. Yet the granite rock contains little evidence of being exposed to extreme heat, indicating that the crater was not caused by volcanic activity. The bottom of the crater contains a large lake which appears to absorb all light giving it a silky black appearance.
60182: The lake is very dark, almost like a black pearl. While the surface is very still, a slight undertow can be felt. A small ripple here and there gives an impression of something swimming across these dark waters.
60183: You have entered a large underwater cavern. A strong current flows over the muddy bottom towards the east causing the water to turn a murky brown which makes it difficult to see your surroundings.
60184: This chamber is narrower towards the east but begins to widen towards the north and west. The walls are very smooth, almost unnaturally smooth. The chamber is completely empty and the floor is hard rock. There is a very strong current towards the east.
60185: This is a very large submerged cavern with a low ragged roof. While there is an obvious exit towards the east, a faint westerly current can be felt. There are many small rocks scattered across the uneven floor of the cavern.
60186: A long slender eel glides along the water, its body coiled to strike.

You have reached what appears to be the eastern end of the underwater cavern, as there is no obvious way to continue onwards. There is a slight current dragging you towards the east. Luckily, the ceiling has caved in, allowing you to reach the surface above you.
60187: You have reached the surface of a smallish lake. Looking around, it is obvious that this chamber was not created by natural forces. Extensive power must have been expanded in the chamber's creation for the walls are too well rounded and the chamber too secluded to have been formed by nature. Yet, clearly, no humanoid life could have wielded the power needed to carve this chamber out of the solid granite rock which forms the Misty Mountains. To the west a small corridor lies beyond the lake's boundary.
60188: This simple corridor, some four feet long and eight feet high, is carved out of solid granite. The walls of the corridor are featureless, smooth as silk and cold to the touch. The only distinctive feature of this corridor is the solid granite door at the western end.
60189: Some small rocks have been piled into a mound here.
The cavern comes to a quick end forming a small snug chamber. The water is dead still and the bottom is littered with rocks. On the sides, a very faint engraving can be seen.
60190:
Staub the Dwarf (SS), wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here (glowing).
Maaskantje the Half-Elf (MK), wielding a sharp thorn, is standing here.
A small spirit floats around here, with despair in its eyes.

You find yourself in a vast underground cavern at the top of an immense chasm; an eerie glow makes the ceiling of the cavern visible. The chasm is no less than two hundred yards deep. Looking across the abyss, you can see a trail embedded in solid stone which seems to slowly wind down towards the bottom. It is not obvious if the chasm was formed within the mountain or if the mountain was formed over the chasm. In either case, the chasm appears as old as the mountain itself.
60191: You find yourself on a small pathway that seems to lead into the bowels of the Misty Mountains. While the path was originally chiselled into the granite floor, over time, a millennium or more, it has slowly sunken forming a natural contour in the rock.
60192: The path, set deep into the granite rock which forms the Misty Mountains, curves to the south, but a deep and narrow chasm makes it unwise to continue in that direction. The northern wall of the cavern rises some twenty yards before forming a ceiling above you. To the east, beyond a granite door, there is a dark lake and to the west the entrance of a small natural cavern can be seen. Scattered about to the side of the path there are several rocks of various sizes.
60193: The entrance into this cavern is from the east. Here, the rocky ceiling is very low and damp, inhibiting your movements. While the air is very stale, some algae have managed to grow on the far wall. The cavern continues to the south.
60194:
Miltar, wielding the silvery broadsword, is standing here.
Ljon the Man, wielding a double edged eket, is standing here.
Cormax the Dwarf is standing here.
Dyrnhild the Woman, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.

The chamber here is very low and damp. Water drips from the ceiling and runs across your face and into your eyes, making it difficult to see. A strong foetid smell of decaying flesh and decomposing matter comes from the west riding an outward air current.
60195:
A web has been spun across the corner of the room.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous tarantula extends her legs to you.

At the back of the small chamber, the cavern opens up somewhat allowing a bit more room for movement. The only exit is the one you came through. On the floor of the cavern there are many bones, most of which have either petrified or started to turn to dust, and the dry husk of a strange wormlike creature.
60196:
A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.
Clinging to some rocks, a web spans the chasm.
Tollin the Dwarf (T), wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is resting here.
Norbert the Dwarf (NN), wielding an engraved broadsword, is resting here.
Budach the Half-Elf (BB), wielding a ceremonial dagger, is sleeping here.

The trail that leads towards the bottom of the chasm has been moulded into solid granite. A dim light seems to luminesce from below, making much of the winding trail faintly visible, though sections of the trail remain hidden in the shadows. There is an eerie feeling as shadows criss-cross the path and blood-chilling howls echo across the walls. The bottom of the chasm is visible to the east, and seems to be the source of the light. The trail continues to the south. To the north a breach in the path is visible.
60197:
A tormented spirit engulfed in grief and despair advances.
A tormented spirit engulfed in grief and despair advances.
A tormented spirit engulfed in grief and despair advances.
A tormented spirit engulfed in grief and despair advances.

The trail bends sharply from north to west, avoiding the chasm to the east and south. Whereas to the south, where the trail turns from west to north, a barrier of solid granite blocks the view of the chasm, to the east the bottom of the chasm can be seen as well as the trail winding unto itself. Across the chasm and beyond the winding trail, the opening of a large cavern is barely discernible in the low light. To the west, beyond an overhang, a much smaller opening can be seen.
60198: This portion of the trail is dug into the western wall of the mountain as it winds around the chasm. From here, the chasm and much of the path are hidden by the overhang, but to the south an entrance to a cavern can be seen in the shadows.
60199: Here, the path runs along the western edge of the chasm, forming a passage deep inside the Misty Mountains. Even in darkness, shadows appear to whip across the floor of the trail. To the west, a narrow opening in the granite wall appears to beckon for exploration.
60200: The cavern is damp and gloomy, mostly hidden from the light that emanates from the chasm to the east. Crouched in the narrow opening of the cavern one can either return to the chasm trail which lies east or head into the cavern by going north, south or west.
60201: This section of the cavern is much wider than the section to the east where the entrance lies. The walls are jagged, indicating that their formation was due to a natural process, possibly an earthquake. If this cavern was indeed created by an earthquake, then it is not clear why it did not extend to the surface. In stark contrast to the walls, the roof and floor of the cavern are smooth and level. The cavern extends to the west where it narrows.
60202: Deep inside the cavern, you are fully isolated from the outside environment. The chamber is somewhat warm, sheltered from the cold which surrounds the chasm trail. Although natural light has never reached this cavern, a soft glow comes from the western wall.
60203: The air here is a bit cooler than to the north and as the water trickles in from the north it begins to freeze, making the floor very slippery. A cool breeze wafts in from the west. In the eastern corner one can see a small spider-web.
60204: A cold breeze blows in from the west making anyone who enters this cavern shiver uncontrollably. This section of the cavern is very narrow and slick. The walls are jagged, and could easily scrape off a few layers of skin should someone rub against them. It appears that an earthquake sometime in the distant past had sealed the passage to the west and opened a passage to the lower chambers.
60205:
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.

You find yourself in a tight pit, its walls coated with ice from the water that once trickled down. While it is possible to climb up, it will take a great deal of effort. The floor is littered with rubble and bodies of those who were unable to escape this pit.
60206: Radikas the Dwarf (RR), wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is standing here.

The floor, covered by ice which was left when the subterranean river vanished, is very slick, making it difficult to move without sliding towards the east, which is the direction of the natural slant of this tunnel. The air here is terribly cold, in spite of a less chilling breeze coming from a conduit above. The husk of a worm-like creature is visible here.
60207:
A white worm-like creature crawls forward in its search for food.
A grey spider is stalking here, preparing to drain you of life.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.

The smooth tunnel makes a bend here, where the river followed a vein of softer rocks towards the south. The floor of the tunnel is made slippery by a thin pellicle of ice. A chilling murmur comes out of a large opening in the north wall along with an ice-cold draught. Dry husks of strange worm-like creatures litter the floor.
60208: A giant slug is here, oozing around.

In this section of the tunnel, a slow mass of stinking earth flows westwards as it follows the slope of an old river, almost blocking the passage in that direction. The dirty earth, along with a foul dark liquid, oozes from a black hole in the ceiling high above filling the air with its polluted stench of urea.
60209: This rounded tunnel, its walls polished by the water which flowed through it centuries ago, follows a twisted path through the mountain. Now the stream is gone, probably frozen by the incredible cold which inhabits these chambers.
60210: A white worm-like creature crawls forward in its search for food.

The tunnel slants downwards to the west where its polished walls still bear the marks of the river which created them years ago. The water, hurling down from an impressive vertical shaft just above your head, created the unclimbable, silky-smooth walls. North of you, a recent seism has caused a vertical crack to open in the rock. Dangling above the crack you can see the remnants of a small spider-web.
60211: Sliding and ramping, crawling and climbing, you can slowly make your way through the twisted crack, scratching your members at the etched edges. The stones that you touch are warmer than one might expect in these surroundings and are covered by a thin pellicle of gluey salivation. Above you, the fissure is closed by a enormous web, in which the dry remains and bones of humanoids are still fixed.
60212: The crack is some five to ten yards high and forms a ragged set of teeth where the granite was ripped apart. The hand and foot holds that allow one to drop down into the crack unscathed are just a little too high to allow to climb out.
60213:
The corpse of a great rat is lying here.
The corpse of a great rat is lying here.

Jumping over the rocks, climbing among the boulders, rolling on the screenings, one should be able to slowly make the way through the cavern. Now and then the mountain lets out a gasp and a large stone falls from the ceiling.
60214: A huge, hungry-looking rat is here.

This had once been a huge cavern with a flat ceiling and a floor polished by running water. Stalactites and stone draperies once hung here, forming impressive white pillars where they met the largest stalagmites. While some of the stalagmites are still discernible, most have been destroyed, crushed by falling granite blocks. The destruction must have occurred many years ago, as new stalagmites have already begun to form.
60215: Before this cavern was ripped apart by a tremor, this was once the junction of an east-west passage with a north-south passage. Falling boulders and crumbling granite now block passage to the north and west. However, one can still move freely to the south and east.
60216:
A newborn spider is here.
A huge, hungry-looking rat is here.

The roof of what was once a large cavern lies partially crumbled on the floor. While the exact events that made the roof crumble are unknown, the condition of the walls indicates that the forces involved must have been tremendous and spontaneous. Broken boulders are piled upon the ground, forcing any traveller through this area to climb again and again while picking the way through the desolation.
60217: An ancient bracelet made of silvery metal lies gleaming here.

This niche in the cavern has been demolished by an underground tremor causing many rocks and boulders to fall on the floor. The collapse of the ceiling has obstructed the path to the west, as several huge boulders have piled against a natural granite pillar. The smell coming out of the furthest corner indicates that death is never far.
60218: Here, near the end of the trail, looking south one can discern some dark shadows floating across the floor of the chasm several yards below. An ice-cold current seems to flow out of the shadows, chilling your skin as it penetrates your clothes. A deadly sensation originates from the darkness just west of here. At your feet a wide crevice forms a passage that leads into a crumbling cavern.
60219: The icy breeze and a chilling murmur paralyze your body, making each movement more difficult. Looking down, you can see the floor of the cavern which is covered by mounds of ice. The ice diffuses what little light is available, creating shadows across the far wall of the cavern. From the corner of your eye, you see silhouette shapes dancing in the shadows where the chasm trail meets the cavern floor.
60220:
A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.
Norbert the Dwarf (NN), wielding an ornate, steel-shafted warhammer, is resting here.
Budach the Half-Elf (BB), wielding a ceremonial dagger, is standing here.
Rabb the Dwarf, wielding a great warsword, is resting here.

Several humanoid silhouettes appear to be standing here, partially hidden in the shadows. Some are wielding swords and maces, but none are moving. A closer observation reveals that they are packed in a crust of ice. Frozen trolls, orcs, and one emaciated human have all been submerged by an even colder wave of frost and turned into ice. A bright light, diffused and hidden, can be seen glowing beneath the ice.
60221:
Unqalome the Great Dark is here, fighting Radikas (RR).
Radikas the Dwarf (RR), wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is here, fighting Unqalome the Great Dark.

The trail comes to a sudden end at a mound of ice. The temperature, well below freezing, eats through the warmest of clothing sending a chill through your bones. No sound can be heard as something much colder and more ancient than the ice in the room seems to sap the warmth of your body.
60222: This is a narrow entrance to an ancient crypt. The black walls glisten as if they were metallic and seem bitterly cold to the touch. This room, as well as the remainder of the crypt, seems untouched by the havoc in the upper chambers, preserved from the flow of ice and natural decay. A frosty mist forms as the cold moist air above meets the bitter coldness of the crypt.
60223: A magnificent and finely crafted archway marks the division between the upper and lower chambers. The arches extend some ten feet above you and are composed of solid marble inlaid with gold, emerald and rubies. The sides are perfectly smooth and oriented much like a tuning fork.
60224: You find yourself in a high narrow corridor. The walls, some six feet apart, are masked by an eerie black which extends from the ceiling, some ten feet above to the floor. With the frigid cold an aurora of nothingness forms, masking the innate essence of oneself and causing a sensation of unnatural panic and fear. Whatever constructed these chambers possessed an ancient power, one well beyond that of mortal beings, able to mask and cancel all forms of present day magic.
60225: The corridor seems endless in the pitch black surroundings, even though a low vibration rattles through the floors. While the walls remain still, the sensation that the corridor has narrowed cannot be mistaken. From here you can go west towards the entrance of the crypt or north.
60226: This corridor at the rear of the crypt turns sharply from east-west to north- south forming a crisp corner. An eerie black extends from the floor to the ceiling some ten feet above and masks all movements in the room. A frigid cold seems to emanate from the room to the east sucking out all warmth. Whatever constructed these chambers surely possessed an ancient power well beyond that of mortal beings.
60227:
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
A deep gloom surrounds you, inky globes and tendrils circling you.

With your every movement, an invisible hand seems to pass through you stealing the heat from your soul, causing your blood to slowly turn to ice. The remains of broken swords and armour lie scattered across the floor, much of it rusted and all of it useless. Scrape marks line the walls where those before you have tried in vain to flee from that which had gripped them.
60228:
Tordol the Dwarf (t), wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is standing here.
Khelak the Dwarf, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.
Ambaal the Dwarf, wielding an ornate, steel-shafted warhammer, is standing here.
Miltar, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.

Unlike the upper crypts, the sacrificial chambers are lavishly designed. The walls are constructed of black marble with inlaid gold and silver engravings displaying the extraction of souls from live victims. In one mosaic the victim can be seen contorted in agony as his tormentor hovers over him. In another mosaic the tormentor is shown gutting his live victim. In all the mosaics the victims are shown to be alive as they are mutiliated and disemboweled as the the tormentor glows with satisfaction from the pain inflicted upon the victims.
60229: An eerie blackness seems to flow through you as you find yourself at the heart of the sacrificial chambers, forming a sensation of suspended animation. You can barely feel your feet upon the floor as the black walls of the chamber seem to engulf all light making it difficult to see the floor or the walls of the chamber. There is no sensation of temperature or wind almost as if you, yourself, were an essence of nothingness.
60230: This room has a vaguely familiar look as if you had seen it before in a picture or engraving. Near the middle of the room the outline of a large table, some five or six feet high and nine feet long is faintly visible in the dim light. In the centre of the table a drawer with a golden handle reflects a faint ray of light as it plays in the shadow. As in the previous rooms, the walls are an eerie black making them difficult to see.
60231:
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
A shadow suddenly leaves its place on the wall, trying to reach your neck.

The victims must have been held in this room while waiting for their turn on the table. Lined up like sheep with their will defeated they waited for their fate. Along the walls there are shackles, some with skeletons of the more fortunate, who for one reason or another died before being processed.
60232:
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
The frozen remains of an uruk lie crumpled on the ground.
A shadow suddenly leaves its place on the wall, trying to reach your neck.

The room is small and cramped, its walls lined with shelves, cabinets and hooks, leaving little space to move about. On the far wall there is a small picture showing Ungoliant approaching the tree of Laurelin, poison dripping from long arching fangs. In the background, behind the tree, the faint outline of a shadow can be seen crouching, almost in fear, but a wicked, gleeful smile seems to be forming on its face.
60233:
Tordol the Dwarf (t), wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is standing here.
Khelak the Dwarf, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.
Ambaal the Dwarf, wielding an ornate, steel-shafted warhammer, is standing here.
Miltar, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.

It seems that many of the victims' bodies were placed in this room. The corpses, stacked one upon another, form a neat pile of gutless bodies which are prevented from rot or decay by the cold. Oddly, the bodies stacked here appear to be those of the strongest and largest victims that were sacrificed.
60235:
Staub the Dwarf (SS), wielding an engraved broadsword, is here, fighting an enslaved elven spirit.
Maaskantje the Half-Elf (MK), wielding a sharp thorn, is standing here trying to concentrate.
An enslaved elven spirit is here, fighting Staub (SS).
An enslaved elven spirit is here, fighting Staub (SS).
An enslaved elven spirit is here, fighting Staub (SS).
An enslaved elven spirit is here, fighting Staub (SS).

This portion of the trail now follows an old riverbed. In this spot a waterfall once roared as water came crashing down the slope to the south. The river ceased to flow long ago and the only vestige that remains are a few stalactites of ice hanging on the wall and the icy floor beneath you. The trail, faintly visible under the ice, was polished by the passage of the water eons ago.
60236: The chasm trail now follows the path of an ancient stream, which had cut a few yards into the walls of the cave. A few well-worn stones remain, left from the days of running water. A small pond which had existed in a natural bowl, had long ago been replaced with ice. From this point on the remainder of the trail is coated with ice.
60320:
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.

This chamber is littered with soft glowing moss. Perhaps it is the odd combination of temperature and humidity which allows this moss to grow in darkness or maybe the creator of this area grew the moss with the aid of magic. There is probably no sure way to know how the moss evolved. As you linger here the moss seems to start growing at an accelerated rate while slowly creeping around your feet and up your legs as it begins to gnaw at your clothing and skin.
60810:
A huge, poisonous tarantula extends her legs to you.
A huge, poisonous tarantula extends her legs to you.

Having arrived at a dead end, the only way back is to the south. This cavern is very damp and the air here is a bit warmer than to the south. The source of the warmth is not obvious and the warmth itself may very well be the lack of coldness which emanates from the chasm. In the far corner of the cavern there appears to be a small nest.
60811:
An ancient bracelet made of silvery metal lies gleaming here.
An ancient bracelet made of silvery metal lies gleaming here.

This room is composed of solid ice. The far and near walls of the chamber are lined with blocks of ice no less than two yards deep. While it is not obvious what might have inhabited this chamber, if anything, it certainly is much too cold for humanoid life. The only exit from this chamber is back towards the east.
60814:
Traces of white tones form the aura of this place.
A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.

Several humanoid silhouettes appear to be standing here, partially hidden in the shadows. Some are wielding swords and maces, but none are moving. A closer observation reveals that they are packed in a crust of ice. Frozen trolls, orcs, and one emaciated human have all been submerged by an even colder wave of frost and turned into ice. A bright light, diffused and hidden, can be seen glowing beneath the ice.
60815: From the top southwest corner of the trail, the entrances to the caverns on the northern and eastern walls are discernible in the dim light. Looking carefully, shadows seem to be flickering in and out, even though no source of them can be seen.
60816: This segment of the chasm trail runs east-west. The northern wall is silky smooth, indicating that its formation was unnatural in origin. The wall is extremely cold to the touch, causing an odd sensation against the warm air from above.
60817: Hugging the souther wall of the chasm, the trail slopes sharply downwards towards the east. An intermittent rustling sound, from the granite floor below, can be faintly heard as it is distorted by an icy wind flowing from the east.
60818: This is the southeast corner of the trail. To the northeast, looking over the chasm, a large opening to another of the caverns along the trail is visible. The trail continues to slope downwards towards the north, encouraging you to proceed in that direction.
60819: This portion of the path, along the eastern wall, is covered with ice making movement very difficult. Great care must be taken if you are to avoid slipping and falling into the chasm below. Careful examination of the ice shows scrape marks where those before you have slipped and fallen. There is a small hole in the middle of the path where the granite floor, the ceiling of a cavern below, has given way.
60820:
The corpse of a black snake is lying here.
A black snake is here, fighting Tordol (t).
A black snake is here, fighting Tordol (t).
Tordol the Dwarf (t), wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is here, fighting a black snake.
Ambaal the Dwarf, wielding an ornate, steel-shafted warhammer, is standing here.
Khelak the Dwarf, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.

The pit is shallow and narrow, some eleven feet deep and four feet wide. While the ground contains a few partial skeletons of smaller animals, the sides of the pit are rough and provide many handholds, making it possible for an average climber to escape via the western wall.
60821:
Huntwind the Elf (HH), wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.
Elerin the Elf, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.
Radikas the Dwarf (RR), wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is standing here.

The odour of urine and blood permeates the air of the dark cavern. The floor is covered with broken bones and half-decayed corpses. Some five yards up, through a hole in the ceiling, the chasm trail can be seen. However, there appears to be no way to reach the hole, and therefore the chasm trail, from here.
60822: A giant slug is here, oozing around.

From this portion of the cavern a fetid stench emanates from deposits of of urea and excrement. Pulverized earth has been dropped on the granite floor, now saturated with urine. Dark lines are visible on the floor where the previous polluted earth has been brushed south, through a grid, behind which must be a makeshift sewer of some sort.
60823: A worm is here slithering around.

Decapitated corpses and partially eaten bones litter the granite floor, while dry blood and some which is not so dry, is splattered across the walls. Undoubtedly, many a feasts have been held here; probably one was fairly recent as is evident from the fresh blood stains. Most of the corpses are those of orcs, but a few aging human and elf bones are identifiable.
60824: You are at a junction in the dark cavern. It is quite easy to get disoriented here as the darkness masks all sense of direction. To make matters worse, a strange mist fills the room making you feel dizzy and disoriented.
60825: Covered with moisture, the walls of this chamber are colder and damper than the adjoining chambers. Though slightly above freezing, the chamber emits an unnatural coldness not felt on the icy path of the chasm trail. The ceiling of the chamber is littered with icy stalactites that slowly drip onto the floor creating a low fog across the chamber.
60826:
A giant slug is here, fighting Cormax.
Cormax the Dwarf is here, fighting a giant slug (glowing).

Against the far wall, the skulls of orcs are piled in a very regular order. To the side of this pile, near the granite wall, the remains of several broken orc skeletons can be seen with a hand there, a toe here all scattered in irregular fashion.
60827: A black pond of water is here.

Pieces of clothing, dry bone and clean sand are dispersed across the floor, creating a lair where a beasts might take a nap between feasts. This part of the cavern is exceptionally clean, and a small pond has formed where some of the ice has melted at the foot of the eastern wall.
60828:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
Cormax the Dwarf is standing here (glowing).

You are in the rear of a dark cavern. Here, insulated from the cold which whirls around the chasm, one could almost call this place warm. This chamber, dug into the granite rock, is padded by animal hair and elf ears. Several humanoid bones are scattered around; against a wall lies a corpse wiggling its toe in the wind. What is scary are the eyes, wide open, looking into an eternal vacuum, but absolutely white, as if it had no soul before its death.
60829:
A giant slug is here, oozing around.
A giant slug is here, oozing around.
Tordol the Dwarf (t), wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is standing here.
Khelak the Dwarf, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.
Ambaal the Dwarf, wielding an ornate, steel-shafted warhammer, is standing here.
Miltar, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.

The remains of excrement, brushed through the grid to the north, slowly decays. Decaying bones and moist earth are piled in every corner, leaching a smell that even orcs would find offensive. A small hole, through which the liquid waste pours, is partially filled with dirty mud.
60830: A white worm-like creature crawls forward in its search for food.

You find yourself in a flat segment of a circular tunnel, smooth and rounded as if the tunnel had been artificially built. However, common sense would indicate that this tunnel was formed by an underground river. The yellow- brownish walls have been moulded into the basalt rocks and polished by age. Small spider-webs can be seen hanging in the corners, a clear indication that in spite of the coldness and deepness of these tunnels, there is enough food to sustain some forms of life. The floor is littered by husks of strange worm-like creatures.
60832:
Tordol the Dwarf (t), wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is standing here.
Khelak the Dwarf, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.
Ambaal the Dwarf, wielding an ornate, steel-shafted warhammer, is standing here.
Miltar, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.

The closet, some three yards wide and three yards long, is filled with an assortment of relics. Examining the relics, it is more likely that they are the remains of items once owned by the visitors to these chambers as opposed to being the belongings of the inhabitants. In the corner, you spy the glitter of an untarnished sword.
60833: At the foot of the granite wall a dark maw opens, partially lined with sharp rocks giving it the appearance of giant teeth. The odour of decaying flesh slowly seeps out from the opening in large puffs, almost as if the cavern were a living entity breathing through its mouth. The cold ambient air makes it difficult for you to move.
60834: The trail, cut a few yards into the southern wall, descends southward where the low rocky ceiling masks a dark cavern. Small stalactites have formed on the ceiling long ago when water still flowed, but now the stalactites are grey and have ceased to grow. At the base of the wall, a small crack lined with cracked mud and ice is all that remains of an ancient spring.
60837: Looping around in the darkness, the trail seems to go on forever. At its deepest point, a cloud of darkness appears to be darting back and forth in the chasm. All that passes under the darkness vanishes from your view to never reappear. Who knows what your fate will be if the shadow passes over you.
60838:
A tormented spirit engulfed in grief and despair advances.
A tormented spirit engulfed in grief and despair advances.
A tormented spirit engulfed in grief and despair advances.
A tormented spirit engulfed in grief and despair advances.

A platform has been etched into the rough granite and from the platform a few steps lead upwards to the north. From this location, one can see and contrast the massive walls of the chasm with the tiny trail. It must have taken enormous effort, far greater than one such as yourself could provide in many lifetimes, to construct this cavern.
60839: This is the northwest corner of the chasm trail. To the east the trail slopes upwards, and to the south four steps have been dug into the solid granite floor forming a convenient downward path in that direction. These steps are greater in height than those that one of your stature would normally traverse, which makes it likely that the architect of this cavern is larger than yourself.
60841: On and on the chasm trail continues along the northern wall of the chasm. In the distant east you can see the wall of the cavern as the trail bends to the south and again to the near west you can see the wall of the cavern where the trail curves to the south.
60842: Far below, by the southern wall of the cavern, the floor of the chasm is plainly visible. From here one can barely distinguish the decaying meat and bones which are scattered across the chasm floor. A dark shadow seems to swoop across the carnage as another bone becomes visible.
60843: From here, the northeast corner of the chasm trail, the bottom of the chasm is plainly visible as is a large cavern across the chasm. A faint rustling sound can be heard below the granite floor, yet it cannot be determined where the sound originates. It is as if the mountain itself was groaning.
60844:
Something cold and scaly slithers past your leg.
Something cold and scaly slithers past your leg.
Something cold and scaly slithers past your leg.

While the pit is some fifty feet deep, the last forty-two feet are filled with a mixture of water and urine absorbing the impact of anything, or anyone, that has fallen into the pit. While the details of the sides of the pit are hidden in the shadows, a few faint indentations in the southern wall can be seen. A smell of rot and decay fills the air.
60846: This space is narrow and cramped with a ragged ceiling some six inches above you forming a small air pocket above the underground stream. While the air is rather stale, it is still breathable. To the west, there is a small cavern offering escape from the icy water.
60847: You are in a narrow underwater corridor. While it is possible to swim eastward, the task would be difficult as the water races down towards the west. Above you there is a small air pocket offering fresh air and relief from the current.
60848: The water rushes west where a very faint light can be seen, indicating an entrance to this passage in that direction. The reflections cast by the faint light emphasise the ragged walls and show where the mountain was ripped apart eons ago. While the current is very strong, it is possible to continue upwards towards the east.
60849: Underwater, you would have to fight the current to move towards the east. A faint light can be seen towards the west, as the stream approaches the end of the underground corridor.
60850: This is a low corridor heading east through the Misty Mountains. The chamber, originally a small fissure that was slowly widened by the continuous flow of water through the walls of the mountain, is large enough for passage. While it is possible to continue eastward, to do so would require you to swim underwater and fight the stream's strong westward current as it passes into the narrow granite crevices.
60851:
A white worm-like creature crawls forward in its search for food.
A white worm-like creature crawls forward in its search for food.
A white worm-like creature crawls forward in its search for food.

This place is an ancient confluence of two underground rivers, one coming from the north and another from the east. These rivers once joined here forming a torrent that hurled down into the deep pit to the south. While the flowing water vanished long ago, a rivulet of dark liquid mixed with soiled dirt still flows slowly in its place, filling the tunnel with a terrible stench.
61019: The cavern comes to a sudden end forming a small underwater room. The water has come to a standstill, leaving the sandy bottom undisturbed. There is a number of neatly arranged small rocks in the far corner forming what could be a small nest of some sort.
61020: This is a very small cavern. The walls are ragged with sharp outcroppings while the bottom is covered with soft clay that lies beneath a layer of silt which has a murky appearance. From the pattern of the silt it is evident that there is a strong current flowing southward.
61021:
A long slender eel glides along the water, its body coiled to strike.
A long slender eel glides along the water, its body coiled to strike.

Oddly, the water whips around this small cavern forming a small whirlpool which, through the passage of time, has worn the walls smooth. The ground is littered with small stones and a few larger rocks. There is a thin layer of soft silt covering the hard bottom, much of it collected by and pushed through the hole at the bottom where the water flows out.
61022: The corridor is very narrow and ragged, the small bends allowing for leverage and movement against the strong westward current. There is almost a calmness, much like one would find in the eye of a hurricane, beckoning you upwards, towards the low underwater cavern just above.
61040: A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.

While the cavern is low and damp, its floor is not reached by the icy waters to the east. The walls of the cavern, composed of hard granite and untarnished by passage of time, are ragged, sharp and cool to the touch. On the floor of the cavern there are small patches of moss covering much of the smooth granite. A small lever can be seen embedded into the wall and in the corner, where a patch of the moss was cleared, a faint inscription has been etched into the stone.
66711: A strong, tall orc-guard is looking for enemies here.

The roof of the tower has always been used as a lookout. Even now, when orcs inhabit the tower, they stand guard here, keeping unwanted guests from entering their new home from the air. Although an important post, it is still considered a punishment among the orcs, as they have to stand post when the sun is up. The roof has a splendid view over the surroundings, and has small crenellations that enable the scouts to hide from any enemies view. Remnants of an old flag post stand in the middle of the roof, but as the orcs want to keep a low profile, they have not yet placed a standard of their own there.
66712:
The remainders of a disgusting elf-stew cover the ground.
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there are a quill pen and a piece of paper.
A burly orc-guard is here, sniffing at the air.
A burly orc-guard is here, sniffing at the air.
A strong, tall orc-guard is looking for enemies here.
A strong, tall orc-guard is looking for enemies here.
Brolg, shaman of the Ohurk-uai, is here, chanting some evil incantations.
An orc of the Ohurk-uai stands here, cursing and grumbling.

This old chamber in the tower might once have been a study chamber or the bedchamber of someone of importance to the keep. Now it has been turned into the most important room of the castle, as the orkish shaman resides here. The cracks in the walls also enable the orcs to use this room as a lookout post where they keep watch on their front door.
66714:
A large, dusty alcove sits in a wall, smelling of soot.
A strong, tall orc-guard is looking for enemies here.
A strong, tall orc-guard is looking for enemies here.
A burly orc-guard is here, sniffing at the air.
A burly orc-guard is here, sniffing at the air.

This tower is the only remaining part of the old keep, which has fallen into ruins. The walls are cracked, with small rays of light filtering in through cracks in the masonry. It does not seem as if the tower could hold back a siege for more than a short while before the walls would collapse. You see a small stair running up the eastern wall, and the remains of an old, grand hearth, now used by the orcs to roast meat, on the northern one. Once the home of some lord's guard captain, it is now only occupied by the gate guards, who stand vigilant, watching out for enemies.
66715:
A sturdy leather backpack has been left here.
A beer barrel has been left here.
A water barrel has been left here.
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
There are two weapons racks here.
An Ohurk-uai orc-guard, holding a broad spear, is sleeping here.
An Ohurk-uai orc-guard, holding a dagger, is sleeping here.

The old tower's cellar, once used as a storage for the keep, now holds all the food and drink the orcs might need. It also contains weapons and armour that might be useful to hold back an onslaught from the outside. A few orcs also use this as sleeping grounds, as is evident from the smell of the room.
66716:
A orc patrol-leader of the Ohurk-uai is looking for enemies here.
An orc of the Ohurk-uai stands here, cursing and grumbling.
An orc of the Ohurk-uai stands here, cursing and grumbling.

This small passage is about two yards high and about two yards wide. Roughly cut through the rock below the castle, it was once used as an escape for the lords inhabiting the castle. These days it is used as a secret entrance for the orcs that live here now.
66717:
A strong, tall orc-guard is looking for enemies here.
A burly orc-guard is here, sniffing at the air.
A burly orc-guard is here, sniffing at the air.
An orc of the Ohurk-uai stands here, cursing and grumbling.

The old lord of the castle was a man that had many enemies. In order to feel more secure, he created this escape passage that would take him out onto the river, thus to safety, should he ever be attacked. The passage is about two yards in height and in width, with roughly cut walls. A few torches are fastened at the walls, but they have long since burnt out. Nowadays the passage is used by orcs that want to remain concealed, and the walls are covered with dirt and writings in blood.
66718:
A soft leather helmet lies here.
A pair of soft leather boots are on the ground.
There are two rafts here.
A soft leather jerkin is on the ground.
A scuffed and worn leather satchel has been left here.
There is a water skin lying on the ground.
Some cracked and splintered pieces of wood float here.

This small natural cavern, created by the river, is rather quiet considering the huge amount of water passing it as the river twists and swirls, forcing powerful streams of water through the mouth of the cave. The walls of the cavern are smooth, polished by the water, but at the back end of the cavern there are some cracks and crevices where the water is calm and still, almost peaceful. Just above the calm waters seems to lie a landing of some sort, with remnants of wooden pillars used to secure small boats.
66719: Below the bridge the water is always in a permanent state of dusk. The narrow cleft which the river runs through creates strange echoes and roaring sounds as the water hurls by. A small cave seems to have been hollowed out by the swift water just to the south. Not much else can be seen here as you are in constant movement due to the speed of the water. The walls of the cleft are steep, grey and slippery, making it impossible to do anything but follow the river.
71268: This path has not been used for a very long time. It leads west into the opening in the side of the mountain. Just outside the opening, where water and mud meet, there are some very big and deep footprints. From time to time the path is totally flooded so one has to swim.
71269:
The corpse of a young cave troll is lying here.
The corpse of a young cave troll is lying here.
Klaees (donny), wielding a heavy morningstar, is here, fighting a young cave troll.
Bulg, wielding a great warsword, is here, fighting a young cave troll.
Drazud, wielding a two-handed axe, is here, fighting a young cave troll.
Ducaht (tooprettytodie), wielding a great warsword, is here, fighting a young cave troll.
A young cave troll is here, fighting Klaees (donny).

You are in a small cave room just inside the mountain. You hear a lot of grumbling noises from the large well-lit cave to the west. The cave seems to have been a mine once, bearing the marks of picks and being quite accurately cut out in the mountain. However, you cannot believe that the skilled masons who once made this cave still live here. Definitely, something else has taken this cave as its home. There is a lot of water on the ground, slowly flowing from the north to the east.
71270:
A couple of burning logs sit in a pile.
A young cave troll is here, staying close to his mother.
A young cave troll is here, staying close to his mother.

You feel a terrible stench from the piles of debris lying in the corners of the cave. This is the home of big and ugly cave trolls, which are among the most fearsome creatures in this part of Middle-earth. Scattered around are the remnants of unlucky animals, humans, dwarves, elves and even orcs upon whom the trolls have feasted. The only way out seems to be through the large opening to the east.
71271:
A young cave troll is here, staying close to his mother (red aura).
The ugly troll mother is roaming the cave, taking care of her loved ones (red aura).

Dull grey rock forms the walls of the hidden grotto. Some loose stones lie on the ground here and there. The cave is almost clean and footprints can be seen on the floor. The one who lives here might feel some kind of responsibility, since he obviously tries to avoid making this place a total mess.
71272: A thick wall of dark and dense vegetation blocks your way south and west. A tall tree spreads its branches very high above your head. All is very silent. A damp smell fills the air. There used to be another tree taller than the other trees, but someone cut it down and even digged out the root. Are dwarves still around? The only remains is a waterfilled pit.
71273: You have found an old, long abandoned mining tunnel. The ceiling is rather low, forcing tall creatures to bend down to be able to move. The tunnel leads east and upwards deeper into the mountain. There is a lot of water on the ground in this part of the shaft.
71275:
A dark intangible shadow turns to face you.
A hungry warg stands here, sniffing around for flesh.
A long time ago silver and iron were gathered here to be loaded on mounts and taken away. Now the cave is empty, and it feels strange to have a place like this deep inside the mountain.
74858:
The corpse of a strong bodyguard is lying here.
The corpse of a strong bodyguard is lying here.
A small oaken table has been set here.
A neat straw pallet is lying here.
A neat straw pallet is lying here.

Less extravagant than the larger chamber adjoining it, this room seems to be of a strictly utilitarian design. The floorboards are bare of carpeting, and the torches mounted upon each wall are held in the simplest of iron sconces. Nevertheless it is apparent that this room sees frequent use; scuffed foot- prints disturb the thin later of sawdust covering the ground, and the air hangs heavy with the odour of sweat.
75954:
An intact skeleton of a man is walking around here.
The shadowy wight of a bodyguard stands here.

You are standing on the main level of an ancient ruined tower. Judging by the style of the construction and furniture remains, this tower was built by the ancient Numenoreans. There does not seem to have been any sign of a battle, yet it seems that some tragedy has befallen this place. Ancient, crumbling stairs lead up and down from here. There is also a door leading out to the south.
75955: You are standing on the stairs leading down to the cellar of the tower. The sense of decay and abandonment grows stronger the further down you go, seeping into the very stone you stand on. You're afraid that if you linger here much longer, the ancient stone will give way, plunging you down into the darkness.
75956:
A mountain mule is sitting here.
A domesticated pony, beast of burden to many, stands here.

There is a sense of death and decay down in this tower's cellar that comes from more than just the remains of barrels and sacks that once held fresh supplies. Not a single ray of light reaches this place making it extremely difficult to see just what is here. The air is stale and the surroundings dismal. Those that find themselves here want to leave this evil place but might hesitate, afraid to risk the stairs.
75957:
The shadowy wight of a bodyguard stands here.
The shadowy wight of a bodyguard stands here.

You are on the stairs leading from the main level of the tower to its upper gallery. All around you, the beautiful stonework...what was that? Did the floor just shift? Maybe you should get off these stairs before they give way.
75958: A simple wooden chest is here.

You are standing in the upper gallery of the tower. Judging by the furnishings surrounding you, the floor served as the living quarters for the soldiers stationed here. Stairs lead up and down from here. The evil presence that you have been feeling seems to be coming from up the stairs.
75959:
A wight bodyguard is here, fighting YOU.
Sza (smurfette), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.
Drazud (freshmeat), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.
Klaees (thedon), wielding a heavy morningstar, is standing here.
Bulg (pukespy), wielding a great warsword, is here, fighting a wight bodyguard.

You are on the stairs leading from the tower's upper gallery to the roof. All around you, the signs of decay are obvious, including these stairs. The stairs feel as if they are about to give way at any moment. Travel upwards is impeded by a closed hatch in the ceiling.
75960:
An old-looking ring, covered with runes, lies here.
Kostilam, wielding a battle axe, is here, fighting a wight bodyguard.
Iarion the Elf, wielding an engraved broadsword, is here, fighting a wight bodyguard.
A wight bodyguard is here, fighting Kostilam.

You are standing on the roof of the ancient tower. Some magical force has managed to cloak the roof in darkness, even in the full light of day. Oddly enough, you can still see the surrounding lands. This tower was obviously set here to watch over the road. Looking around, you see that the only way to leave the roof is by the hatch set in the floor.
77002: You go on, and soon you feel lost. You make a turn and walk back, looking for the path you left. You are pretty sure that you are walking the exact same route that lead you to this place. Still, the area you are in seems unfamiliar. There is no sign of the path. Did you take the wrong turn somewhere? Hmm. The way back to he path must be around the hill east of here. It has to be.
77003: You were wrong! You find no path. You are far away from it and lost. Your only option is to walk on. So you do, firmly believing that you have to run into a path eventually.
77004: You walk a while. The hope of finding the path grows smaller. You are far and deep into the Mountains. Snow covers the ground, and there is a strong wind. Snow drifts away by the wind, making the outlines of the landscape blurry. The wind is cold! Your cheeks are aching. You go at a good pace; your body and feet are still warm.
77005: You have no idea of where you are. Your range of vision is very limited. The wind is very strong. Snow is drifting in the wind at great speed. Tiny ice crystals constantly bombard your face. It feels like someone pricks your face with hundreds of small needles every second. You can barely see anything; you are forced to keep your eyes closed.
77006: The wind makes walking very troublesome. At times you have to sit down, or else you would be blown away. The ground is still covered by snow. It is dry and hard, almost like ice, polished by days of strong wind. Your strength drains rapidly. If you do not find any shelter quickly, you risk severe frostbite.
77007: You can't go any further in these extreme weather conditions. Your face already suffers from frostbite. It's numb with cold. So are your fingers. Some you can't move. For a while, they have had a deep purple colour and aching. Now they feel warm, but large areas are of a white colour, and small black spots appear. You doubt that is a good sign. It really is very cold, it's not only the wind making it feel like it. The snow is dry and crispy, squeaking beneath your feet. Any liquid from your mouth, nose or eyes freezes instantly, and even breathing is troublesome. You'll have to find shelter fast. These conditions might kill you within the end of the day, no matter how hard you struggle against them.
77008: You found a snowdrift well suited for making a cave. Even though you hardly can do anything with your frozen fingers and the fact that you have no equipment made for digging snow caves, you manage to dig a tunnel some metres into the snowdrift. At the end, you widen it to make it possible to sit and turn yourself around. You are now protected by metres of packed snow, a perfect protection from the blizzard outside. The temperature inside your cave is really comfortable, just below the freezing point and most important: no wind, of course. The frostbite seems to heal slowly, and you slowly regain some of your strength. You stay here weatherbound, waiting for better weather conditions.
77009: You leave the cave behind you and feel a cold breeze in your face. This is a snowfield high up in the Mountains, which gives you a good overlook over the surroundings. It is hard to walk here, since every step you take makes you sink down into the snow, and you have to struggle hard to get anywhere. As you walk on, you suddenly see the the path you left below you.
77010: It really is the path you left before! You have been pretty close to it all the time, but no way you would ever find it during the blizzard. You walk back to the path just a bit below you. Sometimes boulders comes galloping down besides you, maybe let loose by mid-day sun on the snow above you.
77053:
A mass of wriggling vines drops on you from the trees.
Some roots lie here waiting to ensnare weary travellers.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.

This used to be a small garden in the courtyard, surrounded by the thick walls. Now the plants have grown savage, and they have managed to ruin the wall. It still gives some shelter, but mostly it is just piles of rubble. Among the stones and vegetation sounds can be heard: soft rustling noises, as if something was being dragged along the stones.
77054:
A circular stone well has been built here.
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.

Once a proud courtyard, vibrating with the busy life of the many men who lived here and the sounds of horses and men, it is now a deserted pile of rubble, with very little to discern it from the ruined castle. The castle well remains, but several large stone blocks have fallen off it and now block the passage into the tower.
77055:
A mass of wriggling vines drops on you from the trees.
Some thick writhing vines whip all around you.
Some roots lie here waiting to ensnare weary travellers.
A hungry warg stands here, sniffing around for flesh.

The old yard just inside the castle gates is overgrown with wild plants and evil thorns. Where once guards in shining armour kept watch now only the wild and furious vegetation remains, reclaiming its once lost territory. The ruined keep lies just to the north. Along the northern wall and towering above it like huge fangs are the remnants of the towers.
77056: A shadowy haunt floats here, oblivious to your presence.

Not much remains here that bears resemblance to a stable. A wall has been knocked down, there is a hole in the roof and several cracks in the remaining walls. Still, it is dark and it can serve as shelter. It seems as if the inhabitants left in a hurry, as you can see splinters of several tools littering the ground.
77058:
A spirit floats around, making strange magical gestures (glowing).
A skeletal warrior is staring angrily at the surroundings.
An intact skeleton of a man is walking around here.
An intact skeleton of a man is walking around here.
A orc patrol-leader of the Ohurk-uai is looking for enemies here.
An orc soldier of the Ohurk-uai is here, patrolling the area.
An orc soldier of the Ohurk-uai is here, patrolling the area.

This small chamber was once the chapel of the keep. Here the inhabitants came for tranquillity and worship. As the keep fell into ruin, the small chapel has not been spared. The paintings on the wall have faded and crumbled. What is left of an altar or a shrine lies in a pile of wood by the western wall. All across the floor lie pieces of broken stone benches.
77971:
Traces of white tones form the aura of this place.
A lever sticks out of the wall beside the iron gate.

A high-domed ceiling curves up overhead, and the centre of the room is dominated by a marble well. A carved swan sits on the edge and deep in the depths of the well you can see water sparkling. Murals unseen by anyone for ages line the walls.
77972: The feel of deep magic throbs in your head, filling your very soul with the ancient magic of the Elves. Never has anything felt so peaceful as being submerged in this cool blue water. Pain and exhaustion fade away as you dive deeper into the heart of the well. Silence surrounds you, calming your heart and soul.
77973: A pale blue stone lies forgotten here.

Here at the bottom, small cave fish dart about in the rocks. Perhaps part of a vast underground river, the water is cool and a current flows over you from out of the darkness. Ancient stones line the bottom of the well, perhaps dropped here by the Elves in a different age.
78443:
A large stone fireplace with a roaring fire warms the room.
A small oaken table has been set here.
A Dunlending woman is here tending to her children.

The kitchen looks tidy and well kept. A long table lines the east wall and a collection of primitive cooking tools are laid upon it. There are also a couple of chests that probably contain food or supplies here. To the west a curtain can be seen hanging down that can be closed for added privacy.
78444:
A coil of rope is lying here.
A small hatchet has been left on the ground.
A small child is here playing happily.
A small child is here playing happily.

This is the front entry hall of the farmhouse. It serves as a place for the family to hang up their coats and wipe their feet. There are some pictures on the wall, and a kitchen visible through the doorway north. West a dining area can be seen. It is a large home, fit to house many.
78445: Entering this room from the front hall directly east, it is noticeable that this is where food is eaten. There is a cupboard with plates, cups and eating utensils. The floor is made of wood, polished to a shine. There is a small window here, which looks out over the front yard and to the barn.
78446:
A goat is here, grazing happily.
A goat is here, grazing happily.
A sturdy billy goat stands here, proudly protecting his goats.
A pig is here, covered in mud.
A pig is here, covered in mud.
A brown cow is here, contemplating a higher reality whilst chewing slowly.
A brown cow is here, contemplating a higher reality whilst chewing slowly.
A hen is standing here.
A hen is standing here.

This is a quite dirty animal pen for common farm animals. Tracks of pigs, cows and hens can be seen on the ground. There is a muddy pool in one corner of the fenced area, where the pigs like to stay, and a small wooden barn where the animals can seek shelter. To the north, behind the fence, is the farmhouse, a large building with many rooms.
78447:
A saddle lies here on the ground.
A saddlecloth lies here on the ground.
A worn leather saddlebag has been left on the ground.
A black-haired farmhand is here.

This small and dusty barn is the perfect place to house some of the animals for the farm. Also kept here is animal feed and farming tools. There is a line of stalls along the west wall where the horses are kept. Hanging near these stalls are the bridles, and on a stand below that some saddles.
78448: This is a very homely room. On the back wall there is a rather large bed with thick, soft blankets and a wooden bedside table next to it. A candle has been placed there to give light when needed. On the northern wall of this bedroom a narrow ladder can be seen leading upstairs. South a window shows a glimpse of the path leading to the farmhouse.
78449:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
A small child is here playing happily.

This room has been divided into two halves by a hanging curtain of vines, with a single bed on each side. A small ladder can be seen leading downstairs into the master bedroom below. Judging by the toys and small articles of clothing that are scattered around, this must be where the children sleep.
78758: A few extremely narrow fissures cleave the ground, stretching off to the north between the massive boulders. The rest of the landscape is strewn with the colossal stones and almost no vegetation is to be seen here. The few hardy weeds which have tried to take hold in the thin soil have been beaten down by the smaller rocks and pebbles which cover the land between the boulders.
78823: A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.
A big bird's nest between two branches makes climbing higher impossible, but the view is good enough from here. Especially in the south.
79965: This small musty room is dug from the earth, with no stone walls. There are shelves that line the walls, and some hooks in the ceiling to hang some meat on. The shelves hold some foods in jars, preserved from the farm garden. There is a small sturdy ladder leaning against one wall, which leads out of this cellar.
79970: This small chamber is hemispherical in shape and built from thick limestone blocks which show a few lichens on their pale surface. This is no tomb for burial and there are no markings on the walls or floor. No light enters this place save the strong light which climbs up the narrow stairs from below casting strong shadows on the inside of the cairn.
79971: This is a small circular chamber of simple faced-stone, while the ground is a series of flagstones. A remarkable portal faces eastwards and is covered in unusual runes and glyphs. These symbols emit a quiet hum and shed a strong light into the room.
79972: This room east of the runed door marks the beginning of a narrow passage. The door on this side is similar to the side in the antechamber but with far fewer glyphs and no visible lock. This side of the door, the floor continues to be paved with small flagstones. However, the walls of the room are of an irregular nature with large blocks of rough stone protruding. Perhaps these blocks are the former foundations of the Tower of Amon Sul.
79973: The passage runs straight in an east-west direction even though large stone columns protrude into the tunnel. A sconce is fixed to the south wall although it contains no torch as the fixture has been twisted beyond repair. The ceiling above continues to be low for a tunnel of mannish construction.
79974: The passage goes from west to east, but the continuity of the north wall is at one point broken by a thin opening from roof to floor. A few small flinders of wood also litter the floor.
79975: A small rat runs about, oblivious to your presence.

This small chamber is oft visited, as indicated by the large number of small prints in the dirt on the floor. The floor is also littered with several nests made of all manner of debris, which have been purposely dumped here. The walls and ceiling are severely blackened suggesting some kind of fire in the past.
79976: A spirit floats towards you and howls with an evil laughter.

The passage here increases in width and becomes more worked compared to the passage west. The walls show signs of fittings which have since been removed so no light illuminates the surfaces and probably hasn't for centuries. The floor has a circle of small blue and greenish stones inlaid into it, although many of the tiles have been shattered by something. Finally, the ceiling of the passage is finished with fine traceries, a product of the high skill of the Dunedain.
