This hole of a place is not very deep but dank and terrifying by implications written in the bones scattered on its floor, the graffiti painted in blood on its walls, and the scratch marks all along the perimeter belonging to something heavy and unknown. Above, a narrowing escape leads outside. Midway up, two crossed bars are wedged securely in it.
102810: The painted narrow door in the western wall belies the appearance of this chamber. Dark and oppressive, this square room has a single torch burning with fierce white fire on the wall opposite of the entrance. Pointed ribs rise from the corners of the room to form a single cross vault, receding into the darkness above. A few crude metal implements are attached to the stone walls all around the room.
102811: Two rows of thick hexagonal columns run from the room's only entrance in the eastern wall and into the darkness away from it. The high ceiling is composed of two barrel vaults on the sides and a sequence of cross vaults, running from the top edges of the columns, all along the middle of the hall. Heavy chandeliers hang from the points where the ribs of the ceiling vaults meet. From there, a multitude of candles casts its ghostly light all across the guard hall. Wooden benches line the walls with tables, hastily cobbled together, standing in front of them filling the nave.

The round base of the keep's tower is bare but for a staircase and two archways. To the north the pointed archway, decorated with sooted runes along the outer edge, leads to the square outside. To the right of the entrance, an entryway to a tall tunnel with a rounded roof recedes further into the keep. The hall encompasses two flights of stairs that lead further up: the lower one is facing the entrance, the one above it faces away from it. The staircase is constructed of solid stone blocks. The chunk of it facing away from the square has holes in its steps.
102813: A grey stone column with hexagonal base widening toward the ceiling is standing in the middle of this large room. Not a window is in sight. A stone bench runs around the column; a few more benches line the walls. The corners of the room wallow in darkness, which not even the bright ghostly torches hanging all around it, can penetrate. A narrow tunnel with rounded roof departs into the western wall.
102814: A wooden ladder propped against the wall is the only way out. It goes through the square hole in the ceiling, where a shadow can be seen. This round room hints at the shape of the building above it, but where in a regular room there would be windows, here there are alcoves with decayed bits of paper and sheepskin hinting at what once must have been a records room. Multiple torch holders line the walls, though no torch has touched them in a long time.
102815: This spacious round room has no windows, but two metal doors, mysteriously bolted open to the walls and opening out to a balcony with guardrails of cast iron, ornately silhouetted against the landscape. Another smaller doorway is inserted into the eastern wall, and two staircases lead above and below this hall. One is a sturdy stone staircase descending to the ground level. The other is a narrow spiral staircase also of cast iron, in the same motif as the balcony, leading to the tower above. Around the top of the walls, tattered banners and standards hang, and rusted ceremonial weapons from lands long gone line the walls below them.
102816: The road leads away from the gates and towards the centre of the guard keep, but curves away to the south circling the citadel. To the south, the road continues along the southern edge of the outer castle walls. Gusts of chilly wind bring smoke and smell here from the direction of the keep. The walls of the area are covered with soot; what colour its stones once were, one cannot tell.
102817: Black cobblestones cover the ground here. Droppings and excrement of indistinct origin lie in deep puddles. The stench is overwhelming, compounding the feeling of despair that soaks this place through every stone. Darkness reigns the skies where they are not concealed by the castle walls, the keep, or the main citadel. The road runs south here, along the perimeter walls.
102818: Turning between the tall black walls on both sides, the road narrows a little here. The black stones covering it are worn with age, same as the walls of the castle. Ashes are piled in small mounds where they meet, as if trying to avoid the chilly touch of the wind whistling shrilly all over the castle keep.

Skirting the southmost edge of the keep, this road has been used for ages for massing the armies. Envoys and friends of the Witch-king, his prisoners and slaves, came this way, some of them never to return to the outside world. Only the cold wind, loud, shrill, and wordless moves here - the only witness of their chilly fate.
102820: The dirty cobblestoned road runs between two tall walls - the wall of the guard keep to the north and the outer wall of the castle to the south. Several broken wheelbarrows without wheels are perched along the sides together with some crushed ladders. Decrepit remnants of some wooden defensive construction rest along the southern wall.
102821: Two mighty walls come together at a straight angle here. They rise into the darkened sky like two stormy waves, suspended forever in their act of insurrection. The road continues west and north of here, just as dirty and putrid as it is here. The inner wall of the guard keep to the northwest leans subtly outwards, and thus overhangs the road ever so slightly.
102822: The craggy mountain surface to the east would have concealed any hint of sunrise, even if it was not so impossibly dark here. The malevolent presence that haunts the castle seems to grow in that direction. The cold clammy walls accumulate moisture around it, and a thin layer of fog clings to it also. The road runs north here, leading to the gates that protect the main part of the citadel.

Across from the back wall of the guard keep, the first level of castle defence, rise the gates of the citadel of Angmar. Opening outwards, they are made to look much like the cliff surface surrounding it. Upon closer inspection, it turns out that they are made of metal. The metal sheets are piled on one another, until each gate half is more than a foot thick. They ring unendingly like chimes, as if singing for the forgotten souls that have entered this Vala-forsaken place never to emerge again. The road runs south and north here, along the walls and around the keep. Upon the gates, a giant ring hangs with a human skull hanging off the chain within it - a giant bell that is no more used for knocking than it is for decoration.
102824: Directly inside the gates five niches are carved into the eastern wall of this checkpoint, where the guards can take stock off newcomers. The old rusted spikes peek from the floor, though it is clear that the mechanism that activates them into the feet of unwelcome guests is broken. The gates are covered with a layer of wood that muffles the sounds coming from outside, and now the oaky rotten smell from it permeates this place.
102825: Dark stains run down the walls that once had intricate geometric designs painted into them in white and red. The passage is quite wide here; enough to let six people walk shoulder to shoulder. The dilapidated rounded ceiling is missing a few stones. While insufficient to make it cave in, this allows the rainwater and humidity from eternal mountain fogs to enter the castle. Here it is absorbed by old spongy walls and in turn breeds some especially resilient forms of mould.
102826: A weapons rack stands against the wall.

Hanging on heavy chains from the ceiling, columns of three beds each are suspended along the northern, eastern, and western walls. In the middle of the room, a set of weapon and arrow racks serves as a miniature armoury for guards attached to this post. The racks are bolted fast to the floor, and are the only feature well-visible through the open doorway.
102827: The clean straight lines of two perpendicular passages intersect here. A diagonal line slashes across the floor where they meet, and their ceilings form a saddle from which a heavy chandelier hangs. A dozen spearheads peek straight out of the corner, all along the length of the wall crease. One would be unwise to lean that way. A faded solemn geometric motif that was once red and white runs at shoulder height along the walls on both sides.
102828: The castle passage leads eastwards here, heading deeper into the stronghold of Angmar. The smooth walls meet above in a rounded ceiling - a complicated arrangement of bricks that are holding up without any underlying support even as the pathway twists here. A small window, narrow and pointed both at the top and bottom, showcases Misty Mountains in all their cloudy magnificence, dark shaded, and shimmering ever so slightly. The view down reveals a precipitous drop and a foggy mountain valley with no bottom, for in it a cloud sleeps comfortably for all times.

The dark corner of the passage harbours a few spiders, a lot of dust, and a legion of ghosts from the past. These walls are silent witnesses to the terrors and atrocities of the Witch-king, as a tapestry hanging on the northern wall depicts in great detail. Woven into its soiled surface in red, white, and black is the story of the Witch-king's victory over the people of Arthedain in Fornost. Occasional gusts of wind disturb the back of the tapestry, for it is nailed over a north-facing window.
102830: No dust is allowed to collect in the passageways of the castle, for the patrols sweep it endlessly, and messengers go back and forth between the high sanctuary of the King and the castle's environs. The wide, dark floor stones are polished smooth by their feet. The pockmarked walls, their close cousins, confine this place from east and west, connected above by a well-proportioned barrel roof. A guard check point is situated south of here.
102831: A defensible guard checkpoint bottlenecks the passage here. It is wider than the rest of the hallway, and has a strangely checkerboarded floor. Spears hang along its eastern wall, rusted to their holdings. A small guard chamber west of here offers a convenient place to watch the traffic without being in the way.
102832: The sterile passageways of the castle attract gloom like a great ageless sponge. Light fails to dissipate the shadows in its corners. Shedding paint on the walls reveals porous limestone behind it, but the floor is made of some other stone. Dark and well-preserved, it is able to withhold the onslaught of both feet and ages, and remain ice cold forever.
102833: Going onwards, seemingly forever, this dark passage looms over the heads of the travellers. The walls are made of strange black stone, ice-cold to the touch. Dust gathers in the corners and small spider webs can be spotted in the ceiling. The floor is smooth, as thousands of feet have trodden this pathway over the centuries. The dry air is permeated with decay and strange unpleasant smells that bring to mind unvoiced terrors of childhood dreams.
102834: The darkened brick walls of this room are lined with chains hanging from the top of the ceiling. A rusty metal grid is hanging on one hinge to the right of the entrance. A pile of bones, looking rather mislaid in a military citadel, is collecting dust in the corner. Clinking and clanging of the chains, coming from some hidden breeze, breaks up the terrible monotony of this place.
102835: The dark passageway makes a sharp turn here, from west to north. The walls are composed of a dark stone, ever ice-cold to the touch. In the southeast corner stands a large pillar made of a single solid piece of marble. From the floor all the way to the roof, carved out of lime-coloured stone, human figures in agonising pain reach out their hands as if asking for redemption.
102836: Leading ever deeper into the fortress, the passage continues in a south to north fashion. At one place, it gets narrower, hampering fast movement. The dark stone walls soak up any noise, leaving one lingering in utter silence. Terrifying, the silent arrow slits face the inside of the passage: what the invisible archers of Angmar look like is left to one's imagination.
102837: The dark hallway here has been constructed in a way that impedes travel, so it is easier to defend the passage. The hallway continues north and south while a large chamber opens up eastwards. The walls loom overhead, a heavy burden on any traveller's soul. There is no movement in the cold air which stinks of death and decay.

Large and open, this chamber dwarves any creature in its bowels. Except, that is, for the ruler on the raised dais along the eastern wall, who can look down upon its vassals from the steel throne high above the ground. The dais is covered with carvings, all depicting crushed and broken men, maimed and in agonising pain.
102839: In the glare of massive ghostly torch flames, the narrow corridor carries a sense of pending doom, originating, perhaps, from an overbearing sense of claustrophobia. The passage is narrow and tall. The eerie lighting spreads above the brass braziers, but never reaches the ceiling, while the floor is just as impenetrable in this unholy darkness.
102840:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.

This spacious room would normally be home to a small squad of guards. These days, it stands deserted, beds taken off chains and stacked in the corner. The darkened sooty ceiling is low, much lower than in the rest of the castle. The door that formerly blocked this room from the chamber beyond stands in the opposite corner, its cast-iron grid rusted through in several places. An old white skeleton is chained to it at the top.
102841: A weapons rack stands against the wall.

Time and rust took toll on all the racks and weapons strewn around this chamber: there is not a usable piece of metal to be seen. This room abuts a magnificent audience chamber with a sinister throne visible if one glances to the right of the crumpled doorway. A few chandeliers are piled in the corner, rusted to each other and to the iron-laid floor.
102842: Unusually delicate carvings adorn the cavernous walls of the corridor here. But while they are exquisite in nature - they are not at all fine in content: dreadful ghasts, malignant spirits, and a variety of abominable phantasms, their eyes glittering with a multitude of semi-precious stones, glare at the passersby from their lofty perches under the ceiling. Sleeping chambers to the east of here is what they are guarding, whether to keep living things in or out.
102843:
A large cabinet capable of storing goods is here.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
A small oaken table has been set here.
A wooden chest stands in the corner.

This circular room has a radius of about twenty yards. The walls are draped in red linen giving it a soft feel that clashes with the rest of the complex. The roof is shaped like a dome, and at the top of the span a small hole is outlined, where the polluted air of this chamber can escape. What remains of the door that once occupied the western doorway, lies scattered on the floor. Four beds stand along the walls, though time has taken its toll on them. Close to the doorway stand a rack and a cabinet where the guests could leave their belongings. A wooden table with six sturdy chairs occupy the centre of the room.
102844:
A raging inferno of flames is here, incinerating you.
A solid ironbound chest is here.
The Lieutenant of Angmar stands tall and proud before you (glowing).
An Angmarian wraith-guard is on patrol here, ever vigilant.
An Angmarian wraith-guard is on patrol here, ever vigilant.
An Angmarian wraith-guard is on patrol here, ever vigilant.
An Angmarian wraith-guard is on patrol here, ever vigilant.

The tall arched windows of this elongated rectangular hall open into a smoky walled courtyard. A raised platform along the eastern wall houses charred remains of a large bed with four decapitated bedposts. The flat ceiling of thick wooden beams is lined with an assortment of metal hooks of all shapes and sizes.
102845:
There is a lot of snow on the ground.
A raging inferno of flames is here, incinerating you.

Piles of dead fish are rotting in the creekbed here. The smelly dirty water, covered with some green foamy residue, is waist deep. No water flow can be discerned. Here and there, dead tree branches stick out of the water, their twisted fingers reaching out in the direction of every perceived movement. A fetid smell suffuses the air, augmenting the underlying feeling of the land rotting and wallowing in its own decay.
102846: A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.

A round chamber, narrowing toward the middle of the ceiling into a cupola, has several windows all around it. All of them are barricaded with sheets of metal, firmly secured against any hint of light from outside, though a cold draft is very much in evidence in this tower. Some hooks and chains hang from the ceiling all the way to the floor, exposing this room manifestly for what it is - a private interrogation room.
102847: There is a lot of snow on the ground.

A semi-circular stone platform protruding from the wall is lined with a cast iron guardrail, intricately shaped into spirals terminating in small triple-spiked crowns. The balcony opens onto the smoke-filled courtyard, with a good view of the iron gate to the west and any possible executions below. An arched doorway leads back into the tower, but there are no visible doors keeping unwanted visitors out.
102848: A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.

The rounded barrel-roof of the passage is stained black above the torch holders lining the walls every foot. Ghostly blue flames flicker in them, but illuminate nothing. The passage wiggles a few feet while keeping the general north to south direction, but at the cusp of the bend, an unadorned doorway leads into an abandoned guardroom.
102849:
A pile of coins is here.
A broadsword made of a dark metal lies here.
An Angmarian patrol-guard, wielding a short spear, is here, fighting Kibgil.
An Angmarian patrol-guard, wielding a short spear, is here, fighting Kibgil.
An Angmarian patrol-guard, wielding a mace, is here, fighting Kibgil.
Kibgil the Dwarf, wielding an engraved broadsword, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.
Antar the Man, wielding an engraved warhammer, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.
Kessler the Dwarf, wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.
Eorberl the Man, wielding a steel claymore, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.

This cramped square room with weapon racks bolted to the walls is a regular guard chamber of the Angmarian castle. Several metal boards hanging on chains from the ceiling, much like a ladder, constitute guard beds. Four guards can take a nap on this rickety contraption while their comrades mull around the guard room or roam the hallways. A few rusted hinges line the entryway, but the door itself lies prone on the floor.
102850:
A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.
Kibgil the Dwarf, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here scouting.
Antar the Man, wielding an engraved warhammer, is standing here.
Kessler the Dwarf, wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is standing here.
Eorberl the Man, wielding a steel claymore, is standing here.

The passage bends here, and where the barrel roofs of its two arms meet, a cross-saddle is formed. From its cusp hangs a cast iron chandelier with nine candle holders at its rounded edge. Two crossed flat crowns span the middle of the circle. South of here, the passage comes to a set of stairs leading down. A small triangular platform of stone protrudes from the wall, spanning but a small part of the corner like a small bench.
102851: A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.

A wide circular staircase plunges to the level below. It is made entirely out of cast iron, and begins with a foot-wide platform at the top, bolted to the floor where the passage ends. Elaborate handrails run alongside the stair on both sides. While cast iron is quite heavy, part of the burden is taken away from the staircase since the steps themselves are not solid, but made of a cross-hatched pattern of iron bars.
102852:
A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.
Kibgil the Dwarf, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.
Antar the Man, wielding an engraved warhammer, is standing here frowning.
Kessler the Dwarf, wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is standing here.
Eorberl the Man, wielding a steel claymore, is standing here.

Deep under the Misty Mountains, unthinkable horrors lie, and while this place is part of the castle made by men, its dark corners belie its origin. No care was taken to smooth the wall of this dungeon, carved out in the rock of the mountains. Sharp edges and pointed angles are everywhere, except the dusty floor toward which a black iron staircase descends from above. A miniscule doorway leads from here into a prison cell. A heavy wooden door with a couple of eyeholes separates the two rooms.
102854:
There is a lot of snow on the ground.
A raging inferno of flames is here, incinerating you.

Trees, cracked and burned to ashes, stand broken, as skeletal fingers, in the still raging fires. Trees not yet consumed glow with red-orange light and waves of heat roll over the ground. The fire is spreading swiftly, with nothing in its path being able to stop its devastating progress.
102855:
Greed the Dwarf (GG) is resting here smiling.
Sigurdur the Dwarf (SS) is resting here smiling.
Tanide the Elf (TT) is resting here giggling.
Eornhan is resting here.

Damp and dark, the dungeon floor is littered with the decaying remains of its former inhabitants. The cold stone walls have faint markings in endless lines and rows, at places covered in wet moss. Piles of bones lie thrown in one of the corners. The only way out is through a sturdy wooden door, reinforced with thick iron bars and carefully blocked from the outside.
102856:
Greed, wielding a mighty dwarven axe, is standing here.
A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.
Tanmh the Elf (TT), wielding a steel claymore, is standing here (shrouded).
Araniz the Elf, wielding a double edged eket, is standing here.
A large warhorse is standing here, clad in mail.

You are standing at the beginning of the dry, rugged lands known as the Lone-lands. The lands truly seem lonely, as even the normal animal sounds you normally hear have disappeared. The much more pleasant rolling plains lie to the west while the rougher terrain continues to the east. A small cave entrance can be seen to the north at the foot of a low ridge of jagged hills.
102857:
A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.
A small, wild lion cub covered in soft, yellow fur is watching you cautiously.
A small, wild lion cub covered in soft, yellow fur is watching you cautiously.

Uneven rock forms the walls and ceiling of this cavity beneath the hills. Once an unspoiled creation of nature, it has now been claimed as a den by some creature. Dry, flattened grass lies in one corner of the cave, and on the opposite side there are several bones littering the earthen floor.
103000: A large stone-laid courtyard extends here. To the north stands a guard post surveying the court and its travellers. A passage in the south part of the court leads further into the castle. A fountain has been placed in the centre of the huge open space. The fountain has been completely constructed out of bone - human bone. The liquid that comes dripping out of a number of different empty eye sockets and gaping yaws is not water.
103001: A tight passage leads away from the courtyard to the north further into the Angmarian castle. No natural light source gives guidance in between the tall iron-clad walls. They are no more than six feet apart from each other. The well-worn floor is composed of large flat stones laid in a straight pattern, the work of someone very skilled as no joints are visible in between the stones.
103002: The passage twists and turns as it goes deeper into the castle, always with a small incline. It is quite narrow here: only a few feet separate the high walls from each other. Along the walls, there hang mighty iron shields, dark and threatening. There is a slight draft in the dry air, moving the warmth upwards and dragging with it the smell of decomposition and death.
103003:
A pile of coins is here.
A dagger lies on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A handaxe has been left on the ground.

The hallway comes to an abrupt end, while a steep stairway continues upwards. The walls and roof lean inward, creating a narrow tunnel where a man would have to bend slightly to be able to proceed. The steps are worn out, making the ascent hazardous. A slight draft moves the dry, reeking, warm air upwards.
103004:
A pile of coins is here.
A handaxe has been left on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A falchion lies on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A broadsword made of a dark metal lies here.
An Angmarian patrol-guard, wielding a warhammer, is here, fighting Greed.
Greed the Dwarf, wielding a battle axe, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard (glowing).
Sigurdur the Dwarf, wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.
Tanide the Elf, wielding a great warsword, is standing here.
Eornhan, wielding an engraved broadsword, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.

The tunnel, narrow and quite steep, ends here. Glancing down the tunnel, one can perceive a steep descent, where slippery steps have been worn out by the constant stomping of metal-clad shoes. The hallway continues north and west, arrow loops facing into the passage glare along both sides of it. Its owners, apparently, were more afraid of things inside the castle rather than outside.
103005: This chamber can host a small force which could defend the courtyard south of here. Solid walls contain a set of hard beds and a few places to sit at. Otherwise, there is no interior furniture or decoration except for a hanging on the northern wall. It depicts a grand man riding a fell beast commanding a large force in battle. A silent whisper floats around, chilling the bones and instilling fear in one's heart.
103006: Imbued with age, menace, dread, and oppressing magnificence, lavish tapestries of days past hang along the sides of the hallway. While their opulence is seemingly misplaced in this castle of walking horrors, its content matter would augment well its owner's ambition: Morgoth sitting stoutly on his subterranean throne in Angband, a vision of terror clad in black armour, iron-crowned, and casting a shadow like a storm cloud.
103007: Trajectories of dull afterglow slash across the middle of the room from torches that have burned here in a different time and different age. These ghostly reminders hang at the edge of one's vision, illuminating the lack of furnish in this room. Where the walls meet the floor, rusty stains line the perimeter where weapons and arrow racks were once bolted. An arched doorway, its scrollwork intact, leads out into the passage to the east.
103008: The austere interior of the castle is just a perforation in the dark stone of Carn Dum. Its walls are barely worked, while its floor is polished smooth - more so by the foot traffic, than by whatever craftsmen built this place eons ago. Strange odours linger in the corners of the passage, a mixture of death and the dampness permeating the walls.
103009: The glum atmosphere of the castle seems to seep out the walls themselves here. Their irregular surfaces accommodate a pair of rudimentary square alcoves, carved opposite one another. Solidified remains of candle wax drip, stalactite-like, toward the floor. The corridor is quite wide here, but its walls narrow quickly above, where they come together at an angle that is unnatural to anything man-built.
103010: Uneven, the walls of the passage present their unfriendly empty faces to the interior. This appears to be a natural fissure that narrows at the top. The walls must join somewhere above, but the merge exists too far up for it to be distinguishable with any regular illumination. Fading arrow marks are painted red on the walls, pointing north.
103011: This wide low crevasse in the dark stone forms a bend in the passage deep in the keep of Angmar. The castle is perched next to a grand mountain range, and its back rests against it, and, in some cases like this, resides within it. Among the ceiling, the walls, and the floor, only the latter is carved, so that it may be smooth enough for visitors and residents to walk upon without stumbling in the eternal ethereal murkiness of the castle's passages.
103013: Fresh air, at a premium in the stagnant bowels of this loathsome tower, filters through a small square window in the northern wall. It tapers slightly to the top, so its perfectly square iron cover does not fit tightly, allowing for a robust draft. A stone bench, as much a part of the rock of the citadel as the table in front of it, sits across from it. Blood streaks the bench, the table, and the stone floor, but wither it came from one can no longer tell.
103014: Cavernous corridors in the heart of the Angmar's dread-castle abruptly come to an end, turning into a small guard chamber to the west. A small, crudely painted window to the north lights up the hallway sufficiently to make out a grand tapestry on the opposite wall. The tapestry depicts the treacherous ice of Helcaraxe, and Morgoth's crossing of it with his hideous companion, Ungoliant the Gloomweaver. Its blood-red background is made of no regular paint, and the fabric itself still seethes of malice from the evils that it took to create it and its subject matter.
103015: Human skulls in clay insets stud the low part of the walls, serving as candle-holders. The dark porous stone of the walls seems to seep darkness, with which the vile blue candles cannot keep up. A red tapestry takes the entire southern wall. In its centre, Ungoliant consuming the two White Trees is depicted; a dreadful visage made more so by the background colouring around it, that is soaked in what is distinctly blood.
103016:
A woodman's axe lies here.
A shortsword is on the ground.
A shortsword is on the ground.
A broadsword made of a dark metal lies here.

Heavy walls of black cold stone lean in over the passage, almost as if they would collapse at any moment. White grinning skulls adorn the walls, their eye sockets softly glowing with crimson red light. The ground has been trodden for many centuries, its surface worn down by countless iron-shod feet. Two huge pillars stand on each side of the exit leading westwards, with small dragons of marble slithering up and down the massive colonnades.
103017: Decorative animal skulls, mouths open, are sitting here in clay insets a few hand-spans above the floor. Short stubby candles, flaring on and off with ghost-flames, are standing in their screaming throats. They illuminate little, for the black stone walls are so opaque, they seem to consume any light that touches them. A blood-red tapestry hangs along the northern wall, into which pictorials of human and elven famine and pestilence are woven around the scene of Morgoth killing Finwe with rather gory details.
103018:
A pile of coins is here.
A mace is on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A rapier is on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A two-handed sword is on the ground.
An Angmarian Gatekeeper stands here, fierce and powerful.
An Angmarian patrol-guard, wielding a handaxe, is here, fighting Greed.
Greed the Dwarf, wielding a battle axe, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.
Sigurdur the Dwarf, wielding a blackened dwarven axe, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.
Tanide the Elf, wielding a great warsword, is standing here.
Eornhan, wielding an engraved broadsword, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.

The chamber is square and dark, plain and unadorned except for the great stair that ascends into the darkness high above, wide and sweeping as it climbs toward the higher reaches of the keep. The railings of the black stone stair are carved and shaped, making the pillars resemble twisted and crippled men, crying in agony and pain, as they carry the weight of the steps.
103019: A large bookshelf sits against the wall.

Dark cold stone walls rise some yards up, where a murky wooden roof shields the inhabitants of the castle from the forces of nature. Six beds protrude from the western wall. They are constructed out of the same dark stone as the walls, but no hint remains if they were ever in use. In the middle of the room, there stands a low table carved of one large piece of stone placed on top of two smaller stones. Around the table stand four wooden chairs. The air is dry and chilly. Where there once was a wooden door in the southern wall, there is now only a dark gaping man-sized hole.
103020: Small and dark, this triangular chamber is more like an alcove in which a few guards can stand, ever vigilant. Blackened stone walls loom above, leaning out towards the stairs, meeting high above. They almost seem to physically push down on the room, the cold stones seemingly moving inexorably to crush whatever or whoever that comes unaware in its path.
103021:
A ragged, dark cloak lies discarded on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A scimitar has been left here.

A small chamber, not quite circular, is irregular in a way that is slightly unsettling. Unadorned and dark, the room seems to focus all attention at the portal in the eastern wall, shaped like the great gaping maw of one of the ancient dragons. Beyond the opening lies a black chamber, whose deep darkness cannot be pierced by mortal eyes. Only a faint, rustling sound can be heard, almost like slow, deep breaths.
103022:
The corpse of *an Elf* is lying here.
The corpse of *a Dwarf* is lying here.
A pile of coins is here.
A spear, nearly two yards long, is lying on the ground.
The corpse of *a Dwarf* is lying here.
A pile of coins is here.
A mace is on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A rapier is on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A dagger lies on the ground.
A pile of coins is here.
A warhammer is on the ground.
The Witch-King of Angmar stands here, shrouded in a veil of shadows (glowing).
Eornhan, wielding an engraved broadsword, is here, fighting an Angmarian patrol-guard.
An Angmarian patrol-guard, wielding a mace, is here, fighting Eornhan.
An Angmarian patrol-guard, wielding a handaxe, is lying here, mortally wounded.
An Angmarian wraith-guard is on patrol here, ever vigilant.
The shadow of *a Dwarf* is floating here.

Shrouded in shadows, the room is dominated by a large black throne, looming high above the floor on a polished black stone dais. Before the dais is a large open area without any kind of ornaments or structures, just cold, dark and unyielding stone.
103023: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

This is a small yet simple abode, with a white marble altar placed at the northern corner of the room. A grey, indistinct carpet covers the stone floor, marking the walkway from the entrance of this chamber to the altar itself. A few lanterns have been set in small niches alongside the walls, providing a permanent light source, yet otherwise the walls are grey and bare.
103024: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

A great white altar catches the eye of those entering the hall, yet it is littered with several burnt-out candles. A grey carpet covers most of the wooden floor, with a few chairs placed in the south-eastern corner, surrounding a small table. A few lanterns have been placed inside several small niches in the walls, providing ample light.
103025: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

An elegant pavilion has been build on the top of a majestic tree amongst its numerous leafy branches with the shape of the floor moulding along with the shape of the tree. The ceiling is made with multi-coloured glass depicting the city of Rivendell. A brightly coloured deck can be seen protruding to the east with its rails blooming with flowering vines.
103026: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

Light coloured planks of pinewood form a small home, although it is crowded with many bookshelves and closets. One closet is wide open, showing a wide array of dress robes of every colour imaginable. The bookshelves are crammed with various books as well, with every here and there an open spot, as those books have been laid open upon a small table in the centre of the room. In the northeastern corner, a small bed has been erected, a cushion of soft leaves upon it.
103027: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

A rather messy room smelling faintly of lavender opens up from gates made of an unnaturally strong ivy. An air of power pulsates from a vanity along the eastern wall. In front of it sits a white marble bench, which seems to be the only clean item in this entire room. The owner of this house is obviously very fond of herself, judging by the fourteen portraits covering the remaining wall space. A small bed sits in the corner, covered in clothes and shoes.
103028: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

You find yourself in a secluded part of the clearing. Silglin, the Alchemist from Lothlorien, was granted this area by Elrond to complete his studies and experiments. Various items - most of them magical - are stored in chests, pegs, racks, cabinets and two big desks, which are magically shielded from being opened by anyone but Silglin himself.
103030: A hobbit is here walking around.

Wild flowers accompany a small dirt path that leads east to the Market Square of Tuckborough and north towards several smials. Verdant grass grows all around, in some places beginning to invade the path, although it is generally well maintained. A few young trees have been planted alongside the path, their branches neatly trimmed.
103031:
A circular stone well has been built here.
A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.
A stocky mountain mule is here, waiting to serve.

A small stone wall surrounds this small piece of earth which someone skilled in gardening turned into a small but beautiful garden. On both sides of a small gravelled path are beds of beautiful flowers and tasty vegetables. The path leads to green door which is round as hobbit home doors have to be. On the right side of the door is a small well full of clear water.
103032: A Hobbit valet stands here faithfully, keeping the home in order.

This smial is a typical hobbit home with tunnel-like corridors and small, comfortable rooms. It is a comfortable home of a successful hobbit, filled with every luxury available. The hobbit living here seems not to be the typical hobbit as the walls are decorated with strange things from strange countries far away, like saddles from Rohan, bear furs from Anduin and even a mummified troll's head from the Troll Warrens. The smial has every feature a hobbit needs, including a very large kitchen full of stores. It seems the owner of this smial loves cooking and eating.
103074: Scattered about this poorly lit room are various articles of clothing, small knives and broken up pieces of old food. It appears that the owner of this cozy hole is either always in a great hurry or just lazy. An open window in the corner looks as if its been opened recently, judging by the footprints on the dusty windowsill. A makeshift alarm of pots and pans has been strung across the entryway of the bedroom to the north to alert the owner of the home of any would-be intruders.
103075: A Hobbit maid stands here straightening up the room.

Dark coloured carpeting serves the purpose of hiding the numerous stains which have resulted from many a party here in this master chamber. An unmade bed sits in the corner, tilted higher on one side than the other. Several small notches have been made into the side of the oaken headboard. A large closet takes up a lot of the space on the south side of the room, spilling its contents all over the floor.
103076: Away from the clutter of the rooms above, this metal lined shelter is spotless and immaculate. Weapons line the walls, shining in their exuberance while kept away from the climate so as not to rust. Newly bound books of medicine and herblore fill a modest sized bookshelf along the wall. The top of the shelf has been modified to hold an assortment of herbal ingredients and concoctions. There are no doors or windows here beneath the hole, only a solid metal ladder which leads up and out.
103077: A pretty hobbit maiden is walking around here.

The path traverses in an almost straight line through the peaceful landscape, widening a little to the east, where the village of Stock can be glimpsed. North of here a large field opens up, and to the west the path goes on.
103078: A pretty hobbit maiden is walking around here.

Passing through the open fields, the path and the surrounding environment harmoniously converge. A few small boulders line the trail, seemingly organized by a caring hand. To the north the fields open up even more, looking profoundly tranquil.
103079: A hobbit is here walking around.
Leading through a vast field, the path goes in east-west direction. Here and there the trail zig-zags a little, going around larger boulders or the occasional grove of trees.
103080: A small hill presents itself to the north so small that it looks like a parody of some of the mightier hills further to the north. What forces of nature made one hill small and another so grand is hard to guess. Surely each hill's role was decided before the dawn of men and will remain long after the time of the mortals living today has passed.
103097: There is a lot of water on the ground.

The little hairs on the back of your neck curl as your look to the east and see that the thicket becomes dark and foreboding. A nagging feeling of being watched doesn't help you to feel any safer, yet curiousity provokes you to travel on further.
103098: There is a lot of water on the ground.

The darkness and eerie quietness of this area suddenly both calms your fears and tightens the grip on your weapon. You no longer hear the carefree chirping of birds, and you sense a lurking danger nearby.
103124: The tunnel runs south through this large field of brambles, which is miles in width. The brambles grow over three feet high in most places. This tunnel is made up of a natural ravine several feet below the surrounding ground with the brambles directly above the tunnel growing in a foot thick arch over it. The thin layer of brambles is not enough to prevent weather and light from reaching through. At the north end of the tunnel stretches a bramble wall in which is a slightly discoloured, circular patch.
103125: This room is partly above ground and partly dug out of the earth. From the hard packed earth floor to the bramble roof is about ten feet with several of them above the fields ground level. The bramble roof and upper walls have been plugged by leaves and dirt to prevent light coming in or out of this hidden room, except though special spy holes with views of the surrounding lands.
103153:
A thumb-long bee buzzes loudly as it flutters among the flowers.
A well-groomed horse examines you with intelligent-looking eyes.

This extensive porch, propped on wooden posts made of single tree-trunks, faces south. Big, wooden, comfortable-looking benches allow you to sit and enjoy the sight of the gardens, especially under the warmth of the westering sun, when the last golden rays fall slanting on the flowers. A few broad steps descend into the garden, where a small path seems to detour the house on its western flank, and then it heads northwards.
103154:
A dirty bandit waits here looking for an easy mark.
Klaees (thedon), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.
Drazud (freshmeat), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.

Dark pines and firs climb up the steep slope to the wall of the ancient half-ruined temple on the hill to the east. A tower of the temple looms almost precisely above you, and the dark openings of its windows stare into the forest as if keeping watch. The old stone wall, which is facing you, looks as if it could collapse under its own weight at any moment, but in the wall there is an iron door, which has a much fresher look, as if it was recently replaced.
103155: What had once been a storage room of the temple is now used as a guardroom by a band of orcs. A few torches flare in the brackets on the walls, and in the dim torchlight you can see the mess of garbage, bones, and rags lying on the floor. There used to be a door in the eastern wall, but it was broken off the hinges, and beyond the doorway there is only darkness. An iron door in the western wall seems to have survived the destruction - maybe because the orcs still have some use for it?
103161: The chamber is greater in width than in height and is covered with a low ornamented dome. There is a circle in the middle of the dome, and many lines lead from it to the border of the dome like rays from the sun. Two intertwining stone ribbons or parchments run around the border of the dome; the ends of the ribbons come down winding on both sides of the arch that opens in the eastern wall. There once was an iron door in the western wall, but it had been broken off the hinges.
103162: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

The sweet aroma of jasmine after the rain fills this round pavilion with a serene atmosphere. Huge, masterfully cut granite slabs alternate between pale-white and slate-black as they cover the perfectly circle floor. In the centre sits a majestic fountain of an indescribably beautiful priestess pouring blessings of peace and love from her hands.
103174:
An elven guard is standing here at his post.
An elven guard is standing here at his post.

This is a beautiful short hallway that allows access to the suites where Elrond and Arwen live. A faint sweet aroma tinges the air from the fragrant woods that panel the walls. On the east wall is a large window that is often left open, weather permitting. Ornately carved oak doors lie to the north and south.
103175: A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.

You stand in a beautifully decorated room, with arched windows on every wall and many comfortable chairs. A rainbow of colourful flowers grow from ornate planters, filling the air with a fresh, pleasant scent. Glancing around, you do not notice any valuable jewellery or money.
103176: A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.

The room is tastefully decorated with long curtains and art objects of elvish make, which are much too heavy to carry out of the room. You see much fine furniture including a huge desk with many drawers. A lovely fireplace, generously piled with firewood, is built into the south wall.
103260:
The Housekeeper looks fed up with her job. She scowls at you unhappily.
A sturdy pack horse is standing here.

A musty odour fills the grey quarters, which are nothing more but a small room with few furniture. A small bed, covered with prickly straw, has been placed in the centre, some of the straw littering the grey stone floor, forming a partial carpet leading towards the door. The door has a window on each side, not offering a view yet allowing the light of day to enter. The walls are as bare and cold as the floor, yet save for the musty odour, the place is relatively clean and well-maintained. A few niches are set in the walls, each set with a lantern.
103261: A crooked man, dressed in dark ragged clothes, is standing behind a long desk.

Dark shelves made from hard, polished beech line the walls of this musty and very much cluttered room. A rough, wooden desk divides the room into two partitions, one for the customers and one for the shopkeeper. A single, spluttering oil lamp hangs down from the ceiling, providing some scant lighting to this windowless room. In the corners, huge rolls of tarred rope serve as chairs for idle customers to sit on, and crates full of dubious-looking merchandise have been haphazardy placed all over the creaky, unswept floor.
103262: The corpse of a proud man is lying here.

The air here is warm and dry, leaving those who breathe it with a parched throat. A heavy stench of decomposing flesh originates from the remains of half-eaten small animals and torn-off limbs hanging from chains that are nailed to the walls. The ground and the cavern walls are unusually jagged, and there seems to be no spot for a comfortable rest.
103304:
A blonde girl is here, fixing the shaft of an old, broken shovel.
A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.
A little girl runs around underfoot.

This room is rather large but completely cramped with crates, sacks and loose supplies, ranging from materials for the smith's work to items for everyday use. Everything is ordered nicely and every crate or item seems to have its place. Near the southern window lie a lot of tools and items that obviously are used to fix worn out cloths, leathers, and other tools next to a cushion.
103306: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

Built in a blue-gray stone, the walls to the north are filled with windows looking out at the mountains. There is a tiny balcony to the north, with a chair and table on it. Along the south edge of the room, a set of rice paper screens partially obscure a bed covered in purple velvet. Easels stand around the room displaying paintings, one of which is clearly unfinished. To the left of the entrance is a small alcove with its own door and window, where horses can be stabled temporarily. A writing desk adorns the south wall, with several pieces of half-finished poetry and letters upon it.
103307:
An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.
A sturdy pack horse is standing here.
A sturdy pack horse is standing here.
Tanmh the Sinda (TT), wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.

This secluded study is decorated with deep oaken accents; shelves, desks and chairs are arranged to provide all guests all manner of comfort. A multitude of scrolls, journals, books and various other forms of writing instruments are neatly organised throughout the library. One can feel the arcane energy that resides in this arcane accomodation.
103341:
A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.
The garden snake slithers harmlessly here.
You are walking through a range of low, sloping hills. Sparse trees cover the land. Wild flowers are in bloom. To the south and east, the forest gets much thicker.
103342: The corpse of a small bat is lying here.

This is a very short tunnel, only about fifty feet long from end to end. A few torches line the way, throwing flickering light upon the walls which are overed in scrawls and pictures. To the south, the passage ends in darkness, and an old rickety door terminates it to the west.
103343: The musty smell of a room long sealed from the outside greets anyone entering this tunnel. Fine white stonework lines either wall of the tunnel, and the stairs that lead down from above appear to have been hewn with care from white stone. Southwards the tunnel vanishes in the darkness.
103344: A giant rat patters against you, squeaking maliciously.

Ancient Dwarven runes cover the walls of this large chamber. Five stone coffins, also covered in Dwarven inscriptions, stand in line across the room. This tomb must be the resting place of some very noble Dwarves. The coffins seem to have been sealed by some forgotten Dwarven method, there appears to be no way into them. The dark tunnel in the northern wall of the chamber seems to be the only way out.
103345:
A stone sarcophagus lies on the floor.
A tall stag is here, grazing peacefully.

Golden lettering and pictures that sparkle in the light cover the walls of this small tomb. This must be the resting place of someone very important. On closer inspection, the lettering is not quite a true golden colour, but the initial effect was stunning. The now familiar Dwarven runes, written in gold, cover most of the stonework in the room.
103346: From the cliff it is possible to get a superb view over the plain that lies north-east of the Tower Hills. The grassy plain stretches north until it reaches the road to the Grey Havens. The cliff itself goes suddenly steep down several hundred feet with no way to climb down.
103363: A tall and strong hunter is standing here.

You find yourself in the middle of a big clearing. There is an old fireplace here which shows signs of a recent fire that was burning in it. You can see far away in all directions here. To the west you can see large boulders and small hilltops. It must be a pain to walk there. To the east and south you can see a more low hilltops and even spot a few clumps of trees around. To your immediate north, there is an old house or inn perhaps.
103364: You stop suddenly as you look around you and wonder in amazement at how you got so far into such an unpleasant area. Your body has grown weary of the branches and small bushes in your way. This might be a good place to rest before going further.
103384: The calm river proceeds for a while along a small cliff to the west. Further downstream the river turns to the west and out of sight behind the cliff. Under the cliff runs a narrow and barren riverbank; on that narrow stretch of land landing might be possible, but making a safe climb over the cliff could very well prove impossible. Whereas the western bank is dreary and rocky there is more comfort on the other side of the river. Bracken grows vigorously in the moist soil, and behind them open fields stretch far into the horizon.
103385:
A grey snake slides along the water.
A water moccasin slithers out of sight just below the surface of the water.

Old tiles that once supported the wall of this earthen tunnel have all but a few loosened their grips and dratted into the water that now fills the tunnel. There is little room to manoeuvre between the roots that penetrate the ceiling and the water surface. The water is dark and cold, and besides a slight stir among the vegetation that grows dense to the east, the water is stagnant. The tunnel appears to be moving upwards to the west and slowly more room becomes available.
103386:
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.
A pack horse (mine) is standing here.

The tunnel runs east-west. While the water is steadily getting deeper to the east, dry ground would most likely be found to the west where the condition of the tunnel improves. Here the tiles in the walls are missing in some places and the woodwork that supports the ceiling looks ready to collapse, rotten as it is. Many different fungi have found the moist conditions suitable, and in places the walls are covered from top to bottom by spores.
103387: A bright red mushroom is growing here.

Old walls of big stones laid as bricks form this dark tunnel. A ceiling of wooden beams and planks appears reasonably intact apart from a few scratches and imperfections near the northern wall. The air inside the tunnel is damp and unpleasant to the throat, mainly due to spores originating from fungi that grow frequently on the lower sections of the walls. Puddles of water on the floor lie deceptively awaiting the next uncareful foot to wet.
103388:
A small oaken table has been set here.
A large cockroach is crawling over the floor.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.

A fusty and moist smell fills the old cellar. The once fine stone walls have felt the mark of time, and many cracks are visible as a result of damage by frost. Thick oaken beams support a ceiling of half-rotten planks which have collapsed in some places, resulting in fallen dirt. The previously spotless paved stone floor is now a soggy mix of mud, dirt and puddles of water. The remains of a system of wooden shelves, that once hosted a large collection of wine, hang despondently from the iron nails that once fixed them to the walls. A crumbling staircase, laid with bricks, stand against the northern wall.
103414: On a cliff overlooking the river Glanduin to the east lie the ruins of the once busy village of Cillien. Bricks and stones from the decaying masonry litter the grass-covered ground between ruined stonewalls. Through time the stonework has experienced such exposure to the elements, that it's no longer possible to determine which walls were once part of the same structure. The remaining stonework is partially covered in lichen and long vines that grow over the cliffside down towards the river.
103415: Bend in the Old East Road

The Road runs alongside a hawthorn hedge, curving in unison with it from north to west. The hedge is dense and bristling with small sharp thorns, but would appear to have grown naturally as opposed to have been cultivated.
103416: A hardened ranger is walking around, looking for tracks.

You are on the only path to Dwaling, which makes a turn to the north and west here around the hills. The path is not too wide, but old criss-cross tracks of wheels and hooves suggest it is well-used. A little further north, you can see that the path makes another turn to the east, but the high hill on this side prevents you from seeing beyond that.
103417: This is a nature-like hallway decorated with purple and yellow flowers. At the end of the hallway there is a small opening leading into a square, which seems to reflect all the colours of the rainbow. You also notice a big sign nailed to the northern door made of oak.
103418: A well-crafted white fountain is here, water pouring forth from it.

You are in a garden made of crystal. If you look long enough at the crystals you can see all the colours play softly; for some, this gives the sensation of peace and righteousness. There is also a cosy bed made of leaves for meditation and rest among the crystals.
103419:
A huge clock is standing here.
A humble man stands here, ready to help you with your things.

The walls of this chamber look old and grey. There is a huge bed placed against the western wall and a fresh scent of baked bread fills the air. You also notice a table and a chair placed on the other side of the chamber.
103420: As you pass through the mist a large cavern is revealed. The walls are smooth and flat from being worn away by the elements for countless years. As you walk further into the room it grows dark, the sounds of the roaring waterfall seem to be left behind you. Further ahead you see lights illuminating a staircase descending into the depths.
103421: The staircase is lit with torches burning along the walls which provide enough light to proceed. As you continue further down the steps you notice that the staircase was carved into the rock. The steps twist and turn further down into the earth. You see a faint glow around the bend.
103422: A humble man stands here, ready to help you with your things.

As you finally reach the end of the staircase you walk into a decorated chamber fit for a king. A large bed rests along the far wall accompanied by a small table where a candle burns. Around the chamber you see large chests filled with jewels and gold casting a faint glow upon the walls.
103423:
A doorwarden stands here ready to obey his master's wishes.
A tall and strong guard is here.
A tall and strong guard is here.

Right after passing the waterfall, begins a flowing water path surrounded by trees of the most various types. The air is thick and short rays of light can barely be seen penetrating through the dense foliage of the highest trees. Following the path, some soft and light music seems to float along through the vegetation, carried by the smooth wind that blows from the south end of the path towards the north. To the south, the line of plants growing in the border of the path leads inside a home; without a doubt, the home of a wood elf.
103424:
A heavy desk, made of solid oak, stands here.
A large bookshelf sits against the wall.
Ralangil the Elf is standing here.

Perfectly carved branches of wood make the walls of this hall. Comfortable furniture, made of the finest oak wood, like only elves could build, seems very inviting for a rest around a large fireplace. If it wasn't for the sound of the rushing water of the Bruinen, one could imagine being inside a camp house of a wood elf in the middle of the wilderness. Everything is kept perfectly organised, most of the things looking untouched. The master of this house is surely a good traveller, who comes here between one adventure or another to rest, and maybe meet his friends for everlasting nights of stories. Twisted wooden stairs lead upward into a calm room.
103425:
A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.
A humble man stands here, ready to help you with your things.

Eolo's house is incredibly comfortable, the way it has to be for someone who comes home exclusively to rest. His bed, large and smooth, stays in the corner of the room, which has the floor covered with a large green carpet of leaves. A large tree is carved out and full of warm water, ready for someone to take a long and relaxing bath. A strong wind flows through the large window, when it is left open for fresh air. Keeping the window closed, the tree house remains quiet enough for the sound of a beetle climbing up the walls to be heard.
103448: A dirty ruffian draped in rags advances towards you.

There are a few tapestries hanging from the walls in this room, their worn pictures indistinct as they have faded so much. Many more tapestries lie on the ground below them seeming to act as an entrance mat. Two large suits of armour stand near the entrance of a room towards the west, their metal dull and rusted. A cloakroom lies to the south, while halls lead off east and west.
103449:
A rather large, a bit rusty sign can be seen on the wall.
A neat straw pallet is lying here.
An old, deaf shopkeeper attends to his shop.

There is little space in this room but the wooden walls and solid roof shelter this place from the elements. The southern section is blocked off by a thick log, which forms some sort counter. The entire room before, behind, and on that counter is cluttered with goods. Baskets stand on crates along the walls, while sacks are stapled or hanged wherever they fit. The western wall is covered with massive boards which again bear countless items of day-to-day use.
103479: The grasslands stretch far to the north and south. In the west, you can see a cliff made out of sandstone which rises a little above the ground. Far in the west, you can see the tower hills. Towards the east, you can see a quite large area where the grass grows much taller than here. Beyond the grass, in the east, you can barely see a dense grove of trees which stretch for long near the horizon.
103480: A beautiful and docile horse is standing here.

In the midst of the grass plains, a solid sandstone rock is rising up in the sky. The western parts of the sandstone hillock are corroded and rocks have fallen down which makes it impossible to climb up the hillock. The top of the hillock also looks broken up and rocks are lying around. Small strips of brown bear fur hang from a sharp edge of a rock.
103481: You are walking through an endless grassland which stretches into all directions. You have the feeling of being hopelessly lost. Head high bushes and trees block your view and you just can't figure out where you are. Besides being lost, you begin to like the grassland. The rich vegetation and the many animals make the grassland a superb hunting ground. But maybe some others have discovered this too ...
103485: The grasslands stretch far to the north and south. In the west, you can see a cliff made out of sandstone which rises a little above the ground. Far in the west, you can see the tower hills. Towards the east, you can see a quite large area where the grass grows much taller than here. Beyond the grass, in the east, you can barely see a dense grove of trees which stretch for long near the horizon.
103501:
A brown bear is sleeping here.
A brown bear is sleeping here.

The entrance of this small niche is partly covered with rocks. The niche is well sheltered from the weather. Bones and furs of smaller animals like rabbits are lying around and in the back of the niche a set of antlers which once belonged to a young, male elk are resting.
103727: A large bulletin board, entitled "Istari Chronicles", is mounted here.
Modelled after the council chamber, this room contains a long table with many comfortable chairs surrounding it. Here the Istari meet informally to discuss matters that concern them.
103759:
A small oaken table has been set here.
A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.
A well-crafted white fountain is here, water pouring forth from it.
An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.
A tall and strong guard is here.
A tall and strong guard is here.

This bedchamber is richly decorated. The stone walls have several paintings hanging on them, each depicting the same person. The ground is entirely covered with a thick, purple carpet. Lavishly decorated chairs are lined up around a table, a dark red sheet covering it. A wooden bed has been set up in the eastern corner of the bedchamber, filled with dried leaves.
103760: An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.

Grey walls outline the hall, partially covered with bookshelves littered with books on the western wall and small paintings of various landscapes on the opposite side. A few niches have been embedded in the wall with lanterns in them, lighting the room. A small table stands in a corner, with various instruments upon it.
103761:
An Elven steward stands here, watching over the household.
A sturdy trained horse is standing here.

Several torches hang all along the walls, lighting a room full of ancient books, scrolls, maps and unrecognisable, strangely interesting items. The many bookshelves are filled to the brim, with an occasional book lying on the grey carpet below. One table stands in the middle, entirely covered with a myriad of different books and papers, on which illegible scribbles have been written down, surrounded by many ink smudges.
103763:
A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.
A humble man stands here, ready to help you with your things.

This room seems like every woman's dream. The bed is huge and very comfortable. To the left there is a window with a beautiful view of the valley. Directly opposite the entrance is a mirror. There is the distinct feeling that the mirror shows only what the mistress wishes to see.
103764: Although this small hillock rises only a few yards above the plains, and its hillsides are long and gentle, it still stands lonely out of the great, green, and drearily flat meadow. Its southern face appears to be slightly steeper, and, surprisingly, the stones are numerous and the soil is rocky and hard, but the grass still grows everywhere, and sometimes it even seems to sprout out of the very rocks.
103765:
A large torch lies here among the dust.
The remains of a giant green fungus lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.

Large trees here take on gruesome shapes as they entwine together with their boughs and branches. Strings of grey moss entangle the branches, which only adds to their strange appearance. To the east the dark forest continues, while in the west, south, and north the forest becomes even darker.
103766:
The remains of a dark oak lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
A tremendous black oak looms here.

The forest grows in an orderly fashion here. The dark trees here look as if someone planted them long ago. However, there is also a lack of decay on these trees. There are no signs of rot here, and no trees are fallen over. The forest floor is devoid of typical life such as mushrooms. The canopy overhead is a mass of huge branches intertwining together to choke out the sky. No sound can be heard in this area, but a pale light can be seen dancing near to the north.
103768:
A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.
Black roots shift uneasily all around you.
A tremendous black oak looms here.

Huge black trees grow here almost in a certain chaotic arrangement. Twisted boughs intertwine with one another to block out the sun and sky. The weather is oppressive here, as no breeze can reach this part of the forest. Silence hangs here, as no forest creature settle in these branches. A pale unnatural light can be seen to the east.
103769:
The corpse of Eblees is lying here.
A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.
The shadow of Eblees is floating here.

A pale eldritch light shines in this area, its source unknown. The trees which surround this area form a circle here. The huge boughs form a canopy so tight nothing of the sky can be seen. The silence which has been so prevalent in the nearby areas is broken here by soft murmuring from under the forest floor. Some large stones mark this area. There are also some large footprints, which means some immense creature lives here.
103778: A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.

This room seems composed of roots and dirt specifically shaped and molded to fit whomever designed it. The roots have even been shaped to a throne of sorts. The ceiling is composed of roots that have formed the beams of this room. If its creators had intended to mock the dignity of a temple, they have succeeded.
103779:
A broadsword made of a dark metal lies here.
A round shield, encrusted with jewels, lies here.
A harness, made from leather, lies here.
A pair of black padded boots lie on the ground here.
A chain mail coif lies here.
A short, broad stabbing blade lies here.
A fine metal breastplate is on the ground.
A two-handed sword is on the ground.
A shiny gold ring has been abandoned here.
A large piece of plain cloth is on the ground.
A soft pouch, made from leather, has been left here.
A plain pair of pants are on the ground.
A plain leather belt is lying here.
There is a water skin lying on the ground.
A pair of smooth boots lie on the ground.
A plain hood lies on the ground.
A sturdy pair of soft leather boots are on the ground.
A sturdy pair of rigid leather boots are on the ground.
A large sack is on the ground.
A sturdy leather backpack has been left here.
A weapon sheath has been dropped on the ground here.
A leather baldric lies on the ground.
A short spear is lying on the ground.
A chain mail hauberk is on the ground.
A metal helmet is on the ground.
A huge, crudely-made spear has been left here.
A lovely silver ring has been left here.

This is the room in which Eblees presumably sleeps. The roots and tendrils have shaped the room according to the forest priest's wishes. A bed of tendrils and humus lays at one side of the room while a table of roots with strangely shaped chairs sits at another. A stone chest has been set against the foot of the bed.
103780:
The remains of a black fungus lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
The remains of a black fungus lie here in a heap of rotting compost.

The forest here looks ordered, in its darkness. There is only the faintest smell of rot here, and there is a lack of bones and other such forest litter which seems common in the other parts of this forest. The canopy seems to be comprised of only large branches that hang far up overhead.
103781: Thick strange looking trees of all shapes twist upwards to the darkness of the canopy overhead. One large tree grows here that stands straight and tall in sharp contrast to the chaotic forest that surrounds it. This one tree is also remarkable because it has a much wider base than the other trees here. Gloomy darkness is all that can be seen here.
103782: The air here is stifling as so many thick branches close in around this tree. Many branches twist and tangle making a tunnel going up and down. Looking down there is darkness of the forest, a musty fetid odour of the forest floor reeks in this direction. In the treetop above, some skylight can be seen.
103783: The Top of a Large Tree

The forest canopy of Mirkwood opens up into the sky here. It is a sharp contrast of sky and open air, compared to the darkness and shadowed canopy below. Birds, butterflies and clouds can be seen floating in the sky overhead. A breeze catches the other treetops and creates waves with the leaves as if this were only a meadow.
103784:
The corpse of a shadowed man is lying here.
A black shadow is here, cloaked in malice and dread (glowing).
A shadowed man, wielding a scimitar, is here, fighting Jeru.
Rawr the Dwarf, wielding an engraved warhammer, is here, fighting a shadowed man.
Hildifons the Hobbit (HH), wielding a black runed dagger, is standing here.
Jeru the Dwarf, wielding an ornate, steel-shafted warhammer, is here, fighting a shadowed man.
Alcion the Elf, wielding a Dunadan blade, is standing here trying to concentrate.
Gelmir the Elf, wielding a black runed dagger, is here, fighting a shadowed man.
Fantasy the Half-Elf, wielding an engraved broadsword, is here, fighting a shadowed man.

Quickly dug, this hole is much deeper than one can expect from above. The walls below the edge have been carved in, to make the base wider than the entrance. Piles of dirt and rocks have caved in and lie scattered across the uneven floor. Twigs and branches have tumbled down from above, as someone or something crashed through the foliage that once covered this hole and created a blocking layer of dense debris that almost block out all light.
103785:
Black roots shift uneasily all around you.
A tremendous black oak looms here.
A large warhorse is standing here, clad in mail.

Darkness prevails here, from the dark leaves on the trees to the blackness of their bark. Even the lighter coloured vegetation looks dark and dreary because it is covered in shadows. The vegetation is still thin enough here to allow a small group to pass. To the east it becomes much more dense and may be impossible to traverse.
103965: The crack to the north is quite a squeeze and it leads out into the river Sirannon. The water here is quiet and still, it leads up to a rocky beach. The beach is generally narrow, but in the west end it leads to a deep cavern.
103966:
A strange bat-like creature is flitting around.
A strange bat-like creature is flitting around.
A strange bat-like creature is flitting around.
A strange bat-like creature is flitting around.
A strange bat-like creature is flitting around.
A strange bat-like creature is flitting around.
A strange bat-like creature is flitting around.
The cave ventures deep into the mountainside. Your light cannot fill the whole cavern and there are always dark patches that may hide some danger.
103967: These softly rolling hills provide a good view of the surrounding landscape. To the west, jagged hills dominate the view. Fertile hills, crowned with trees, can be seen to the south. The woods grow more dense to the east, where the trees entirely cover the multitude of hillocks.
103968: A lazy upward slant continues to the south and east with the tip of the hill some five or six miles away. An apple tree marks the landscape to the west and a burned out hut is north of here. The land appears to be tranquil and signs of elks are clearly visible.
103969:
The corpse of the kraken is lying here.
The corpse of *a Dwarf* is lying here.
The remains of a tentacle lie here.
The remains of a tentacle lie here.
The remains of a tentacle lie here.
The remains of a tentacle lie here.
The remains of a tentacle lie here.
The remains of a tentacle lie here.

As you slide below the surface of the murky pool, your vision decreases to the point of barely detecting your hand in front of your face. Light filters in from the surface however, just enough to see a piece of ripped flesh go floating in front of your eyes. Mixtures of animal excrement and decaying organic matter is what gives the pool its murkiness. The water is cool, having just passed through underground rivers, and there is an air of evil here. Long dim shapes sway ominously a few feet away.
103988: The last tremulous gleam reflected by the surface of the lake momentarily dances on the walls of the opening before the darkness swallows everything. The filth that has for long poured inside the mountain has shaped this drifting tunnel. Filled with a calmness, it slithers wide into the mountain. The sharp foundation, which is surrounded by a cold, murky water, emerges each time the tunnel narrows. The silence is unbroken with the exception of softly vibrating debris that briefly stir the viscous excrement at the bottom.
103989:
A copper penny lies on the ground.
A copper penny lies on the ground.
A copper penny lies on the ground.
A copper penny lies on the ground.
A copper penny lies on the ground.
A copper penny lies on the ground.

The dark subterranean passage contains a liquid as cold and viscous as if it has poured through the mountain since the day it was carved out from the filthy earth. The distinctive currents breaking through the cracked foundation agitate an unnumbered amount of particles that struggle to fit between the sharp and sedimented walls of the cavity. Embedded in a bleary breadth of view, the sludge is accompanied by the constant sound of splattering, making it extremely difficult to perceive the surroundings.
104031: This great hall, unlike others, is not a monument to heros, nor a testimony to the greatness of kings long buried. It is a hall for all Dwarves, a great cavern dedicated to the honor of every Dwarf, great or meek, living or dead. The avenue is lined with trees of stone, trees from whose boughs hang flowers or fruit carved from fine opals, sapphires, diamonds, and other jewels. The walls are not covered in reliefs, nor molded by carvings. In fact, they seem utterly bare until you look closer. Slowly your eyes focus on the marks impressed upon the stone: names. The name of every Dwarf living and dead is here, to be honored by all, and remembered.
104066: A humble man stands here, ready to help you with your things.

The inside of the door to this home is painted a colorful grassy green with a knob in the centre. The floor is made of rich old wood and a large window cut out of the far wall overlooks a well-tended garden. Teacups and biscuits lie strewn on the modest table along with what looks to be the resident's daily mail delivery. Oftentimes one can hear the kettle steeping more tea or the chirp of the birds outside the large window.
104067: A large bookshelf sits against the wall.

This is the Zarboff family living room. There is a table in the centre of the room, and couches lining each wall. It is a rather large room, and could hold about twenty hobbits, and on some occasions, it does! The room smells of mauve and pipeweed smoke.
104068:
A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.
A Hobbit valet stands here faithfully, keeping the home in order.
There are all sorts of things lying in unorganized heaps on the ground of this cozy bedroom. An unmade bed sits in one corner of the room, its blankets scattered all over.
104070: A fierce-looking eel lurks in the darkness.
