To the east an impenetrable wall of vegetation completely blocks any possibility of travel. To the north the marshland appears to continue.
107259:
A dense patch of dark ferns grows in the shade.
A strong wisent snorts and shakes his horns in the underbrush.

The trees in this area have thinned out dramatically. What trees there are have a dull, grey appearance which could be due to the lack of those mosses and fungi which cover the trees to the north-east. Many have dying branches, completely devoid of leaves. Towards the south the same theme of decay appears to go on for miles. The forest has become filled with other plant life, ranging from ferns and grasses to, in some spots, swathes of flowers and patches of berry bushes. To the north and east the forest begins to come alive again, the trees showing leaves and having a characteristic black bark.
107260: The increase in elevation is rapid as the ground slopes heavily down to the east. The forest floor is littered by roots and vines of various sizes. The tall, ancient trees reach high into the sky and are so numerous that sunlight is nearly completely blocked out. The almost total absence of light prevents small vegetation from growing here. To the west, the forest appears to open up, while to the north it becomes far more dense.
107261: Here, it seems as though the very earth and sky have succumbed to Mirkwood. Looking up yields not a glimpse of anything beyond the branches which form an entangled mass forty feet above the ground. On the forest floor, the ferns and grasses twist and contort together, competing for every scare ray of sunlight.
107262: One look at the razed remanants of the decorated flets tells you that wood elves once resided here. In the middle of the encampment the trees were cleared, allowing the sun's warm beams to shine down unimpeded. There, a garden was planted; its flowers are now long dead and the soil is ridden with weeds. To the west a massive oak door is set into the trunk of an ancient oak tree. No doubt, the presence of Sauron has forced the inhabitants of this old elven place to flee.
107263: The base of this ancient oak has been hollowed to form an escape shelter if the need for one ever arises. The base of the tree has a circumference of twenty feet. Inside this massive room there is little light, since the trunk is void of any openings except for the oak door which serves as the entrance to this wooden room. Along the north-western side of the room an intricate and elegant spiral staircase travels up the sides of the trunk.
107264: This wooden room is located approximately fifteen feet above the ground deep inside of an old oak tree. The trunk of the tree has several holes around the circumference of the tree. At this altitude one can easily peer through these holes, making this room into a tree-top vantage point with views of the nearby surroundings. To the west, a large hole has been made in the trunk of the oak.
107265: This dark bower deep within the forest looks amazingly like a cave, a strange cave where the surfaces are of living wood, not stone; for the roof and walls of this gloomy cavern-like arbour are formed by the branches of the trees, all twisted densely together.
107266: A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.

Here the forest is composed primarily of tall ancient beech trees, though there are also some oaks. The bark of these trees is dark as night, and some have rub marks, betraying the presence of large animals. The trees are distorted and twisted, their branches weaving together to form a canopy which allows barely any sunlight through. To the east the forest appears to thin out and allow for easier and a quicker pace.
107267: The edge of this clearing is beginning to look more and more like the forested area which surrounds it. Trees are now becoming numerous and have begun to grow close together. While it is still easy to travel through, it has become more of a challenge. To the west the forest turns as dark as night. To the south the depths of Mirkwood are visible. Tall pines stand out above the tree line.
107268: This clearing is well hidden by the maze of twisted and contorted trees which lies to the north. The trees have separated enough to make crossing this area easy. To the south the vegetation becomes denser, with bushes growing thickly there.
107269: An iron-grey wolf stands here, grizzled from countless hunts.

This is a strange part of the forest. Rather than growing tall, reaching up to the sky, the trees, both large and small, have instead twisted around each other. It is often difficult to see where one tree begins and another ends. Travel here is very hard. There is no path at all and it would be very easy to loose one's bearings and stray ever deeper into this entangled, malicious- looking wood.
107270: Numerous black, twisted, malicious-looking trees grow here. Their thick trunks block the travelling in some directions, while in some others one may find paths to go past them. All around, branches with sharp-looking thorns reach out as if trying to harm anyone entering this forgotten grove. Above the entangled forest a large oak is easily visible, standing tall on a slight incline to the west.
107271: An iron-grey wolf stands here, grizzled from countless hunts.

Tall oak trees cover this hilly area. There is an incline to the north where a slope leads up to more dense forest. The incline has allowed light to break through the forest canopy and thus enabled a multitude of plant life to flourish on the forest floor. Ferns and grasses are prominent throughout these forest hills. To the west and south the forest grows darker and more dense, blocking the way.
107272:
A great wolf with coal-black eyes stares intently at you, drooling saliva.
An iron-grey wolf stands here, grizzled from countless hunts.
A great wolf with coal-black eyes stares intently at you, drooling saliva.

The forest here is so dense that only the smallest of animals can live in it. The forest floor sees very little light: most of the sun's rays are trapped by the elaborate network of branches high above. The lack of sunlight means that most normal woodland vegetation cannot grow here; only small fungi and the hardiest of light grasses grown on a soil which is rich and dark.
107273: An iron-grey wolf stands here, grizzled from countless hunts.

The vegetation is overwhelmingly dense in this area. To the north and east there is a large thicket which cannot be penetrated. The only option left for travel is to enter the dark twisted forest to the south or to attempt the arduous passage which the root-infested lands to the west present. A big thick log lies here, stripped of all bark and marked with a few hacks from a sword or an axe.
107274:
A great wolf with coal-black eyes stares intently at you, drooling saliva.
A hungry warg stands here, sniffing around for flesh.

Atop of the forest hill stands a massive, decaying fir tree. This tree once stood so high that only the eagles could gain the altitude needed to see its crown from above. Now all that stands of it is a rotted shell. To the north-east one can discern mountain ridges above the forest tree line. To the east the vegetation begins to get thicker, almost giving the impression of being impassable.
107275: Very few rays of light are able to escape the forest canopy to touch upon this dark and densely forested hill. Due to the lack of sunlight the ground is desolate and free of vegetation. The only signs of life on the forest floor are small animal tracks and the massive roots of the ancient trees which can be seen reaching high to form the forest canopy at the top of this very hill.
107276:
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous tarantula extends her legs to you.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.

The air is dark, heavy and thick under the malevolent trees, which seem to lean towards travellers, stretching out to reach them. The movement is difficult because of the giant roots and branches that are intertwined everywhere with each other. And where the nature has not blocked the way, sticky, silvery spider webs have been woven between the trunks.
107277: Massive, black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy.

The forest here is marked by a meshwork of twisting vines, interweaving the alive with the dead. The dense vegetation creates tall natural walls, purposefully encircling anyone trying to explore it. The trees loom over one another, stopping the sun and stars from casting their light into Mirkwood.
107278:
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A black squirrel peers down from the branches of the trees.

The darkness surrounds, even engulfs this area. The solid canopy of the forest hangs above with heavy branches growing downwards as other free directions do not exist. So thick is the ceiling made of wood and leaves that daylight probably never shines on this feral place. Some stones lie on the ground; their edges half concealed by moss and ferns creating treacherous places to stumble upon. A deathlike silence pervades the whole forest.
107280: Tall straight trees form these woods, close to the border of a rocky meadow to the south. Further into the forest, the darkness becomes deeper, and the denseness of the old oak trees and thorny shrubs prevents going north or east. The shadows beyond the trees are home to many strange creatures.
107281:
Klaees (thedon), wielding the great black scimitar, is standing here.
Drazud (freshmeat), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.
Ducaht (tooprettytodie), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.

The forest to the south is lighter and more spacious. The edge of the forest is close, and trees give way to a small meadow surrounding the ancient Old Forest Road. To the north the woods are getting darker and damp, with twisted trees and dense bushes blocking any movement. East and west of here, the forest is more friendly, and travel in those directions is easy.
107282: A large rock stands in the middle of this overgrown meadow. Moss-covered trees are clearly visible to the north: their branches have grown so thickly together that it appears travel in this direction would be hard. The ground is somewhat marshy, and springs a bit under your foot. To the east and west, the meadow continues a bit farther before being swallowed by the dark forest.
107306: A hollow tree is growing upright here.

This place is well inside Mirkwood, lacking any landmarks or signs of civilisation. At some places though, odd shapes printed into tree barks remind one that the forest is inhabited by ancient and powerful creatures. The trees grow denser to the west, making travel in that direction too difficult. To the north, the spaces get very narrow, but possible to traverse. The trees around seem to move and reach toward travellers, making it hard to tell which direction leads where.
107314:
A huge, poisonous tarantula extends her legs to you.
A brawny wisent is slowly striding through the vegetation.

The ground is mostly sandy here. The forest is made up of dead-looking trees with no leaves left. To the east however are some more lively-looking ones. Some spider webs hang from the trees, like the ghostly sails of some ethereal ship. A small, almost non-existing trail leads towards a huge boulder standing at the foot of a dark wall of trees.
107315: This part of the forest looks dead. The forest floor is covered by a great number of what look like white sticks. On a closer look, they seem to be bones. The ground is covered with them, though sometimes they are partly concealed by dead leaves and roots. There is at least one complete skeleton here, wrapped in spider-silk. To the west, a mass of vines forms an insurmountable wall.
107316: Occasionally one notices strange white stones, lying around between the roots of this dark, dead forest. Squares of bark are missing on many of the trees, as if they had been assaulted by some evil creatures. Innumerable spider webs hang down between the trees. The forest continues toward east and west, but the way south is blocked by an impregnable forest wall.
107319: Massive roots shift uneasily all around you.

This dense forest of pines is very dark. The ground is sandy and covered in pine needles. Lots of ferns grow in the humid sandy soil. Trails lead to the west, through Mirkwood. One of them snakes between the very thick forest to the Old Forest Road. To the west, the trees seem curiosly lifeless.
107337: Clusters of slender stems and tall leaves thrive in the mud and shallows.

The vegetation in the marshland here is a mix of muddy trees, forest plants and marsh ones. The marshy ground sinks readily under the least weight, threatening to give way and leave the unsuspecting traveller to the dark deep water which lies beneath the deceptive surface. And yet, the splendour of the different colours of the mosses and fungi make the scene one of beauty as well as deception.
107338: This is the lowest and wettest part of the surrounding forest. Most of the forest floor is soaked in a putrid liquid, oozing around the tree trunks. A thick mist blankets the whole ground, making it impossible to see any drier patches of ground, even if there were any. The trees around here are high and smooth, and shaped as though trying to stay as far away from the ground as possible, and the bushes are no more than a mass of grey, rotting twigs, smothered by the bog.
107339:
A black moth flutters around.
A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.

Here at the edge of the marsh the terrain becomes more firm and secure, making for easier going than that to the south. The pallet of colours has changed dramatically from that of the marshlands to the south. Flourescent mosses and fungi are now replaced by a twisted path of dark roots and vines coming from the east. Far to the east a slight hill is visible.
107340: Massive, black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy.

Roots and vines twist together into an conglomerate of thick and rising obstacles which make this area very hard to pass through. The mass rises in some areas up to ten feet tall, while in others it dives deep below the level of the forest floor. The rooted mass makes finding any visible path impossible. Looking beyond the roots to the east, a rising hill is evident as well as an ancient fir tree which rises high above its surroundings. The roots appear to continue to the south and to the southwest where they will leech the resources of the saturated marshland.
107341: Roots and vines surround this room. The floor is muddy, treacherous to walk upon, making leaving this room both dangerous and exhausting. Looking up all one can see is the twisted forms of the roots and vines which dive deep into this very room. These vines could perhaps be a convenient means to help an unsuspecting traveller escape this underground chamber.
107342:
A sprawling green bush of stinging nettle grows here.
Some roots lie here waiting to ensnare weary travellers.
Some roots lie here waiting to ensnare weary travellers.
A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.

Here lies a mass of roots, intertwined and distorted, which stretches from Mirkwood in the east to the marshy lands lying to the west. The roots can be seen diving deep into the forest floor and reappearing yards away. They make traversing this terrain an incredible challenge. To the south a massive forest wall blocks any possibility of travel in that direction.
107343: A small, sickly green mushroom grows here.

The humidity in the air has made mosses and fungi grow abundantly. Many of the tree trunks are covered to a considerable height in black and dark-green moss, and the bases of the trees are surrounded by patches of fungi and giant mushrooms. None of the mushrooms have been disturbed or eaten by animals, and they have strong distinct colours, seemingly indicating their poisonousness. The denseness of the woods prevents going west or east, and travel to the south is hampered by thick thorny bushes.
107344: A small cluster of clover grows here.

The ground slopes down to the east, nearing the edge of a marshy, depressed part of the forest. The soggy ground is springy and makes a slight slushing sound when walked upon. The proximity to the marshlands creates an extremely humid atmosphere, causing the tree trunks to be wet, and many are starting to rot. To the west, the ground slopes up and the forest becomes drier.
107346:
The remains of a tangled creeper lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
A small cluster of clover grows here.

The gloom deepens in this part of Mirkwood forest. Movement is severely hampered and no paths or other signs of civilisation are visible, except for small animal trails that appear to go nowhere. The only landmark is the rising slope towards higher ground to the east and south. Thick, entwined bushes form dark, thorny walls that block any travel to the south and west. On both sides of the animal trail the grass and ground has clear traces of old decaying animals, still covered in strong sticky web.
107347: A black spider crawls here, a shiny red spot visible on its belly.

The forest here is too dense to see very far in any direction. The surrounding oak trees are ancient and crooked. Their trunks and branches twist and turn around each other, forming small niches and impenetrable wooden walls that prevent any movement except to the west and south. This is an excellent place for small animals to build a nest, or as a shelter for anything that wants to stay hidden. The ground is partly covered in thick white web that climbs its way up on the trunks.
107348: A strange white skull lies on the floor looking at you.

Thorny bushes are everywhere in this dense part of the forest. Scattered all around on the forest floor, rotten pieces of bone slowly disintegrate. High up in the trees, some very strange shapes seem to hang from the branches. The canopy is not easily visible, as the many twisted branches, many more than anywhere else in the forest, are densely interlocked, forming an odd sort of net well below the level of the canopy. Suspended from a few of the twisted branches, round spider webs of various sizes can be seen. The bushes prevent any move to the north and the south. To the west, the branches that block the only way through could easily be moved.
107349: The spider lair is surrounded by walls of trees and web. Fallen trees and thorny branches are packed together and held in place by thick chains of spider silk. The ground is sticky and pulls on one's feet as one walks around. A foul stench comes from a section of the lair to the west, and to the north the forest becomes narrower and filled with shadows.
107350:
A brown snail is crawling across the ground here leaving a slimy trail behind.
A small, red-spotted spider lurks here (hidden).

Old, tall trees reach upwards, their crowns disappearing into the green, overgrown canopy. The forest floor is covered with huge roots, leaves and old dried branches. A large, web-covered hole can be seen on the ground between a few very thick trunks.
107351:
The corpse of a huge, poisonous spider is lying here.
The corpse of a huge, poisonous spider is lying here.
The corpse of a huge, poisonous spider is lying here.

Below the cavern dome enormous spider webs stretch out, covering the walls and the slightly sloping floor. The webbed ground is very sticky, making it difficult to walk fast. Webs are spun between the ceiling and floor, creating a maze of walls and niches and pulling on anything going past. Towards the south-east the floor slopes up and the webs become thicker, rising up to the silken throne of the lord of this lair.
107373: The thick forest has created a corridor leading to the north and south; the moss-covered trees lean in on each other, forming a fairly easily travelled, though very narrow, passageway in the seemingly ever-present darkness. Little besides the dark trees and some equally dark vines grow here.
107471: Large piles of crushed, uneven boulders litter the northern part of the forest, at the foot of a near-vertical rock face. The top of the rock face is hidden from view by the dense vegetation of the treetops. In between the gnarled trunks of beech and oak, the ground is covered by decomposing layers of old leaves and patches of black moss.
107493: Some small rocks have been piled into a mound here.

These bare hills rise above the darkness of Mirkwood below. Few plants thrive here, there is no undergrowth except small, brown shrubs that grow wherever their roots have found cracks and irregularities in the rocks. A deep crack separates these hills from a stony plateau to the east, deepening into a ravine that continues out of sight below.
107494:
An experienced orkish scout is looking for tracks on the ground.
An orc sentry is here on patrol.

Small rocks litter this ledge, but a part of the area has been cleared of stones and a primitive shelter of wood and brush has been built as protection from the wind. A deep ravine to the east would make any fall from this ledge fatal, and with the steep, broken slopes blocking passage to the north and west, the only reasonable way off this ledge lies to the south.
107514: The trees of this area are tall, dark and twisted. The boughs hang low, full of black leaves and sticky-looking spider webs. Some smaller animals have got themselves entangled in the webs, and ended up being hopelessly stuck. The forest is open enough for travelling to the north and east, while a forested ridge stretches out to the southwest.
107515: Dark trees twist and claw their way upwards towards the sky, competing for space and light, and leaving none for the inhabitants of the lower layers of the forest. A particularly twisted and dense patch of trees makes up an impassable obstacle northwards; and while travel in all other directions is possible, easy it is not.
107524: Black, oppressive trees stand tall: watching, listening... Their trunks rise high into the darkness where the intermingled crowns twist around each other creating a full, shadowy canopy. Thick masses of vines, low-hanging branches, roots and other parts of the underbrush form tangled barriers, leaving no choice for a traveller but to continue to the north or west. The ground ascends steadily to the west.
107525: Winding its way through the dark and dense forest, a meandering passageway runs in a wide arc around a rise south-west from here. A thick layer of rotten mulch covers the way, and the surrounding trees lean inwards, as if trying to swallow these last passable parts of the woods. The occasional spider web has been woven between the black and dark-grey trees.
107526: A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.

Tall, wide, twisted trees are all around, leaving only just enough room to move below the dense branches. What little room is still left on the ground is being conquered by dead leaves, twigs, mosses, roots and lichens which have obviously been piling up for a long time. The sky is completely blocked out by the thick canopy - darkness pervades Mirkwood.
107527:
Foul webs span across Mirkwood, engulfing the exit south with their complex patterns.
A fallen tree lies on the ground, its clump of roots pointing upwards.
A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.

The surrounding forest looks as dark and twisted as it does everywhere else, as it continues its implacable struggle to overwhelm the narrow pathway that barely allows passage through this area. Roots, branches and fallen trunks make movement hard. There is a knoll to the southeast, forcing travellers to go around it to the left or right, and so luring and leading them further and further into the woods. The thick canopy looms above, engulfing everything in perpetual darkness.
107528:
A few coins have been left here.
A hateful wraith glares at you and groans in torment.

Twisted, strange-looking trees grow in an isolated small group. They look like a band of wicked old men who have frozen into positions expressive of eternal torment and pain. Outside this creepy grove, steep slopes climb upwards to the east and south, their surfaces a mess of trees, roots and other entangled vegetation.
107529: A thick blanket of moss covers large parts of the ground, concealing the small, twisting paths below the looming trees. Dark bushes with needle-sharp thorns grow all over the area, trying to conquer any open space there still is. A foreboding, unusually total silence has taken over the area, especially the western part where it seems to become almost palpable. One can continue from here towards the west, south and east, where the forest looks less oppressive.
107530: Steep Cliff Deep in a Twisted Forest

Amid the dark trees a steep, vine-covered cliff rises to the west. The vines are dark and leathery, possibly also sturdy enough to provide support if one was to attempt to scale the cliff. A patch of entwined trees grows to the south, forcing anyone to travel around it; with the cliff to the west, this leaves east as the only possible route.
107531: Unnaturally dark trees grow all around, gripping at each other's branches and twisting around each other, creating a wall to the woods that greatly restricts both vision and movement. Whereas most forests would be filled with sounds from its inhabitants, not much can be heard in here, as if whatever inhabitants there are prefer to stay as silent as possible.
107532:
A sprawling, twisted tree grows here.
A few hawthorn berries lie on the ground, slowly rotting.
An emaciated warg, half-mad with hunger, is here.
An emaciated warg, half-mad with hunger, is here.
A huge warg is here, moving in for the kill.

Black hawthorns are pressing in on all sides, as if trying to create a prison amidst the twisted trees. Among the trees, dark vines grow, further hampering sight and movement which the trees already hindered very well on their own. The soft cover on the ground and the dense vegetation muffles all sounds, making the forest unusually quiet.
107533: Great, dark trees stand tall, blocking out any sight of the sky above with their dense branches, widespread crowns and wide, gnarled boles. There are some big boulders on the ground, surrounded by dense, sharp-leafed bushes. To the east and south the ground tilts down somewhat, trees and dense undergrowth blocking travel down the slopes.
107534: A dark mass of vines grows densely around the area. The vines reach down from the canopy, then snake around the twisted trees, and finally entangle themselves in the shrubs, creating impassable barriers. It is possible to move to the east, but to the west a vine-covered cliff rises from the ground, blocking the way. Southwards the ground slopes downwards, though the vines make it impossible to tell how much, or how far until the ground levels out again.
107545: A small open passageway runs through the room from an outdoor to the west to an innerdoor to the east. Other than that, the room contains beds, beds and beds; There are two bunk beds next to each other both on the northern and on the southern wall, with three beds on top of each other in every one of them. The beds and the walls look grey and old, and at parts they are covered in spider webs. There are neither windows nor other furniture in the room.
107546:
A large cabinet capable of storing goods is here.
A large, dusty alcove sits in a wall, smelling of soot.
*Valgumihkel the Black Numenorean* , wielding a dark curved sword, is standing here.

Judging by the the long table with benches on both sides, some cabinets along the walls and a sturdy oven in the corner, this room is clearly an old kitchen. It has not been in use for ages though, as all surfaces are covered with dust and numerous spider webs have been woven around the room. Planks have been nailed to cover the windows. There are two doors, a sturdy one leading out and another leading deeper into the cottage.
107547: A pile of dry, brown leaves lies here.

Tangled beech trees grow all around this small opening, making travel hard but not impossible, except to the north where a thick thorn hedge intermingles with the beech trees, creating a dense, impassable barrier. Exposed roots snake across the ground, at times camouflaged by piles of leaves and twigs, making the footing precarious.
107548: The forest forms an impenetrable ceiling out of branches, leaves and vines, blanketing the woods in perpetual darkness. The ground is a shady mixture of shrubs, thick masses of vines and gnarled trees. One can proceed in all directions save the north, where the rugged terrain rises too steeply.
107555: An Old Cottage on the Forest Glade
A brawny wisent is slowly striding through the vegetation.

The sea of grass is surrounded by the dark, twisted and inwards-reaching woods on all sides except to the east, where the waves of grass continue in defiance of the high and looming trees. The forest to the north is too dense and twisted to allow any travelling. To the west stands an old moss-covered cottage. Even when its roof and grey walls are growing bushes and mould, and vines have entangled themselves with it, the walls made of sturdy logs look still intact. There is a small overgrown path which leads from the cottage to the south where something that could be a road can be seen through the trees.
107566:
A small barrel stands on the ground.
A pale ghost advances forward, shimmering with a pale light.

This room is nothing but a hole of few square yards dug into the ground. There are old partly broken shelves on every wall, small ladders that lead upwards to a hatch on the ceiling and and old barrel in one corner of the room. The walls behind the shelves and the floor of the room are of the dark soil.
107573: A brawny wisent is slowly striding through the vegetation.

Long grass stretches out all around this treeless opening, which is like a sea of stillness within the twisted forest. The sky with all its wonders is visible above, but this privilege is of no great extent, for the dark forest looms close to the north and south, standing there as densely as anywhere with just barely enough space between the dark boles to make room for passage.
107667: Narrow, winding, seldom-travelled trails lead through the dense and gloomy woods further into the forest somewhere to the west while to the south the forest opens up into a clearing of some sort. To the north a wall of dark oaks rises above the other trees, blocking out whatever lies north of it.
107668: Deep within the dark woods is a dead-end formed by the entwined trees. The forest in the only direction out from here, east, is not much different than elsewhere, except that the trees do not grow so closely together as to prevent passage for everything but small animals.
107708: On an Expanse of Black Moss

A patch of moss grows here on a wet, flat stone.
An iron-grey wolf stands here, grizzled from countless hunts.

A vast expanse of thick, black moss thrives in this part of the forest. Few bushes and even fewer trees grow here, and the black moss covers the ground completely like a large, dark blanket. The black moss crumbles in on itself at the slightest touch, filling the air with the heavy scents of rot and decay.
107741: The Forest of Mirkwood emanates a peculiar feeling of warning here. Intruders are clearly not welcome beyond this point; growing plants seem to catch or snag at clothing in proof of this feeling, the trees seem to follow any unusual movement, and dangling spider webs and mosses tremble slightly even though there is no wind of any kind.
107753:
Klaees (thedon), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.
Drazud (freshmeat), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.
Bulg (pukespy), wielding a great warsword, is standing here.

The hills here are lush with green grass and scattered low bushes. The ground is soft, albeit difficult to walk on with its numerous ups and downs, especially to the north the terrain ascends rapidly. In the distance, the great forest can be seen, stretching towards the horizon.
107765: The grass-covered hills roll and bounce around in all directions, gradually descending in height to the south. Dense shrub thickets and tall clumps of grass and weeds dot the landscape, intermixed with occasional patches of rock and boulders.
107778: The ground here is covered with stones and is difficult to walk on. The flora on these hills is limited to some small patches of grass, struggling against the harsh surroundings. The view to the west is blocked by a steeply ascending hillside. There seem to be small cracks high up on the rock wall, and the rock beneath these are covered in white streaks.
107779: The hills here are almost completely sterile and little to no vegetation can be found, except for some patches of grass, fighting for survival. Sharp rocks lie scattered over the hill, making travelling by foot difficult. To the west, a rock face can be seen, stretching southwards.
107780: A small and tough weed grows here.

These rocky, windswept hills are almost devoid of wildlife. Tufts of tough mountain grass grow in cracks in the stony ground and a crust like grey lichen can be seen on the southern side of many of the large boulders that litter the area.
107781: These harsh, stony hills nourish few plants and only the most enduring of trees, yet even the trees that do grow here are twisted and stunted things. The hills slope downwards to the east and the trees grow closer together, and taller, in that direction.
107782: A variety of trees and undergrowth thrive on these hills. Rocky outcroppings and large boulders covered in grey lichen are interspersed throughout the forest. The rockier terrain is mainly found towards the west and south where the ground rises higher into the hills.
107783: Great, dark trunks of ancient trees, overgrown with moss and lichen, rise up from the forest floor towards the unseen sky above. The branches stretching out in all directions, thick and heavily-leaved, blot out the sky and cause these parts of the Mirkwood to lie in a perpetual gloom.
107784: Several enormous dark oaks dominate this part of the Mirkwood forest. Their trunks are at least ten feet thick and are covered wholly by a pitch-black lichen that emanates a smell of rot and decay so thick that it could almost be touched. Piles of rotting black leaves cover the ground, adding their smell to that of the lichen.
107785: Little undergrowth can be seen on the leaf-covered ground between the tall trunks of the old, gnarled Mirkwood trees. A silent row of giant cocoons wrapped in spider web is hanging from the black branches, some of them occasionally swinging in the air. A thick canopy above blocks out the sky and sun. Although visibility is short, limited by darkness and the trees, the forest seems to stretch out endlessly in all directions with no hints of a change in the terrain.
107786: Layers of leaves in various stages of decay cover the forest floor. Thick, knotted roots poke through the rotting mass here and there, and at other places bumps and curves beneath the fallen leaves hint at more roots. The forest is encompassed in a deep, brooding silence and there is no hint of a change in the terrain in any direction.
107787: The shadows lie deep beneath the roof of the forest. Not even the slightest hint of sky can be seen through the densely intertwined branches above. Towards the west the ground rises steeply and the forest seems to come to a halt at the foot of stony slopes. At the edge of the forest, many boulders, large and small, litter the ground. Perhaps the result of landslides in the past, most of the stones are long since covered by moss and lichen.
107788: A rock lizard is here, motionless as it observes you.

Many boulders, large and small, lie on the ground at the bottom of the slope to the west, a sure sign of a rock slide in the past. Little but weed and dry shrubs grow on the hard, stony ground, and there are not many signs of wildlife in this region. Directly to the east, the hills give way to the malignant forest.
107789: On a Flat Shelf of Rock

This plateau is encircled by steep edges on three sides. To the south and east, the dark roof of Mirkwood forest does not offer even a small glimpse of the forest floor beneath and the dark canopy reaches almost up to the edges of the plateau. To the west there is a long drop to the bottom of a ravine. Nothing grows on the windswept rock and the only way off the plateau is into the hills to the north.
107790: A narrow, rocky trail lined by dry shrubs follows the downwards slope of a ravine towards the south. Loose rocks clutter the trail and steady feet and good balance are required to navigate it. Rocky protrusions extend out above the ravine and sounds coming from atop these suggest that there might be bird's nests up there.
107791: A narrow, rocky trail follows the descent of a ravine towards the west. Towards the north, the end of the ravine can be seen against the sky. There is little undergrowth here, for the ground is hard and dry, and lies in shadows much of the day.
107792: At the Bottom of a Ravine
A large boulder is here, it must be heavy.

A wide bed of flat rock, about twenty yards across, extends from the uneven rock face to the west and across the floor of the ravine to the eastern side where it disappears under a large overhang. The ravine continues out of sight towards the north and south where the floor of the ravine itself is concealed by rocky outcroppings and boulders, but the course of the ravine is visible as a jagged scar through the hard stone.
107793: At the Bottom of a Ravine

Large, cracked boulders lie scattered across the bottom of the ravine where they have fallen from higher up in the hills. There is just enough space between boulders to travel unhindered along the bottom of the ravine. The hard ground and coarse sides of the ravine are mostly bare rock, although patches of dry moss and small tufts of tough grass grow here and there.
107794: A low overhang extends out across the stony ground here, casting this part of the ravine into dark shadow. There are many tracks on the hard ground, both leading towards the south where the overhang continues, and into a dark cave entrance to the east.
107795: An orkish warg-rider, wielding a lance, is here, riding a hungry warg.

The steep, rugged rock faces crowd close on both sides, leaning inwards above the narrow, rocky trail that makes a slow descent towards the north. Many boulders, both large and small, lie along the trail, most of them long since overgrown with patches of green moss. There are no signs of recent rock falls although there are several deep cracks running up and down across the rock.
107796:
An orc sentry is here on patrol.
An orc sentry is here on patrol.
An orkish warrior of the Tarkhnarb tribe stands guard here.

A juncture has formed here. Rough, low openings lead into dark caves towards the north and south, while a faint draft comes from the west, bringing fresh air into the cave system. This room seems to serve as a watch post: several crude wooden stools have been placed against the back wall and there are marks from spear-butts in the dirt next to them, where guards lean their spears against the wall.
107797:
A long water trough made of wood stands here.
A large brown wolf stands here, its teeth partly bared.
A large brown wolf stands here, its teeth partly bared.

A large overhang extends above the hard, dusty soil here. A primitive stable has been constructed against the back stone wall. There are many tracks of pawed feet in the dust and scraps of raw, bloody meat lie strewn in one corner, leftovers from a recent meal perhaps.
107798: The rough, scabrous rock walls in this cavern are damp, almost moist. Large sections of the stone are covered with growths of slimy, viscous brown mould. Small stalactites hang down from the roof above like icicles, slowly dripping percolated, calcareous water to the cavern floor.
107799:
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack are two broad spears and two scimitars.
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.
An orkish warrior of the Tarkhnarb tribe stands guard here.

This cavern is in great disorder, the floor littered with all kinds of junk related to warfare. Crates along the eastern wall are filled with crude armour, much of it battered and broken. Several racks of weaponry stand leaning against the north wall, the scimitars and axes in them notched and rusty. The top of a crude wooden table in the middle of the room is the only space where there is some order. A few leatherworker's tools lie on it, but otherwise it is free of clutter.
107800: A demon wolf lurks here, its dark form twisting and hiding its shape.

Filthy, dark water drips from the wet, uneven cavern ceiling above. Small rivulets of dirty water trickle down along the walls to form shallow pools where the walls meet the cavern floor. Wet, slimy mould grows across the walls, filling the cave with a musty odour. The tunnel opens up towards the east, where there seems to be a large cavern.
107801:
An orkish warrior, wielding a wooden club, is sleeping here.
A powerful, squat orc captain eyes you with contempt and scorn.
An orkish warrior, wielding a longsword, is sleeping here.

A wide, high cavity has formed beneath the hills here. The walls are of solid rock and while jagged and uneven, there are no cracks or fissures and the risk of a rock fall should be negligible. There are many signs of recent inhabitation strewn about the large cave, and the inhabitants do not seem prone towards keeping a neat, clean living space.
107802: The coarse, jagged stone ceiling is very low in this natural cavern. Much of the cave roof shows cracks and fissures, and every now and then dust and tiny rocks sift down through the cracks and fall to the cavern floor. The cavern extends towards the south, and the roof disappears higher into darkness in that direction.
107803: The stony ground is solid and free of loose rocks and undergrowth, providing a wide, steady ledge cradled against the rock face. The ledge is, however, slightly slanted outwards and a careless step might result in a tumble over the edge. The ledge leads nowhere as it narrows toward both north and south, only to completely disappear after less than twenty yards in either direction.
107804: The ground here consists mostly of dry, hard earth. A few bushes and shrubs struggle to survive on whatever moisture and sun that find their way down to the bottom of the ravine. Several large, jagged boulders lie scattered across the ground, partly buried in the soil and overgrown with moss.
107805: The sides of this crevice are rough and uneven, but the walls are far enough apart that two horses could walk here side by side. The crevice leads down into a ravine to the north, the descent steep but not unmanageably so. The ground is solid rock for the most part, with patches of dirt held together by the roots of tough mountain grass and small shrubs. To the south, the crevice ends in a black thicket of tenacious-looking bushes.
107867: The hills seem to form a natural hollow, fully occupied by tall, old trees. Patches of rocks and standalone boulders are randomly strewn throughout the area, partnering with dense shrubs and isolated groves of dark saplings. The deep bowl formed by the hills makes passage in any direction other than north impossible.
107868:
A large cave troll is here, staying close to his mother.
The ugly troll mother is roaming the cave, taking care of her loved ones.

The stench of unwashed beings and excrement fills the air. The darkness spreads greedily towards the entrance seeking to gobble up any natural light. Loose shards of shale and grey stone shift underfoot and dust puffs up with each step. Farther in, the darkness deepens to pitch black.
107943: The forest does not look healthy here. Some of the big trees are clearly rotten, and they look like they may fall down at any moment. A few trees have broken and collapsed already, lying among the vegetation as a part of the decayed, smelly mess that covers the ground. Above, the upper part of branches have grown compactly together, making the forest very dark.
107944: A black squirrel peers down from the branches of the trees.

The black, shadowy forest looms in all directions as far as one can see. The trees are massive, and the big tree trunks are easily more than two yards thick. The ceiling above is formed by the forest itself, blocking the sky totally out of the field of vision. Branches twist to and fro, covered by the seemingly endless vines. The undergrowth looks half rotten, complementing the rather scary and oppressing atmosphere this place has.
107960: A fallen tree lies on the ground, its clump of roots pointing upwards.

The ground here is covered in a thin layer of fog, making the surrounding forest seem cold. The mist swirls with each step and keeps the surface of the othewise dry ground damp. Several trees have fallen, apparently because of the loose soil and their top-heavy branch load. Their rotting remains are festooned with white and grey lichens and green mosses, which suck the remaining colour out of the ancient brown trunks.
107961: Some dark, thick writhing vines whip all around you.

The black trees grow tight and tall, creating small tunnels and narrow, twisting passageways between the trunks and dense hanging branches. Darkness dominates the area as thick foliage is not allowing daylight to shine upon the mossy ground. Ominous-looking dark vines hang from the branches in abundance.
107963: The dreary, gloomy forest is filled with an almost tangible smell of rot and decay. Slithering lengths of mottled vines creep up the old, gnarled trunks amidst clusters of parasitic fungi. Thick, knotted roots crawling across the ground and thickets of thorn-covered bushes collaborate to make these woods very difficult to travel through.
107964: Great, sprawling shadows of huge, tangled bushes block passage towards the south, but in other directions it might be possible to squeeze through the dense undergrowth. The forest lies deep in shadows, the dense canopy above shrouding the sky from view and it is hard to descry any landmarks to orient by.
107965: A fierce boar is here, making grunting noises.

The Forest of Mirkwood completely encloses this space with a thick layer of branches overhead and bristling, thorny vines and tall bushes interspersed with dark, stout tree trunks on every side. Glistening, ebony tendrils dangle from above, while obisidian weeds and grasses provide an odd carpet underfoot.
107966: Twisted, gnarled trunks of oak cast strange shadows in the gloom, darker shades of black against a forest floor that has not seen sunlight for centuries. There are no distinguishing landmarks here, nothing to differentiate one part of the area from the others around it. Without a proper sense of direction, it would be possible to wander this dark forest for eternity without finding a way out.
107967: Mirkwood opens up into a space where no vegetation grows. Instead, the remnants of tree trunks and undergrowth are flattened in a pattern resembling a concentric circle. In the middle of the circle, nothing grows or lives. It is obvious some spell or power was used here, destroying all of the surroundings.
107975: The remains of a mass of vines lie here in a heap of rotting compost.

The dark and dense undergrowth gives way to a central grassy area, which looks like it was a pasture in the past, during the days when the shadow had not yet fallen upon the forest. Now the black trees surround it, arching towards each other creating an intact, black canopy over the opening. An old, but still sturdy fence borders the glade. The eye is drawn to a wooden gate which guards the exit to the east.
107977: A patch of moss grows here on a wet, flat stone.

Great roots and vines support the walls and ceiling of the narrow tunnel. Black soil has been cleared from between the foundation of the great trees, creating a treacherous underground path. Moths, termites and other bugs have been caught in many of the webs spanning wide throughout the twisting tunnel. Cracked cocoons have fallen, littering the ground together with a myriad of frail eggs. The tunnel zigzags its way through the roots and rocks eastwards.
107978: A hairy black spider wraps up a silken package with her hind legs.

As the tunnel makes its way through the roots and rocky soil it opens up by an exhausted waterhole. Bigger rocks and finely woven webs surround the spring. Grey webs cover much of the big roots from the great forest above, which are mainly what holds the ceiling up here. The twisting and turning tunnel continues to the north and west.
107979: A mixture of withered old roots and younger agile ivy create a twisting tunnel. Many cobwebs have been spun from root to root. The dark soil is packed solid among the rocks and boulders. Bugs of all sorts scurry along the floor, others hanging lifeless in the ashen webs. The tunnel continues in its pitch black darkness to the east and south.
107980: A tunnel opening has collapsed, with a small mound of boulders impeding any further travel to the west. A slope lined by fallen trunks and gnarled, old branches leads upwards, into the ground level of Mirkwood. Ashen webs cover most of the surroundings, making it hard to find the way.
107981: The forest canopy opens up a bit here, allowing a stream of sunlight to reach the forest floor below, where yellow, waist-high grass grows in abundance. A ring of rocks have been placed off to the eastern part of the glade; no doubt this place was sometimes used as a camp ground. The forest around the glade is massive and dark. Between the bushes, a web-covered mouth of a tunnel leads diagonally downwards, and in other directions the thick, thorny bushes makes passage impossible except to the east.
107982: The rickety webs give way, and you fall through the tunnel floor.

Towering, dark oaks stand together in dense rows, their massive and gnarled canopies blotting out any natural light from above. Long, foul-smelling strands of lichen hang down from the boughs, and blackish, green-tinged mosses cling to the huge, scarred trunks. Among the upper canopy, platforms made of spider web and vegetation connect all the trees of the area together. To the east, a narrow strip of rich red cloth has been attached to a branch with no obvious intention or meaning.
107983: Massive, moss-covered trunks rest here on this overgrown, boulder-strewn forest floor. Apparently fallen a long time ago, they have curiously enough been arranged in such a way that they all point towards a common centre where a large, black boulder rests on a slightly elevated part of the forest. Undergrowth and moss have run wild here, except in the centre, where the boulder remains unblemished.
107995:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
A cavebear is sleeping here.

A wide, rough cavern opens up in the darkness. The ceiling is somewhere far above, leaving enough space for a stone giant to stand in full height and still be unable to reach anything. The walls are far from each other, there must be tens of yards space between them. The ground is filled with gravel, rocks - and half-eaten carcasses.
107997: Massive, black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy.

A black, weird-looking rock stands in the middle of this dark grove. The rock is about ten feet high, with two veins of ore visible. A huge, almost two feet thick root has entwined itself around the rock as if holding it fast to the ground like an arm of the forest protecting its own treasures. All around, sharp branches reach out from giant gnarled trunks standing next to each other. An abundance of vines growing between the trunks create a wall that severely limits travel options.
107998:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
Some thick writhing vines whip all around you.
The wicked undergrowth rustles malevolently, shifting and widening.
A mass of wriggling vines drops on you from the trees.

Below the dark canopy of Mirkwood, masses of corpse-grey trees are leaning towards the small opening in a perfect unison. The trees have lost their vitality but still stand as massive as ever, darkening the surroundings with their thick trunks. Old, gnarled roots snake across the ground, making walking difficult and riding impossible. Some of the trees are gnawed by ivy, some of them have fallen over and now lie rotting on the ground. The rotting trees seem to have been disturbed recently. Patches of the forest floor are riddled with traces of a struggle, some of the roots have old cuts in them and the ground looks disturbed as if it had been dug in recently.
107999: A mass of wriggling vines drops on you from the trees.

Like a tightening circle, the plants of this dark sinister grove seem to shift around as if trying to reach for travellers. Black shrubbery covered in nasty sharp thorns, oozing vines thick as a bear's neck and towering trunks have all entangled together, leaving only a few exits open below and between the plants. The ground is shadowed by the continuous canopy of Mirkwood which filters out most of the light that could ever reach this place.
108008: Close to the cliff to the west and south the forest opens up somewhat; nevertheless the trees atop the cliff fill eagerly all the space available, blocking out the sky and never allowing sunlight to reach below the treetops with more than a few indirect, weak rays. The cliff wall seems impossible to scale, and to the north tall, dark and twisted trees grow densely making east the only direction to travel forward.
108009:
A black-furred bat is sleeping here.
A black-furred bat is sleeping here.

A small cave opens up inside the rock. The stony walls are close to each other, and the ceiling of black rock looms quite close above. The way out is located to the east: a small hole which can be opened and closed with a loose boulder. Small rocks and black gravel cover the floor.
108016: Atop this rocky cliff one could see far and wide, were the ever-present twisted trees not reaching high above and thus blocking the view. The cliff prevents further passage in all directions save to the west, unless one wants to test the strength of the plants along the steep cliff wall leading down. To the west the forest becomes darker and more foreboding.
108017: Thick oozing vines hang from the branches, entangled to gnarled old trunks and dense dark bushes growing all around the trees. Yet there are some open passageways where trees do not grow, allowing travelling to all directions. Above, partly inside the canopy, a dense network of grey spider silk can be seen. The ground is filled with forest litter.
108018: The dark, twisted trees grow in a tight semi-circle. Their low-hanging branches and the wide spider webs that have been woven all around are resisting any attempt to pass through, leaving south as the only possible way to travel further in the ever dark and twisted Mirkwood. Dead branches and foliage cover the ground in what appears to be a constant state of decay.
108019: Despite the abundance of dead branches on the ground the trees seem to thrive here, even though they are far darker and more twisted than any normal tree. The forest is relatively open, allowing one to move on in any direction save to the south where a large number of fallen trees, overgrown with vines and lichens, prevents travel.
108020:
Some roots lie here waiting to ensnare weary travellers.
A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.

Around the dark trees masses of dark roots cover the ground, requiring care not to trip over them or get stuck into some particularly twisted part. Black trees are growing very densely to the north, preventing travelling in that direction. A faint smell of rotting plants fills the air, though it is hard to make out exactly what direction it comes from in this stale, windless place.
108021: The dark, twisting, thick and sinister forest grows densely here. Giant bushes cover the ground, with the occasional tree-root visible between them; tangled vines hang from the boughs. The forest continues to all directions, the only exception being to the east where one can make out the shape of a rising cliff, but only vaguely.
108022: Ominous-looking Crevice under the Dark, Twisted Trees

With their roots firmly entrenched in the ground, the high-reaching trees have twisted their branches and crowns around each other, making it impossible to tell where one tree ends and another begins. A wide, darkling crevice to the south makes it impossible to travel in that direction. To the north a wall of trees rises, seemingly impenetrable.
108023: The ground in this part of the forest is covered with thorny bushes and tangled shrubs. Long, slithering vines with short, hook-like spikes crawl through and across the dense undergrowth, creating an ever worse tangle. Amidst the abundance of undergrowth, dark boles rise up, wide boughs spreading out and forming a thick foliage above that casts the forest into deep shadows.
108024: Great tangles of brush and vines block the way towards the south and west. Towards the east and north, the undergrowth is also very dense but not impassably so, although getting stung, snagged and scratched by the many sharp thorns is unavoidable. The forest floor is shrouded in dark shadows by the dense foliage above that hides the ground from the skies.
108025: At the Bottom of a Muddy Slope
A cluster of dark green, feathery fronds flourishes in the shade.

Gigantic, gnarled trees stand next to each other, rising to great heights. Somewhere far above in the dark, twisted branches, vines and huge, black leaves create an unbroken canopy over the forest. At ground level, great tangles of thorny brush and large, green ferns make passage very difficult, blocking the way altogether towards the east and west, while a muddy slope is rising steeply upwards towards the north.
108026: A hairy black spider wraps up a silken package with her hind legs.

Large, tangled brambles covered in sharp thorns spread out across the entire valley floor. The valley goes up a steep slope to the south which seems to be the only way to leave it. In the deepest part of the valley, towards the west, the ground is wet and bog-like, and a filthy-looking pool has formed there.
108027: By a Huge, Fallen Oak Trunk

A huge oak has fallen westwards. Its massive, hollow trunk forms a tunnel, which crosses the deep crevice to the west. Even though the crevice is too wide for anyone to jump over it, still the trees grow high and wide enough to block out the sky above it. Densely growing trees to the south create an effective barrier against travel. To the north the dense forest shows an opening that would be possible to get through.
108028: Low shrubs and masses of dead leaves cover the ground and hinder movement. They make a faint rustling sound as one moves through them. The thick mass of trees opens up to the north and west, while a mix of large beech trees and a dense thorn hedge makes passage impossible to the south. To the east a cliff cuts off the way.
108029: Atop this rocky cliff one could see far and wide, were the ever-present twisted trees not reaching high above and thus blocking the view. The cliff prevents further passage in all directions save to the west, unless one wants to test the strength of the plants along the steep cliff wall leading down. To the west the forest becomes darker and more foreboding.
108035: Small Hill in a Twisted Forest

The ground rises slightly to form a small hill covered with the same dark and twisted trees that are surrounding it. On the north side a number of trees have died some time ago, and now their vine- and lichen-covered trunks create a barrier that blocks travel in that direction. To the south dark, thick and leathery vines make up a wall. To the west the trees grow quite densely but it could be possible to pass through the mass of entwined branches.
108036:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.

Sinister Mirkwood continues in all directions but to the east, where a cliff rises preventing any passage beyond it. The trees of this area are rising to great heights, their thick trunks disappearing from the sight to the shadows of the canopy above. Bleached skeletons lie on the ground, half-concealed under the weeds, brush and other litter.
108037: Black, twisted trees grow high and so close to each other that their trunks and numerous boughs form small tunnels between the trees. This makes visibility very limited and navigation rather confusing. A thick wall to the west would seems to prevent passage to that direction. To the south it seems to be possible to push between the trunks and through some low-hanging branches, though there is no way telling what awaits on the other side. A faint smell of decay permeates the air.
108045: Threads of sticky, thick spider web have been spun from the upper canopy of the forest to form a swinging bridge two yards wide which spans across the open air, stretching between the branches of two huge oaks. The ground level of the forest looms through the vines and branches far below, where trees and thorn-bushes surround a small open area, as if trying to conceal and suffocate it.
108046: A small platform opens up upon the branches, centred around a web-covered, black tree trunk. There is a hole in it, through which one could descend to the lower levels of the canopy. The only other exit is along a stretched spider web, swinging in the air like a rope bridge, leading across the open air to another tree to the north.
108047:
A swift and agile forest cat moves silently through the vegetation.
A gorcrow is standing here.

A circular tunnel crawls and zigzags through the canopy, occasionally sloping upwards, sometimes downwards. Its walls are made of skilfully woven spider silk which creates an elastic, sticky barrier around this space, denying even a glimpse of the outside and forcing one to stay inside the tunnel.
108048: Spider webs surround this area like a huge, grey- and silver-coloured veil, covering everything with its suffocating embrace. Inside this sticky shroud, some worn-out tunnels exist, creating causeways between the old, worm-infested trees. Here, the tunnels meet each other, forming a junction inside the canopy.
108049:
A half-decayed corpse of a goblin lies rotting on the ground.
A swift and agile forest cat moves silently through the vegetation.

A narrow tunnel crawls through the dense, web-covered vegetation, winding around the tree trunks and twisting as it follows the branches upon which it is built. A pool of dried blood stains the floor of this cramped passageway. A strong, foul stench hangs in the stale air, getting stronger the further the tunnel climbs.
108050: Dark, thorny vines hang from the darkness like limp, hairy tentacles. The vines, black leaves, branches and ever-present spider webs are all tangled together, creating an almost impenetrable wall of mess around this small platform. The only ways through this barrier are a black hole to the west, leading further into the canopy, and another hole at the bottom of the landing, leading down to the ground of the shadowy forest.
108051: A huge, poisonous spider is here.

The tunnel slopes quite steeply in a north-south direction, ascending towards the south. The tunnel floor is very uneven. Sometimes the web-covered surface rises abruptly up, forcing the traveller to crawl over the obstacle, other times it sinks down, forming deceptive hollows - many of them being full of litter and foul-stinking slime.
108052:
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.

A strong and wide spider web rises almost vertically along a huge oak trunk here. The threads of the web spread from its centre in concentric circles, creating an unusual but climbable passageway between different layers of the shadowy canopy. Some half-rotten bird corpses hang from the web: victims of the spiders who hunt here.
108064:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
A rotten corpse is hanging here.
A large metal full shield is on the ground.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.
A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.
A grey spider is stalking here, preparing to drain you of life.

Judging from the amount of corpses, bones and broken armour lying about, this gloomy tunnel could almost be an abandoned battlefield. A thick layer of spider webs and stinking, gooey slime covers it all, mixing everything into disgusting-looking grey porridge. Within the slime, several huge egg sacks can be seen, woven from white silk. The stench of gore, rot and slime hangs heavily in the air.
108065: A huge, poisonous tarantula extends her legs to you.

The tunnel stops at a dead-end, the only way out from here being to the east. The walls, floor and ceiling are all covered with several layers of sticky, veil-like spider web which lend to this dark, gruesome area shades of grey and white. Some cocoons are hanging in mid-air.
108066: There is a vast, level surface inside the canopy. Some thick branches form its foundation, which has been strengthened with vegetation and spider silk - a seemingly endless amount of sticky, grey spider silk. The platform continues to the north and shows signs of frequent usage: at places it has been worn almost smooth. A giant spider web has been woven at its edges, starting here and continuing downwards into the darkness, creating a deceptive trap.
108067: A platform made of vines, twigs and spider silk follows the shapes of the supporting branches, altering its way to the left and right. A dense, fence-like tangle of spider web encircles sticky cocoons hanging from the upper branches. The cocoons are grey and of different sizes, but all hold their unlucky victims securely fast. A strong stench of rotten meat pervades the area.
108068: A cylindrical tunnel spirals around an old, web-infested trunk, leading to an open platform at the top, and to a narrow, slimy passageway at the bottom. The bark of the trunk is rather smooth, as if having been ground down by someone or something for a long time. A continuous wall of spider web has been woven on leafy branches, limiting visibility to no further than the next turn of the tunnel.
108069: A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.

Some twisted, thorny branches impale the webbed walls of this narrow tunnel, making passage somewhat difficult. There are red stains on the branches and on the floor, and the walls are covered with trickles of stinking, grey slime, acidic-looking and sticky to touch. The tunnel splits into three directions, leading east, south and up.
108073: A rotten corpse is hanging here.

The foul-smelling, narrow tunnel makes its way inside the canopy. The branches which serve as the floor of the tunnel are somewhat bumpy due to the numerous fungi that infest them. The way gets narrower and pokier towards the east, and finally ends at a massive, strong spider web which blocks the tunnel altogether. The only way out of this trap is to the west.
108074: This shaky, swinging platform within the canopy has been woven from spider silk wrapped tightly around the branches. Although the threads have been pasted together with a sticky, green slime and litter from the trees, the supporting branches themselves are not strong enough to keep the landing firm and stable. To the north, the platform gets a roof as it leads into a tunnel made of spider webs. The web continues downwards, creating a ladder-like construction allowing one to climb down from the canopy.
108075: A forest spider is here crawling around.

Long, broad branches reach out towards the darkness, sometimes meeting each other, sometimes ending abruptly in the air. A natural gangway has formed upon some of them, allowing movement from tree to tree. On some boughs grows a thick layer of ancient lichen, while others are totally smooth and clean, hinting that the passageway is in frequent use.
108076: On the Branches of a Huge, Black Elm

Mossy vines hang from the shadowy canopy, entangling themselves with the gnarly branches that stick out from a giant black elm tree. The surrounding canopy is very dense but provides no proper foothold, so that moving from the side of the trunk is not possible save to the west, onto the sturdy branches.
108077: A treeless circle approximately 50 yards from one end to another opens up under the intact canopy of the surrounding trees. The black, gnarled trunks form a wall all around, as if trying to conquer the open space. The process has already begun, as sharp thorn-bushes grow in abundance in the grove. Any spaces there might be between the trees have been filled with thick, sticky spider webs.
108078: A silky, spidery web is here, spun into a spiralling wheel-shape.

A treeless circle approximately 50 yards from one end to another opens up under the intact canopy of the surrounding trees. The black, gnarled trunks form a wall all around, as if trying to conquer the open space. The process has already begun, as sharp thorn-bushes grow in abundance in the grove. Any spaces there might be between the trees have been filled with thick, sticky spider webs.
108079: Foul webs span across Mirkwood, engulfing the exit north with their complex patterns.

A treeless circle approximately 50 yards from one end to another opens up under the intact canopy of the surrounding trees. The black, gnarled trunks form a wall all around, as if trying to conquer the open space. The process has already begun, as sharp thorn-bushes grow in abundance in the grove. Any spaces there might be between the trees have been filled with thick, sticky spider webs.
108080: A treeless circle approximately 50 yards from one end to another opens up under the intact canopy of the surrounding trees. The black, gnarled trunks form a wall all around, as if trying to conquer the open space. The process has already begun, as sharp thorn-bushes grow in abundance in the grove. Any spaces there might be between the trees have been filled with thick, sticky spider webs.
108081: A small hollow has been formed out of the leaves here, with dried grasses pressed into the mud. The walls and floor of this small space are covered with a mixture of rotting leaves and various mosses, creating an obnoxious, disgusting aroma. Large worms crawl through this putrid stuff. The odour of entrails is distinct from that of rotting leaves.
108128: The corpse of a large, fanged spider is lying here.

A heavily forested small ridge rises up from its surroundings. The malicious- looking twisted trees stand close together in a circle, like a crown on top of the highest part of the ground. All around, the endless rows of thick trunks dotted by thorny bushes and blanketed by an eerie gloom make the navigation hard.
108129: The canopy high above blocks most sun or moon light, but the oak trunks stand far apart and the branches are not as twisted and thick as elsewhere. The widely spaced forest continues to the south and west, but to the north and east the density of trees and bushes increases so much that travel in those directions is impossible. The ground slopes up towards the west, soon reaching the top of a small hill.
108130:
A thin, hairy plant, with small, oval leaves, grows here.
A squirrel scampers around here, looking for nuts from the trees.

Here a small, lonely, wooded hill rises out of Mirkwood. In contrast to the rest of the forest, the trees here do not completely block the view, and several prominent landmarks are visible from this vantage point. The dark, fir-covered slopes of the Mountains of Mirkwood dominate most of the northern skies. Going east is the easy way off the hill, as all other directions are either blocked by dense bushes or require climbing down a steep cliff.
108136:
A stiletto is lying here.
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.

This small, enclosed area of the forest looks like the place where the spiders leave the equipment and other inedible goods they find on their victims. The ground is blood-soaked and dark red, a testament to the horrors that have taken place here, and nothing wants to grow on it. The trees are blackened and old, as if scorched by fire. Their branches twist and turn, and only to the south is a gap large enough to squeeze through.
108137:
A half-decayed corpse of a goblin lies rotting on the ground.
A newborn spider is here.
A grey spider is stalking here, preparing to drain you of life.
A huge, poisonous spider is here.
A huge, poisonous tarantula extends her legs to you.

This dark, narrow tunnel between the huge trunks and interwoven branches has sticky walls made of spider webs. There are corpses and skeletons of small animals gotten stuck, and occasional scrape marks in few places. The dark grey ceiling is just above and some thick branches penetrating the endless webs are so low that creatures taller than a dwarf have to crawl forward.
108140: The oak trees growing here are thick and ancient. Most of the trees lean inwards - whether that comes from their own weight or the shifting ground is unclear. A permanent dark atmosphere pervades the forest, making the trees look like giants rising up, ready to strike. Their branches touch one another at a low height, twisting around and hugging each other, creating a sort of low wooden roof. The ground here is sloped and the only possible exits are a open path north, or downhill to the south, the way to the east being blocked by thick, twisted branches.
108141: Old Stones in the Dark Forest

The trees here are ancient and bent in this gloomy and humid forest. Some are dark and rotten, and overgrown by younger bushes. Like everything in Mirkwood that grows old and weak, they feed the newest generation. Here and there lie old stone blocks, now covered in moss, that once perhaps formed part of an outpost. Everywhere around, evil has seized power over this place, proud of its influence on what happens in its lands. Fallen trees and thorny bushes seem to prevent travel in the eastern or southern directions.
108142: This is a lighter part of the forest, with more space between the trees, making it easy to move around. The area appears to be frequently used by the animals inhabiting these woods, as many small animal trails twist between the trees. Around some trails, however, scratches in the bark of trunks suggest dangerous creatures around. The widely-spaced forest continues to the north. To the east the spaces get narrower but still traversable, while to the west and south the forest is too dense to move through.
108143: The trees in this part of the forest stand close together, making it difficult to move around. To the west, the forest becomes lighter and the spaces wider, but in all other directions the branches are twisting and entwined. This creates impassable barriers to the north and south, but to the east it is possible to squeeze through a narrow passage. Coming back from that direction might not be as easy, though.
108150: An elaborate red flower sits within a dark mass of briars.

This area has been conquered by poisonous-looking bushes. They grow all around the place, between and around every single dark trunk that stands majestically in the sea of vegetation. Some of the bushes have giant, red flowers which exude an odd, stunning stench pervading the area, mixing with the other scents of the forest. Sticky black ooze coats the uncountable leaves.
108151: The passageway through the forest is more like a dark tunnel inside the earth than an actual passageway. Giant, moss-covered trunks lean greedily forward, as if trying to grab any travellers. Their twisting branches and squirming roots hinder movement, and render leaving the tunnel impossible. Visibility is limited to few dozen yards at best.
108152: Massive, black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy.

The ground of this area is sloping slowly but steadily downwards to the west. Tall, pointy beeches grow on the slope, their moss-covered, black trunks curving lazily over the area forming an arched roof above. Dark vines are hanging from the canopy. There is a massive skeleton of some four-legged mammal on the ground, its pale bones creating a sharp contrast to the black vegetation of the forest.
108153:
Some dark, thick writhing vines whip all around you.
Some dark, thick writhing vines whip all around you.
Some dark, thick writhing vines whip all around you.

The canopy of Mirkwood hangs very low here, preventing the daylight from shining upon this place, ever. Entangled, impenetrable-looking brush has conquered the ground, which slopes steeply to the west. The vegetation leaves only a few narrow black gaps between the tree trunks and giant-sized shrubs through which one can venture still deeper into Mirkwood. Gnarled roots twist along the ground, embracing each rock, stump and other bulge in their firm grip.
108163:
Pitch-black water with a strange smell has collected here.
An ancient fungus smothers the boulders.
An ancient fungus smothers the boulders.
A small leech is here, floating in the water.
A small leech is here, floating in the water.

The ground is wet and marsh-like. Thick, knotted roots slither just beneath the surface of the shallow, filthy water as if lying in wait to trip unwary travellers. There is plenty of dry, solid ground interspersed with the shallow, murky pools, yet this are mostly occupied with large, tangled brambles. Thick, gnarled trunks of ancient trees can be seen all across the area and their thick boughs above form a dense canopy that blots out the sky.
108213: The corpse of a black widow is lying here.

A giant spider web spreads through the forest, reaching from tree to tree, from branch to branch and from the dark canopy to the ground. The web is sticky- looking, and at some parts even several inches thick. Some carcasses are hanging in the air, birds, squirrels and a humanoid wrapped in grey cocoon. The trees of the area look grey and putrid. The undergrowth consists of branches intertwined with the thorny brush, slowing the advancement of anyone journeying here.
108223: A pile of dry, brown leaves lies here.

A myriad of rotting branches and leaves are spread around, almost covering up the moss and gravel on the uneven ground. The cramped together trees, nestled with vines and fallen branches, block further travel in all directions except for to the east, where the trees seem to grow further apart.
108224: By a Boulder in the Forest
A large boulder is here, it must be heavy.

A great boulder lies at the centre of great swathes of fallen trees and decomposing thickets. Traces of blood and fur lead towards the boulder. The forested ground makes an abrupt drop to the south, impossible to traverse. In the west vines and shrubs grow quite densely between many large, gnarled oaks and birches.
108225: A Collapsed Cave under the Boulder
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.

The ceiling is partly supported by withered old tree trunks stacked upon one another, and partly by black soil packed hard. Roots and vines have been roughly scraped off the walls in order to give more room in the collapsed cave. A big pile of twigs and leaves lies in one corner and perhaps once formed a big creature's bed. It seems that it has long been abandoned though, leaving it to the pests infesting it and the decayed remains of the carcass which it bears. The fallen cave opens up into a larger space to the west.
108226:
On the ground is a foul orkish-looking metal helmet.
A piece of bloody meat lies here.
A short spear is lying on the ground.
