A withered husk hangs here, drained of all life.
Nemi, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.
A great black and silver wolf is standing here, at the head of the pack.
A great black and silver wolf is standing here, at the head of the pack.
A great, wild boar with large tusks is here, ready to charge.

An overwhelming stench permeates this horrid lair at the back of a wet web-filled tunnel. Great bulbous egg sacs hang from the white woven ceiling amidst a sticky mass of strong strands. Several shrunken husks of former victims lay lifeless and shrivelled upon the wet stone floor, undoubtedly serving as recent meals at the convenience of the creatures that have taken up residence here. The roof is not visible through the thick webs spun from wall to wall, masking unknown and foreboding heights that lurk above the countless silk strands in the darkness.
111861:
A forest spider is here crawling around.
A forest spider is here crawling around.

Rising high into the sky, imposing walls close in to form a narrow passage. Some trees have managed to take root along the canyon floor in small clusters. The space created by the fissure breaks up the forest canopy hanging far above. A cleft looms ominously in the great stone wall to the west.
111862: Uncounted stones fill the bottom of a steep incline, making it difficult for any plant to take root in this area of the forest canyon. Rugged rock walls are adorned with thick vegetation at the top of the crevice which sprouts dark vines that hang down from the forest floor far above.
111863: A forest spider is here crawling around.

The cover of Mirkwood imposes itself over a canyon's narrow opening above as branch and vine hang down ominously into the gaping chasm. The great dark walls curve downward into a black soil as they form a narrow floor covered in dark moss and fern growth.
111864: Dark, ridged stone forms nearly vertical walls towering upward that block all light from reaching this place. A cluster of gnarled oaks grows ravenously upon one smooth area of soil, free from the loose rock and large boulders that dominate most of the fissure's bottom. Loose stones and boulders give way to dark moss and young ferns toward the east.
111865: A wide and deep crevice cleaving the hard bedrock beneath the soil of mirkwood cuts its way down to form a steep slope toward the east. Debris made up of decaying plant matter and cracked boulders lies piled here along the bottom of the great crack in the earth, having fallen from far above over countless years as it amassed to form an artificial floor.
111866: A scrawny Durbuk-hai orc is cowering here, hiding from arachnids.

A tiny recess in the stone carved by the elements, the rough ceiling of this hollow provides some shelter from the open canyon to the east. Smooth grey walls are disrupted by deep cracks that reveal veins of different types of rocks and minerals. The floor is hard and barren but for a few grains of dirt.
111868: A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.

Gnarled ancient trees grow evenly spaced inside a vast valley, with only the tips of their leaves intertwining to form a matted mass of vegetation. Black fungi twist around the serrated bark of the great trunks, keeping themselves close to the moist air and under a cloak of permanent darkness.
111870: A bright red mushroom is growing here.

The endless rows of trees resemble a troupe of gnarled, dancing giants in the dim light under the canopy. Massive roots snake out radially from grizzled trunks while small clusters of vegetative growth sprout up amid red umbrella-like mushrooms that dot the forest floor.
111871: Great evergreen trees grow closely together in a tangled labyrinth of boughs, branches, and roots. The low branches are hard and dry, scraping and scratching against one another from some unseen and unfelt wind far above. Dry stones covered in yellow lichen lie scattered all about the forest floor.
111872:
A small termite is running around making strange sounds.
A giant termite is here, crushing skulls and bones.

This small cave hollowed out beneath a thick patch of lichen-covered stones is filled with organic debris of various sorts. Rotting vegetation is intermingled with various bones that cover the cave floor. Old, dry wood from fallen trees lines the stone walls and is visibly riddled with holes that appear to have been bored throughout.
111873:
A brown snail is crawling across the ground here leaving a slimy trail behind.
A swift carnivore bustles around.

Towering oaks stretch over this patch of forest-clad hills, obscuring the sky with their opaque canopy. Thick branches droop to the ground, weighed down by heavy blankets of vines. Blind ravines cross this choked woodland, their steep, sudden slopes inviting a careless plummet. The air is humid with moisture from the silent respiration of the trees.
111874: A cluster of dark green, feathery fronds flourishes in the shade.

This narrow valley is bordered by tree-laden slopes. A cloudy brook oozes over moss-covered stones, its pitch-black mire carrying debris from decaying vegetation upstream. The persistent hum of insects pervades this dank gorge.
111875: A cold wind rushes across the hills as if running away from a mountain peak in the west. The trees seem to be on a mission of covering all available ground with growth. Dark oaks and thick maples spring up at every opportunity, sending thick roots twisting and swirling in and out of the exposed, rocky soil. The foliage rustles constantly in the breeze.
111877: Punching out of the surrounding hills, this mountain is a baby - by mountain standards. Far in the north, a taller peak looms while in the far northeast, an enormous mountain range dominates the skyline. In all directions, forested hills and dark woods spread out like an earth-tone quilt made out of black, green, and brown patches.
111878:
A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.
A swift carnivore bustles around.

The hills here are lumpy and bumpy, sometimes rising and sometimes falling as if they can't make their minds up to become mountains or not. Weighing them down is a large overgrowth of dark trees, thick brush, and gnarled roots. The dense undergrowth is mirrored by a thick, green canopy above.
111879:
A tangled creeper writhes its shoots between the forest's roots upwards.
A tangled creeper writhes its shoots between the forest's roots upwards.

The ground here rises above the surrounding Mirkwood as it snuggles up to a small peak to the east. Festooned with gnarly brown oaks and strewn with thick roots, the land is not easy to traverse. The underbrush is dense with thorny plants of all types that seem to delight in catching on clothes and skin.
111880:
A long-tailed bird watches you from the vegetation.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

The rocks and trees seem to be competing for dominance in this area. On every rising rocky hill, dozens of dark oaks perch like flocks of vultures. The trees cast long shadows during the day and obscure the moonlight at night. For that reason, the way is dim and treacherous for foot and hoof alike.
111881: A fallen tree lies on the ground, its clump of roots pointing upwards.

The landscape here is blasted and lifeless. The rocky hills are covered with the corpses of trees that look like old men who died standing up while holding each other. The once-verdant foliage, although dead, is nevertheless thick enough to keep out most sunlight, making the area dim.
111882: Massive, black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy.

Dark trees march across the rising landscape like squads of black troops. Gnarled and weathered by time, hoary oaks seem to huddle together blocking out most of the sunlight overhead as the undergrowth crunches drily with each step. The hills rise and leap as if competing with each other to see who can go higher.
111883: A patch of orange mushrooms springs from the ground here.

Though sometimes rising above the treeline proper, these hills have still been overtaken by clumps of dark trees and bushes that seem to have formed social cliques. The land rises and falls sharply and the way is littered with snaggly roots and shifting loose rock.
111884:
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

Conquered by trees and bushes, these hills nevertheless stand tall as they slope up and down in waves. The forest canopy seems intent on keeping sunlight from ever reaching the ground as a network of interwoven branches provide continual shade. Small rodents nervously squeak here and there and birds seem to flit from tree to tree as if uncomfortable on their perches.
111885: A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.

The tree-covered hills roll in all directions, gradually descending in height to the south and east. Dense thickets fill in the gaps between clumps of dark, gloomy trees. Intermixed with occasional patches of boulders protruding from the earth are the clenching roots of black oaks and dark pines. A steep slope leads downward to a dark valley.
111886: The hilly land seems to be locked in a preternatural gloom as drooping trees whisper soft rumours to each other with each gust of wind. Animal noises are muted and the air itself feels tense and oppressive. Skeletal roots erupt from the rocky terrain like bony claws intent on making travel difficult and tiresome.
111887: The landscape, in shape of a gentle slope, is filled with towering black barked oaks blocking out the sky. The slope slants into a forest to the east, while hills dominate the horizon to the north, west and south. A black and white moss covers the boulder-strewn slope, and foul smelling fungi thrive in the shadows cast by the larger stones.
111888: An ancient fungus smothers the boulders.

Rows of ancient, gnarled oaks and firs line a boulder-strewn ridge. There are wide gaps in the canopy above rocky outcroppings and the largest boulders. The undergrowth, mostly small bushes, grow in clusters around these rocks and boulders, where the openings in the canopy are like an oasis from the eternal gloom of Mirkwood.
111889:
A sprawling, twisted tree grows here.
On the tree, there are a few hawthorn berries.

Trees with dark brown bark grow in sparsely spread rows, the gaps between them filled with various berry bushes and thorny briars. Black moss covers much of the trees' trunks, and a type of bone-white lichen, which gently swings whenever a breeze sifts through Mirkwood, hangs from the gnarly branches.
111890: Some black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy towards you.

A hill rises up amongst the forest, covered in thorny briar patches and spindly bushes. Some oak trees grow scattered across the knoll, with bone-white, thorny vines dangling from their gnarled limbs. Although the forest is sparse, the crowns of these ancient giants reach dozens of feet in all directions, as if reaching for one another.
111891: Along this forested ridge, the trees grow tall and in abundance, their branches hanging low and intertwined with neighbouring trees, creating a dense canopy of limbs and leaves. Grey and green lichen is draped across the branches, dangling low and touching the various shrubs and thorny bushes that sprout up next to the trees.
111892: A rabid rabbit is here, frothing at the mouth.

The terrain rises up from the surrounding hills to this overgrown ridge. The trees growing here are short and squat, and covered in moss and vines weighing their branches down so that they almost rest on the ground. Rubble and boulders form a steep slope up to a higher plateau that rises above the forest to the east.
111893: A small black cricket is here, chirping loudly.

Large, sprawling shrubs and bushes flourish on the slopes and on top of a green knoll. A few tall oaks grow on the slopes, spreading their branches over the undergrowth. The undergrowth is dominated by barberry bushes with flowers and berries in shades of yellow, red and white.
111894:
A pile of dry, brown leaves lies here.
A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.

The jumbled woods of this area feature short and gnarled oak trees, twisting their branches in an upward angle. Black briar bushes with spindly arms grow in clusters around most trees, causing a rasping, scratching noise as they scrape against the trunks. Dead leaves and detritus are scattered across the forest floor, creating a foul yet earthy odour.
111895: Short and squat thorny bushes fully dominate the undergrowth, creating a nearly impenetrable barrier to traverse through. The spindly branches slowly move in the stale, humid air of these woods. A few solemn oak trees stand tall among the briars. Their creaking, rustling branches seem to tear and rend at the air. The wood is alive with noises and the trees' crowns flutter with dark moths and black butterflies.
111896: The barren nature of this forest creates an eerie atmosphere. A noxious, gaseous cloud rises up from the muddy surface covering the forest floor, as if terrible things rotted beneath the ground and released these toxic fumes. A few pale trees can be seen rising up through the mist, with their gnarled roots hidden under the wisps of gas.
111897: A large, loyal falcon is circling above.

The densely forested terrain of the surrounding Mirkwood finds no foot-holds on this plateau. The ground is bare or consists of moss-covered rock, with boulders and jutting crags scattered across its surface. Being elevated above the forest, the view from this peak is quite breath-taking. Resilient grass and hardy weeds still manage to find cracks and crevices in which to take root on this lofty, stony apex.
111898:
A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

Dense, dark vegetation grows thick through these woods, the blades of bushes and trees in shades of green so dark it often appears black. Black oak trees sprawl across the landscape, their roots crawling in and out of a soil covered in green moss. A patch of nightshade bushes, surrounded by spotted mushrooms, grows at the centre of a grove of towering oaks.
111899:
A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

The trees in this forest grow short and squat, with stunted branches growing at odd angles. Black lichen hangs thickly from the twisted limbs, swinging gently whenever a breeze rustles the leaves above. Vines wrap around the short trees, oozing a stinking liquid out of their wooden pores.
111900: The menacing nature of these woods is derived from its impenetrable nature; the trees grow closely together, with vegetation of all sorts growing between them. Branches droop low, with the vines draping them reaching the ground. The dense growth literally blocks any light coming from the outside.
111901: The forest is thin here on a hill rising above the surrounding Mirkwood. Dark blue-green crab grass grows tall and dense across this knoll, with a few bushes sprouting up in the recesses of the slope where most shade can be found. The occasional fir can be seen, few and far in between; the rich smell of grass permeates the air.
111902: A huge gnarled oak tree is here, looming ominously overhead.

Rows of massive trees dominate this wooded region. Their branches growing long and thick, the leaves wide and flat. Ample shade and fertile soil has provided a home to a myriad of plants and fungi. Spiny shrubs grow tall and spotted mushrooms are found in abundance around the gnarled tree roots.
111903: The terrain rises up out of the forest, affording a better view of the surroundings. The dark green vegetation that thrives here sprouts up from the rich soil. An earthen smell is potent throughout this area, the moisture evaporating off of the ground. Tall trees grow with twisting limbs, arms covered with grey lichen.
111904: A cluster of dark green, feathery fronds flourishes in the shade.

Sprawling masses of oak trees form a thick grove, their limbs sprouting out leaves so dense they block out any incoming sunlight. Tall briar shrubs grow between any open spaces their roots allow them to take. Little air moves through this stale forest, making the environment stifling and humid.
111905: Ancient oak trees grow tall in these woods, their massive branches overlapping high in the air to create a dense roof of leaf, twig and vine. Thick and gnarled roots grow outwards from the trees and crawl across the forest floor. Patches of moist ground and mud collect in depressions and other low terrain, and thorny shrubs sprout around these mud-pools.
111906:
A man's-waist high evergreen shrub grows here, with bright green branches.
On the shrub, there are several splayed leaves.

The undergrowth here consists mostly of mud and trampled grass. Several trees, oaks that stood for hundreds of years, lie uprooted in the mud, rotting away. Great scratch marks mar the bark on several of the trees; both standing ones and their less fortunate kin in the mud. Sticky, oozing vines hang from branches, pale and sickly-looking, in stark contrast to the dark brown trunks.
111907: A low but steeply sloping mountain range runs through Mirkwood here, offering a view of the dense jungle-like woods below. Much of the ridge is tree-covered; between trees spiny, sprawling thorn bushes grow wild. Black vines hang down from the trees' branches, slithering on top of and through the bushes.
111908:
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

Large oaks grow at various angles on this ridge, their gnarled branches swaying slowly in the breeze. The sides of the ridge fall away steeply but the ridge itself is flat except for scattered, moss-covered rocks. A few black thorny bushes grow in a cluster around a lone, large boulder.
111909: Jagged rocks covered in a slimy moss cover this steep ridge; stunted oaks form rows along the top of the ridge, sprouting from in-between rocks wherever there is enough space. Branches intertwine above to form a dense, low-hanging canopy.
111910: The terrain here is a sharp incline, offering a view over the surrounding tangled woods. Large oak trees grow across the spine of the ridge; dark and slight blackberry shrubs cover the steep slopes. A few large boulders entirely covered in moss lie on the slopes where they blend in seamlessly with the vegetation.
111911:
A mountain ibex is jumping from rock to rock.
A mountain ibex is jumping from rock to rock.

Rising out of the forest proper, this foothill of the surrounding mountains includes an intact canopy of tall, black trees standing like watchtowers. The ground slopes down to the east for relatively easy travel while to the south the jumble of boulders and thick brush blocks passage.
111912:
A mountain ibex is jumping from rock to rock.
A mountain ibex is jumping from rock to rock.
A mountain ibex is jumping from rock to rock.
A mountain ibex is jumping from rock to rock.

A firm line of tall firs and dark oaks crowns this rocky area as the stony foothills grow into small mountains to the west. The ground undulates as it rises westward making travel fatiguing. Wet leaves and slippery verdigris mosses cloak almost every exposed surface, adding to the treacherous passage.
111913: The dark trees spread their reaching, grasping branches overhead, menacing anyone who travels underneath. Tough, dark bushes spring up all around, making a straight passage impossible, and to the west the face of a steep cliff cuts through the forest. Frequently, small moss-covered rocks punch through the leaf-covered ground.
111915: A sparse row of black oaks rise throughout these woods, beset on all sides by large and thorny bramble patches. Tangled ivy crawls from bush to branch, blanketing the vegetation. The dark, prickly brambles dominate the undergrowth, scratching anyone who is bold enough to attempt the plunge through them.
111916: The conifer trees that once stood tall and proud in this small clearing have been utterly destroyed, some even torn with their roots. It appears that the bark on these fallen logs have been gnawed on by some large creatures. A foul odour emanates from the soil, and the weeds and grass are stomped flat into the stinky muck.
111917: A huge gnarled oak tree is here, looming ominously overhead.

The trees in this area are nearly obsidian in colour, the bark emanating a darkness typical of these woods. Perhaps it is a trick of the light, of which there is very little due to the thick and tangled canopy above. Black roots crawl through the damp terrain around the oak trees, spreading across the forest floor.
111918: Dark and twisted oak trees grow thickly in these woods, thorny bushes scraping against their bark. Vines crawl down the low hanging limbs touching the spiky vegetation. The forest floor is teeming with dark grass; thick, gnarled roots crawl through it. The dense canopy obstructs the view of the sky.
111919:
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.

The air in these woods is stifling and humid. A thin mist rises between the roots that crawl through the mud. Moss and a vast plethora of fungi sprout up around the bases of the old twisted oaks. A patch of large, thorny bushes grows in a dip of the terrain, their branches reaching up defiantly as if hoping to get a fresh breeze by some miracle.
111920: Pitch-black water with a strange smell has collected here.

The ground is cast in shadows as the crowns of the trees provide shade from sun- and moonlight alike. A small dirty-looking pool has formed between some roots, perhaps filled by the raindrops drizzling down the tops of trees. A few shrubs sprout up along the edges of the pool, their leaves of dark, sickly green.
111921: Tall, ancient trees stand proudly amongst the tangled undergrowth, reaching up towards the skies, their trunks holding up a vast, entangled canopy. A few large rocks are piled up near the centre of a ring of oaks, covered in roots and steeped in moss. Broad and black fallen leaves are scattered around the forest floor.
111922: The trees in these parts of Mirkwood are stunted in their growth with wide, gnarly trunks covered in coarse, mossy bark. Their branches twist and bend, interlocking with each tree next to it in a tangled embrace. Their dark leaves grow wide and flat and lichen dangles from the canopy like grasping grey-brown tentacles.
111924: A pile of dry, brown leaves lies here.

Tall pines grow here, shrouded in darkness. Black moss clings to the bark of the trees and mottled grey-black vines hang down from their branches. Shaded bracken grows thick around the trunks of the trees, thriving in the eternal gloom beneath the canopy of Mirkwood.
111925:
Pitch-black water with a strange smell has collected here.
A large brown snake with black patches is coiled here.
A tree-snake lies wrapped around one of the tree branches.

A ring of immense, gnarled black trees occupies this area, their branches intertwining high above to form a dark canopy that casts a shadow over these woods. The knotted roots of these towering trees spread out in a crooked pattern, forming a sort of bowl on the forest floor. Water has collected in this basin between the trees, dark and putrid from mingling with oozing sore-like wounds of the roots.
111927:
A sprawling, twisted tree grows here.
On the tree, there are a few hawthorn berries.
A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.

Squat, dark oak trees sprawl across the landscape with their branches drooping toward the ground. Black vines dangle from the branches, reaching all the way down to the forest floor, thus creating a shifting black-green curtain of vegetation. Lichen grows on the vines, making them look like hairy tangled arms grasping and dragging at the thorny briar shrubs that grow thickly amidst the gnarled trees.
111928: The darkness envelops this area at all times of day; an overgrown and twisted forest canopy spreads across the tree tops. Low-hanging branches tangle into one another, connecting the trees to form walls of foliage that hinder travel in several directions. The little grass growing here is dull and lifeless, and overgrown with thorny weeds crawling their way across the terrain.
111933: Thorny shrubbery dominates this landscape, growing wild and abundant in all directions. The thorn-clad branches of these prickly bushes sway whenever the slightest breeze blows through them. Many towering, dark trees stand defiant among the briars, with dense foliage blocking the view to the sky.
111934: Massive, black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy.

Amidst the short and stocky trees of these surroundings some thick brambled bushes grow, making access and travel very tedious and difficult. Thorny branches scratch and drag at anything that moves along the forest floor and tree roots crawl up through the soil. The branches stretch from tree to tree with vines hanging down from them.
111936: A very heavy branch is lying here on the ground.

Tall and venerable oak trees stand proud here in these woods, untouched by time and the elements. Grey lichen hangs from the gnarled branches and moss covers the rough bark, crawling its way upward to the few rays of light that manage to pierce through the forest canopy. A musty odour rises up from the damp vegetation on the forest floor.
111937: The tall, gnarly trees that populate this part of Mirkwood creak and groan even when there is no wind to shake their crowns. A heavily intertwined canopy consisting of vines, branches and leaves grows so densely that hardly any natural light breaks through it. Gnarled black roots crawl across the forest floor, oozing a stinky sap from sore-like wounds in their bark.
111938: A colossal tree, its trunk as wide as a small cottage, stands here.

Gnarled and squat oaks stand here with their branches drooping, as if protecting the short, thorny brambles growing around their trunks. The musty smell of stale air rises from the roots and the vegetation. Black and brown leaves cover the forest floor, crunching noisily when stepped on.
111939: Travelling is quite difficult in the tangled vegetation of this flourishing valley. Mountain sides can be seen through the dark green leaves that intertwine to form a dense but not impenetrable canopy above. The overgrown floor of the dell continues to the west, while travel in other directions is cut off by the steep walls of the Emyn-nu-Fuin.
111940: The vegetation in these woods grows wild and thick along a steep slope, causing a difficult traverse through the landscape. Dark and tangled roots grow on the forest floor beneath the twisted and stunted oaks; lichen hanging down from low branches. A few moss-covered rocks are strewn across ground, with spiny thornbushes cropping up in-between.
111942: The walls are crudely fashioned from a strong but plain digging technique that simply shoveled unwanted rock and dirt out of the way. Claw and blade marks can be seen biting into surfaces here and there. The dusty rock floor has been disturbed recently as tracks come from the west yet the only entrance appears to be from above. Trash and rotting debris decorate the edges of this space.
111944: A very short plant with bright white flowers is growing here.

The rocky terrain slopes up and down, following the shape of a heavily forested ridge that ascends to the west. Chunks of granite punch upwards between the huge trees like stony fists and numerous moss-covered roots twist on the ground ready to trip, grab and trap anyone coming too close to them. Overhead, dark branches have intertwined to form a dense canopy.
111945: A mountain ridge slowly rises to the west as the ground seems to deepen and mature. Massive trees with dark trunks and occasional boulders precariously perched atop rock walls line the ways leading north and south. The ground slopes down to the east as it continues into a dark, forested area.
111946: A large pile of boulders is sitting here, probably debris from a rockslide.

Loose rocks and hardy roots litter the rocky area, making walking on foot difficult and unpleasant. The land slopes downhill to the east and north while a steep drop to the south leads to dark, stony paths. Looking in most directions presents an impressive view of Mirkwood. However, to the west, a rocky protrusion lifts up and out to an even higher vantage point.
111947: A faint trail can be followed, coming out of a ridge to the east and heading up into a higher mountainous area. The way is narrow due to rock ledges and walls on either side that seem to greedily want for attention. The rocky overhangs block out most light and keep the area eternally dim.
111948: The hilly forest slopes up and down, seemingly at random. Black pines rise from the grey, crumbly rock to form a canopy that stretches in all directions, filtering and blocking out most of the light. Several large, cracked boulders lie on the forest floor.
111949:
A small mushroom grows nearby.
A black squirrel peers down from the branches of the trees.

The hills here have been taken over by thick stands of tall oak and birch that spreads their branches above to form a dense canopy. The ground slopes downward to the north and the forest floor gets increasingly wet further down. Some plants like ferns and others that thrive in shade grow among a layer of leaves that carpets the ground.
111950:
A snake slithers towards you.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

A row of thickly forested hills leans away from the mountain slopes to the north. Ancient, sprawling trees and numerous boulders with moss-covered surfaces cover the ground. Crowded by thick brush and dark weeds, passage is only possible to the east and south.
111951: Thick, dark oaks and dense pines grow side by side like formations of marching soldiers. Criss-crossed branches shoot down at all angles like crossed spears and enormous, gnarled roots twist with stout vines to make passage impossible to the north. The ground begins to slope to the west while to the south, dark silence pervades the woods.
111952: Huge, black oaks stand like sentinels, their great branches outstretched and entangled so that no sunlight ever reaches the forest floor. Several trees have fallen, effervescent mildew covering their rotting, corpse-like trunks. A haze drifts in from the north making any kind of travel hazardous. The air is so thick it feels like being underwater. On either side of a small worn trail, ominous roots, covered with dead leaves, encourage passage through a large, black pool of liquid that makes no movement, not even in the strongest wind.
111955:
A nest is here.
A mother eagle flies high above, looking for prey.
A small, helpless eaglet screams for more food.
A small, helpless eaglet screams for more food.
A small, helpless eaglet screams for more food.

A rather wide expanse of shale has been thrust upward like an outstretched arm with the palm face-up. The result is a majestic, commanding view of the surrounding areas: thickly forested Mirkwood to the west, dark hills to the south, and darker patches of trees to the east. In the north, misty clouds seems to permanently obscure any views in a thick haze.
111965: A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.

On all sides, the forest slopes down to a bowl-shaped valley, nestled deep within the hills. Pierced by rocky outcroppings, the way back up is tangled with jutting roots and hanging vines that seem ready to trap anyone fool enough to try going back up. In the exact middle of the valley is a smooth rocky expanse with no undergrowth on it.
111969: A dense wall of trees rings a foetid pond that occupies the lowest depths of a broad valley. The water of the pool absorbs all light, guarding the secret of what lies beneath its surface. Several barren trunks of long-dead trees stand in the midst of the toxic water. The roots nearest to the pond blacken and shrivel as they carry poison back to their dying trees. A muddy slope to the west feeds the pond with black, sticky mud.
111984: A recent landslide from the shelf above this plateau has torn through wide ranks of fir trees. Shattered trunks protrude from beneath the boulders that struck them down. Fuzzy moss already grows on the mounds of rock, making a soft yet slippery blanket.
111985:
A nest is here.
Kral the Zaugurz scout surveys the forest far below.

Large boulders shelter a niche in the cliff wall that hides a secluded eyrie. The niche offers a clear view of a valley full of blighted, dying trees. Damp, acrid mist drifts from a tunnel that carves into the cliff to the south. A distant roar of falling water emanates from the tunnel.
111988: A deft, young orc monitors the area, ready to attack any enemy.

The thickly growing trees and shrubs around this small enclosed space create a perfect hiding place inside the shrubbery. The growth of vines, brush, and trees is so thick that it blocks all directions except back to the east through the shrubs. A road is visible to the south behind the shrubs and trees.
111989: Border of a Fell, Stygian Forest

Dark trees rise high in the gloom of their own canopy, from which a plethora of vines reach down in odd, intertwined patterns. The impression is that of a gigantic cobweb made of plantlife, each silken thread of the web as thick as a wrist. The undergrowth of ferns and thorny bushes is dense and inhospitable, although a perfect habitat for snakes and lizards, and anything else that slithers or crawls.
111990: The aged trees that dominate most ancient forest are largely absent here. Only a few scattered oaks, ancient and gnarled sentinels, remain standing. Between thorny bushes and those few sprawling ancients, a vast number of saplings grow. The young trees grow in odd shapes, leaning and twisting against and around each other as if involved in a physical struggle.
111992: In the Shadow of a Fell Tree
A warped tree draped with lichen reigns over a quiet clearing.

The forest here is hidden in shadows and gloom. The canopy above is impenetrable and the undergrowth consists mainly of ferns and other plants that need little light. There is an open area, free of other trees and plants, around a twisted black tree, as if it consumes the light with such absoluteness that nothing else can survive near it. Though no greater in stature than the other trees, it seems to loom over them as the queen of this region of Mirkwood.
112000: Fringe of a Fell, Stygian Forest

The forest here is completely overgrown and moving through it is almost impossible. Especially the thickets and bushes, equipped with sharp, black thorns, hinder movement. The branches of the ancient oaks growing here shift and rustle in the wind, but sometimes louder noises are heard as unseen animals move through the undergrowth.
112001: Tangled Maze in a Fell Forest

The thorns on the thickets here are black and sharp. From the tips of the thorns, there is some sort of liquid seeping out. The undergrowth is almost impassable, although it is slightly less dense to the west, where the crowns of several ancient, sprawling oaks block the sunlight with such finality that only smaller ferns grow under them. In the bushes and thickets, there's the occasional rustling sound as something moves through it unseen.
112007: Thorns and Brambles in a Fell Forest

A dark, sinuous form lurks in the shadows.
A lichen-draped tree, hoary and warped, grows among the thickets.

The forest growth has become a mayhem of entangled branches, vines, and thorn-clad bushes. The mere act of walking ten feet in a straight line presents an almost impossible challenge. Thick, gnarled roots crawl across the ground, largely hidden underneath the foliage.
112009: Edge of a Fell, Stygian Forest

The canopy of Mirkwood allows for some glimpses of sky between boughs and leaves. Even so, not even the brightest summer day could lift the shadows that rest over these woods like a suffocating blanket. The trees, ancient and gnarled, are chiefly a mix of oak and aspen with the odd sprawling linden interspersed with them. High ferns thrive in the space between the tree trunks and the forest floor is completely obscured.
112010: Fell Oaks within a Shadowy Forest

Towering ancient oaks dominate the forest here. Some of these have stood rooted in the same spot for thousands of years. Massive, gnarled roots crawl across the forest floor. The largest are thick and high enough to conceal a pony standing on the other side. Few species of plants grow beneath the dense foliage of the oaks, but these are ideal conditions for the ferns that thrive here.
112012: Tangled Maze in a Fell Forest

This part of Mirkwood is overrun by infernal bushes reaching more than ten feet high. They are covered in wicked thorns and form thick walls that completely obscure the other side from view. What might be narrow paths can be seen in some places, although it is impossible to say if they lead anywhere. A lifetime could be spent being scratched and torn while trying to find a way out of here.
112015:
A black, thorny bush grows here, enshrouded in a murky gloom.
On the bush, there is a black, corrupted flower.
A fallen tree lies on the ground, its clump of roots pointing upwards.
A black snake hurries towards you with sly intentions.

In this corner of the forest, there are a lot of broken branches and fallen trees on the ground. Something huge has crashed mindlessly through the forest, not caring about neither the thorny bushes nor the trees. The forest seems to be passable only to the west, although the ever-shifting foliage makes it hard to see a clear path.
112020:
A gaunt, vicious-looking warg pads towards you, jaws slavering hungrily.
A gaunt, vicious-looking warg pads towards you, jaws slavering hungrily.

An area next to the main outpost has been fenced in by a solid-looking fence of thick, crooked branches and smaller trunks. The enclosed area is located between three big pine trees and the outer palisade encircling the whole outpost. Inside the area, there are many gnawed bones and one bloody, half-eaten carcass of an ox-like animal lying on the ground.
112026: Some small rocks have been piled into a mound here.

Slick round stones form a peculiar pattern on the ground amidst long patches of dried stiff thickets harbouring long, hollow thorns ending in needle-like points. Great natural stone walls block most natural light from entering the bottom of the chasm, and above, tall firs overshadow it. The walls are very steep, save for one point where a narrow path leads upwards.
112027:
The corpse of *a Hobbit* is lying here.
A domesticated pony, beast of burden to many, stands here.
The shadow of *a Hobbit* is floating here.

Several clumps of dirt and small, round stones litter the bottom of the chasm, which is framed by smooth, tall cliffs that impede natural light, only to be broken up by a small opening to the west. Dry, green-brown shrubs, some over two feet high, grow on the bottom of the chasm, the sole vegetation to be found.
112029: A bear is here, covered with coarse black fur.

This narrow tunnel runs a few feet beneath the forest floor of Mirkwood. Thick roots poke through the roof, making the low tunnel even lower. A small stream of black water crosses the tunnel at its lowest part, creating a wide pool of mud around it. The tunnel might serve as the lair of a wild animal, as bones, some with meat still clinging to them, litter the ground.
112031: A narrow valley extends to the west and east, nestled between low mountains to the north and south. Packed with trees consisting primarily of dark oaks with a smattering of coniferous types, the shadows from the mountains combine with the broad, stretching canopy and tangly vines that creep along the floor to create a deep unending darkness.
112032:
Some thick writhing vines whip all around you.
An ancient fungus smothers the boulders.
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.
A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.

A forested valley is sheltered by low mountains to the north and south as it dead-ends into a steep cliff wall along the eastern edge. Beneath the forest canopy, sickly moulds and twisting vines intertwine with one another amidst great lichen-covered boulders and large slabs of cold granite.
112033: A mountain mule (ulo) is standing here, ridden by you.

Oak and fir trees seem to mesh with one another in a small wooded valley, the branches and leaves overlapping to create a blur of dark vegetation and blackness beyond. Thorny vines and bristly roots cover the forest floor under the shadow of the great trees looming above.
112034: The canopy and entwined branches of the dark and gnarled trees keep this area of the valley eternally dark. Gigantic black roots spread out like cobwebs from the feet of what must be extremely ancient oaks. A wrathful anger is almost palpable, seeming to emanate from the hateful trees that stand tall and ruthless above the inhospitable ground beneath them.
112035: Pitch-black water with a strange smell has collected here.

Old, gnarled trees form a natural barrier as their branches wrap around one another, twisting into a complex bark-covered mesh. A small puddle has collected in a depression in the ground, made up of murky black water that continues to drip from the overhanging trees. Boulders appear to have tumbled down from the mountains that rise to the west and south, coming to rest violently in the soft earth beneath the tall trees amid their ruthless strangling roots.
112036: A pile of dry, brown leaves lies here.

Immensely tall, pitch black oaks tower over the stifled dusty ground below. The sharp ridged bark of the merciless trees seems to carve its way out of the rot-filled soil, littered with the remnants of smaller vegetation that partially wasted away long ago but that never fully decayed. The thickness of the great black roots that burst forth from the rancid ground make even some of the broader branches look thin by comparison.
112037: A great collection of crudely-hewn stumps jut up from the mountainous ground among many large rocks that lie interspersed with the few fir trees that still grow in this part of Mirkwood. Some of the stones are blackened with ash, and the surrounding woods seem to produce a feeling of tenseness. The air is stuffy and thick with malice.
112038: Few trees remain of what was once undoubtedly a densely forested mountainside. Numerous trees appear to have been crudely hacked down and limbed here. Evidence of a recent campfire is apparent, with charred wood in a pile nestled under an ash-covered boulder. Other blackened rocks are visible with similar traces, appearing as though they too had been exposed to a recent fire.
112039:
An elaborate red flower sits within a dark mass of briars.
Some thick writhing vines whip all around you.
Some thick writhing vines whip all around you.
A mass of wriggling vines drops on you from the trees.
A mass of wriggling vines drops on you from the trees.

Hulking twisting tree trunks interlock with great gnarled boughs and branches to form an inhospitable wasteland beneath the black lightless canopy of Mirkwood. Long murderous vines squeeze both root and trunk, sapping life from every living thing that they touch. Crusted lichen dangles from the serrated bark of the towering trees, while wicked thorn-filled brush chokes out all other vegetation from the forest floor.
112040:
A tangled creeper writhes its shoots between the forest's roots upwards.
A mass of wriggling vines drops on you from the trees.
A mass of wriggling vines drops on you from the trees.

Down in a shallow crack of the forest floor lies a rugged miniature canyon covered entirely over its top by thick tangled vines. The vines grow so numerous here that they themselves block all light that might have reached the bottom of the crack, twisting this way and that along the stone walls as they throttle all other living things.
112041: Loose slimy rocks and sprawling roots cover the ground beneath the sea of trees that loom dark and ominously above. Shiny, slippery portions of wet roots protrude at various points from the dark moist soil. The ground becomes extremely steep to the north as it climbs toward the peaks of the Mountains of Mirkwood.
112042:
A large boulder is here, it must be heavy.
Some black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy towards you.
Some thick writhing vines whip all around you.
Some black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy towards you.
Some thick writhing vines whip all around you.
A tangled creeper writhes its shoots between the forest's roots upwards.
A small, dense tangle of roots covers the ground.

Every manner of parasitic vine and creeper have entirely overtaken the forest here via strangulation and murderous sap-sucking conquest. Thick, gnarled bodies of strangely long, agile tentacles have forced their way under root and over boulder, choking all other life from this place in a ruthless and magnificent display of tangled tortuous takeover.
112043: A black squirrel peers down from the branches of the trees.

Dark, enveloping coniferous trees peer over the rising mountain slope facing the south. Great bulbous root balls grow precariously atop sprawling stone slabs beneath the menacing trees. Smooth, rocky cliffs form an impassable line to the east while to the west and north, the forest climbs upward with the mountain.
112044:
A great pine tree is here, ancient beyond reckoning.
A black squirrel peers down from the branches of the trees.

Gloomy pine trees with cold, dry needles grow here atop the lower Mountains of Mirkwood. Stunted bushes and vegetation struggle to survive in the darkness on the cold stoney ground. Each tree has broken its way through a tough layer of bedrock as it took root in some miniscule crack long ago, splitting the stone as it aged over countless years.
112045:
Some small rocks have been piled into a mound here.
A black squirrel peers down from the branches of the trees.

The steep slope is covered with massive boulders that form small crawl spaces beneath and around various stones, making up a network of tiny tunnels and crevices in the darkness beneath the canopy of the forest. A large sprawling field of sharp rocks covers much of the soil around the bases of the trees, indicating that a landslide occurred here in the recent past.
112046: A black squirrel peers down from the branches of the trees.

Small scraggly shrubs grow among withered fir trees that overlook a massive cliff to the west. Dark boughs loom high above the steep rocky soil surrounding one great stone peak that rises up into the dense canopy, disappearing in its dark tangled mass.
112047: The denseness of the forest even on this lower peak ensures that not a single ray of sunlight reaches the rocky ground. Towering trees rise upward from steep mountainsides with their massive roots brutally plunging deep into the stone as they seek sustenance and stability. Small shrubs cling precariously to steep stone faces, their roots visible in the small cracks and fissures along the bedrock.
112048: A dry cavern formed inside the hard granite mountainside has been altered to serve as a modest abode. A door crafted specifically to remain hidden from the outside adorns the southern wall, though the rest of the cave appears to formed naturally. The cave continues in darkness to the north and east.
112049: A vast natural cavern has formed here with a tall ceiling supported by thick columns of pure granite. The smooth stone suggests that water flowed through here at one time, though the cavern is entirely dry and appears as though it has remained absent of moisture for many years. The floor is worn smooth, tilting slightly upward toward the north which disappears into further darkness.
112050: Uneven stone surfaces and sudden dark crevices with no bottom in sight fill this cavern drowned in darkness. Strange stone steppes climb up in seemingly arbitrary locations, only to fall steeply down below the floor. Sharp ridges of splintered rock jut up from the uneven floor in various locations, while dark alcoves and corners lead to dead-ends along the northern and western walls.
112051:
A water barrel has been left here.
A great stone table has been set here.
A young ill-tempered stone giant is here, muttering incoherently.
A huge stone giant is here, glaring at you.
A young ill-tempered stone giant is here, muttering incoherently.

A large alcove is tucked back in the corner of the larger cave system, and it is currently serving as a home for some very large humanoids. The alcove, which would be considered a modest-sized cavern to most, is adorned with a massive stone table that sits in the centre of the room. The inhabitants of this humble abode appear to live modestly, not caring for subtle pleasantries normally found in most dwellings.
112052: Clumps of withered pines grow here amidst a grove of stumps that have clearly been hacked apart by axes. Many large rocks cover the ground, covered in blackened ash and other signs of recent campfires. To the north thick foliage dominates the forest floor between massive severed tree trunks.
112053:
A Durbuk-hai warrior is here, ill-equipped but ready to fight for his tribe.
A Durbuk-hai warrior is here, ill-equipped but ready to fight for his tribe.
A Durbuk-hai warrior is here, ill-equipped but ready to fight for his tribe.
An elite Durbuk-hai guard is standing here, armed with spear and shield.

Tall dark tree trunks crowd each other on the hillsides in every direction surrounding a sudden depression that cleaves its way down into the earth. The cavern opening appears as a black maw, even in the darkness of the thick forest canopy that prevents natural light from penetrating to the uneven ground below.
112054: This cavern descends away from a cave mouth to the south. The western side is lower than the eastern, a continuation of the slanting entrance. Narrow crevices in the deeper part of the cavern are filled with brackish, silty water. One of these crevices cuts into the western wall, where it opens into a broad pool.
112055:
Something cold and scaly slithers past your leg.
Something cold and scaly slithers past your leg.

A dark pool covers the entire floor of a high-ceilinged chamber. The pool is shallow in various places where sand bars rise to the surface. Deep crevices filled with opaque water make it difficult to discern the difference between shallow and deep areas. The stagnant oily water is occasionally disturbed by bubbles that ominously rise to the surface from unknown depths below. A gap in the eastern wall leads to a north-south passage that slants upward away from the pool.
112056: This north-south passage slants steeply across its axis. The high side along the eastern wall is relatively level, making for sound footing. The passage falls away from this natural path, narrowing eventually into waterlogged crevices. A few shattered and rotten logs lie in the deep side of the passage.
112057: A noticeable crack runs down one of the walls.

This passage has an oblong cross section which is slightly tilted so that the eastern end is higher than the western. Jagged cracks crisscross the walls and ceiling of the passage, none more than several inches wide. Water seeps from the cracks, running westward down the slanted passage and into a wide gap that seems to broaden as it disappears into the ground.
112058:
A young orc grips his weapon impatiently, eager to prove himself.
A Durbuk-hai warrior is here, ill-equipped but ready to fight for his tribe.
A deft Durbuk-hai slinger lurks in the shadows.

Several dark, forbidding openings lead away from this great intersection. Some of the exits are small, no larger than crawlspaces. Others are so great that an Oliphant could stand in them. While the cavern's origin is no doubt natural, it is now the habitat of creatures that dump their refuse in piles along the walls and create paths that lead to and from the various tunnels.
112059: A large natural cavern is worn into the bedrock here by untold years of flowing water. Frequently used paths are clearly marked on the floor leading off in all directions, while refuse and unidentifiable junk is scattered in piles along the walls. A low opening that is rounded and much smoother than the surrounding rock allows passage to the south.
112060:
A broken stalagmite, ground flat, serves as a makeshift table here.
A young orc grips his weapon impatiently, eager to prove himself.
A young orc grips his weapon impatiently, eager to prove himself.
An elite Durbuk-hai guard is standing here, armed with spear and shield.

A cavern opens into a large circular grotto. A set of simple, crude stairs leads down into a deeper tunnel below. Though this part of the cave may have been natural in origin, rough work has clearly made the place more habitable. Large stalagmites have been broken off and ground down to serve as smooth table tops. The floor appears fairly level, and many of the smaller stone formations have been hewn away.
112061:
A battered warg fur has been left here.
A mass of tattered fabric lies here in a heap.
A sturdy peg for hanging armour from is on the wall.
On the peg, there are a pair of soft leather sleeves, a pair of soft leather boots, a pair of soft leather gloves, a soft leather jerkin and a pair of soft leather trousers.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack are a short spear, a sling and a wooden club.
A water barrel has been left here.
A Durbuk-hai warrior is here, ill-equipped but ready to fight for his tribe.
A Durbuk-hai warrior is here, ill-equipped but ready to fight for his tribe.
A deft Durbuk-hai slinger lurks in the shadows.

This part of the cavern descends sharply from its entrance to the south, flattening out into a broad chamber pocked with shallow pools. Water trickles down the walls and drips slowly from the ceiling. Piles of bedding lie scattered in the dry spots between pools. Each pool seems filled with sundry pieces of garbage, filling the air with the stench of rot.
112062:
A squat, grizzled orc cracks his whip with trained precision.
A gaunt, vicious-looking warg pads towards you, jaws slavering hungrily.

The walls of this enormous tunnel-like cavern are lined with deep cracks, outcroppings, and fallen scree. At a section of the western wall, which is remarkably smooth compared to the rest of the cavern, a narrow opening leads into an alcove. There are trampled paths along the cavern floor leading north, south and into the alcove.
112063:
A water barrel has been left here.
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.
A scrawny Durbuk-hai orc is here, rifling through supply crates.
A scrawny Durbuk-hai orc is here, rifling through supply crates.

Jumbled piles of miscellaneous supplies fill a large alcove connected to vast caverns to the east. Towers of half-full, opened crates sit near the entrance, their supplies spilling onto the ground. Empty crates line the wall to the west, tossed in a great heap lacking any sort of order. A layer of sawdust, splinters, and large planks covers the floor.
112064: The tall stone walls veer outward here to form a truly massive unlit cavern. The ceiling is hidden in a shroud of gloom overhead and standing against one wall reveals nothing about the other side of the cave except blackness. The ground is surprisingly soft, being apparently made from layers of gravel and sand as well as mud toward the centre of the cave. The walls narrow to the south, as if much of the had water drained away into the bedrock.
112065: In a slow majestic bend, the enormous cavern wraps itself around a rough wall of granite to the south-east. The smooth, wet stone floor continues down into the darkness as it carries on to the south. Shallow pools of dark water along the centre of the cave, coupled with patterns in the sand, seem to indicate that water occasionally flows through here.
112066: Much of the ceiling of this vast cavern is lost in gloom. Sharp, glittering tips of stalactites sprout from the darkness in various locations as water slowly drips from their tips to land on the cavern's wet floor. The ground slopes from east to west, showing signs that water recently flowed here. Though the cave appears natural in its formation, a well-trampled path follows the lowest point. Small pieces of refuse litter the ground along the subterranean trail.
112067:
A Durbuk-hai warrior is here, ill-equipped but ready to fight for his tribe.
A Durbuk-hai warrior is here, ill-equipped but ready to fight for his tribe.

An elite Durbuk-hai guard is standing here, armed with spear and shield.

Scraggly trees rise upward toward the forest canopy above the entrance to an enormous cavern. Massive stalactites hang down from the low arch of the opening itself which, together with the trees growing through the stone lip at the bottom of the entrance appear to form a great gaping maw. The cavern itself stretches away westward, fading into deep shadow.
112068: Tangled Hillside Forest at a Cavern

The thick, tangled forested hills crowd up against an enormous cavern entrance leading down into complete darkness. Great trunks rise from the very mouth of the cave opening, making the pitch black entrance appear even darker than the rest of the gloomy wood. The soil becomes softer as the ground slopes downward into the stoney recess.
112069:
A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.
A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.

Tall trees blot out the sky, leaving the hilly terrain below in a heavy darkness. The tangly roots that emanate from every trunk create large mounds of tough, gnarled wooden loops that twist and turn into one another. A mist of smelly spores hang in the air produced by pitcher-like black fungi that have overrun the forest floor.
112070:
A great pine tree is here, ancient beyond reckoning.
A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.

Mighty trees cover the rising hills in a complete darkness, dominating the landscape in every direction. Gnarled oaks and disfigured pines brood in the dense air, stifling any drafts that might be blowing above the canopy. Thick leaves cover the ground around the great trunks rising from their tough, knotted root foundations.
112076:
Some small rocks have been piled into a mound here.
A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.

A wide, rugged shelf clings to the western side of the rising Emyn-nu-Fuin. The hills jut sharply upward at the eastern edge but fall away on the western side just as abruptly. The shelf is littered with large, moss-covered boulders and jagged outcroppings clad in grey lichen. Ancient trees spread their wide branches overhead, obscuring the skies beneath a great green ceiling.
112077: A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.

Steep cliffs rise to the east and south, closing the forested shelf in on two sides. A steep slope extends away westward, covered in tangled thorny bushes and great black oaks. The shelf itself is primarily flat and dotted with large mossy boulders. Thousands of large, black butterflies flutter about just above the crowns of the ancient oaks growing on the slope to the west.
112078:
A battered warg fur has been left here.
A mass of tattered fabric lies here in a heap.
A mass of tattered fabric lies here in a heap.
A sturdy peg for hanging armour from is on the wall.
On the peg, there are a pair of rigid leather sleeves and a pair of rigid leather gloves.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack are three wooden clubs.
A scrawny Durbuk-hai orc is here scrubbing the greasy stone floor.
A young, eager Durbuk-hai warrior, wielding a handaxe, is sleeping here.
