Each step makes the small rocks slide underfoot, which gives the impression that a wrong step could start a large slide. Two massive, withered, trees grow here, with a messy pile of branches between them.
115298:
There are two iron ore fragments here.
A rusty pickaxe with a broken handle lies discarded here.
A large black bat flitters near you.
A large black bat flitters near you.
A large black bat flitters near you.

A few ruined stone buildings are clustered here, though their long-destroyed walls are razed to rubble, and there are no remnants of roofs or doors. Beside them, a deep pit has been haphazardly dug into the rust-tinged rock, though the mine workings have long since been abandoned. Multiple rockfalls have cascaded into the dark, open quarry, providing many hiding places where some predators could be lurking.
115299: This clearing ascends slowly into the southern hills of Dol Guldur. The whole clearing is covered with patches of stinging nettles and bushes with sharp thorns. A steep, crumbling cliff blocks travel to the east while the dark forest of Mirkwood extends gloomily in the north and west.
115300: The forest is thick and dark all around here. The trees look old and strong, but are strangely twisted and bent. The smell of rotten leaves lingers in the stagnant air. The forest continues to the east and west, while to the south a clearing is visible.
115301: A tangled creeper writhes its shoots between the forest's roots upwards.

Black trees cover the area. Many of them are dead. The air is stagnant and smells like the whole forest is slowly rotting away. Dead plants and thorny vines cover the ground. It seems it is only a matter of years until this area is as barren and treeless as the hills to the south and east.
115302: A black pond is here, filled with putrid water.

This stretch of forest lies in the shadows of Dol Guldur that looms to the south. The trees look sickly, their roots covered with fungi. The smell of rotten plants stands in the air. A small pond with black, muddy water lies close to the sheer cliff that marks the beginning of the mountainous land to the south. The expanse of Mirkwood continues to the east and west, following the rise of the hills.
115303: A human skeleton is chained to the tree with thick iron chains.

Black trees, most of them dark oaks, cover the slopes of this gently hilly area. There are heavily forested slopes in all directions except south, where the terrible hills of Dol Guldur hold the border of Mirkwood at bay. One high hill holds one single very large tree, it is twisted as though something has caused it great pain.
115304: The land ascends towards the east and the south. To the west are smaller hills, all thickly forested. The forest continues here, but the closer it is to the bald hills, the more trees appear to have withered and died, as though there is something poisonous that prevents them from taking root. Those twisted trees have thin, leafless crowns, and many have fallen.
115305: The land rises up from the lowlands to the west, and continue ever upwards to the east. There are some trees here, and a lot of undergrowth. Some deforestation has taken place towards the west near the foot of the hills.
115306: The terrain is difficult to travel. The hills are steep and criss-crossed by small cracks and fissures. A dense forest grows on the slopes, with plenty of undergrowth, mostly thornbushes, that make movement difficult. Suddenly the forest ends, as the hill ends in almost vertical drops to the east and south.
115307: The slopes of these cracked hills are densely covered by a variety of plantlife. Most have either nasty thorns or look poisonous and sickly, with leaves covered in thin slimy layers of vicious fluids. The slopes are caught between steeper hills to the west and Mirkwood to the east. A jagged crevice splits the hillside apart to the south, too wide to jump or otherwise pass safely.
115308:
A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

Dark pines dominate this valley, but a strong storm has uprooted many of the old trees. A bright, green moss covers the fallen trees. A thick, brown layer of pine needles covers the ground, giving a soft crackle whenever stepped on. To the south, the forest thickens even more, and the shadows reign under the trees.
115309:
An elaborate red flower sits within a dark mass of briars.
A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.

The forest consists of dark oaks and groves of tall, black firs. The ground is soft. Thick layers of rotting compost fill the air with their smell. Entangling roots and vines are hidden under the surface, forcing every traveller to be cautious. Despite the rich plantlife, the forest lacks any sign of animal life.
115310:
A shimmering glow is here, emitting pale, green, light.
A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.
A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.
A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.

This forest is extremely dark and the trees look very old. Most are gnarly oaks with dark, almost black, bark. The trees rustle, crack, and creak constantly, as if agitated. There is little undergrowth visible, as scant sunlight reaches the ground. In the northern part of this area grow many bushes of somehow strange roses. Their long needle-like thorns make travel perilous.
115311:
A green-skinned hill troll is pacing around with a nervous zeal.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.
A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.

The woods here are made up of ancient trees, covered with moss and creeping vines that draw their nourishment from the vast trunks. The ground below the trees lies in an eternal shadow. The undergrowth is very sparse except on the southern border where the forest thins into a clearing.
115313:
You see two mushrooms on the ground.
A black, thorny bush grows here, enshrouded in a murky gloom.
A bright red mushroom is growing here.
A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

Black oaks and alders make up this part of the forest. Their limbs and leaves form a dense ceiling that blocks out all light. The ground is soft and muddy and the air is stagnant. Sickly grey-green lichen and patches of fungi cover many of the trunks.
115314: Once this area was a part of Mirkwood, but in recent years it has been deforested. The removal of the trees seems to have given room for a wide variety of thorny bushes to thrive. A gigantic rockspire rises to the west, blocking the view of the rest of Dol Guldur.
115315: A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.

The forest is dense and dark, the leaves of the old, black-barked oaks form a ceiling that allows not a single sunbeam to reach the ground. Great tangles of vines embrace the towering trunks, disappearing into the canopy. To the west and the south thick underbrush marks the borders of the forest.
115316: A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.

The forest is dark and silent. The trees are hoary old oaks, their bark rough and almost black. The undergrowth consists of thorny rose bushes that seem to strangle the trees. The flowers on the bushes are mottled in shades of grey and even though they look like they should be rotting, they are in full bloom.
115317: Between the Hills and the Forest
A small evergreen plant grows here, its woody stems reaching two feet.

These low hills border Mirkwood to the east and south. Though the trees have found no purchase here, there are some smaller plants. A deep crevice separates these slopes from those to the north. Several large boulders dot the slopes, some as big as houses; apparently the debris from landslides off the higher hill to the west.
115318: A dead-end valley lie nestled between stony slopes to the north, south, and west. The valley's floor is densely forested by great, gnarly oaks clad in drapes of thorny vines. The forest continues to the east, equally dark and ominous.
115319: A massive pile of smashed troll, all stone, lies here.

This hillside slopes away from the tall rockspike to the south. At the bottom of a steep drop to the west lies a canyon from which a fearsome stench rises. But the most remarkable sight here is the enormous pile of rubble at the foot of the rockspire. It looks like like hundreds and hundreds of troll statues, all broken into rubble from a great fall.
115320: A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

Here, in the depth of Mirkwood, the land is shrouded in shadows and mirk by the thick layers of branch and leaf overhead. The air is humid and stagnant with the smells of rot and decay. Thick layers of fallen leaves, knee-deep in some places, cover the forest floor.
115321:
A waist-high evergreen shrub grows here, with thick, reaching branches.
On the shrub, there are two piles of grey-green leaves.

These hills are crumbling away like rust from ancient iron. To the west the cliff edge is still solid and high, but in the east nothing appears to hold a natural shape. Rocks are strewn around as though thrown by mythical giants. In a few of the many cracks hardy plants have rooted themselves. Most of the plants protect themselves with long thorns against the few beings that travel this inhospitable land.
115322:
A large toadstool grows nearby.
A pair of rigid leather gloves are lying here.
A wooden cudgel lies on the ground.
A rusty pickaxe with a broken handle lies discarded here.
A horrific grimy corpse, covered in pus and boils, lies here.

Grey walls of rock form a small and twisting canyon. The canyon floor is littered with boulders, rocks and stones, it seems the walls are slowly eroding away leaving the canyon wider at the bottom than overhead. Torn clothes, smashed pottery, dented and dulled metal lie everywhere, mixed with bleaching bones. A few remains of beings and their belongings that dropped into the canyon from above are spiked on rockspires. An odour of rotting flesh fills the canyon.
115323:
A faded and stained black shirt lies here.
A small hatchet has been left on the ground.
A cup has been set here.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.

The walls of this canyon lean overhead and consist of brittle, cracking rock. Impossible to climb they allow travel only to the north and south. The canyon floor is littered with debris from the eroding canyon walls and rubbish. Smashed and broken bones, rotting clothes, pieces of leather and broken weapons cover the ground. The air is stagnant and there are tones of rotting flesh. A small arch of rock spans high over the canyon like a natural bridge.
115324:
A wooden club is on the ground.
A pot helm is on the ground here.
A large torch lies here among the dust.
A half-decayed corpse of a goblin lies rotting on the ground.
A dirty shovel is lying on the ground here.

The walls of this canyon are steep and hang over, making it impossible to climb them. The canyon floor is littered with small rocks and refuse of every type The distinctive odour of excrement covers every surface. About halfway up the canyon a tunnel has been carved out of the rock but the steep walls prevent any access. It is evidently the source of this plethora of junk and rubbish.
115325:
There are three arrows here.
A ragged leather breastplate is on the ground.
A small metal target shield is on the ground.
A curved horn lies on the ground.

This rocky canyon slopes up to the north and down to the south, while thick rock walls block passage to the east and west. The canyon is filled with eroded dirt and rubble which makes travel tricky and possibly dangerous to those who fail to take care. A strange looking rock-spire looms above to the southeast.
115326:
A leather collar, with heavy metal studs has been dropped here.
A pair of rigid leather boots are on the ground.
A soft pouch, made from leather, has been left here.
A broad knife lies on the ground.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.

This section of the canyon is very narrow, the walls lean overhead and are spanned by a gated stone block bridge. It seems some lazy being throws waste directly off the bridge without thought or worry for the canyon below. There are broken glass vials, pots and even the occasional bunch of giant bones littering the ground. The western canyon wall looks slightly unnatural, on a closer looks slightly smoother than the rest of the canyon walls.
115327:
A soft leather helmet lies here.
A long, evilly curved knife lies on the ground.
A half-rotten corpse is hanging here.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.

The canyon widens towards the south, but ends there at a vertical wall of rock. The canyon walls are too eroded to climb out. Every wall and facet of this canyon shouts 'dead end'. Scattered bones show the presence of carnivorous beings, though there appear to be no tracks and no evidence of struggles. The mouth of the canyon is wide and it would be nearly certain death to fall into such a place.
115328: A large black bat flitters near you.

A dark tunnel runs north into darkness and east out into the canyon. The walls are rough-cut rock that must have been hollowed out ages ago to make the way somewhat passable. It is evident that the passage has not been used in some time, as a thin layer of wet grime covers every surface.
115329: One wall of the tunnel has collapsed inward, leaving rubble and rock strewn across the ground. Much of the stone has been hewn by miners searching for the ore within. A few deep furrows run to the west, possibly made by carts hauling ore away in years long past. A small, opening leads into the darkness to the east.
115330: A rusty pickaxe with a broken handle lies discarded here.

A narrow path has been carved into the black basalt rock. The tunnel connects to the outside world to the west, and the way up is very steep. To the east the passage levels out where it leads into a wider area. Several rough tracks in the rocky floor of the tunnel suggests that heavy things were hauled through here in the past.
115332: A large black bat flitters near you.

No light penetrates this section of the tunnel. The walls are made of dark rock mixed with thick, black earth. The floor is a mix of sure footing and soft mud that can trip up even the most experienced travellers. To the east, the rock gives way to earth and clay as the passage narrows.
115333: A large black bat flitters near you.

An old mineshaft extends to the west from this tunnel. The basalt walls are pocked from old mining yet the floor of the cavern is surprisingly smooth and even, as if this tunnel has seen a lot more traversing than a dead-end mineshaft would merit.
115334: This narrow tunnel seems about ready to collapse. Rubble lies strewn about the ground while deep fissures in the ceiling show the rock is anything but stable. The walls are covered in pick marks, but they are covered in dust indicating no one has mined here recently. A steep, rocky path leads down into the darkness.
115335: Bottom of an Old Mine Shaft

This appears to be the bottom level of an old mine shaft. A steep path leads up while a dark mining tunnel continues to the south. A few metal hooks in the wall and some old wooden boards indicate that at one point this shaft was actively mined. But the thick layer of dust covering every surface reveals this is no longer the case.
115336:
A large black bat flitters near you.
A large black bat flitters near you.

This passage has been cut through the rock stone by stone with pick and hammer. Rubble and dirt lie scattered about the passage, making every footstep grind and crackle. The ceiling is a mix of great cracks and dull brown slate. Several spots seem likely to fall with the slightest disturbance.
115337:
A large black bat flitters near you.
A large black bat flitters near you.
A large black bat flitters near you.

This tunnel is a mix of natural rock formations and pick-hewn cavities. A few small boulders lie about, evidently discarded as worthless by the miners. The top of the tunnel is bare rock, though large cracks riddle the stone. The dark passage continues to the north and east.
115339:
A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.
A swarm of mosquitoes is here, humming around you.

A current of trash and excrement fills the centre of this tunnel. It leads east, toward an opening where the garbage and sewage spill out into the canyon. A small bit of fresh air from the opening cuts the worst of the vile stench. To the the west, the line of refuse continues deeper into the earth.
115340:
A tarnished arrowhead lies discarded on the ground.
Some ugly blow-flies are buzzing around here.
A swarm of mosquitoes is here, humming around you.
A cockroach is scuttling across the floor carrying some debris.

This portion of the tunnel has been fashioned into a disgusting living space. A few piles of rotting vines have been piled into beds against one wall. In the centre of the cave, a pot sits on top of a bed of ash. A vile odour emanates from the pot, it is clearly not fit for consumption by any but the least discriminating palate.
115341:
Some ugly blow-flies are buzzing around here.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.

The stench in this cave is overwhelming. A foetid mixture of sweat, excrement, and rotting food rises from every surface. In one corner, a pile of brown ooze forms a disgusting bit of decor. A few piles of refuse lay around the room, clearly set with intention. Though it is unclear why anyone would want such worthless junk.
115342: Some ugly blow-flies are buzzing around here.

Both walls of the tunnel are lined with every sort of cast off. Broken furniture, rotten food, and brown muddy clothing has all been shoved aside to form a somewhat clear path. Though cleared of the largest debris, the middle of the tunnel is still filled with a thick muck of mud and worse.
115343:
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.
Some ugly blow-flies are buzzing around here.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.

The tunnel bends here, which seems to have caused a buildup of caustic sludge. Along the outer wall, the rock of the tunnel is covered with thick, brown goo. The air is heavy with a terrible odour that can almost be cut with a knife. Another smell, just as awful, but different, invades the tunnel from the south.
115344:
A tarnished arrowhead lies discarded on the ground.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.

This cave is narrow, and has a pungent aroma that smells like some horrid combination of bodily waste, turned meat, and fermentation. The source of the odour is readily apparent. One section of the back wall is entirely covered by green sludge. About eight feet up, more sludge bubbles out in a slow trickle of repugnance. Beneath the grime and muck, some some stone arches, carved into the form of branches, indicate that this tunnel once served a nobler purpose.
115345:
Some ugly blow-flies are buzzing around here.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.
A foul malformed orc crouches here with a hungry look in its eyes.
Some ugly blow-flies are buzzing around here.

This cavern is dominated by dozens of green, oozing pools. They are not uniform in size. Some look large enough to swallow a bear, while others would barely fit a boot. Each pool is covered in a film of green algae, which gives the cave its own distinct odour. Several of the pools have been filled with various objects, though it is tough to tell what they were originally as many are broken and each is covered in the same green algae as the pools.
115346: This tunnel is narrow, with a brown wet channel of sludge running down the middle. The channel continues to the east, carrying the sludge away. To the west, the wall rises in a steep incline. About a hundred feet up the wall, an opening can be seen around twelve feet in diameter. A brown trail of much covers the wall below opening, continuing to a pile on the ground below, the source of the goop.
115347: A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.

Dark and twisted trees form a strangely dense forest. Lichen hangs down from the limbs. No light reaches the ground, which is covered by a thick layer of rotting leaves and dead branches. The only visible undergrowth is some fungi and climbing plants that seem to strangle the trees.
115348: A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.

If there was once a path through the forbidding forest here, it must get scarce use these days. Despite there being a discernible space between the black, twisted trees, that narrow rock-strewn gap is almost entirely obscured by dark, dense bushes, long thorns and fierce stinging nettles.
115349: Characterised by massive dark oaks and mutated, twisted beeches, this part of the dimly-lit forest is a little clearer at ground level than most of the terrain. Countless years of passing seasons have allowed a dense, decaying mat of rotting foliage to cover the ground. It is so thick that the thorny, tangled ground cover seen elsewhere in the forest has been unable to compete. Behind a large black oak lies a small pit mostly hidden from sight; its contents are pretty unrecognisable at first glance.
115350:
A tangled creeper writhes its shoots between the forest's roots upwards.
A tangled creeper writhes its shoots between the forest's roots upwards.
A black raven flies in the sky searching for flesh to prey upon.
A tall Uruk paces about, issuing commands to his troops.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.

The evil blackness of Mirkwood presses in from all sides in a very physical way. Ancient, twisted trees tangle together so tightly that one is almost indistinguishable from the next. Undergrowth full of thorns, foul fungi and decay lines the ground in a continuous mat, and a ceiling of grasping branches claws down from above.
115352: A black crow flies low to the ground here, looking for carrion to eat.

Thorny shrubs encroach upon the tenuously narrow path from all directions. Their wicked spikes are razor-sharp and as long as fingers, and every last one appears hungry to catch and ensnare any who pass by. The path continues to the north and south, just as fraught with frightful fauna.
115355: The sharp-edged cliffs prevent movement to the south and east. The whole area is covered with small cracks, sharp-angled boulders and treacherous gravel. The lack of plantlife allows the malevolent winds to carry plenty of dust which makes it difficult to see far into the distance. A very narrow natural bridge spans over the canyon to the west. To the north the hills become lower, but not more hospitable.
115356: A wide span of stone serves as a bridge across a canyon from which a fearsome stench rises like a invisible, malicious cloud intent on the ruination of any nose it encounters. The bridge-like span looks to be natural, as it is rough, uneven, and full of protruding jagged outcroppings that hinder movement.
115357: A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.

West of a deep canyon, this grey and inhospitable land stretches for miles. Almost without vegetation and covered by ash-grey dust it looks utterly lifeless. A small path to the east leads on to a narrow natural bridge.
115358: The rocks of this bleak slope are grey and dark like old ashes, stifling all growth. A rotten smell creeps out of the canyon to the east, as if trying to escape the confines of the darkness below. The hills rise to the south and the highest area of Dol Guldur lies some distance to the southwest.
115359: These hills are grey and barren, and the few paths are steep and treacherous. The ground is covered with a loose combination of dust and small gravel that slips under foot. Ruins of a small structure lie here, the sunken walls are hard to distinguish from the stones covering the hills.
115360:
A tall Uruk paces about, issuing commands to his troops.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.

An ancient wall lies here, shattered and decaying. It is difficult to tell what the wall was for and who made it, so little of it is left that the stone must have been taken and used somewhere else after it fell into ruin. The ridge here is rather high and affords a good view of the bleak surrounding landscape. A large rock formation is visible in the south east and dark, rolling, treeless hills persist in the south.
115361: Hills West of a Stone Bridge
A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.

Black hills of volcanic stone, littered with sharp-edged rocks surround a small plateau between a small ridge of hills to the north and a dangerous canyon to the east. A rough, stone bridge leads east across the canyon toward a massive spire of rock that stretches into the sky.
115362:
A hungry warg stands here, sniffing around for flesh.
A slobbering giant greedily lumbers towards you.

This narrow space between a rock face to the west and a narrow valley to the east looks well travelled, despite being nearly a dead end. To the south a sheer cliff rises defiantly into the air, it's slightly rounded edge looking somewhat like a bottom jaw. The eastern way into the valley looks severely eroded with fallen rocks and other debris lying scattered down the narrow entrance. The slope is very soft and there is clearly no way easy path down.
115363: This small bridge is built of the same ancient rock as the outer gate fixtures. A solid wooden door blocks the way to the east. The bridge spans the deep canyon below which protects the rockspire like a moat. Safety was clearly not a concern for the builder, without rails or walls, it seems quite possible to fall down into the canyon below.
115370: The land here rises toward the east, the ground covered by dust and loose gravel. The slopes are filled with cracks making every step uncertain. Some large boulders form a natural turn, blocking passage to the north and west. To the east, a flat plateau rises above the forest.
115371: A narrow ridge connects the black hills below to a bare and windswept plateau. Steep and treacherous slopes descend to the lower forest to the north and south. In these directions the brittleness of the ground make the descent an impossible task. The only safe path runs along the ridge from west to east.
115372: Bleak and bare hills form this windswept plateau. The forest covering the lower hills is here replaced by a few struggling brambles and weeds. The plateau extends in all directions for miles and its edges are sharp and steep. The only way down seems to be the slope to the west.
115373: The bare and flat ground extends in all directions except towards the east where a sudden drop marks the border of the plateau. There are no trees here, and vegetation is sparse. The windswept heights hold little topsoil except what's trapped in small cracks.
115374: This plateau rises above the forest to the east and north. Its windswept heights look down on the dark canopy. The flat surface of the plateau has very little soil, mostly it is bare, black rock. At one place boulders are piled in a half-circle, as if someone tried to build a windshelter here, but it looks like it would provide little shelter.
115375:
An orkish wolf-rider is here, riding a brown wolf.
An orkish wolf-rider is here, riding a brown wolf.

A steep rise ascends from the lower plateau to this higher promontory. Bare, black rock covers the ground and no plant or tree grow here. The promontory overlooks the lower forest to the west and to the north, but the canopy is too dense to see through. Far to the west a rocky outcrop stands out against the sky with the main part of Dol Guldur beyond it.
115376: At a Ravine on a Plateau

The flat plateau is crossed by a shallow ravine filled with brambles and boulders. Little grows on top of the windswept plateau where the ground is black rock with barely any soil. The few straggly trees that do grow here are sad looking things with thin branches and few leaves.
115377: A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.

Some twisted, scraggly birches accompanied by dry, brown bushes are the only signs of life on this otherwise desolate plateau. The lower land south and east is covered by a dense forest, but is unreachable due to the steep sides of the plateau.
115378:
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.

This cave has been dug directly out of the plateau. The floor is rough stone, but piles of eroded dirt blur the lines between the walls and the ground. A hitching post and feed trough line one wall, surrounded by a ring of brown, dried, droppings. Clearly the occupants are not overly concerned with cleaning. To the other side, a few logs have been set around a crude fire pit.
115379: This cave is filled with thick, old roots from the forest above. They cover the entire roof and press in from the sides giving a claustrophobic feel. A few of the roots have freshly stripped bark, showing that this cave is not uninhabited. In addition, a packed trail of dirt leads deeper into the cave, away from the light of the surface.
115380:
A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.
A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.
A massive hill troll is here, sniffing the air for the scent of enemies.
A swift carnivore bustles around.
A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.

This is a large cavern, evidently hollowed by some massive creatures. It smells like some horrible mixture of sweat, unwashed flesh, excrement and the unmistakable odour of rotting meat. A few large large tree trunks have been pulled around a pile of burnt bones. A few piles of cloth and leather lay near the back of the cave.
115381: A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

The slopes of these gentle hills are covered with birch and fir, while the hilltops are dominated by gnarly old oaks. Their crowns are wide and dense, casting the land into an everlasting darkness. Faint murmurs rustle through the leaves as the wind stirs them, as if the trees whisper to one another in hushed voices.
115382:
A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.
A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.
A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

Gentle, rolling hillocks cover the lands in this part of Mirkwood. Slopes, hilltops and long valleys continue in every direction except toward the west where a sudden drop puts a halt to any consideration of travel. The sturdy trees, ancient-looking behemoths, are covered in ensnaring vines and moss in various shades of green and grey.
115383:
A large, black butterfly is fluttering about erratically.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

The round, softly sloped hills in this area are covered with a dense, strange looking forest. Most of the trees are oaks that grew tall and strong, but their bark is almost black. A few ashes and pines stand between the oaks. The undergrowth is thick, with many thorny climbing vines that conceal some nasty little cracks in the ground. A sharp edged cliff protects the hills to the west, while to the east the land changes to a plain forest.
115384: A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.

These woods are dark and gloomy, no sky is visible through the ceiling of leaves. The trees are mostly dark oaks with rough bark and thick branches laden with leaves. Due to the lack of light, little brush grows under the trees. Dead leaves cover the ground in a thick layer of rotting plant material, adding an unpleasant aroma.
115385:
A huge, smoking campfire is burning here.
A large copper cauldron stands here on three short, stout legs.

The forest is extremely dark and dense, with huge trees that prevent any sunlight from reaching the ground. A crude camp was set up between some large rocks and ancient trees. It consists of a few ragged furs and dirty hides around a fireplace. A huge dulled, dirty cauldron, used to cook something or someone, hangs over the fire.
115386:
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.
A green-skinned hill troll is pacing around with a nervous zeal.

This tunnel has been hollowed out by the hill trolls out of the black rock that makes up Dol Guldur. A rough stair leads back upwards into the forest that seems to have been a natural cave at some point in time.
115387: A humble man stands here, ready to help you with your things.

Black-painted stone was used along the base for a foundation of this workshop, with a silver, decorative moulding that is waist-high, to separate the stone from the rest of the white and glossy walls that travel to a high and vaulted ceiling. A small stove made of cast iron stands along the south wall, vented up through the ceiling where it disappears from sight; two porcelain crucibles that are slender and easy to work are on top of it. A door and handle line the front of the stove were a small fire burns even now. A shelf stands in the corner with metal castings that appear silver and very fine, all in an orderly stack next to a cast iron mould for molten metal; the mould is used to make twelve arrowheads at a time of various sizes. Next to the table is a clay pot, almost spilling at the rim with all of the arrowheads made here; the grey pot contrasts off the black wall behind it. A corner rack is filled with many bows of various sizes and design, with arrows on display as well.
115389: The ground slopes steeply here, uphill to the east and downhill to the west. Any movement in other directions is impossible, with a sheer cliff drop to the north into a pitch-black chasm, and a mass of stinging undergrowth to the south. The dank forest looms high to the east where even the steep, rock-strewn slope is filled with the twisted, torturous trees.
115404: This narrow tunnel has been burrowed into the earth. Some roots from the trees above form the sides of the burrow. Some solid rock can be seen in the sides and floor of the burrow, mixed with root and dirt. To the west, the tunnel continues into the darkness.
115405:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
A small reptile with large eyes scurries along the walls.

This cave appears natural, though the smooth floor indicates it has been traversed frequently in recent times. A narrow passage leads out of the cave to the east, while a broad tunnel to the west leads into a wide cavern. A few stalactites hang from the ceiling, each with a small trickle of water running down the side.
115406: A hefty stone club is on the ground.

The cave here opens up into a wide cavern, over twenty feet tall at the ceiling. Apparently some trolls have made their home here, as there is a sizable collection of discarded bones, bits of flesh, and filthy rags. The disgusting odour that hangs thick in the air is enough to turn the stomach of even the most stalwart adventurer.
115407: A small black vicious rat squeaks at you for disturbing it.

There is nothing growing here on the rocky ground of the wide cavern. A few rocks and pebbles are strewn about, but the floor is otherwise featureless. The eastern wall is solid and continues to the north and south. To the west the cavern opens wider.
115408: This natural cavern is big enough for several trolls to stand abreast. Some of the southern wall has collapsed, leaving rough and jagged boulders strewn about the floor. Some water drips in through the cracks in the wall, but it appears stable for now.
115409: A rotten corpse is hanging here.

The cavern comes to a corner here, with walls of hard rock standing firm to the west and south. It is evidently inhabited, as the bits of flesh and discarded refuse show the signs of a recent meal. A strong smell of decay, mixed with the odour of fresh meat fills the air.
115410:
The half-eaten corpse of a pig is lying here.
An olog-hai troll is here, watching the tunnel entrance.
A large earth troll is digging here, looking for some tasty morsels.

A passage to the west leads out of the cavern into a dark tunnel. In front of the entrance to the tunnel, a few half-eaten animals and makeshift furnishings indicate the presence of trolls. The cavern is certainly tall enough to accommodate such creatures, though where their food comes from is a mystery.
115411: The cavern is quite high here, causing the faint sounds of dripping water to echo through the chamber. The cave appears to be natural, but the scattered refuse and faint odour of unwashed flesh indicate it is now inhabited. It appears to widen to the south, though the dim light makes it difficult to see how much.
115412: The rocky walls of this tunnel are jagged and sharp. A bit of dirty water forms a basin in the middle of the floor, its source not readily apparent. The air is humid, and a thin layer of mud covers the floor. Within the muck, a few pieces of bone mixed with trash can be seen.
115413: The rocky walls of the tunnel here show no signs of digging, apparently it is a natural formation. The tunnel is tall enough here for a man to walk straight, though the lack of light might make that a somewhat disturbing endeavour. An odour of decaying meat wafts through the tunnel, though the source is not readily apparent.
115414: Various bones and body parts lie about, apparently dragged here by some predator. They reek with a strong odour of decaying meat. The floor of the the tunnel is hard rock, with a few pebbles scattered about. The walls, though hard, seem to be made of densely packed earth rather than rock.
115415: The rocky ground here is grooved with the traces of ancient currents, but the water has long since dried up. The air remains humid with a strong odour of decomposition. The soft parts of the tunnel wall have been shorn up with some rough wooden pillars.
115416: The tunnel here is mostly of natural formation, probably hollowed out by an underground current. No water flows here now, but a few damp spots on the floor indicate there is still water above. The ground is mostly hard rock, but toward the south it looks like it is changing into softer sand.
115417:
A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.
A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.

The earth is soft and the air humid in this part of the tunnels, making it the perfect habitat for the fungi that grow in abundance here. The tunnel is partly natural but has clearly been widened to allow for an easier passage. The ceiling is high enough for a man to walk upright without worry.
115418: This tunnel looks as though it was dug out with shovels. It is clearly not entirely natural, as thick beams cross the ceiling supported by sturdy wooden pillars. The earth floor is a rough mixture damp dirt and moist sand with a few rocks and pebbles here and there. A heavy stone slab blocks the passage to the west.
115420:
The corpse of a brutish forest troll is lying here.
A dread guardsman of Dol Goldur stands here haughtily.
A dread guardsman of Dol Goldur stands here haughtily.
A dread guardsman of Dol Goldur stands here haughtily.
A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.

A huge gate of steel is set in the western wall of this cavern-like room. There are weapon racks along the walls and chests for supplies, and a small forge to repair equipment fills one corner of the room. To the south, a passage leads deeper into the spire.
115421: A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.

Several crude stone passages meet here. A large tunnel to the south looks to be well used as the rock as been trodden to a smooth sheen. A short tunnel to the east opens up into a room full of shelves. The walls look rough and natural as if this was originally a cave.
115422: Wooden shelves cover every wall of this room. They are packed with sacks of wheat, salted meats, and other fare. In addition to the food, there are a number of other curious objects, such as jars of unidentifiable liquid and a large supply of iron chain. The floor is filled with barrels, except for a small wooden door that leads below.
115425:
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.
A brutish forest troll is hunting here, looking for some tasty flesh.
A huge stone troll looms overhead, ready to crush your body.
A large mean-looking troll is here.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

The cavern narrows here to a small hallway about 6 feet across. A few simple wooden barriers have been set up, allowing for some defence should attackers attempt to breach this part of the spire. A giant metal door covers most of the south wall, evidently intended to hold even the strongest of creatures at bay. The wall to the east is black stone, without any feature or adornment.
115426:
A sleuthing orc is tracking here, sniffing along the ground (hidden).
A huge stone troll looms overhead, ready to crush your body.
A large mean-looking troll is here.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.
A Morgundul orc snarls about here, looking for a fight.

This large room serves a single purpose, that of keeping prisoners locked up. There are no bars, only strong steel chains that are bolted into the solid stone walls. The cell is totally dark, the floor covered by a smelly mass of dirt and droppings. The stench lingering here leaves little doubt that those locked up here recently were trolls or something equally filthy.
115427:
Pitch-black water with a strange smell has collected here.
A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.

There is a depression in the cavern's floor here, and the bottom of it is filled with water. Unidentifiable brown and green things float in the water and the pool gives off an unimaginable stench. The surrounding cavern's floor is somewhat higher, a bit drier, and equally filthy.
115428:
An enormous, stinking pile of dung sits in the corner of the room.
A strong hill troll is standing here, his hide covered in large scales.

The floor of this nasty cavern is covered in filth and droppings. A large amount of it is piled against the eastern wall, possibly to keep the level of filth in the rest of the cavern below waist level. Flies and roaches thrive in the filth.
115429:
A huge stone troll looms overhead, ready to crush your body.
A large mean-looking troll is here.
A disgusting forest troll is searching for fresh meat here.

This cell is dark, bleak, and containing nothing but filth and grime. The walls are of solid rock and looks like part of a hill or mountain, no amount of pounding or digging is likely to get through them. The air is moist and full of a lingering stench.
115430: A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.

This is clearly a barracks for the spire's defenders. An unpleasant mixture of sweat and stew gives the room a distinctive odour. Along the walls, rough beds have been carved directly into the stone, while wooden tables take up the majority of the floor.
115432: This valley is more a cleft in a mountain than a real valley. It is so small that a goose could jump over it, if a goose would live in these unpleasant hills. The valley winds in many curves and bends, forming a huge bend from the south towards the east. The bottom of the valley is littered with many stones fallen from the walls.
115433: The narrow crack, well-concealed by the twisted tree trunks above, widens quickly to a natural cave and then transforms into a rough-hewn tunnel that continues to the south. This passageway seems to be very seldom used, judging by the thick layer of untouched, slimy and slippery crud that covers the wet floor. The air is musty, stuffy, and moist.
115434:
A black pond is here, filled with putrid water.
Something cold and scaly slithers past your leg.
Something cold and scaly slithers past your leg.

A partly collapsed, slightly winding tunnel runs through the cold, wet stone. The walls are leaning inwards and occasional big rocks have fallen from the ceiling and from the walls, making travel somewhat difficult. The air is humid due to numerous streams of black water that trickle between the eroded rocks, forming deep-looking pools on the floor. At one point, a broad pool stretches across the whole tunnel, the floor completely hidden beneath the murky black water.
115435:
Pitch-black water with a strange smell has collected here.
A large and twisted beast lurks in the rotten pool.
A long slender eel glides along the water, its body coiled to strike.
A long slender eel glides along the water, its body coiled to strike.

A huge underground pool of water fills the large cavern. The water is black, still, and has a dark, ominous look about it. Smooth stone walls rise directly from the water all around the pool, save a rocky, stench-ridden strip of land which lies between the pool and the cavern walls on the eastern and southern shores. The land forms a narrow, traitorous-looking path across the cavern. To the north, the path transforms to a narrow corridor, quickly twisting into the darkness. At the other end of the path, there is an old, rusty metal gate in the stone wall, blocking the way to the west.
115436:
A crudely-fashioned quiver litters the ground.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack is an orkish shortbow.

This small, abandoned room has clearly been a prison cell in the past. Old, rusty chains are hanging from the stone walls, and grey bones, skulls and skeletons lie scattered around the room. A thick layer of dust and red stains is vaguely visible on nearly all surfaces. The back wall of the dungeon is formed of solid rock, whereas the other walls have been constructed from crude boulders. The ceiling of this grim room is low, and the floor is made of sturdy, square stone tiles.
115451: Black volcanic stone mixed with dark earth form these hills. To the north, the cliff is too steep to descend to the lower lands. A few bushes and weeds grow between the basalt channels, giving a scruffy texture to the otherwise smooth landscape.
115453:
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.
A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.

The forest rises to cover a wide but low hill. The trees are old, black oaks in the lower parts and tall firs higher up. They form a dense ceiling, beneath which the shadows reign. Little grows here but the ground is covered in dead, rotting leaves.
115454:
A grim-looking wolverine growls threateningly.
A small troll is here, scavenging for something edible.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.
A green-skinned hill troll is pacing around with a nervous zeal.
A green-skinned hill troll is pacing around with a nervous zeal.

The valley floor is covered with a dense and dark wood of ancient oaks, which block most of what sunlight there might be above. The valley continues to the south while gentle slopes rise to the north and west, leading up to higher ground, which even so look equally covered by dense forest.
115455: A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

The floor of this wide valley is covered by enormous oaks. It narrows to the north while the south side is blocked off by slopes too steep to ascend. Fallen leaves cover the ground in a thick layer of rotting compost. The smell of rotten plantlife hangs heavily in the air.
115456:
Some black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy towards you.
Some black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy towards you.
Some black, oozing vines reach out from the choked canopy towards you.

The branches of this tree form a loose canopy. The footing is treacherous, but plentiful. Rotten vegetation clings to the trunk, giving off an unpleasant odour. The tree itself seems solid, though it has hard to tell behind the multiple layers of moss.
115457:
A shrub with maple-like leaves is growing here.
On the shrub, there are two handfuls of blackcurrant berries.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

No light reaches the ground of this forest. The crowns of the trees block the sunlight completely. The old oaks are black and have a strangeness about them. Most of them did not grow straight, their trunks are twisted and their roots seem to wrestle with each other to get the most nutrients from the soil.
115458:
Pitch-black water with a strange smell has collected here.
A knotty tree grows here, entangled in a rotten mess of wet shrubbery.

The ground under the dark canopy is soft and muddy. The trees are mostly oaks and alders that look like they have stood here since an earlier age. The alders surround a small sinkhole filled with murky, muddy water that smells of sulphur. The deep tracks of large foot prints leading to the water show that it is potable for at least some kind of creature.
115459:
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

Tall dark trees dominate these rolling hills, their leaf-covered branches forming an almost solid ceiling above. Little sun ever reaches the ground and as a result the undergrowth is very sparse. The hills expand in all directions except to the south, where there is a steep drop.
115460:
A green-skinned hill troll is pacing around with a nervous zeal.
A dreadful hill troll with a skin full of warts is standing here.

This forested hillock is elevated over the lower parts of Mirkwood to the east and north. The same gnarly ancients grow here though, their massive trunks standing a tad too close to each other. Their outstretched branches intertwine above to form an almost solid ceiling of vegetation.
115461:
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.
The small fierce-looking bat is hanging from the ceiling, obviously sleeping.

The dark tunnel suddenly stops in what seems to be dead end. A few splintered crates, some completely upended, have been dumped unceremoniously at the end of the tunnel. Some roots grow down from the forest above amongst the troll filth.
115462: The walls of the tunnel are stricken with claw marks that can be seen leading to the south and east where they finally disappear into darkness. A foetid smell of rotting flesh reeks from the southern tunnel.
115463:
A rotten corpse is hanging here.
A half-rotten corpse is hanging here.
A half-decayed corpse of a horned bat-like creature is hanging here.
A massive hill troll is here looking for something to eat.

The tunnel suddenly opens into a large cave that has been turned into a foul larder. Rotting corpses hang from crude hooks to preserve the meat and prevent any worms from reaching the flesh. The only way out of here is to head back north through the tunnel where the air smells slightly cleaner.
115465:
A large bulletin board, entitled "The Board of the Tarkhnarb", is mounted here.
A fine marble chessboard with ivory and ebony pieces is set here.
A wiry and furtive-looking orc crouches here, eyeing your belongings.

In the deep foundations of Lugburz, bound about by the power of the One Ring, stand many impenetrable caverns. They survived the overthrowing of Sauron, but went unnoticed when he rebuilt his mighty fortress. And here, for a time, you must dwell, unable to participate in the wars of Middle-earth. A tattered sign has been fixed to the wall.
115466: A mailbox stands here stuffed full of messages.
Though these pits and caverns were delved exceedingly deep beneath the tower of Lugburz, still somehow, tales from Middle-earth manage to reach you here, from time to time.
115467: In a Hidden Pit beneath Barad-dur
A large bulletin board, entitled "News from the Goblin Gate", is mounted here.

These mighty vaults and caverns, hidden by deceit, deep beneath Barad-dur, are never reached by the light of the sun. And yet, by some strange means, tales of the world without sometimes reach you here. Perhaps they are but echoes of stories long forgotten, or perhaps they are dreams of what is yet to come.
115468: Whatever this pool is cannot be told. It might be pure evil that has collected here, deep down below Barad-dur. The surface is perfectly still but it does not shine like a mirror. It is of an even deeper black that can be imagined and it seems to go on forever, down into the deepest, forgotten places below Arda, where unknown evil and power eagerly await the return of Morgoth.
115470:
A black, leather-scaled reptile glances around with gleaming eyes.
A black, leather-scaled reptile glances around with gleaming eyes.
A black, leather-scaled reptile glances around with gleaming eyes.
A black, leather-scaled reptile glances around with gleaming eyes.
A black, leather-scaled reptile glances around with gleaming eyes.

The earth opens up into a large black hallway, dominated by a few protruding boulders and a somewhat smooth rock floor. Though much of this area may have been a natural formation in the earth, its looks as though at least some of the rock has been broken and formed into the shape of a large entryway. A thick white mist sits subdued on the ground, stirred only by the occasional quick movement of an unseen, low-lying creature. An atmosphere of evil lurks here with a foreboding presence; it waits in the cracks and crevices to instil fear in any unwelcome visitors.
115471: The uneven cavern is crowded from above by low-hanging rock formations. Even the slightest sounds seem to be magnified, echoing deep into the black void. The occasional light breeze of fresh air can be felt from the north, but the dominating atmosphere is damp, dank, and heavy. A few smaller passageways veer off into the east, but stop abruptly after just a few feet.
115472:
A large toadstool grows nearby.
A black, leather-scaled reptile glances around with gleaming eyes.

A formidable opening in the surrounding black stone gives way to a few major passageways. Huge piles of crushed and broken rock have been pushed toward the northern wall, evidently by some beast with unimaginable strength. The ground here is smooth compared to the sharp and jagged rock walls. The faint sound of moving water can be heard to the west, while an unpleasant odour wafts in from the south.
115473: A black, leather-scaled reptile glances around with gleaming eyes.

The cave is narrow here, crowded in from all sides by extremely hard rock. The moisture in the air has completely covered the passageway, making any hold extremely slippery and treacherous. Spewing from an unknown source, a small spring shoots with great force out of the earth. Access to the water is limited to just a few yards before it is swallowed once again by the solid, black rock. The sound of the rushing water dominates the air; the closed in surroundings make the water sound even more powerful than it looks. To the east, the ground slopes upwards.
115474:
A stone statue with Elven features stands watch here, spear in hand.
A stone statue with Elven features stands watch here, spear in hand.
A stone statue with Elven features stands watch here, spear in hand.

Huge, entangled tree roots have penetrated the ceiling and the walls of this rocky, but surprisingly high chamber. The black soil above looks unstable and volatile, as several loose rocks seem to have shifted with the earth and now wait patiently for their time to come crashing to the floor below. On the ground, several somewhat polished rocks and large boulders are looming amid the thick, white mist that is creeping along the floor.
115475: The skeleton of an enormous dragon lies here, blocking the tunnel to the south.

A large tunnel begins its journey into the dark unknowns under Mirkwood here. The tunnel is large enough to cause the smallest sound to bounce back and forth between its walls as it travels deeper underground. The northern end has been sealed off by a wall of large, solid blocks of stone.
115477:
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.
An orkish captain is here, gleefully whipping his troops into obedience.

There is a broad gate to the south, consisting of two swinging doors, reinforced with strips of charred metal. The trail goes on to the south and north of here. A palisade has been built on both sides of the trail. To the north, higher above, a fortified rampart provides a view over the trail.
115478: Before the Gates of the Camp
A half-decayed corpse of a goblin lies rotting on the ground.

The trail from the gate runs into a sturdy wooden building here. To the east and west a narrow path leads between this building and the camp walls. A large iron-bound gate can be seen to the south. Above the trail here, a wooden platform spans the length of the wall.
115479: The trail in the camp here passes between the palisade to the south and a wooden building to the north. The space here is quite limited, creating a corridor. But there is still enough room to walk side by side or ride a horse. The ground is quite hard, packed down from the tread of boot and hoof.
115480: A crude palisade wall rises from the ground here, its sharpened tips burnt and blackened to fire-hardened points. Scaling this wall would be a dangerous proposition at best. Rough weeds grow at the base of the wall, but the rest of the ground is smooth earth packed down by the endless tread of heavy feet.
115481: The trail takes a turn here, next to the guardtower to the west. The rugged palisade lies to the south. Broken branches, roots and stumps litter the ground at the base of the wall, remains of the impassable forest. The trail itself is mostly clear, with just a few roots winding across like snakes.
115482:
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.

The trail in the camp makes a bend here. Westwards, the trail leads into a narrow alleyway, while to the north it continues into the camp next to a wooden building. There is a palisade wall to the south, and to the east, a wooden guardtower is visible.
115483: The camp trail comes to a crossroads here. To the north and south, the trail continues, while to the east a short path leads to a wooden guardtower. A sturdy wooden building stands to the west, much larger than the other structures.
115484: The camp trail comes to a fork here. To the west, a wide trail leads into some sort of square or courtyard. The trail also continues to the north and south. There is a wooden building to the east, with a large pile of basalt rocks stacked up next to it. Black smoke rises from the chimney of the building.
115485: The camp trail continues south and north, with a bend to the southwest around a wooden building. The trail has seen a lot of traffic here, leaving the ground muddy and slippery. An opening to the west leads into a sturdy, but not particularly well-constructed, wooden building. An odour of blood and meat emanates from inside.
115486: The trail is very muddy here with deep, thick boot prints leading up and down. Some crude huts and tents have been set up to the east. A wooden building can be seen to the west. A few discarded bones lying against the wall indicate that this must be where food is served.
115487:
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.

There is a four-way intersection of the trails here. The trail seems to continue to the north and east, but it looks likely that the trail ends at the palisade in both directions. To the northeast, a wooden guardtower is visible and to the northwest, a large, well-built building stands tall.
115488:
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.

A few simple tents have been pitched here, evidently for some of the camp's less important inhabitants. The only clear passage is back to the trail to the south, as a crude but effective palisade has been built to the north, shielding the camp from outside attacks. A guardtower rises above the palisade in the east, and a well-built building is visible in the west.
115489:
A long water trough made of wood stands here.
A pitiful slave is here, ready to tend the stable.

The stable here is maintained surprisingly well, making it look out of the place in the otherwise filthy camp. The walls are robust, made from good quality, thick lumber. The earthen floor has been hardened by the weight of the animals. A wooden trough provides water for the steeds, while a pile of hay serves as food.
115490:
There are three bales of hay here.
A saddle lies here on the ground.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.

Stacks of hay line the back wall of this stable, enough to feed several dozen horses. A few barrels of water sit in a corner, while saddles and tack are hung from the southern wall. The ground is a mix of muck and hay, somewhat squishy underfoot. A few piles of manure indicate the stable is in serious need of a good shovelling.
115491: In Front of a Wooden Guard Tower

The path to the guard tower turns south here, as a wall of rough-cut tree trunks form a wall to the east. The tower itself climbs high above the southern palisade. The path under the tower is open, while a sturdy wooden building lies directly to the north.
115492: This corner of the camp is relatively quiet. A small dirt path leads off the main trail toward the southeastern guard tower. To the west, a crude latrine has been fashioned from rough wood planks and a few split logs. There is no door, leaving anyone sitting on the latrine in full view of any unfortunate passerby.
115493: In Front of a Sturdy Building

This muddy path winds its way between two buildings to the north and south. There is a wooden door in the southern building, with a large iron handle. The building itself is built from sturdy logs with a roof made of a combination of leather, straws, branches all mixed with a mud sealant. The north building is more of a shelter than a proper building, with open sides in several directions.
115494: A smell of burning carcasses emanates from the north as thick, black smoke rises above the fence. It is made of sticks, branches, and thin logs attached together with a rope. To the south, there is a sturdy building built of rough logs. Its roof is a mixture of wood, leather, hay, and straw all sealed together with mud.
115495: The trail becomes a narrow alley here between the two wooden buildings. The sturdy building to the south is made of solid rough-cut logs, fastened together with rope. The building to the north is also made of wood, but it appears considerably less stout. Neither building has any windows.
115496: The trail comes to a junction here, with paths continuing to the north, south, and east. To the west, a small hut can be seen just off the trail. The ground is smooth dirt, worn flat by the persistent beat of heavy boots. A few rocks and weeds peek out amid the otherwise evenly stomped ground.
115497: There are some rocks on the trail here, making the path somewhat uneven. A massive leather-roofed structure stands to the southwest, marking the corner of the camp. A large rectangular building, made from thick hardwood, stands to the east.
115498: A small campfire burns here, its low flames giving off only a little light.

The camp trail comes to an end here next to a wooden guardtower. A short path to the north leads up to some stairs under the tower. To the south, a few small huts and shacks are visible. A tall wooden palisade to the east separates the camp from the wild.
115499: The path through the camp is quite muddy and worn here. Most of the trees have been cut down or ripped up, although there are a few smaller ones still living beside to the path. The large building to the north dominates the area, while some smaller buildings border the south side of the path.
115500: A foul stench fills the air here. Something is burning, and it is not wood. A muddy path with red, slimy footprints leads into a deep pit to the south. This must be where the camp's food us prepared. A solid building lies to the north, while the trail continues to the east and west.
115501: The camp trail passes through a small courtyard here. A gravel path, lined with vicious metal spikes, leads through the courtyard to a large stone building. The structure appears to be of higher quality than the rest of the camp. It is made of uniform bricks of stone and it has a strong foundation made of larger stone blocks.
115502: This junction connects the east-west trail and north-south one. To the northwest, a guardtower climbs above the corner of the camp. A large, solid wooden building lies to the northeast. The trail is packed mud that gives a bit with each step.
115503: To the west, a sturdy wooden building stands tall. The only entrance is a heavy oaken door. Two crossed axes, painted in dark red blood, indicate this is probably the barracks. The path to the door is well-trodden, apparently it is used frequently. To the north, the path comes to a crossroads.
115504:
An uruk of the Morgundul tribe is here commanding his soldiers.
An orc-guard of the Morgundul is on patrol here.

The trail through the camp narrows here. A large, wooden barracks stands to the west, while a crude, make-shift shelter lies to the east. A few cut stumps indicate this land used to be part of Mirkwood, but it has since been claimed for some other purpose through a combination of harsh steel and hard toil.
115505: The northeast guard tower rises above the camp here. Some crude stairs built from roughly cut logs provide easy access to the platform above. The stairs are covered in muddy footprints, indicating frequent use. The strong wooden palisade protects the camp from the east and north.
115506: A Morgundul orc guard is sleeping here.

This guardtower caps the northeastern corner of the camp. A gloomy forest is clearly visible to the east while some desolated hills can be spotted to the north. A thick leather canopy covers the guardtower from the sky above. A narrow stairwell leads down to the camp below.
115507: Thick, grey smoke rises from a burning pile of animal carcasses, filling the air with the acrid smell of burning flesh and fur. Bones lay forgotten around the area, maybe left around as feed for the wargs of the camp. The path continues northwards, where it widens into a more open area. And to the south, it looks like there are more carcasses on the ground.
115508:
The partly-chopped corpse of a pig is hanging here.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.

There is a shallow pit dug in the ground. The very bottom of the pit is soaked with blood, mixed with pieces of meat and shattered bone. A few axe-scarred logs, stained red, form a circle on the pit's edge. Along the wall to the south, a few carcasses, some animal, some humanoid, hang upside down. Below the carcasses there are pots for collecting the dripping blood.
115509:
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.
A small suspicious orc butchers hectically to prepare meals for the camp.

A pungent stench hangs heavy inside this large wooden building. Rows of partially butchered corpses hang from sharp meat hooks, while other cadavers are thrown into large crates. Each crate has several holes in the bottom to allow the blood to drain into a large pan set into the floor.
115510:
A water barrel has been left here.
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there are two small pieces of raw meat.

This room has a few tables lined with simple wooden chairs. The tables are covered with leftover food, pieces of bones and other inedible scraps. The stink is heavy in this area, which has attracted a number of flies hungry for a meal.
115511: A half-decayed corpse of a goblin lies rotting on the ground.

The trail comes to an abrupt stop at the wooden palisade. The side of the wall is partly broken, evidently something crashed into it causing several of the wooden logs to snap and splinter. A few boards have been nailed to what remains to cover the gap. The ground in front of the palisade is mostly barren, save for a few burnt stumps and chopped up roots.
115512: A rotten corpse is hanging here.

A massive wooden guard tower looms above, on top of a buttress in the palisade. Disfigured corpses dangle from some chains fixed to the walls, while birds and insects are feasting on the remaining flesh. The forest has been cut and burned back all around the tower and many charred stumps dot the ground.
115513:
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack is a short spear.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.

This enclosed yard is shielded off from the camp by a high wooden fence on three sides, weapon racks line the fences, and the central area is kept clear for practice. Blood stains the ground in several places, indicating that the weak are shown no mercy here. A stairwell leads up into the tower above.
115515: All the trees have been cut down here leaving numerous stumps poking out of the ground. There is some twisted and thorny undergrowth left, and the land here resembles more a barren field now than a forest. There is a crude but effective palisade built to the west of here.
115516: A narrow path here leads along the western palisade to a guard tower in the southwest corner of the camp. Some wooden supports for the southern palisade keep anyone from straying off the path to the east. A few wooden stumps lay about, possibly used for relaxation after a long shift in the tower.
115517: Ground Floor of a Guard Tower

A cutlass is on the ground.
A mace is on the ground.
A sturdy pack horse is standing here.
An Uruk-rogtar of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
A slender orc scans the area, his bow ready for a sudden strike.

A high guardtower has been built above the corner of the wooden palisade. A narrow flight of stairs leads to the upper floor, standing on six strong poles. Hides were used to shield the area between the poles from the wind and rain, allowing sentries to take a quiet rest. Building tools and cruel weapons are scattered around.
115518: This guard tower rises high above a cruelly spiked wooden palisade. It offers a good view over the area in front of the massive southern gate, and the blackened trail leading through it. A wide column of smoke dominates the southern view, originating from a small hill seemingly ablaze. Westwards lies a dense and dark forest. A small stair leads down through a hole to the ground floor.
115519: Some branches of the forest reach out almost to the brink of the platform, but they are not quite close enough to grab. The canopy of the forest is dense and dark, blocking the view to the sky. To the north and below, a trail goes straight through the camp and it bends to the east.
115520: This part of the wooden platform offers a good view of both outside and inside the camp. The wooden guardtowers in the corners of the camp are also clearly visible from here. The road to Dol Guldur snakes away from the camp to the south and into the forest to the west.
115521: This spot on the platform offers a perfect view of the gate to the south, as well as the road beyond. A fence has been built on the edges of the platform and a few well-placed gaps provide ample sight lines against any would-be attackers.
115522: This platform stands at the top of the southern palisade. It is crafted from rough wooden planks that creak with every step. To the west and south, the road to Dol Guldur peeks out between the trees like a snake winding through a green field.
115523:
An arrow rack stands upright in the corner.
Standing in the rack are eight war arrows.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack is a shortbow.

This guard tower, built on top of a buttress in the palisade, offers a good view of the gloomy forest just outside the wall. Several of the swaying trees in the forest have grown as high as the tower. A crude rack for bows and arrows stands in a corner on a particularly squeaky floor plank.
115524: This wooden guard tower rises in the corner of the palisade. It is covered by a thatched roof of leather. Small gaps in the leather indicate that it is less than waterproof. To the south, the forest is visible while to the east the bare hills of Dol Guldur stand alone in the endless forest.
115525: A wooden palisade protects the southern and eastern edges of the camp here. Clumsily built stairs lead up to the top of a guard tower in the corner of the palisade. The tower is made of strong wooden timbers with a roof of thatched leather.
115527: A saddlecloth lies here on the ground.

The stench of rotten flesh and damp fur is heavy in this area. A large pit has been dug into the ground, subdivided into numerous stalls. The walls are reinforced with wooden planks and hardened earth, and they hold rusted shackles, with sizes varying from that of a man to that of a troll. A steep ramp gives access to the pit and stalls.
115528:
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.
A warg whelp is here trying to look dangerous.
A warg whelp is here trying to look dangerous.

At the southern end of the stable, a mess of blood and wet goo covers the floor. From the looks of the small footprints tracking through the muck, this must be the whelping area for the wolves and wargs. There is plenty of food as as well. A large trough is filled to the brim with scraps of meat and bone, mixed into a rough paste with some flax and grass to hold it all together.
115529:
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there are a stiletto and a rapier.
A weapons rack stands against the wall.
In the rack are a short spear and a backsword.

This wooden shed has been built against a stone building to the north, and the heat radiating from a rough doorway suggests that it is the camp forge, supplying this small armoury. Wide racks and tables line the walls, holding cruel weapons and armour pieces of various types and sizes. The floor consists of squeaky wooden planks, to prevent the heavy racks from sinking into the mud.
115530:
A scorching forge with a smoking fire warms the area.
A large stone chest is here.
Aghuk the smith, wielding a hammer, is standing here by his forge.

The heat is intense in this small forge, sparks flying through the air and coming to a sizzling rest on the floor, walls, and anyone walking around. Snagas walk in every now and then with blocks of hardwood to fuel the kiln, while others may operate the bellows, creating a scorching heat. A large anvil stands in the centre of the room, surrounded by tongs, hammers, and half-finished weapons and pieces of armour. A doorway to the south leads to the armoury.
115531:
A small oaken table has been set here.
A noseless orc, half-blind and heavily scarred, guards his wares like a bulwark.

This small patch of ground in the edge of the camp is drier than the surroundings. A small canopy shields a pile of wood and branches from the weather. Another overhang contains tools and materials for the production of various potions and vials. The air is filthy from a huge column of black smoke to the south. A muddy trail lies to the west.
115532:
A small campfire burns here, its embers barely giving off any light.
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.
A harsh orkish veteran is here, heavily scarred but ready to fight.
An orkish captain is here, gleefully whipping his troops into obedience.

This sturdy stone guard house is built with care, as the main defensive structure of the camp. Low walls and niches can be used by guards to ambush and shoot at any invaders. A reinforced oaken door leads outside to the south. To the east, a small archway leads into a much more well-appointed room.
115533:
A mailbox stands here stuffed full of messages.
A large bookshelf sits against the wall.
On the bookshelf, there are an ancient book, a small book, bound in maroon leather, and a well-thumbed book.
Adragor the Numenorean, commander of the camp, is standing here.

A long table stands against the southern wall of this well organised study. It is covered with charts, maps, and opened books. Flickering candles illuminate the areas that the weak light from the high windows cannot reach. A winding stairway along the eastern and northern wall leads up through a hole in the high ceiling to a tower above. Numerous bookcases line the space under the stairs, containing books on a wide variety of subjects, from dark magic to the history of Mirkwood. This study clearly does not belong to an orc or troll.
115534: A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.

There is a splendid view from the tall windows of this high tower. To the south, the noisy, smoky camp bustles with activity. The eastern horizon is dominated by the craggy hill and fortress of Dol Guldur, while to the west endless forests stretch out. The room is apportioned with hand-carved furniture and thick, soft rugs.
115535:
A mass of tattered fabric lies here in a heap.
An orc-guard of the Morgundul is on patrol here.
An orc-guard of the Morgundul is on patrol here.

This crude structure is not well-built. The wooden walls are so light and so poorly held down that it appears a stiff breeze might topple them. Some tattered fabric and a bed of hay indicates that someone probably sleeps here. A second room lies to the north.
115536: This room is very dark. A thick roof made of a combination of sticks, branches, planks, leather, and mud ensures no light enters from above. The dirt floor is somewhat soft and moist, indicating the roof is probably not watertight. A hole in the floor leads into the earth below, but any stairs there may have been have long since rotted away.
115537: A beer barrel has been left here.

Tables and benches are loosely scattered around this large room. It provides a suitable place for the orkish guards to drink their brains into oblivion, and when needed run to battle, if they can still find their own weapon.
