Sharp, bare rock covers all sides of this cylindrical tunnel. A few scratches mark the walls, probably caused by some largel animal sharpening its claws. The tunnel continues to the west and east, and a small draft of musty air passes that way.
121492: Rubble and rock cover the floor of this narrow tunnel. A small path has been cleared around the tunnel bend, apparently by the pacing of some large creature. The ceiling is low, making each step a potential hazard for the tallest beings.
121493: A tear-shaped cavern is here beneath the earth. It narrows to a point to the north, where a slim tunnel heads in that direction. From there, walls of earth and rock curve around to create a room nearly twenty feet in diameter and eight feet tall near its centre. The floor slants towards the east. It is covered in rocks and loose soil, looking to have been recently disturbed in places.
121510: A furtive footpad is here waiting for his prey.

Partially broken water troughs and piles of collapsed wood on rotting hay indicate this was once where travellers tied their horses while they attended to business in the town. It is a convenient distance to the well to the west for keeping the water troughs full of water.
121511:
A mass of tattered fabric lies here in a heap.
A broken cabinet rests against a partial wall.
A wiry smuggler is here, attempting to avoid being seen.
An experienced husky smuggler is here, plotting his illicit ventures.
An experienced husky smuggler is here, plotting his illicit ventures.
A wiry smuggler is here, attempting to avoid being seen.

Walls that once separated the area into rooms for privacy have almost completely been destroyed. The remains of several simple beds lie broken in the debris. Torn linens grow mould in the corners. The exterior walls are intact enough to prevent things from entering except from the old tavern to the west. A section of roof attached to the tavern still covers part of the interior. The ceiling nearest to the east edge of the building is completely missing.
121512: The road running through town ends here with more open space in front of the ruins of several buildings. A wagon with all the wheels broken lies in the dirt next to a ruined building to the south that appears to have been a large home. Other buildings at the end of the road have been turned to piles of rotting wood and squared stones.
121513:
The remains of a black fungus lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
An ancient fungus smothers the boulders.

Perhaps this house once belonged to the most powerful person of Andrath at one point in time. Tall columns partially stand in front of the house and some detailed carvings are still visible on wooden beams lying on the floor. The walls of the home have lost significant integrity and lean to the west as if the next strong wind could blow everything down.
121514:
A sturdy bandit bodyguard stands here, eager to hack you to pieces.
A sturdy bandit bodyguard stands here, eager to hack you to pieces.
A thief is here looking for some stranger to rob.

Against the eastern wall, a row of large barrels stand in various states of disrepair. Despite being empty, they still smell strongly of wine. A few crushed wooden boxes are scattered on the otherwise empty floor. Like other buildings in the village, the roof has long been absent and allowed the elements to begin wearing away the interior.
121530: A pale ghost advances forward, shimmering with a pale light (hidden).

Baskets and small barrels with rusting bands are stacked around the room. An expansive layer of mould grows in soft tufts on the remains of vegetables and potatoes. The floor is dry dirt and mostly level as it seems the most care was taken there as opposed to the roughly-carved walls. Narrow tunnels to the north, east and south are obscured in darkness.
121536: A spirit floats towards you and howls with an evil laughter.

The tunnel generally curves between the north and south but meanders back and forth between those points. Most of the tunnel is large enough for one or two persons side-by-side with one area that is large enough to accommodate a group of people. Muddy puddles formed in the large room where the depth of the tunnel apparently bumps against the water table.
121537:
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.
A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.
An ancient fungus smothers the boulders.

The ceiling in this tunnel consists of the floorboards and support beams for the building above. Tiny flecks of dust waft slowly down from between the boards on to the dirt floor. The walls are rough with marks from picks and shovels. The floor is exceptionally flat.
121545:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
An arcane spirit floats around, making strange magical gestures (glowing).

The roof of the tunnel is low enough to make stooping necessary for most individuals traversing the area. Some areas are narrow while others expand into larger round rooms. It seems most of the tunnel was formed naturally as the walls are mostly smooth rock and dirt. The tunnel ends abruptly with only some small unusual iron tools partially buried at the bottom of the final wall.
121546:
A shadowy haunt floats here, oblivious to your presence.
A spirit floats towards you and howls with an evil laughter.

A short tunnel leads to an unusually large room with impenetrable darkness. The gloom intrudes the senses with a heavy weight. It is hard to find the walls of the area as they are indistinguishable from the blackness of the air. A thick smell of damp decay makes breathing difficult.
121548:
A large stone fireplace with a roaring fire warms the room.
A peaceful farmer is here, whistling merrily.

This farmhouse is much larger than most of its kind, and is divided into several rooms. Open doorways lead west and east, while a door of pine that has been stained a pale golden colour stands in the south wall. The floor is made from heavy wooden boards, but much of it is covered in a thick woolen carpet. A fireplace has been set at an angle in the southeast corner.
121575:
A stove stands against one wall here.
A large cabinet capable of storing goods is here.
In the cabinet, there are a casserole, a sack of flour, a chunk of salt, and a bulb of garlic.
The farmer's wife is bustling busily around.
A young girl is smiling at life.
A peaceful farmer is here, whistling merrily.

This kitchen is a mess. A wide counter runs almost the full length of the east wall. It is covered in half-prepared food and dirty pots and pans. Shelves and cabinets line half of the south wall and much of the west. They bear a wide variety of items that can be incorporated into meals, but there seems to be no rhyme or reason to how things are arranged. Small windows in every wall but the west allow in a good amount of light and breeze.
121581:
A sturdy bed made from solid oak lies here, covered in warm blankets.
On the bed, there is a warm blanket.
A young girl is smiling at life.

This bedroom is much larger than those found in most farmhouses. A broad bed skilfully crafted from dark wood sits against the east wall. A narrow table stands opposite it, bearing a comb, razor, and a pair of brushes. A polished sheet of metal is attached to the wall above it to serve as a mirror. An angled wall of bricks fills the northeast corner, no doubt part of a fireplace and providing some heat to this room on chilly winter nights. A polished wooden door leads into the main room, while a narrow staircase leads upward.
121626:
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there is a die.

This room is small and unadorned, but very tidy. A door in the west wall leads outside, allowing the farmhands to come and go without disturbing the farmer and his family. An open doorway least east into the main house, while a narrow ladder extends through a hole in the ceiling. A small table and a couple of chairs are almost the only furnishings.
121703:
A plain pair of pants are on the ground.
A chequered shirt lies here.

This tight room is squeezed between a plain wooden floor and the sloping sides of the peaked roof overhead. A single window in the western wall stands open, but stout shutters on either side stand ready to close off the room from the weather. Two narrow cots fill most of the available area. A ladder leads down through a hole in the floor to the room below.
121719:
A small box has been left here.
A young girl is smiling at life.

This room is large, but its ceiling is low and sloped, coming to within two feet of the floor at the east and west walls. Two large windows stand open in the south wall, allowing in plenty of fresh air, as well as ample light during the day. Two small but comfortable-looking beds are set up near the north wall, with a small box of toys set between them.
121735:
A reddish-brown shrub with purplish-pink flowers grows here.
Inside the shrub, there are two clusters of purplish-pink flowers.
A long-necked bird, with a fairly short spear-like bill stands here.
A large elk is standing here, chewing grass and leaves.

The hills drop off sharply to the west and south, giving an expansive view of the wide valley between the Downs. The ridge continues to the north and east, giving an elevated path through the terrain. A few rocks dot the hills, giving it a pockmarked look among the otherwise green landscape.
121751:
A large bat is here, hanging in the darkness.
A large bat is here, hanging in the darkness.

Thickets of thorns and brambles tangle themselves into a living labyrinth in this underground cavern. The walls and floor are covered in a chaotic tapestry of rotting leaves and various mosses. The decay adds a sickly sweetness to the air, punctuated by the acrid tang of fungi. The leaves underfoot are damp and spongy, muffling any sound of passage. The underground choked underbrush extends to the south.
121767:
A huge bat is here, emitting piercing squeaks.
A huge bat is here, emitting piercing squeaks.
A large bat is here, hanging in the darkness.

In the tunnel, the constant rustling sounds echo from deep within the wall foliage, their sources concealed by the enveloping darkness. Luminous patches of bioluminescent fungus speckle the ground, casting an eerie, ghostly glow upon their surroundings. Small sinkholes, long since abandoned by the burrowing creatures who created them, lurk beneath the surface, waiting to swallow the foot of the unwary. There are openings in the bushes towards the north and the south.
121769:
A huge, venomous spider is here.
A huge, venomous spider is here.
A huge, venomous tarantula extends her legs to you.

The walls and ceiling of the tunnel are composed of pitch-black soil. Puddles of stagnant water lie pooled upon the muddy floor which provides sustenance to the malicious poison ivy that creeps and twines its way through the underbrush, its sinister tendrils reaching out. As the cavern continues northward, the way becomes choked with loose rocks and forest debris, remnants of the ancient forest that once stood here.
121787:
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.
A swarm of hornets is coming out of its nest.

Walls of dried, papery wood pulp and mud surround a large central chamber. They are covered with millions of hexagon shaped cells where eggs are lain. It is difficult to find solid footing on the sloped, spongy floor. There is a loud buzzing coming from all directions. In one corner, the pulp and mud seems to form a faint outline of a body.
121803:
A brown bear is sleeping here.
A brown bear is sleeping here.

The curving walls of this cave resemble a large egg. The air is damp although no water source can be seen. Some water droplets slowly drip down exposed rocks in the sides of the cave. Old bones with teeth and claw marks blend with the decaying corpses of small animals.
121819:
A huge black fungus is here, exuding a foul stench.
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.

The northwestern corner of the huge cavern ends with a narrow crevice, almost hidden behind a large round boulder standing neatly on the floor. To the southeast, large stalagmites jut out from the uneven cavern floor, concealing the rest of the cavern.
121835: A particularly large pillar of stone stands here, seemingly holding up the whole cavern, surrounded by smaller stalagmites and stalactites on either side. Tiny streams of water make their way around the rock formations, forming small puddles on the ground.
121837: Nestled between a pair of huge stalagmites, a shallow puddle of clear water covers the floor here, fed by a number of tiny streams of water dripping down along the walls and rock formations. The cavern ceiling is too high to be seen, with only a few sharp ends of stalactites hinting at its position.
121841: A thick, broken stalagmite rises up from the floor.

The end of a large stalagmite seems to have been completely severed from its trunk, lying sideways within a shallow puddle on the ground. The cavern seems to lead into a narrower section to the southwest and the ground hints at a slight upward slope in that direction.
121849: Rock formations of various sizes fill this part of the cavern, with huge stalagmites being especially dominant like some sort of an underground rocky forest of sorts. A quite smooth walkway seems to be worn into the ground, leading towards the northwestern corner of the cavern. A narrow tunnel branches off from the cavern to the south.
121866: A huge set of stone stairs has been carved into the soft limestone in the southern end of the cavern, leading down toward an opening in the cavern's floor. To the north, the cavern grows a lot wider and higher, with huge stalagmites and stalactites forming a semblance of an enormous maw.
121909: A somewhat even pathway meanders between huge stalagmites extending out from the otherwise uneven ground here. The cavern ceiling is quite high above, with only the pointy ends of some huge stalactites peering out from the darkness.
121961: A patch of moss grows here on a wet, flat stone.

The cavern walls are quite smooth and damp, with tiny streams of water running along the ground, leaving behind deep crevices and grooves. To the north, the ground seems to slope upward slightly until ending abruptly at a large stone slab blocking further passage. A wide crack to the south opens up into a narrow canyon.
121977: At the Entrance of a Cave

The walls of the canyon are pretty close to each other now, with only about six feet separating the two. To the north, the walls meet completely at a narrow crevice, leading into a dark limestone cavern. To the south, there seems to be a small camping spot below an outcropping in the eastern wall.
121979: At the Bottom of the Canyon

A worn sleeping bag is here.
A beer bottle has been left here.
A ruffian is sneaking around here, looking for some mischief to do.
A ruffian is sneaking around here, looking for some mischief to do.

A few worn wooden blocks are placed around the remains of a campfire next to the eastern wall of the canyon, right below a small outcropping that provides some cover from above. A few weather-worn sleeping bags are placed next to the campfire. To the north, the canyon seems to grow a bit narrower.
121983: A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.

The flat floor of the canyon is riddled with puddles of water. The walls are steep and quite smooth, with tiny streams of water dripping down along cracks and crevices in the surface. A huge pile of worn ropes sits in a mess along the western wall, next to a harness and some empty crates.
122007: A swarthy, little bandit advances forward.

The worn and uneven walls of the tunnel are moist, with liquid dripping along the wall and collecting into small puddles on the ground. The tunnel opens up to the north, revealing a large canyon with steep limestone walls to either side. To the south, the tunnel grows darker and narrower.
122009: The low tunnel turns a sharp corner to the east and ends abruptly at a wooden construction of sorts. To the north, the tunnel's ceiling grows higher and higher, opening up into the wide canyon. The ground here is damp, with shallow puddles of water lining the walls.
122013: Wooden boards and beams of various sizes have been nailed together to form a surprisingly sturdy-looking wall, only a single crude door in the middle of it blocking passage south. The bottom of the barricade looks half-rotten, as a shallow puddle of water seems to have collected here from the dampness of the surrounding caves.
122037:
A simple wooden chest is here.
A small barrel made of aged oak and strong iron hoops stands here.
A small barrel stands on the ground.

A dilapidated wooden staircase leads from the large trapdoor in the ceiling to the uneven floor of the cellar. Piles of crates and large barrels line the walls here. A somewhat fresh-looking trail of dirt leads from the staircase to the northern wall.
122053:
A large, sturdy table made from oak is sitting here.
On the table, there are a piece of cheese, a map of Bree, and a map of Tharbad.

A roughly rectangular room is built at the end of the tunnel here, worn boards mounted between a line of support beams that probably keep the whole tunnel from collapsing. A large table sits in the middle of the room, covered in a pile of old maps, mostly depicting the surrounding area. More maps and documents cover the walls. In the corner, a large trapdoor is built into the floor.
122069: A wiry smuggler is here, attempting to avoid being seen.

The passage south is blocked by a sturdy-looking wooden wall, with a large reinforced door in the middle. Wooden supports line the walls to the east and south, along with a wooden walkway leading into the dark tunnel to the north.
122071: A few wooden support beams are propped up to hold the northeastern corner of the cave from collapsing. A rough wooden walkway provides a somewhat more stable surface to walk on, leading south along the main tunnel. To the west, a dimly lit cave can be seen in the distance.
122075: An intersection of tunnels sits on a slight slope, with larger passages leading up to the northern caves, another larger passage branching off to the east and an even narrower tunnel leading south and turning sharply to the west. A barely burning torch is mounted into a wall sconce on the western cavern wall, providing dim light.
122083: An experienced husky smuggler is here, plotting his illicit ventures.

A wooden walkway connects the northern and southern tunnels, with another side passage branching off to the east. Various smaller cracks and crevices lead to even narrower crevices, all snaking back into the main tunnels, creating quite a maze.
122147: After a few twists and turns, the tunnel ends at a cave-in, blocking further passage to the east. A few broken crates and the remains of a smashed barrel lie in a pile in the middle of the cave. Beyond a wide crack in the cave wall to the south, a narrow side tunnel leads farther into the rock.
122163: The walls and ceiling of the tunnel are rough and uneven, with cracks of various sizes running through them at odd angles. The tunnel ends abruptly to the north with a sharp upward turn. A wooden ladder is mounted to the wall, providing access to the opening. To the south, the tunnel leads farther into the rock.
122179: The tunnel comes to an abrupt end here, with dark walls closing in from all directions save the north. The faint footpath visible in the dirt floor ends abruptly toward the back of the tunnel, next to some smooth rock. Very little dust covers that area of the tunnel.
122191:
A grey wolf is here, thin from starvation.
A grey wolf is here, thin from starvation.
A fierce boar is here, making grunting noises.
A boar cub is playing here, and exploring the wide world.

This narrow tunnel angles downward to the south. A barely noticeable footpath has been beaten down into the tunnel floor. A few spots of earth are scorched, perhaps from fires or a hot lantern. To the west, the tunnel opens up into a wide field.
122277: A ruffian is sneaking around here, looking for some mischief to do.

This tunnel appears man-made with walls having clear marks from picks and shovels. The floor is plain dirt, and the ceiling is supported by beams and rafters. Some larger stones, apparently left over from the excavation, have been pushed against the walls. A ladder leads up to a trap door in the ceiling.
122293: This large, carved-out chamber could comfortably house several people. Several cots are arranged around a central fire, and cooking equipment is scattered nearby. The air is thick with smoke and filth, and a pile of trash and debris has been heaped against the south wall. Torches hang from the walls.
122295:
There are three canoes here.
There are two torches here.
A scuffed and worn leather satchel has been left here.
A beer barrel has been left here.
A pan is here, ready for use.
A butcher knife is lying here.

This small room appears to be the storage room for smoked meats, berries and several barrels of beer. Some cooking utensils and spare equipment lie in the dirt. The walls have the familiar cuts from human workmanship. The ceiling supports here look the least stable in the tunnels.
122307: A ruffian is sneaking around here, looking for some mischief to do.

The ceiling is taller than the tunnel is wide. Some rough beams and stones help support the ceiling and walls but their placement appears reactionary rather than as sophisticated architecture. To the south is a messy living area. The tunnel slopes down towards the north where some dark water covers the floor.
122331: The tunnel is completely filled with water. The tunnel walls visible above the water are smooth for a couple inches and then show shovel and pick marks from manual excavation. The water is very clear, revealing dark green algae growing under the surface.
122347: The tunnel bends in a smooth arc to the west and north here. The jagged ceiling is quite low in some areas leaving less than a yard between the water and the rocks above. Algae softens the surfaces beneath the surface of the water in some places.
122363: A black catfish is here, lurking in the mud.

The tunnel widens here compared to the narrower sections to the north and south. The widest part is around seven yards from wall to wall. Under the clear water the bottom of the tunnel is covered in a soft, powdery mud. When disturbed, the dirt particles slowly drift back down to rest on the tunnel floor.
122379: The water-filled tunnel continues to the north and south. The tunnel wall opens to the west into what appears to be a room large enough to stand up in. The wall to the east may have once also led to another room but is now boarded up with old-looking wood.
122395:
A black candle burns in a silver stand, giving off little light.
A pewter candlestick is standing here.
An intact skeleton of a man is walking around here.

This chamber appears to have been a temple. A large arrangement of candles crowd on the floor around a tall altar. Piles of melted wax shroud whatever implements hold the unlit candlesticks upright on the floor. The altar is jet black stone and is covered in elaborate and delicate runes. A thick, putrid smell hangs in the air.
122411: An ancient spirit, dressed in the arms of a soldier, challenges you.

The tunnel is narrow and winding. It weaves back and forth as if avoiding obstacles hidden behind the earthen walls. Empty torch holders are attached to the walls at regular intervals. The tunnel leads to an open room to the north and an ordinary metal door at the south west end.
122427: A skeletal warrior is staring angrily at the surroundings.

The large cavern is mostly empty save for some broken wooden crates and other debris. Some of the items may have been clothing or eating equipment but has degraded beyond identification. Several small tunnel openings line the walls but only one to the west could potentially be entered.
122443:
A water moccasin slithers out of sight just below the surface of the water.
A water moccasin slithers out of sight just below the surface of the water.
A water moccasin slithers out of sight just below the surface of the water.

The tunnel ends here in a larger section of open space. The ceiling is higher than in other parts of the watery tube although it appears entirely natural without markings from digging equipment. There is a small hole in the eastern wall on level with the surface of the water which extends into darkness.
122636: A magpie is flying around looking for some food.

The rocky hillside slopes towards the southeast, its uneven terrain covered with thick vegetation. Tall grass and a thick bushes bushes form a canopy over the rocks and boulders that litter the landscape. The hillside looks to be slightly more even to the west, running below a tree-covered ledge.
122639:
A brown bear is sleeping here.
A brown bear is sleeping here.

Short, narrow walls, and a drooping, root-covered ceiling make this dirt-carved cave extremely cramped. The confined space also accentuates the pungent smell of damp fur, making the musty odour the most prominent feature of this dirty abode.
122683: Soft earth comprises the walls and floor of this hole, which is apparently home to wild animals. Tufts of fur and a few small bones are scattered here and there, but the den has an almost wholesome feeling about it, with no sign of droppings or rotting matter to be found.
122699:
Some small rocks have been piled into a mound here.
A brown fox is here, looking for some rabbits to chew up.

This grass-covered, narrow ridge rises up above the round hills that lie far below to the west. Beyond the hills, a stretch of thick brushland covers most of the ground to the southwest. The ground here slopes downward to the southeast towards the Greenway that makes its way through a pass there.
122715:
A clean fragrance drifts up from a thick clump of leaves.
A clear spring babbles as cool water trickles out of the ground.
A robin is here, carrying small pieces of wood to its nest.

This place appears to be a dell or hollow and, emerging from the northern slope, where it was taking an underground route, a small stream of water makes a few small pools as it flows gently east. As it reaches the eastern slope, it forms a larger pool, but it is not clear where, if anywhere, the water goes next. Growing on the eastern slope, blackthorn, with its dense spiny branches, has formed a hedge-like barrier. There are many bushes in all directions and particularly dense undergrowth to the north.
122716: A furtive footpad is here waiting for his prey.

An odd tunnel has been formed here underground, and it continues off to the west. The walls and ceiling are lined with roots, and the ground is bare and dusty. Peculiar noises emanate from the west, echoing quietly throughout the tunnel. The roots lining the ceiling above appear to block passage in that direction.
122718: Western End of a Root-lined Tunnel

A narrow, cramped tunnel has been formed underground here, spanning off to the east. The walls and ceiling are covered in roots, but the floor is bare dirt. The roots above can be moved easily to expose an accessway to a brush-filled valley above.
122719: Some thick writhing vines whip all around you.

Steep, rocky walls rise up in the west, south, and east, covered in hanging vines and roots. The terrain opens to the north, where the vegetation becomes thicker. A carpet of thick roots on the ground blocks a passageway below. A strong gust of wind blows into the valley from the north.
122720: The valley walls bend southward and westward. Dense, thorny brush grows high overhead with thorny vines hanging down. Vines and roots creep down the rocky walls of the valley. The ground is dry and cracked, and strong wind gusts blow in from the west.
122721: The brush-filled valley branches and splits off to the north, west, and east. Dense, thorny brush grows abundantly all about. The valley walls are rocky and steep, with roots protruding through the rocks here and there. The ground is bare dirt and covered in roots. A blustery wind blows in from the west.
122722: Prickly, white-stemmed plants, with blue flower heads grow in abundance.

The valley continues to the north, south, and west, with a tall, rocky, earthen wall to the east. Blue thistle flowers grow all throughout the dense vegetation here, which is covered in sharp thorns and spines that hang down. The ground here is cracked, dry and bare.
122723:
Prickly, white-stemmed plants, with blue flower heads grow in abundance.
A black snake, with red markings, is lying here.

The brush here is thick and dense, and travel is daunting and perilous. Adding to the difficulty of travel, roots cover the ground, waiting to ensnare unaware travellers. Creeping thistle weeds, with bright blue heads, grow all around in sporadic patches.
122724:
A monstrous, creeping thistle shifts about on thick vines.
A snake slithers towards you.

The valley branches off to the west, east, and south. The vegetation here is dry and dense, filled with thorns and spines. The earthen valley walls are dry and covered in dirt and crumbling rock, with the occasional roots sticking out. A strong gust of wind blows in from west to east.
122725: Prickly, white-stemmed plants, with blue flower heads grow in abundance.

The valley dead-ends to the south, but opens to the north. Dense, dry vegetation fills the landscape all around. The ground underfoot is bare dirt. Clumps of dirt and rock tumble down the valley walls, and blue thistle flowers grow all over the valley floor.
122726: A black snake, with red markings, is lying here.

The valley dead-ends here, but opens to the east. Patches of grass form here, breaking up the otherwise dull landscape. Dry vegetation is seen all about, and clumps of dirt tumble down the valley walls to the ground below. Thick roots cover the ground, even where grass is growing.
122727:
A snarl of creeping vines is here, thorny and tangled.
A snarl of creeping vines is here, covered in thick bark.

The valley dead-ends to the west, north, and south, but opens up to the east. Dense, dry vegetation, covered in thorns, fills the landscape and hinders travel. The ground is dry and cracked, and the walls of the valley are earthen and covered in rocks, which occasionally tumble down to the valley floor.
122728:
Prickly, white-stemmed plants, with blue flower heads grow in abundance.
A snake slithers towards you.

The thickness of the brush obscures the view in most directions. The earthen wall to the north, west, and south only becomes noticeable when in immediate proximity. The valley opens to the east, where the brush, while still thick, thins slightly. All about, blue thistle flowers grow in abundance.
122729: A snarl of creeping vines is here, grasping around.

The brushy valley comes to a dead-end in every direction except to the west, where it opens up into a dense, brushy landscape. The vegetation here is thin and grass grows on the ground in patches. Vines and roots hang down from the earthen valley walls, and a tree grows horizontally, high above from the wall to the east.
122730:
Vibes, wielding an ornamented sabre, is standing here (shrouded).
Tjemara the Elf, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here (shrouded).
Baelish the Dwarf, wielding a burnished hewing-spear, is standing here (glowing).

The brown water of this pool swirls in a muddy torrent of dangerous energy. The walls and ceiling covered in a thick layer of dark, wet earth, dotted with pockets that seem to connect below the surface. The pool continues to the north, while the walls close in from every other direction.
122731:
A massive, deformed leech floats on the surface of the water.
A large leech is moving close to you, searching for blood.
A large leech is moving close to you, searching for blood.
A large leech is moving close to you, searching for blood.
A large leech is moving close to you, searching for blood.
A large leech is moving close to you, searching for blood.
A large leech is moving close to you, searching for blood.

Water swirls around this cavern in a powerful current of darkness. The walls are thick with mud. Deep, black holes spot the muddy walls in a speckled pattern. The holes seem to connect, perhaps as a home for some gigantic, burrowing creature. The brown water of the pool is entirely opaque, hiding what lies beneath the surface.
122732:
A humongous pile of polished bones covers the cavern floor.
Baelish the Dwarf, wielding a black metal staff, is standing here (glowing).
Vibes, wielding an ornamented sabre, is standing here.
Tjemara the Elf, wielding an engraved broadsword, is standing here.

Polished white bones cover every inch of this chamber. Each bone gleams, having been sucked clean of every vestige of flesh and muscle. To the east, a dark pool splashes against the shore, washing the bones with every shift of current.
122733: Even a halfling would have to crawl to make use of this tunnel. The earthen roof hangs low, giving only a few feet of clearance. To the west, the tunnel ends in a wall of masonry, while to the east it enters a chamber of some sort.
122734:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
An arcane spirit floats around, making strange magical gestures (glowing).
A spirit floats towards you and howls with an evil laughter.
A spirit floats towards you and howls with an evil laughter.

This small hemispherical chamber is literally packed with the skeletal remains of humans. From the sizes, it appears most of them belonged to women and children. The roof of the chamber is hardened earth, and upon closer inspection, it appears that whoever these people were, they were desperately trying to dig their way out. One skeleton lies alone in a corner, propped in a sitting position.
122735: A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.

This chamber is lined with blocks of grey stone and appears to have been hastily built, judging from the great cracks that have formed between adjacent blocks. Scattered about the floor are the remains of several human skeletons along with bits of armour and weapons. None of the refuse appears to be of use. Perhaps this place was looted some time in the distant past.
122736: A tiny spider is here, eating a tiny bug.

This room is about six feet tall, and is recessed into the earth. The upper half of this structure is built of logs and mortar. The walls of the lower half are made of stones pressed into the earth. The floor is flat, dry, compact dirt. A stone slab rises a foot high in the centre of the room. Scattered about are bones and shards of clay pottery. A portion of the southern wall has collapsed, exposing a passage.
122752:
A dark werewolf paces the floor and growls deeply.
A sturdy pack horse is standing here.

Unlike the barrow to the north, this earthy hollow was not made by man. Roots have forced their way through the smooth dirt ceiling and walls in several places, providing many places for spiders to build their webs and small animals to burrow and hide.
122914:
A small barrel made of aged oak and strong iron hoops stands here.
There are two stout barrels here.
A solid ironbound chest is here.
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.

A small square-shaped room is dug into the rock here, hidden behind the reinforced wall to the north. Various wooden crates, musty sacks and barrels are stacked against the walls. A flickering torch sits in a wall sconce, providing dim light.
122930:
Several shards of broken glass lie scattered about the ground.
A large stone chest is here.

A short tunnel from the west opens to a narrow chamber that was dug within the surrounding hill ages ago. Flat, grey stones hold the earth at bay. Water has seeped in creating trails of mud running down the walls in several places. A flattened mound of smooth rocks, roughly six feet long and three feet wide, marks what was meant to be the final resting place of an ancient noble. It now sits empty.
122946: A black snake hurries towards you with sly intentions.

The tunnel's walls are composed of dark, jagged layers of slate, fractured and sharp in places. Thin sheets have peeled away over time, leaving shards scattered across the uneven floor. A faint metallic scent lingers in the cool, still air, mingled with the sound of occasional drips echoing softly.
122962:
A small mushroom grows nearby.
A black snake hurries towards you with sly intentions.

The tunnel widens into a rough chamber where large slabs of slate have fallen from the ceiling, forming jagged piles. The walls are irregular, their layers tilting at odd angles, revealing the forces that shaped them long ago. Moisture clings to the stone, highlighting the deep grey and bluish tones of the rock.
122978: The tunnel bends in a wide arc, its walls flowing smoothly as though shaped by a river's patient hand. Shallow grooves mark the sandstone, their patterns mirroring the curve. Sand drifts collect at the base of the walls, disturbed only by faint draughts.
122994: A huge, venomous spider is here.

The passage grows tight as it twists sharply, its walls pressing closer together with jagged edges from uneven erosion. No natural light nor vegetation are present here, and the atmosphere is stale and dark. A faint trickling sound echoes, hinting at unseen water deeper within.
123010: An ancient fungus smothers the boulders.

The tunnel twists into a gentle curve before opening into a natural junction where three passages meet. The sandstone walls at the intersection are smooth, with faint striations radiating outward as if shaped by converging streams. Fine sand and small stones have accumulated at the base of the junction, creating subtle ridges that hint at the path water once took through the branching tunnels.
123012:
The remains of a giant green fungus lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
The remains of a giant green fungus lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
The corpse of a giant slug is lying here.

The winding path descends slightly, its curves soft and gradual as the floor dips. Moisture clings to the sandstone walls, darkening their hue and creating a cool, damp atmosphere. Loose rocks gather in shallow pockets, swept into place by centuries of shifting water.
123024:
The remains of a black fungus lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
The remains of a black fungus lie here in a heap of rotting compost.
An ancient fungus smothers the boulders.

A slight widening in the tunnel at a curve reveals a shallow alcove, its walls rougher and darker than the main passage. Fine debris has collected here, as though caught by the winding flow of air. The space feels quieter, a brief reprieve from the outside world.
123043: A solitary hermit is sitting here, meditating with a serene expression.

The floor of the cave is a solid, mostly flat piece of rock. It is clean without any evidence of dirt or leaves left to clutter the room. While it appears this cave would be an ideal home for critters seeking a hidden home, there is no indication that animals frequent the spot.
123118:
A wooden chest stands in the corner.
A small rat runs about, oblivious to your presence.

The chamber is quite cramped and appears carved out over a large stone as the cool rock makes up the floor of this space. The dirt is dry and dusty, collecting in soft piles as it is brushed from the walls. The roof of the tunnel has a slight arch.
123119:
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.
A giant, strange looking green fungus is here, ready to devour you in seconds.

The woods seem tired and extremely dreary in this dark place. The trunks emanate a lacklustre energy that inspires nothing and drains anything living. Although sleep is most unwise here, the heavy haze of dreariness causes the forest's fatigue to become highly contagious.
123120:
A skeleton of some humanoid lies in the dust.
A moderately-sized copperhead snake is here.
A diamondback rattlesnake is coiled here, ready to strike.
A moderately-sized copperhead snake is here.

A hole in the undergrowth has been carved out here, creating a well-hidden escape from the malicious trees and poisonous spines. Strewn about are the bones and bone fragments of various creatures, possibly the prey of something that lives here. To the north, the backside of the hole is blocked by a large black boulder jutting up from the earth. Some carvings can be seen along its edge.
123121: The forest of Mirkwood climbs up into the hills here. A few spots of bare, black rock peak through the hillside amidst the dense foliage. Elsewhere, the dense undergrowth of Mirkwood is as thick as ever. To the west, the hills drop sharply down into the forest.
123122: There is some snow on the ground.

The path ends here. You can't spot any safe passages up into the mountains from here. Suddenly, you hear the sound of some falling rocks above you. Fortunately, they stop before they reach the place you are standing. You had better leave this place soon; you realise that a lot of huge boulders above you might fall down any time. Rocks surrounding you and the steep mountainsides prevent you from choosing any other safe way from this place except the one you came.
123123:
There is some snow on the ground.
A large pile of boulders is sitting here, probably debris from a rockslide.

This narrow trail is well-hidden. It deliberately takes advantage of the rocky terrain to remain almost invisible from the trail to the west. It rises at a sharp angle, and the footing at times is treacherous. It seems to level out a bit some distance to the east.
123124: The Great River flows here from the east and then changes direction, continuing on its southern path through the great plains. The northern bank is quite bare, with the brown mud giving the water rushing along the bank a darker colour.
123125: You are walking through a range of low, sloping hills. Sparse trees cover the land. Wild flowers are in bloom. To the south and east, the forest gets much thicker. A road lies to the north of you.
123126:
A malicious thug is here, threatening you.
A dirty bandit waits here looking for an easy mark.
A dirty bandit waits here looking for an easy mark.

The chamber is littered with tattered bedrolls, broken cookware, and crude wooden tables. Narrow bunks of spartan design line two walls, their mattresses filled with straw and covered in tattered blankets. A long table runs between them, with sturdy wooden benches to either side, worn smooth from countless occupants. Simple cabinets stand against the far wall. To the south, a door with rusty hinges leads to a storage room. The wooden wall to the east bears the marks of age, with cracks and fissures running through its rough surface.
123127:
A large bat is here, hanging in the darkness.
A large bat is here, hanging in the darkness.

The tunnel follows a gentle curve westward, but comes to an abrupt end in other directions. Its walls are smooth and uniform, suggesting the patient work of ancient water. The ceiling remains steady in height, while faint grooves in the sandstone trace the path of slow erosion. Loose sand collects at the base, hinting at subtle shifts in airflow.

The tunnel broadens slightly, its straight course interrupted only by a shallow, natural depression in the floor. The sandstone walls are dotted with small hollows, formed by uneven erosion over centuries. The air feels calm, with the faintest whisper of a breeze moving steadily through the open span.

The straight passage splits abruptly into a T-shaped junction, the three tunnels disappearing into shadow to the north, east, and west. The walls at the intersection are slightly curved, as if worn by centuries of water flow. Scattered stones lie in small piles, remnants of minor collapses over time.
123130:
A pool of darkish water has formed in a depression of the stone.
A long slender eel glides along the water, its body coiled to strike.

This segment of the tunnel feels narrower, the ceiling dipping slightly lower as it passes through a dense layer of sandstone. The moist walls reveal faint traces of mineral deposits, pale streaks standing out against the golden rock. Steady trickles of water run down, forming large pools on the ground.
123131:
A pool of darkish water has formed in a depression of the stone.
Something cold and scaly slithers past your leg.

The floor dips gently downward toward the north, the incline barely noticeable but steady. The walls grow darker and damper as the descent continues, with streaks of moisture reflecting faint glimmers of light. Water pools at the floor, flowing in from the higher ground to the south.
123132:
A large bat is here, hanging in the darkness.
A fierce bat is here, lusting for your blood.

A tunnel stretches to the east, its walls naturally smooth from ancient erosion. Faint striations in the sandstone form subtle patterns, interrupted only by occasional cracks. Fine grains of sand coat the flat floor, carried in by draughts that sweep through unseen crevices.
123133:
A small oaken table has been set here.
On the table, there are a large wooden full shield, two lanterns, two dark coloured flasks, and a water skin.
A grim smuggler blends into his surroundings.
A grim smuggler blends into his surroundings.

The vast chamber is filled with the remnants of plunders. Cobwebs drape over countless crates. Elaborate sconces, now devoid of flame, line the walls. In the centre of the cavern, an enormous stalactite hangs like a frozen teardrop, its surface glistening with moisture. Water drips incessantly from the ceiling, pooling in the crevices and nourishing a carpet of luminescent fungi. To the west, a small exit leads to the living quarters.
123134:
A sturdy crate made of nailed wooden planks sits on the floor.
A wiry smuggler is here, attempting to avoid being seen.

On the rough walls of this warehouse, an array of cupboards and wooden shelves stand. The air is thick with the scent of damp soil and lingering traces of pipe smoke. Cobwebs drape the ceiling, revealing the passage of time and the lack of housekeeping. The floor is uneven and strewn with a curious mix of hay and sawdust. To the north, a hinged door leads to living quarters.
